paragraphs: After they waited for some time, Yuan Tianling landed in front of them and opened her eyes. Tian Yan immediately emerged from her body, stood in front of Yan Huo, and looked at him with a complicated gaze. "Old Yan."

"Haha." Yan Huo laughed and patted Tian Yan’s head with his transparent hand. "Little Yan, you’re quite old now, and you’ve found your master. Moreover, she has such a strong husband, and there are many others by their side, so I’m sure you won’t feel lonely. I died because of the Sky Flame, but it was my fault, not yours. You should stop blaming yourself, and you should look forward to a new future together with them."
"Old Yan." Tian Yan called out softly as he tried to hug Yan Huo, but he actually passed through his body.

"Back then, Tian Kongquan and I discovered the Sky Flame by chance, and everything happened quickly. Although I died at the time, we managed to bring you to this realm, and we named you Tian Yan based on our surnames. Even though we’re dead now, our hope will live on with you." Yan Huo sighed softly after saying that and turned to face Tian Yan. "Little Yan, it’s time for me to go, and I will leave with peace of mind. Moreover, my old friend already said that we will meet again in the future, and I have always believed in his abilities because he paid for it with his lifespan; thus, you don’t need to be sad, especially since we will meet someday. For now, you will stay with them, and you must help your master to become stronger. Do you understand?"
"I understand, Old Yan." Tian Yan replied in a sorrowful tone.
"Tian Yuanling, please take care of him for me."
Yuan Tianling wiped her tears and answered him. "Elder Yan, I promise you I will always look after Tian Yan."

"Yeah." Yan Huo patted Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "I won’t say anything about the matter between you and the Tian Clan, especially since my old friend has already spoken to you personally. I hope you can end things amicably, and I hope to witness you standing at the top of the cultivation world someday in the future."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at him. "I don’t know when we’ll meet again, but you’ll definitely hear my name from all corners of the cultivation world in the future."
"Hahaha." Yan Huo laughed heartily at that, and his body quickly disappeared from their sight. "Take good care of yourselves, and let’s meet again in the future."

Tian Yan fell to his knees after Yan Huo disappeared, but he could not shed a single tear even though his feelings were filled with deep sadness and sorrow. Huo Diqiu embraced him from behind, struggling to find words to console his grieving brother.
Yan Huo’s departure was not only felt by them, but people who knew him, such as Tian Jingxuan, could also feel his departure.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] walked beside them and patted Tian Yan’s head. "It’s okay to be sad, but I hope you don’t wallow in sadness. The past cannot be changed, and the future is still long ahead. He has promised that you two will meet again in the future, so you have to believe in his promise."
"Yeah, you’re right." Tian Yan immediately stood up. "I can’t continue to be sad, and I believe in Old Yan’s promise to meet again in the future."
"That’s good." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then opened the gate to the Sky Jade Realm. "Yuanling, we should go to that realm, and we will hold our wedding there."
"Huh?" Yuan Tianling blinked her eyes repeatedly as she was shocked by that. "Are we really getting married today? Why didn’t you ever discuss this with me before?"

"You slept here for so long, remember?" Yuan Tianling stuck out her tongue toward Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "While you were sleeping, I discussed the matter with your parents, and they agreed with my plan. Not only the two of us will be getting married today, but all my clones and I will also be marrying all our women."

"Hahaha!" Yuan Tianling laughed bitterly at that. "What can I expect from a man with many clones and partners like you? Even though I want to get married in a glamorous way, I know it will only waste time and resources, so be it. Please return, Tian Yan."
"Yes, Master." After Tian Yan entered her body again, Yuan Tianling immediately entered the gate, followed by Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Huo Diqiu.

Since Zhang Fei’s women were too numerous, Shen Xueyi and Liu Qingyu deliberately held their wedding at the Yin-Yang Pavilion. The Shen Clan members closed off all areas of the sect and forbade disciples from approaching their main area, especially since so many powerful cultivators were present, even if they were only close relatives.

As soon as they arrived, Ren Ziwei and several women immediately helped Yuan Tianling dress up. Unlike usual weddings, they didn’t wait for the auspicious time or anything else, and they also didn’t wear actual wedding dresses; instead, they simply wore their best clothes and minimal makeup.

Even so, the entire Yin-Yang Pavilion was still decorated with various wedding decorations, and many tables were neatly arranged there, with Zhu Yan leading many people in preparing the dishes for their wedding banquet. The sound of singing and playing musical instruments also continued to be heard from the main area, leaving the disciples of the sect wondering for themselves.
Once everyone was ready, Zhang Chen, Qing Yi, and all the family members of Zhang Fei’s women sat side by side on the chairs arranged in front.

They didn’t get married at the same time, but their wedding ceremony began with Zhang Fei and his main harem members, who had never been married to him. Despite their large number, their ceremony didn’t last for too long, and the members of his main harem grew even larger after their wedding ceremony was over.

After that, the event continued with Zhang Fei [1], who married all of his partners, such as Yan Lu’er and the others. Once they finished, the event continued with Zhang Xiaolong [3] and his partners, but Feltia [2]’s partners joined them, especially since he was on his way to the Paradise Realm.

Zhang Fei [4] also married Ilsath, Orith, and Zilvora, even though the three women did not actually want him. Among Zhang Fei’s five clones, his fifth only had one partner, Yan Jinwu, the golden crow.
Yan Jinwu was the only female mythical beast who did not become part of his main harem, especially since she preferred to be Zhang Fei [5]’s partner.
After everything was finished, they immediately enjoyed the dishes that had been prepared on the table, and they gathered together until nightfall.

Afterward, Zhang Fei sent them all back to the training space except for Zhang Xiaolong [3], who returned to the Life Pond in the Sovereign Heaven Realm. All of his acquaintances chose to rest in their respective rooms to prepare themselves before starting their training tomorrow, except for Tang Ying, who immediately continued her training using the gravity feature, especially since she was lagging far behind her junior brother and the others.

Zhang Fei didn’t return there immediately; instead, he went to the Shandian Realm to meet Feng Xishui, who had been staying there for quite some time. He asked the male phoenix to visit the other planet in the upper realms, but he didn’t let him go alone, and he asked several people from the demon fox group to accompany him.

Since all of Zhang Fei’s clones were already used to cultivating with their respective partners, their first night had no significant meaning for them. They immediately began their usual activities, but all of his clones were more focused on helping their partners.
Unlike his clones, Zhang Fei’s marriages with some of his women were significant for many of them, especially since they were still virgins.
The women who had frequently cultivated with Zhang Fei did not join them in the main bedroom, allowing all his new wives to enjoy their first night with their husband.
"So, who do you want to do it first?" Yuan Tianling asked.

"No one." Zhang Fei’s answer confused all of them. "We will spend our first night after my second clone arrives in the Paradise Realm, and you must also transform the Divine Qi in your body into the Celestial Qi first, especially since the difference between the two is significant."
"How much will it improve, husband?" Xian Changyue asked.
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei rubbed his chin. "Simply put, if the Divine Qi is one, then the Celestial Qi is one hundred."
"What?" All of them exclaimed in shock. "Is the difference really that high?"

"All my prisoners have converted their Divine Qi into Celestial Qi, and the amount of their Yin Qi has increased by that much." All of them were completely shocked after hearing all of this from Zhang Fei. "You guys should have known long ago that I’ve never considered any of you as tools, and I truly love you all from the bottom of my heart. However, I feel it would be a shame if we had our wedding night today, especially since your virgin Yin Qi would be wasted. Additionally, my second clone will arrive there in about a month and a half, so I hope you guys are willing to patiently wait for that day, and I will satisfy you all at that time."

"I have no problem with that, and I’ll work on my body cultivation technique while waiting for the day to come. This way, my physique will be stronger, and I won’t get tired so quickly on our first night." Wang Yourou decided immediately. "What about you all, sisters?"

Murong Mengying nodded in agreement with her. "I am also not in a rush for our wedding night, so I will wait. Moreover, our cultivation will also increase faster if he’s stronger than he is now, and our virgin yin qi will be of great help to him in that regard."

Shang Xinyu, Shang Yaolin, Shang Yumei, and the other virgin women also agreed with Zhang Fei’s decision. A month and a half wasn’t a long time for cultivators like them, and it would pass so quickly without them realizing it.

"Even though we won’t be having our first night today, we will still do our usual things. I will focus on helping you all, just like what all my clones do with their partners." Zhang Fei then asked all the women to return to the main bedroom. "We don’t have time to relax, so we’ll start now, and we don’t need to worry about the outside world."
"Yes." Since she had become Zhang Fei’s wife, Tantai Lingyan didn’t leave the bedroom and join them.
"Why are you so gloomy? Didn’t you agree long ago for Aunt Lingyan to marry our junior brother?" Jing Qiuyue decided to leave the pavilion and accompany Yan Yinqing.

Yan Yinqing sighed heavily. "I’m gloomy, not because I disagree with their marriage, Senior Sister. I’m just annoyed that they kept it from me for so long, and they only told me today, so I couldn’t tease my mother!"
"What a ridiculous reason!" Jing Qiuyue shouted at her. "Instead of teasing your mother, you should think about yourself. If you continue like this, you will eventually turn into a lily!"
Yan Yinqing folded her forehead. "Hey, senior sister, you are still single too, okay?"

"Tch!" Jing Qiuyue immediately refuted her. "I’m single, but I’m different from you, and I wholeheartedly love Qiao Liangren. On the contrary, you have never had any interest in men, so I doubt that you are a normal woman."
Hearing that, Yan Yinqing immediately pounced on the unprepared Jing Qiuyue and kissed her on the lips, causing her eyes to widen in shock.
Before Jing Qiuyue could beat her, Yan Yinqing had already fled their room. "Hahaha! Senior Sister, you’ve become a lily, and your first kiss is already mine!"
"Tch!" Jing Qiuyue wiped her lips and chased after Yan Yinqing, causing the people in the portable mansion to feel disturbed by their behavior.
Hun Di immediately intervened to stop his two disciples from causing trouble, and he threatened to punish the two severely, forcing Yan Yinqing and Jing Qiuyue to stop and return to their room.

Meanwhile, in the Sovereign Heaven Realm, Tian Jingxuan, Qing Huang, and Shi Yan were frustrated because their plans for the past three weeks had always failed. They had tried to attack the Ning and Yin Clans several times, but Tian Kui and Serpentera always stopped them.

They considered attacking the clans affiliated with Zhang Fei, but Gu Changsheng, Cao Yunbai, and Sima Huiqing continued to protect those clans. Even if the three of them didn’t protect them, Serpentera and Tian Kui would surely protect them.

Although their efforts continued to face a dead end, the three old men never considered giving up. Tian Jingxuan even met Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing in person, and he managed to convince them to join him. However, the two foxes couldn’t do anything yet, especially since they hadn’t managed to complete their Dao test, despite their great efforts to complete it.

Serpentera and Tian Kui naturally informed Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was cultivating in the Life Pond, of all that. However, he had not thought about facing them yet, and he was fully focused on preparing himself to face the situation in the Paradise Realm in the future.
After several months of traveling, they finally reached the end of the tunnel path, and Feltia [2] immediately flew the flying artifact out of it.

However, they found it strange that they didn’t feel any gravitational pressure, especially since the gravity in the Paradise Realm was supposed to be much heavier than in the Three Mortal Realms. Moreover, the system had not given any reaction, which confused Feltia [2].

The two of them stood at the side of the flying artifact, and they saw many tunnel paths opening up below them, followed by many flying artifacts flying out from within them. "Are they also people from the Three Mortal Realms like us?"
"I think so, Old Han." Feltia [2] noticed those people floating away from their flying artifacts and storing them, so he and Han Ling also did the same.

After Feltia [2] stored the flying artifact, they immediately landed in a slightly open area. The two of them ignored those people because they didn’t bother with the two of them either, and they were more interested in passing through those large gates.
"Are you going back there now?" Han Ling asked as he looked at the crowd.

"At first, I intended to go straight back there, but I changed my mind, and I will accompany you to the Empyrean Domain first." Feltia [2] suddenly raised his eyebrows when he saw a familiar figure walking out of one of the gates. "Feng Yao?"
Feng Yao immediately moved in front of them and looked at Feltia [2] with a playful smile. "You didn’t disappoint me, but your level isn’t yet high enough to survive in the Paradise Realm."

"I know." Feltia [2] then asked her. "How did you know I would arrive here today? Isn’t this place part of the Paradise Realm? I can sense the Celestial Qi here, but I feel like there’s something strange about it."

"Haha." Feng Yao laughed before pressing her index finger into Feltia [2]’s chest, and a small fire came out of his body. "I have long left a wisp of my flame in your body, but you never noticed it. This flame enabled me to keep track of you, even though I was staying in this realm. For your second question, this place is the border between the Three Mortal Realms and the Paradise Realm, so the Qi here is indeed the Celestial Qi. Once you pass through one of those gates, you will arrive at one of the domains there."

Feltia [2]’s lips twitched as he looked at the flame in Feng Yao’s hands, but she quickly returned it to his body. "I give up! I will never be able to win against you! Should I call you Feng Yao, Huo Yanling, or Shen Yuanzhi?"

"Yes." Luo Yunxiao nodded at her. "Zhang Fei is my childhood friend and lover."
"Eh? Is he really your lover, Big Sis? Didn’t you separate from him when you guys were ten?" Cheng Mengyao curiously asked.

"Hey, Big Sis! I know he’s your childhood friend, but he’s too young to be your lover, right?" Luo Zhenyu blurted out.
Luo Jiaxuan nodded in agreement. "I think the same as my brother, Big Sis. Look at him; he’s even younger than me. I think he’s not suitable for you, and you should find a man of your age."

"Brother, how do you think our brother-in-law managed to learn all that in just three and a half years?" Luo Zhenyu could only shake his head at Luo Jiaxuan.
Bing Xingying and Cheng Mengyao immediately grabbed their husbands. "Let’s follow them, husbands! We’ll ask him many things later, so we don’t need to be too curious now."

"Me too, Yunxiao." Zhang Fei caressed her head. "I’m happy to see you again, and we’ll see each other more often from now on."

Luo Zhenyu, Luo Jiaxuan, and their two wives still wanted to ask Zhang Fei many questions, but Luo Yunxiao hurriedly took him to her private chamber.
As soon as they arrived, Zhang Fei and Luo Yunxiao immediately embraced each other and engaged in a passionate kiss.
He slowly pushed her back until the wall stopped them, and the two kissed for quite a while.
Luo Yunxiao then hugged him tighter.
"Fei, I’m really glad you’re here now."
"Me too, Yunxiao." Zhang Fei caressed her head.
"I’m happy to see you again, and we’ll see each other more often from now on."

chapters.title: Chapter 1054: Luo Yunxiao’s Master
paragraphs: Zhang Fei and Luo Yunxiao stood in front of a painting while embracing each other, with her head resting on his shoulder. "I remember you loved painting when we were kids, but I never thought your paintings would be this realistic, making me feel like I was looking at myself in the mirror."

"Hehehe." Luo Yunxiao giggled at that. "Honestly, I deepened my skills in painting because of you, Fei. I couldn’t see you because you lived far away on Earth, so I wanted to paint your figure to overcome my longing for you. I painted all these paintings by imagining you growing up, but I was always worried that your adult face in my paintings didn’t look like the real you. Even though your adult face in all these paintings is not completely identical to your real face, I feel that my imagination of you is not far off."

"The difference between my adult face in your paintings and my real face is negligible." Zhang Fei then led Luo Yunxiao to the canvas at the side of the room, and he pulled a chair towards them before sitting down. "I haven’t seen you paint in a long time, so I want you to paint me now."

Luo Yunxiao smiled when she heard that, but she immediately sat on Zhang Fei’s lap before taking out her brush and painting oil. She then embraced him, wrapped his arms around her waist, and posed as best she could.
"Don’t move, okay?"
"Okay."

Luo Yunxiao’s next action surprised Zhang Fei because her brush moved on its own and began painting on the canvas. "Are you surprised? My brush is an immortal-grade artifact, and it is connected to my mind. Therefore, I don’t need to stand for too long, and I can control it with my mind to paint all my paintings."

"Haha." Zhang Fei softly laughed in response. "Back then, I was just an ordinary human, and this kind of thing would definitely surprise me. However, I’ve been a cultivator for many years now, and I’ve seen many things, so this kind of thing no longer surprises me."
Luo Yunxiao asked him again, "Why didn’t you bring them here?"

"Unlike you, they’ve lived with me for so many years. Therefore, I won’t bring them here yet, and I’ll accompany you first." Zhang Fei’s response caused a beautiful smile to spread across Luo Yunxiao’s face. "By the way, I will transform my Divine Qi into the Celestial Qi first, okay?"

"Why can I sense a faint trace of the Celestial Qi in your body? Have you tried changing your Divine Qi before?" Zhang Fei immediately told Luo Yunxiao about Qi Lai and the old man’s connection with Ma Kuangyu, which shocked her. "Since you’ve already done it once, I’m sure you won’t have any trouble converting all your Divine Qi, and your cultivation will be much faster afterward."

Zhang Fei nodded at her. "Actually, I could have broken through a long time ago, but Feng Yao forbade me from breaking through while my clone was in the tunnel path, so I kept delaying my breakthrough. Since I’m in this realm now, I’ll break through immediately after I’ve converted all my Divine Qi into Celestial Qi. However, I need a special place to break through because I’ll be breaking through several stages at once, and my breakthrough process is much different from that of other cultivators."

"There is a suitable place for you to break through, and I will take you there after I finish our painting." After that, Zhang Fei closed his eyes and absorbed the Celestial Qi from the air, and he did it so quickly that it made Luo Yunxiao speechless. ’I was never wrong about you, Fei. You have always been smart since we were little, and I have always believed that you will surpass all cultivators. If only my parents were willing to bring you here back then, your cultivation might have surpassed my parents and master.’
Not only Zhang Fei, but all his women, family members, and acquaintances in the training space also immediately worked hard to transform their Qi into the Celestial Qi.

Meanwhile, Feng Yao and Huang Xiaoyi stood side by side on a balcony, but their eyes were focused on the location of Luo Yunxiao’s private chamber. "How could he already have a tiny portion of the Celestial Qi in his body?"

"Zhang Fei got the Celestial Qi from Qi Lai, and he used it to change a little of the Divine Qi in his body." Huang Xiaoyi turned to Feng Yao, asking for an explanation. The phoenix princess immediately explained to her about the old man and some information she had obtained before. "Can you send someone to investigate the Spirit Temple?"
"The Spirit Temple?" Huang Xiaoyi was confused by her request.

"Inside Zhang Fei’s tiny soul world, there exists the soul of a powerful cultivator named Ma Kuangyu, who comes from the Ma Clan of the Nirvana Sky Domain, which is the same domain as the Spirit Temple." Huang Xiaoyi was shocked to hear this from Feng Yao, especially since she and her family were quite familiar with Ma Kuangyu and his Ma clan. "From what I heard, he obtained a cursed artifact and hid it somewhere, but Gongsun Ye of the Gongsun Clan found out about it. He led the others to gang up and kill him, and they sent his soul to the Star Tower. However, the Ma Clan is the second strongest after the Soul Temple, and their reputation is not small, so I’m sure those people didn’t move of their own accord."
Huang Xiaoyi raised an eyebrow for a moment. "Are you saying the Spirit Temple ordered them to kill Ma Kuangyu?"

"Yes." Feng Yao nodded at her. "The Spirit Temple is no longer the same as it was in Sheng Qingtai’s era, and they allow those demons to roam their domain. The Qi Clan is a subsidiary of the Gongsun Clan, and both clans have connections to the Nine Nethers Demon Clan. If my guess is correct, the cursed item Ma Kuangyu found was related to that demon race, and they ordered Sheng Youhun to kill him after they couldn’t find it."

Huang Xiaoyi immediately contacted her husband, and she discussed Feng Yao’s request with Luo Fenghan first, mainly because the Spirit Temple is not an ordinary force. "Actually, Ma Kuangyu and the Ma Clan were close friends of our family. We’ve heard about his death, and the Spirit Temple declared him a heretic after his demise. However, we never knew the real situation, so I didn’t expect theirs to be so complicated. My husband decided to send someone to that place, but that place is pretty closed to outsiders, so he can’t move rashly there."
"It’s fine."
"Do you think Zhang Fei will stay here?"
"If Luo Yunxiao persuades Zhang Fei, he will definitely stay here for her." Huo Ling immediately emerged from Feng Yao’s body. "Since he’s already here, I’ll return to the Flame Spirit Citadel now."

Huang Xiaoyi smiled wryly as Huo Ling and Feng Yao disappeared, and she looked toward her daughter’s private chamber again. "I hope Zhang Fei is willing to stay here so Yunxiao won’t be lonely, and he can cultivate much faster if he brings them all here."
After that, Huang Xiaoyi went to meet her husband to discuss the matter of Ma Kuangyu and the Ma Clan.
Several hours passed quickly; Zhang Fei had already transformed all the Divine Qi in his body into Celestial Qi, and Luo Yunxiao had also finished her painting.

Zhang Fei immediately opened his eyes and gave Luo Yunxiao a gentle kiss. "The Celestial Qi is truly amazing! Although it doesn’t directly impact my cultivation, it has had a significant impact on my body. Everything about me is stronger than before, from my bones, veins, dantian, and so on."

"Haha." Luo Yunxiao immediately got off Zhang Fei’s lap and pulled him in front of their painting, but the result left him dumbfounded, especially since she painted them as husband and wife. "Do you like it?"
"Naturally, I really like it." Zhang Fei then faced Luo Yunxiao and held her shoulders. "What if we get married, Yunxiao?"

Tears involuntarily flowed out of Luo Yunxiao’s eyes, especially since she had been waiting for Zhang Fei for hundreds of years. She hurriedly wiped her tears and gave him an answer. "I want to marry you, but we have to discuss this matter with our parents first. How about we meet them now?"
"Let’s meet Uncle Luo and Aunt Huang."

As soon as Zhang Fei and Luo Yunxiao arrived at their place, Luo Fenghan immediately teased his daughter. "Oh? Why are you two here? I thought you guys wouldn’t leave your private chamber for the next few days."
Unlike her husband, Huang Xiaoyi nodded in satisfaction, especially after she discovered that Zhang Fei’s Divine Qi had completely transformed into Celestial Qi.

"Father! Mother! I want to marry Zhang Fei." Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi were not surprised to hear that from Luo Yunxiao. "I’ve waited hundreds of years for this, so I want to marry him as soon as possible."
Zhang Fei also spoke to them. "Uncle Luo and Aunt Huang, I know this matter is too sudden, but I hope you two are willing to allow us to get married."

Luo Fenghan immediately stood up from his chair, stood in front of them, and grabbed their shoulders. "Zhang Fei, I’ve never liked a man with many wives, let alone a man with over a hundred women like you. Unfortunately, I can’t do anything, especially since my daughter has already set her heart on you. For us, our daughter’s happiness is above everything else, including our feelings and thoughts. She will suffer if we separate the two of you by force, so Xiaoyi and I will allow you two to get married. You must promise us that you will always make her happy, and you must protect her from anyone who has evil intentions toward her."
"Don’t worry, Uncle Luo." Zhang Fei held Luo Yunxiao’s hand tighter. "I will definitely make Yunxiao happy, and I will kill anyone who has evil intentions toward her."
Luo Fenghan nodded slightly. "You must keep your promise, or I will hold you accountable if I see Yunxiao sad because of you."
"Before that, you have to bring your mother and grandmother here." Huang Xiaoyi said.
Zhang Fei nodded to Huang Xiaoyi before summoning Zhang Chen and Qing Yi out of the training space, but Zhang Yue and Zhang Lin followed them.

Huang Xiaoyi immediately enveloped the four of them with her aura, as she was worried that they would be unable to move due to the strong gravitational pressure. "Sister Yi and Aunt Chen, I need your help to prepare for my daughter and Zhang Fei’s wedding."
"Huh?" Zhang Chen and the others turned to Zhang Fei immediately, especially since he had just arrived in the Paradise Realm, but he intended to marry Luo Yunxiao directly.

"Haha." Zhang Lin laughed before hugging Luo Yunxiao’s other arm. "My brother never wastes time on women, and he wants to secure you as his wife, even though he hasn’t arrived here long, Sister Yunxiao."
Luo Yunxiao nodded to her. "I don’t want to waste any more time, and I want to become his wife as soon as possible."

"I think that’s great, especially since you guys have liked each other since we were all little." Zhang Lin then moved her face closer to Luo Yunxiao’s ear and whispered a few things to her, causing both of her cheeks to turn bright red.
Zhang Yue approached Luo Yunxiao and grabbed her hand. "Congratulations, Yunxiao. Despite the long separation, your childhood dream of becoming his wife will soon come true."
"Thank you, Big Sis Yue." Luo Yunxiao replied with a smile.
"Would you like to join us, Yue’er and Lin’er?" Huang Xiaoyi asked the two women. "You’re all new here, so I wanted to show you around our place."
"Yes, Aunt Xiaoyi!"
After the five women left, Luo Fenghan immediately spoke to Zhang Fei. "Please call Ma Kuangyu out; I want to talk to him about his death."
Without waiting, Ma Kuangyu immediately walked out of Zhang Fei’s tiny world, surprising Luo Yunxiao. "Long time no see, Little Yunxiao."
"Uncle Ma." Luo Yunxiao wanted to hug Ma Kuangyu, but she immediately thought better of it. "I was truly sad when I heard the news of your death, but now that you are here, I feel relieved."

"Haha." Ma Kuangyu laughed and patted his head. "This is all thanks to Zhang Fei; if he hadn’t challenged the Star Tower, my soul would never have been able to leave that place. By the way, congratulations! You’ll be his wife soon."
Luo Yunxiao nodded her head a few times. "Thank you, Uncle Ma."
"I haven’t seen you for a long time, Fenghan."
"Long time no see." Luo Fenghan nodded at him. "What exactly happened to you back then? Are you sure it was Sheng Youhun who ordered those people to kill you?"

Ma Kuangyu shook his head slightly. "I don’t have any evidence, so it’s just my guess for now. However, I’m sure that Gongsun Ye and the others wouldn’t dare move against me without outside support, and the person most likely to support them is Sheng Youhun, especially since he holds control of our domain."

"Don’t worry, I’ve sent my confidant to infiltrate the Spirit Temple. He has unique abilities, so I believe he will succeed in finding clues about your death. If it is true that Sheng Youhun ordered them to kill you, I will teach him a lesson he will never forget for the rest of his life." Lou Fenghan grabbed Ma Kuangyu’s shoulder. "Let’s talk somewhere else, Kuangyu. We haven’t seen each other for a long time, so I want to hear a lot of things from you."
"Haha!" Ma Kuangyu laughed at that. "I’m also quite bored staying in this kid’s tiny soul world."
Before they left, Luo Yunxiao hurriedly spoke to her father. "Father, Zhang Fei wants to break through, so I’ll take him there now."

"Fenghan, I think we should go with them." Luo Fenghan turned to Ma Kuangyu directly. "This kid’s breakthroughs are never normal, and his breakthroughs always provoke heavenly phenomena. He has killed countless living beings, and the heavens have repeatedly wanted to kill him. Therefore, we must accompany them, and you must stop those who are intrigued by his breakthrough."

Luo Fenghan let out a heavy sigh as he looked at Zhang Fei. "You must control yourself and not let your bloodlust control you; otherwise, the heavens will no longer forgive you, and they will mete out the strongest punishment for you."

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed bitterly in response. "Uncle Luo, I don’t want to kill too many either, but those people keep coming to me and causing trouble. If I don’t kill them, they will bring me endless trouble."
"Yunxiao, contact your master and ask her to meet us there."
"Yes, Father."

A while later, they arrived in front of a small mountain quite far from the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary. Luo Fenghan had deliberately brought Zhang Fei there because he was afraid his breakthrough would destroy his place, especially after Ma Kuangyu had told him about the heavenly phenomenon.

The mountain looked like a dead mountain, with large holes at the bottom and top. Although he couldn’t see them, Zhang Fei could sense that the place was equipped with several powerful formation arrays.
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei looked the other way when he felt a powerful aura moving towards them.

In a few moments, a pretty woman in her early forties landed not far from them. She immediately looked at Zhang Fei, but her expression seemed displeased when she saw Luo Yunxiao hugging his arm so intimately.

"Master." Luo Yunxiao immediately brought Zhang Fei to the woman. "Fei, meet my master, Beiming Youhuang. She taught me many things since I was little, including my painting ability. Master, Fei is the man I’ve been telling you about all this time, and we will get married soon."

In a few moments, a pretty woman in her early forties landed not far from them.
She immediately looked at Zhang Fei, but her expression seemed displeased when she saw Luo Yunxiao hugging his arm so intimately.
"Master." Luo Yunxiao immediately brought Zhang Fei to the woman.
"Fei, meet my master, Beiming Youhuang.
She taught me many things since I was little, including my painting ability.
Master, Fei is the man I’ve been telling you about all this time, and we will get married soon."

chapters.title: Chapter 1055: Divine Expansion Realm I
paragraphs: Beiming Youhuang has a lovely, youthful face with a delicately pointed chin, smooth skin, and high cheekbones. Her eyes are large and slightly upturned with a soft, bright pink eyeshadow. Her eyebrows are thin and arched, matching her long, vibrant pink hair, which is styled with a high, crown-like bun at the top, decorated with ornate golden accessories and gemstone embellishments. Her lips are soft and full, painted with a gentle rose tint, forming a composed yet confident expression.

Beiming Youhuang has a tall, slender, yet curvy figure. Her waist was narrow and well-defined, accentuated by a gold-embellished belt. Her chest was full and rounded, noticeable but not exaggerated, and well-proportioned to her body, emphasized by her form-fitting long pink dress.

Mei immediately informed Zhang Fei about Beiming Youhuang’s status, but there was nothing special about her except her unknown cultivation, mainly because the system could not yet detect the Five Celestial Realms.

Beiming Youhuang’s eyes moved up and down, observing Zhang Fei. "I understand that he’s your childhood friend, but you should leave him, Yunxiao. A disloyal man like him is unworthy of you, and you deserve a better man than him, especially one who loves you alone. Moreover, his cultivation is too low, and you will only waste your time on him."
"Heh." Zhang Fei snorted at that. "You may be her master, but you have no right to interfere with her decisions."
"You—"
"Who are you to control her life?" Zhang Fei then pointed at Luo Fenghan. "Uncle Luo is her father, and he has already agreed to our marriage, so your opinion is unnecessary."

Beiming Youhuang’s face darkened because Zhang Fei dared to be impudent toward her, and she immediately suppressed him with her aura, almost causing him to fall to the ground if Luo Yunxiao hadn’t supported him.
Luo Fenghan wanted to stop them, but Ma Kuangyu directly stopped him and shook his head. ’Pay close attention to your future son-in-law.’
"Master—"

"You don’t need to say anything to her, Yunxiao." Beiming Youhuang was shocked to hear Zhang Fei speak under her pressure, but she was even more shocked when his cultivation became equal to that of a cultivator at the Three-Sun Celestial Lord stage, especially after he activated the soul link. "You are indeed amazing and powerful, but I am not a weak persimmon that you can suppress as you please."
After he said that, Zhang Fei immediately activated his soul domain, which shocked not only Beiming Youhuang but also Luo Fenghan and Luo Yunxiao.
"Ugh!" Beiming Youhuang felt dizzy and staggered backwards as soon as Zhang Fei activated his soul domain, the effect of which was to attack her soul directly. "How... how is this possible?"

"Your cultivation is indeed higher than mine, but that’s only because you were born and live in this realm. Unlike you, I was born in the Three Mortal Realms, and I don’t have powerful backers like you, so I have to try to get everything myself. Even so, I am superior to you in many ways, and your initial stage of the Divine Soul Level is as meaningless as long as you are within my domain, especially since its effect weakens your soul power, which allows my soul level to surpass yours." Luo Yunxiao pulled Zhang Fei’s arm, asking him to stop. However, he didn’t want to stop because Beiming Youhuang would continue to belittle him if he stopped now. "I admit that I’m a disloyal man, but I dare say with confidence that no other man is more worthy to be her husband than me."
After he said that, Zhang Fei released his soul, revealing white lotuses that shocked the three of them. Additionally, he released his eight elemental domains, which shocked them further.
"Nine domains at once, and eight of them are elemental domains." Beiming Youhuang muttered under her breath as she looked at Zhang Fei’s nine domains in shock.

Luo Fenghan took a deep breath after seeing all that. ’This kid! How did he create so many domains? Even I only have one, but he has nine! Moreover, eight of his domains are elemental domains, which means he has eight elements!’
Unlike them, Luo Yunxiao’s lips curled into a proud smile, especially since Zhang Fei’s flaunting action proved that her choice was the best for her.
Zhang Fei instantly canceled all his domains except his fire element domain, making Beiming Youhuang breathe a sigh of relief as the pressure in her soul disappeared.

"If you still think there is a better man than me out there to be her husband, I will show you something else." Zhang Fei asked Luo Yunxiao to step back before taking out several types of alchemy ingredients. "Open your eyes and look carefully."

Luo Fenghan and Luo Yunxiao already knew that Zhang Fei was an alchemist, so they were not surprised by his intentions. On the other hand, Beiming Youhuang didn’t know much about him, and his actions left her wondering.

In a few minutes, Zhang Fei had finished preparing the ingredients and let them float within her fire domain. Several types of flames immediately emerged from his domain, enveloped the herbs, and processed them.
Luo Yunxiao didn’t say anything, but her expression was filled with excitement, and the proud smile didn’t fade from her pretty face.

Beiming Youhuang finally realized that Zhang Fei was an alchemist, but she had never seen such an alchemy method before. However, she was more intrigued by some of his flames, and she immediately recognized them. "Phoenix flame, dragon flame, vermilion flame, and golden crow flame."
’Where did he get those flames?’ Luo Fenghan looked at Ma Kuangyu.

’Hahaha.’ Ma Kuangyu laughed in response. ’He has many mythical beasts as his wives, and he obtained his flames from them. Actually, he still has some other flames, but they aren’t suitable for alchemy. However, he combined them to create a fire technique, and the explosive power of his technique is incredibly great.’

Lou Fenghan immediately returned his gaze to Zhang Fei. ’This kid is like a cocoon evolving into a butterfly! He was born in a mortal realm and initially knew nothing about cultivation, but now he possesses many things that others might envy. Dual cultivators can indeed cultivate really fast, but his cultivation speed simply surpasses the other dual cultivators’.’

’That’s true.’ Ma Kuangyu replied with a nod of approval. ’Little Yunxiao’s master knew nothing about Zhang Fei, but she dared to underestimate him. He had already obtained the ten-tailed fox’s pride soul, and that made him quite prideful, forcing him to show off his abilities to her. One day in the future, all the cultivators in this realm will hear his name, and they will bow down to him, especially after he evolves into a ten-tailed fox.’
After they waited for some time, Zhang Fei had already started combining the ingredients to form the pill, and he finished it three hours later.
Beiming Youhuang stared at the five pills floating in front of Zhang Fei in amazement. "Five superior-grade pills in one alchemy session."
"Master, Zhang Fei is a venerable rank alchemist, and he will become a celestial rank alchemist soon." Beiming Youhuang looked at Luo Yunxiao in shock.

Zhang Fei immediately dispelled his fire domain, grabbed the five pills, and gave one to Beiming Youhuang. "Rank 8, the Heaven and Earth Pill! Despite its name, it’s more useful for dual cultivation, and its effects will synchronize yin and yang without any backlash. You can swallow it even if you are not a dual cultivator, and you will understand its efficacy afterward."
"Give me one, Fei." Luo Yunxiao immediately swallowed the pill as soon as Zhang Fei gave it to her, and she hurriedly dissolved and spread it throughout her body to accelerate its effects.
Beiming Youhuang said nothing and followed Luo Yunxiao in swallowing it, and she did the same with her disciple.
In a few minutes, Luo Yunxiao and Beiming Youhuang felt the change in their Yin Qi, and they immediately sat cross-legged before absorbing the Yin Qi from the air.

Luo Fenghan and Ma Kuangyu approached the two women and examined their bodies to determine the effect of Zhang Fei’s pills on them. "Hmm? Their flow of Yin Qi became so fast, and the amount of Yin Qi they absorbed doubled once it entered their bodies."

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed and handed a pill to Luo Fenghan. "You can swallow it, Uncle Luo. However, the more potent the pill, the shorter the duration. The effects of my pill will only last for three hours, and you can only swallow it once a month."

"Where did you get the pill recipe?" Zhang Fei responded to Luo Fenghan with a smile, especially since he couldn’t possibly tell him that he got the recipe and ingredients from the alchemy shop in the system. "I’ll swallow it now."
After Luo Fenghan began his cultivation, Ma Kuangyu asked Zhang Fei, "What are your plans for your breakthrough? How many levels will you break through today?"

"I’ve been forcing my prisoners to convert their Divine Qi into Celestial Qi, but the Qi I need keeps increasing due to my eight cores. Since my Qi reserves are only enough to break through to the One-Moon Divine Expansion Realm, I will immediately break through to that stage." Zhang Fei then looked up at the sky with a serious expression. "However, I hesitate to do it all at once because my lightning tribulations became too strong when I broke through to the Seven Divine Realms, and I’m sure they will become even stronger if I break through to that stage at once. Even though I have the Azure Emperor Roc bloodline, and my lightning element and elemental law have reached the peak, I’m not confident about facing them all at once. Thus, I’m thinking of breaking through one stage at a time, and I’ll continue straight on once the previous one is finished."

Ma Kuangyu nodded in understanding. "I think that’s the best option, but you can observe your first lightning tribulation. If it’s too strong, don’t rush to the next minor stage. You can do so if you feel capable of facing more than one."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei released a soft sigh.
Some time later, Luo Fenghan and the two women had finished cultivating, and they were truly satisfied with the effects of Zhang Fei’s pill.
Luo Yunxiao immediately asked him. "Do you want to break through now, Fei?"

"Yeah," Zhang Fei then spoke to Luo Fenghan and Beiming Youhuang. "My breakthrough will probably attract the attention of many people, so I hope you two can help me keep them away. I’m not afraid of them, but they will suffer from my lightning tribulation."
"Lightning tribulation?"

Zhang Fei nodded to Beiming Youhuang. "I’ve faced lightning tribulations hundreds of times since I broke through to the Earth Realm, and it continues to get stronger with each breakthrough in my cultivation. During my lightning tribulations last time, the heavens manifested themselves not just in one form but in three forms, as they were eager to kill me."
"You have too much bad karma." Zhang Fei just smiled at Beiming Youhuang and led Luo Yunxiao into the dead mountain directly, followed by the other three.

As soon as they arrived inside the dead mountain, Lei, the lightning spirit, immediately came out of Zhang Fei’s body, shocking Luo Fenghan and Beiming Youhuang. "Master, you must do it one at a time."
"I’ll take a look at the situation first, Lei." Zhang Fei then summoned Lei Que, the thunderbird, and Long Jishan, the thunder dragon.
"Thunder dragon!" Luo Fenghan and Beiming Youhuang screamed quite loudly.
Zhang Fei then opened the portal to the Yin-Yang space, causing Beiming Youhuang to frown, especially when Hong Xinxin walked out of it.

Beiming Youhuang’s expression turned shocked as soon as Zhang Fei’s four clones walked out after Hong Xinxin, mainly because all of them were so real, and their cultivation was on par with his real body. ’What kind of clone technique is he using? How could he create such real clones?’

"Husband, the celestial Qi is truly amazing, and my cultivation has accelerated significantly since I cultivated using it." Hong Xinxin spoke in a tone full of excitement, but she then looked at Beiming Youhuang. "Who is that senior woman?"
"She is Yunxiao’s master, Beiming Youhuang." Zhang Fei inhaled and exhaled a few times to prepare himself. "Xinxin, return to your beast form because I will break through now."
"Yeah." Hong Xinxin immediately flew up and returned to her Azure Emperor Roc form, shocking Beiming Youhuang again. "Let’s go, husband! We will help you face your lightning tribulations."
Zhang Fei and his four clones immediately jumped onto Hong Xinxin’s back, and she carried them flying into the sky through the large hole above them, followed by Lei, Lei Que, and Long Jishan.
Beiming Youhuang immediately pulled Luo Yunxiao to her side. ’How did he create his clones? How did he obtain those two mythical beasts?’

’Master, I haven’t told you about this, but Zhang Fei is a mythical beast, the Heavenly Fox to be precise.’ Luo Yunxiao’s answer stunned Beiming Youhuang. ’As for his clones, it’s not a technique, but it’s one of his abilities as a demon, and he actually has five clones.’
Beiming Youhuang’s eyes widened. ’Are you serious? Is he really a beast and a demon? How did he become like that? Why can’t I feel his beast and demon aura?’

’I’m not lying to you, master.’ Luo Yunxiao looked up at them. ’Zhang Fei was born as a human, but he suffered an accident and died before he became a cultivator. Luckily, someone saved him from death, but that person gave him something that turned him into a heavenly fox and a demon. Since then, he has lived with three different identities, and each identity has its own advantages and disadvantages. As for his savior’s identity, he didn’t know it, especially since that person had disappeared when he woke up.’
"I see." Beiming Youhuang nodded in understanding and looked up at Zhang Fei and the others in the sky.

"He’s already begun," Ma Kuangyu spoke as the sky outside the mountain rapidly darkened. "You two better get ready because the people from this domain will be coming soon. If possible, call more people to protect this place, especially since the situation will soon become chaotic."
Beiming Youhuang and Luo Fenghan said nothing, but they immediately contacted people from their two sects, ordering them to come to their location right away.
*Rumble... Rumble...*
Luo Yunxiao became very tense, especially since the sky became darker, and rumbling sounds began to ring out. ’Be careful, and don’t force yourself, Fei.’
[Congratulations! Your cultivation has broken through to the 2-Moon Divine Transcend Realm.]

Unlike them, Zhang Fei and his clones remained calm, focused on assessing the power of his lightning tribulations. ’As expected! My lightning tribulation is even stronger than last time! Do you think I can take on two lightning tribulations head-on, Mei?’
[I don’t think it’s too difficult, Master. Maybe you can face three lightning tribulations head-on, but don’t do it all at once and try to break through one more time first.]
Zhang Fei nodded slightly, and his clone in the Yin-Yang space immediately absorbed the Qi in the glass tube, triggering another notification.
[Congratulations! Your cultivation has broken through to the 3-Moon Divine Transcend Realm.]
*Rumble... Rumble...*

The rumbling sound in the sky became louder as soon as the notification appeared, and the darkness not only gathered above them, but it also began to spread to all corners of the Empyrean Domain, provoking the curiosity of the strong cultivators living in that domain.
*Swoosh... Swoosh...*

Luo Fenghan, Beiming Youhuang, and Ma Kuangyu immediately flew into the sky. However, they did not approach Zhang Fei and the others, and they kept quite a distance from them. On the other hand, Luo Yunxiao did not join them and hid inside the dead mountain, using artifacts to hide herself because only people in the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary knew about her existence.

"He broke through twice." Ma Kuangyu then turned to the new arrivals. Luo Fenghan and Beiming Youhuang told him that they were their people, and both immediately ordered them to spread out. "Hmm? Are you going to break through for the third one, kid?"
[Congratulations! Your cultivation has broken through to the 4-Moon Divine Transcend Realm.]

Maybe you can face three lightning tribulations head-on, but don’t do it all at once and try to break through one more time first.]
Zhang Fei nodded slightly, and his clone in the Yin-Yang space immediately absorbed the Qi in the glass tube, triggering another notification.
[Congratulations!
Your cultivation has broken through to the 3-Moon Divine Transcend Realm.]
*Rumble...
Rumble...*

The rumbling sound in the sky became louder as soon as the notification appeared, and the darkness not only gathered above them, but it also began to spread to all corners of the Empyrean Domain, provoking the curiosity of the strong cultivators living in that domain.
*Swoosh...
Swoosh...*
Luo Fenghan, Beiming Youhuang, and Ma Kuangyu immediately flew into the sky.
However, they did not approach Zhang Fei and the others, and they kept quite a distance from them.
On the other hand, Luo Yunxiao did not join them and hid inside the dead mountain, using artifacts to hide herself because only people in the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary knew about her existence.
"He broke through twice." Ma Kuangyu then turned to the new arrivals.
Luo Fenghan and Beiming Youhuang told him that they were their people, and both immediately ordered them to spread out.
"Hmm?
Are you going to break through for the third one, kid?"
[Congratulations!
Your cultivation has broken through to the 4-Moon Divine Transcend Realm.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1056: Divine Expansion Realm II
paragraphs: *Swoosh*
Huang Xiaoyi, who had previously left with Zhang Chen and the others, finally arrived at the dead mountain. She wasn’t alone; she was accompanied by several members of the Huang Clan.
They were stunned for a moment as soon as they saw the beast forms of Long Jishan and Hong Xinxin. Huang Xiaoyi immediately ordered them. "Spread out and protect him!"

"Yes, Matriarch!" The people from the Huang Clan immediately spread out around the area, and they took out talismans before throwing them into the sky, creating a protective barrier that enveloped the entire dead mountain.

Luo Yunxiao’s two brothers and sisters-in-law came shortly after their mother, but they were shocked after seeing the two mythical beasts. They were even more shocked after they detected Zhang Fei’s cultivation, which had already reached the 4-Moon Divine Transcend Realm.

"Hey, Jiaxuan! Our brother-in-law is really crazy! Not only did he break through three stages at once, but his breakthrough provoked the wrath of the heavens!" Long Zhenyu spoke with a serious expression.

"You’re right, brother. However, the wrath of the heavens is truly terrifying, so I think he’s too reckless, and I’m afraid he’ll have a hard time getting past it." Luo Jiaxuan then asked Huang Xiaoyi. "Why doesn’t he break through in the Three Mortal Realms, Mother? Wouldn’t he be much safer if he broke through there? With his current strength and the people around him, I’m sure that no one will dare to disturb him."

"Try to pay attention to Zhang Fei’s body." Luo Jiaxuan immediately did so and realized what Huang Xiaoyi meant. "Since he has transformed all the Divine Qi in his body into the Celestial Qi, he can no longer break through in the Three Mortal Realms. The Celestial Qi does not exist there, and its power is too great for those weak realms. If he breaks through there, and the heavens use it to attack him, then the realm where he broke through will be destroyed, which will take too many casualties."
"Mother, doesn’t this mean that Zhang Fei has accumulated too much bad karma? Otherwise, the heavens wouldn’t be that angry and want to kill him, right?" Bing Xingying asked.

Cheng Mengyao, who was beside Bing Xingying, seriously observed Zhang Fei. "He’s much younger than us, but he’s killed far more than us. Back then, I thought my grandfather was the most vicious, but he’s far more vicious than him. I don’t know how many living beings have died at his hands, but it’s probably more than my grandfather’s."
"You’re right, Mengyao." Huang Xiaoyi released a soft sigh. "Despite his young age, Zhang Fei’s victims far surpassed Cheng Zhong’s, and the heavens wanted to kill him because of it."

All of them suddenly felt an overwhelming pressure coming from the darkened sky, and that pressure was still too strong even for cultivators in the Five Celestial Realms like them, making them doubt Zhang Fei’s chances of passing his three lightning tribulations.

Luo Yunxiao, who was watching from inside the mountain, clasped her hands together in front of her chest. Her eyes and expression were filled with worry, mainly because Zhang Fei’s lightning tribulations continued to grow stronger.
Among them, only Ma Kuangyu was not worried about Zhang Fei’s situation, especially since he had witnessed him go through hundreds of lightning tribulations.
"Hey! What’s that?" Long Zhenyu exclaimed as he pointed at several lightning figures that began to form in the darkened sky.

"They are the manifestation of the heavens." Long Zhenyu and the others turned to Ma Kuangyu directly. "The heavens have already manifested themselves twice to kill Zhang Fei. The first time was when he broke through to the Quasi Divine Realm, and the second time was when he broke through to the Seven Divine Realms. They were too strong for ordinary cultivators like us, but they could never stop him. You guys don’t need to worry about him, and you should pay attention to how he will defeat them."
*Boom*

A loud explosion suddenly rang out in the sky, and everyone gasped in shock as Zhang Fei’s cultivation broke through to the 5-Moon Divine Transcend Realm, causing the lightning to rumble even more and putting even greater pressure on the people below.
[Congratulations! Your cultivation has broken through to the 5-Moon Divine Transcend Realm.]

"He’s too crazy and reckless." Luo Fenghan shook his head before turning to the dozens of cultivators who had just arrived. "Please forgive me; his breakthrough has disturbed the peace of all of you, but I hope you guys don’t approach him for now. As you can see, his lightning tribulations are no ordinary ones, and the pressure they exert is incredibly powerful. If you approach there now, you will be swallowed by his lightning tribulations and perhaps die to ashes."

"Hahaha!" An old man suddenly laughed as he moved to their side, followed by four senior cultivators, a man and three women. "Sect Master Luo, this old man is still not senile, and I can see that his lightning tribulations are truly terrifying. However, we are curious about his identity, so I hope you are willing to enlighten us."
"He-"

"Senior Fan Ning, that kid is the future husband of Empress Huo Yanling’s reincarnation." The old man and the new arrival cultivators immediately turned to Huang Xiaoyi with looks of shock, especially since they were very familiar with the latter’s name. "You guys might not believe me, but Empress Huo Yanling returned to this realm several years ago, and she lives in the Flame Spirit Citadel now. If you want to prove it, you can all go to that place to meet her."
"How did you know that Empress Huo Yanling was back, Xiaoyi?" A senior female cultivator curiously asked.

Huang Xiaoyi immediately touched the senior female cultivator’s forehead and shared some of her memories with her, especially her memories of her encounter with Feng Yao. "You can see her for yourself, Senior Ru Yan. Her current name is Feng Yao, and she has already proven her identity by showing me the plaque of Empress Huo Yanling."

The other four were also curious about that, so Ru Yan shared Huang Xiaoyi’s memories with them, and they immediately watched them all. Sometime later, they had already opened their eyes, and there was no doubt in their eyes, especially since no one dared to fake the plaque of Empress Huo Yanling.

Another old woman released a soft sigh. "Empress Huo Yanling died thousands of years ago, and many people have been waiting for her return, especially people from the Blazing Nirvana Domain. However, despite their long wait, she never returned."

"Empress Huo Yanling is back now, so their wait is over, Zhi Yuan." Another old woman spoke as she looked at Zhang Fei in the sky. "Her return will revive the Blazing Nirvana Domain, and those demons will tremble in fear if they learn of her return. However, I didn’t expect that she would return to this realm with a husband-to-be, and that kid is definitely no ordinary one. His cultivation has only been broken through to the 5-Moon Divine Transcend Realm, but he has a Thunder Dragon and an Azure Emperor Roc as his beast contracts."

"You’re right about him, Chen Qi." Zhi Yuan replied with an approving nod. "However, I think he was too rash in breaking through four minor stages straight away, which caused his already strong lightning tribulations to become even stronger. Moreover, look at those faint figures; they are clearly manifestations of the heavens, and I’ve never met any cultivators who managed to provoke them to such an extent."
Fan Ning, Ru Yan, Zhi Yuan, and Chen Qi continued to pay attention to Zhang Fei, as did the cultivators floating in the distance.
Unlike them, the last male senior cultivator is more interested in other things. "Aren’t you Lord Ma Kuangyu of the Nirvana Sky Domain?"
"Haha." Ma Kuangyu laughed and nodded at him. "A lot of time has passed since my death, and I didn’t expect you to still recognize me, Zhuang Qihong."
"Lord Ma, I—"

"No need." Ma Kuangyu stopped Zhuang Qihong, who was about to kneel to him. "My Ma Clan fell with my death, and those people declared me a heretic; thus, I am no longer a lord. Right now, I’m just a wandering soul, so you can forget the past and act normally with me. Did you bring your Zhuang Clan to move to this domain after my death?"

"Yes." Zhuang Qihong nodded at him. "After your death, the situation in our domain became utterly chaotic, especially after the Spirit Temple appointed Gongsun Ye and the Gongsun Clan to replace you and your Ma Clan. Among the ten clans under your leadership, the Song, Shuo, and Ruan clans met their end. The Nie, Fu, Situ, Wan, and Guan clans chose to be loyal to them, primarily due to their fear of destruction. I brought my Zhuang Clan here because I remembered that you had a good relationship with Sect Master Luo, and Tan Beng brought his Tan Clan to move to the Peach Garden Domain."

"Let’s talk about that later, especially since that kid has almost started." Ma Kuangyu and Zhuang Qihong stared at Zhang Fei, but the latter was shocked because he had committed another madness by breaking through to the 1-Moon Divine Expansion Realm. "Hahaha! That kid is as fearless as ever!"
[Congratulations! Your cultivation has broken through to the 1-Moon Divine Expansion Realm.]

After the final notification appeared, Zhang Fei immediately swallowed his fifth True Foundation Pill. He then summoned his last clone out of the Yin-Yang space, and they stared at the dozens of lightning figures that had already fully formed.
"Are we going to fight them head-on, husband?" Hong Xinxin asked.

"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded as he summoned the demon extermination sword, and all his clones took out other weapons. "At first, I thought they would be extremely powerful, but their strength was no different from last time, and they only increased their numbers. Fortunately, I’ve improved a lot after I went to the Sovereign Heaven Realm, so I deliberately broke through to this stage directly; otherwise, we would have wasted our precious time facing them again and again. Let’s fight them now so you guys can continue your cultivation again, and you can break through to the Five Celestial Realms faster than our initial estimate."

After he said that, Zhang Fei activated the soul link, making his and his five clones’ cultivation skyrocket sharply. They also activated their lightning domains, all of which shocked all the cultivators, who were watching them from a distance.
"Follow me, Xinxin." Zhang Fei and his five clones immediately flew toward those lightning figures, followed by Lei, the lightning spirit.

Hong Xinxin immediately flew behind them, leading Lei Que and Long Jinshan. All of them disappeared into the darkened sky while fighting the lightning figures, which made it difficult for the cultivators to observe their battle. Just like Zhang Fei, they also activated their lightning domains, which had different advantages.
"Do you think he’ll make it, Mother?"

"Even though those lightning figures are powerful, he’s not weak, and he has a lot of support by his side. I’m sure he’ll pull through, so we just have to wait for him to finish." Huang Xiaoyi looked towards the dead mountain, as she knew that her daughter must be worried about Zhang Fei. ’Didn’t you always believe in him, Yunxiao? Don’t you believe that he will successfully pass the lightning tribulations?’
’Yes, Mother. I believe Zhang Fei will successfully pass his lightning tribulations, but I’m still worried about him because those lightning tribulations are so strong.’

’I know you are worried about Zhang Fei, but you should go back to our place now.’ Huang Xiaoyi looked at the cultivators before continuing to speak to her daughter. ’I’m afraid these people will notice your presence, and we will face new problems if people find out about you. Once he completes his breakthrough, I will bring him to you, and the two of you can spend some time together after that.’

Luo Yanxiao was silent for a long time, causing Huang Xiaoyi to sigh and try to persuade her again. ’Okay, Mother. I’ll go back now, and you must bring Zhang Fei to me immediately once he completes his breakthrough.’

’Don’t worry, I will bring him to you straight away.’ After that, Luo Yunxiao disappeared from the place using a device similar to the returning jade, much to Huang Xiaoyi’s relief. She then looked at the sky again. ’Zhang Fei, you must finish your breakthrough as soon as possible, or Yunxiao will continue to worry about you.’

While the people below were worried about him, Zhang Fei and his clones were enjoying their fight with the dozens of lightning figures. Lei, Hong Xinxin, Long Jishan, and Lei Que were also enjoying themselves, beating up their enemies.

Unlike in Zhang Fei’s previous breakthroughs, the group was much more relaxed in facing their enemies, especially after they created their lightning domains. Moreover, the Qi in their bodies was no longer the Divine Qi but the Celestial Qi, which significantly improved all their aspects.

The hellflame frost lotus, the annihilation flame, and many other techniques caused those lightning figures to be overwhelmed to face Zhang Fei and the group. Although the lightning figures put up fierce resistance, they gradually vanished one by one from all the attacks, which continuously reduced the pressure in the sky.

Quickly, the day changed, and the previously pitch-black sky began to become a little brighter with the appearance of stars there. Sometime later, the sky had returned to normal, but those cultivators couldn’t find Zhang Fei and the group anywhere.

Almost all of them believed that Zhang Fei had failed and turned to ashes, but a few knew he had safely survived his multiple lightning tribulations, especially since he had already informed them of his departure.
"The show’s over, so you can all go back now," Luo Fenghan’s words broke the silence between them.
"Did he survive, Sect Master Luo?" Fan Ning asked him.

"Hahaha," Ma Kuangyu laughed at that. "That kid was tough and stronger than his level, and those lightning tribulations weren’t a big deal for him. He managed to get through them just fine, but he didn’t easily get along with strangers; thus, he took them away once he finished everything."
"How did he manage to take them away without us knowing?" Zhi Yuan asked with a frown.
Ma Kuangyu was too lazy to explain to her, and he directly led Luo Fengyan and Zhuang Qihong to leave the place to return to the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary.

"Senior Zhi, I already told you that he is Empress Huo’s future husband, right? Do you think she would choose him if he were an ordinary kid?" Without waiting for Zhi Yuan’s answer, Huang Xiaoyi immediately left with her two sons and two daughters-in-law.
Beiming Youhuang followed Huang Xiaoyi and her family members, especially since she had many questions for Zhang Fei.

Chen Qi suddenly let out a soft sigh. "Old Zhi, I’m also curious about that kid’s identity, but we shouldn’t think too much about him, considering Empress Huo’s character. If she finds out we’re disturbing her future husband, she will come to us and bring trouble to our clans."

"I agree with her, Old Zhi," Ru Yan said as she nodded. "If he truly is Empress Huo’s future husband, he will surely rise above many other cultivators with her support. At that time, we will definitely hear that kid’s name, and we will know his true identity."
Zhi Yuan nodded in agreement with them. "Let’s go back! We must inform the people of our clans about him, and they won’t look to trouble him if they meet each other."

"You guys can go back, and I’ll go to the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary to talk to Luo Fenghan." The three women could only shake their heads as Fan Ning left in such a hurry. They also left the place, leaving the cultivators still filling the air, wondering about Zhang Fei’s identity.
