chapters.title: Chapter 1057: Training Space Change
paragraphs: "Fei!" Luo Yunxiao immediately jumped up to hug Zhang Fei as soon as he appeared, and she hugged him really tight as if afraid of losing him. "Are you okay, Fei? Did you suffer any injuries during your previous breakthroughs?"

"I’m sorry to worry you, Yunxiao." Zhang Fei pushed her back a little and gave her a brief kiss. "Even though my previous lightning tribulations were powerful, I am no longer the one I used to be. My lightning domain greatly helped me reduce their power and weaken them; thus, I didn’t suffer any significant injuries, and I just needed to rest for some time to recover."
"Is it true?" Luo Yunxiao doubtfully asked, considering the power of those lightning tribulations.
Zhang Fei smiled and teased her. "If you don’t believe me, you can check it yourself."
Luo Yunxiao’s cheeks reddened because of his teasing, but she immediately grabbed Zhang Fei’s hand and led him away to another place.
Soon, they arrived at a bathroom, which made Zhang Fei a little surprised, especially since it was completely similar to a modern bathroom on Earth, complete with a bathtub, shower, and so on.

"Hehe." Luo Yunxiao giggled. "Are you surprised to see this bathroom? Back then, my father said that the cultivation world is completely different from Earth, and there’s no technology here, especially since cultivators rely on artifacts. I asked him to buy a lot of things before we left, especially bedroom and bathroom furniture. After we arrived here, he ordered our people to construct this place specifically for my needs."

Zhang Fei nodded at her. "I’m a bit surprised, but I have many shops in the Three Mortal Realms, and all of my shops sell Earthly goods. They sell well in all realms, and I’m quite wealthy now, even though I’m still not as wealthy as you."

"Hey! I can enjoy this kind of life because of my ancestral heritage, okay?" Luo Yunxiao shyly started to undress Zhang Fei, starting from his upper clothes. She was amazed to see his naked torso, and she groped around his body, feeling the muscles protruding from beneath his skin. "Your body is truly strong, Fei. Compared to you, my two brothers are nothing, especially since they’re too lazy to train as body cultivators."

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed in response. "Not everyone is as crazy as me, so you don’t need to compare them to me. Unlike them, I mastered six body cultivation techniques, and I had to go through a lot of suffering to master some of them. When I first became a body cultivator, Hong Xinxin repeatedly beat me with an iron pole, and she also shocked me with her lightning element."

"Sigh." Luo Yunxiao released a heavy sigh. "Fei, I understand your enthusiasm to become the strongest, but I want you to take better care of yourself, and I hope you are willing to stop doing anything rash. If you die, we will be sad and miserable, and I will immediately follow you to the afterlife."

"Don’t ever talk like that again, okay?" Zhang Fei spoke softly as he rubbed Luo Yunxiao’s lips. "I am striving to become the strongest not for my own sake, but to protect all of you from anyone or anything that could cause you harm. I promise I will take much better care of myself, and I will never take rash actions that might kill me."
Luo Yunxiao grabbed Zhang Fei’s hand and linked their pinky fingers together. "You promised me, so you have to keep your word."

"Definitely!" Zhang Fei then lifted Luo Yunxiao and sat her on the countersink table; he did nothing but stare at her eyes and rub her cheeks. "You’ve been beautiful since childhood, but you’ve become a grown-up goddess now. I feel lucky because I can remember you again, and I’m also fortunate because you have always been faithfully waiting for me, even though you know that I can’t necessarily become a cultivator due to the absence of Qi on Earth."

Luo Yunxiao wrapped her arms around Zhang Fei’s neck and pressed their foreheads together. "My parents often said that you would never be able to become a cultivator, and they asked me several times to forget you, but somehow I always had a feeling that we would meet again one day. I believed that my feelings would not disappoint me, and I decided to continue waiting for you. Even though hundreds of years have passed, my wait for our reunion was not in vain, and we are together now."
"I will never let you wait for me like in the past, and we will always be together from this day forward." Luo Yunxiao closed her eyes before kissing Zhang Fei, which he immediately reciprocated.

Zhang Fei grabbed Luo Yunxiao’s head, pushed her to lean against the mirror, and led her into a hot French kiss. They guided each other to get their tongues into each other’s mouths, and their tongues danced nimbly as they continued to move between their mouths. Their tongues linked and licked each other, sucking and savoring each other’s nectar.
"Mhmm..." As their kiss grew hotter, Luo Yunxiao’s one hand ruffled Zhang Fei’s hair, and her other hand ruffled around his back, feeling his muscles bulging. "Mhmm..."

Once they were satisfied, Zhang Fei and Luo Yunxiao immediately stopped their kiss, circulating their breath. Both of them stared at each other in silence, rubbing each other’s cheeks with smiles on their faces.
[Master, I detected something unusual in the training space.] Mei suddenly broke the silence.
’What do you mean by that?’

[All these years, you’ve lived in the Three Mortal Realms, and the time flow inside the training space is four times faster than there, right? However, that changed after your real body arrived in this realm, and the time flow inside it became four times faster compared to here. Therefore, you don’t need to stay here, and you can bring Luo Yunxiao to live with you in the pavilion.]
Zhang Fei was shocked to hear that. ’Is that true, Mei?’
[Why don’t you try going inside yourself to check it? I’m sure you’ll be able to feel the difference, especially since the time flow in this realm is much faster than in the Three Mortal Realms.]
’Okay, I’ll check it.’ Zhang Fei then spoke to Luo Yunxiao. "I still want to accompany you here, but I want to confirm something important, so I will take you to my training space."
"Let’s go! I want to meet all your new wives." Luo Yunxiao immediately informed her parents about it, or they would be confused looking for her, especially her mother.
"Which of them are your new wives?" Luo Yunxiao pointed to the many people who were still struggling to move in the middle of the training space.
"Wait a second." Zhang Fei immediately moved to the center of the room, picked up five women, and brought them before Luo Yunxiao. "Catch your breath first."

The five women nodded to Zhang Fei, who immediately introduced them to Luo Yunxiao one by one. They were Leng Xueyan, Shangguan Yan, Duanmu Luolan, Qian Shuang, and Wei Xiaoya, especially since she had met the others at the Star Tower back then.
Luo Yunxiao nodded in understanding as she smiled at them. "Nice to meet you, Sisters. My name is Luo Yunxiao, and I am his childhood lover, but I will be his wife soon."

Since they had lived with Zhang Fei for a long time in the pavilion and become his wives, Duanmu Luolan and the others naturally already knew about Luo Yunxiao. However, they did not expect that she was so beautiful, and they felt that she was the most beautiful among all his wives.
"Nice to meet you too, Sister Yunxiao." They spoke in unison.

Zhang Fei then spoke to her again. "Yunxiao, Shangguan Yan is a domain master, and she’s the one who taught me to create my domain. If it weren’t for her, I wouldn’t have been able to create my domain, let alone create so many. Duanmu Luolan is an array master, and she has already reached rank 9. Leng Xueyan is an alchemist, and her rank is on the God Rank. Qin Shuang is an elf, and her healing abilities are truly impressive; even Ru Xue’s healing abilities are slightly below hers. Wei Qiaoya is a bit unique because she is a reincarnator like Feng Yao, and she used to be an earthling with a knack for business."
"I see." Luo Yunxiao nodded in satisfaction after hearing their abilities. "As I recall, there was a female blacksmith by your side, right?"

"Shi Xi is a saint-rank blacksmith like me now, and her metal element has always been very helpful to us." Zhang Fei then led them into the pavilion. "By the way, I married them all two weeks ago, and I married them at the same time."
"Haha." Luo Yunxiao laughed at that. "In this universe, you are probably the only man with hundreds of wives, and our number will probably continue to grow if you don’t control your lust."

After they arrived at the pavilion, Zhang Fei asked all his women to gather in the main garden, and he also summoned some of his women who were in the beast space, such as Feng Yichen, Feng Qingmeng, and many others.
"Hmm?" Luo Yunxiao’s attention immediately fell on Jia Yuyan. "A fairy from the Floral Mirage Domain, right?"
Jia Yuyan nodded at her. "The fairy king sent me to the Three Mortal Realms to look for the successor of the ten-tailed fox, and we met in the Sovereign Heaven Realm."

"Your fairy king is not a good person." Jia Yuyan raised an eyebrow as soon as Luo Yunxiao said that. "I have an acquaintance from the fairy race, and she ran away from your domain because of him. Actually, she’s not the only one, but there are still many members of your race who choose to move to another domain. If you are considering returning there, I would advise against it. If you force yourself to go back there, you’ll bring great trouble to all of us, especially since he’ll capture you. If that happens, our husband definitely won’t stand idly by, and he’ll immediately go there to rescue you."
"I know." Jia Yuyan then asked her. "Do you know what really happened there?"

"No," Luo Yunxiao shook her head in response. "My acquaintance didn’t want to tell me about it, and she preferred to forget about her life in that domain. If you want to know the real situation, you should contact your family, who may still live there."

Jia Yuyan nodded in understanding. "Honestly, I planned to go out and contact my family, but I’m sure the fairy king will immediately notice my return, and he’ll probably send his subordinates to capture me. Therefore, I chose to cancel my intention and wait for Zhang Fei to be ready to explore the Paradise Realm."
"You have made the right decision." Luo Yunxiao gave a light nod.

"Who is your acquaintance? You don’t have many friends, right?" Luo Yunxiao pursed her lips and lightly punched Zhang Fei’s chest. "Haha! Old Ma told me that your parents deliberately hid your existence from the public, and only people from the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary know about you."

Luo Yunxiao released a soft sigh. "My parents decided to hide me from the public because they were worried that people would find out about my special physique, which used to belong to the ten-tailed fox. Anyways, the acquaintance I’m referring to is my master, Beiming Youhuang. Her real name is Jia You, but she changed her name to that, and she used a special method to transform herself into a full human."

"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding, recalling that the system had previously detected Wan Jiang as a human, and he only learned that the old man belonged to a fairy race after Jia Yuyan informed him. "By the way, I wanted to tell you guys about the new thing that changed in this place, and—."
"And the flow of time in this place follows the flow of time in the Paradise Realm, right?" Liu Hua immediately added.

"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded at her. "I noticed the changes after arriving in the Celestial Realm, but I was busy with my breakthrough. I wanted to tell you all now, but I didn’t expect you to notice it first. I didn’t expect it myself, but this change is beneficial for us, especially since the flow of time has become four times faster than in that realm. The downside is that the flow of time in this place has started to affect our lifespan, so we will age much faster, but I don’t think it’s a problem for us. With the fast flow of time and Celestial Qi, we will become stronger much faster, and our lifespan will also be much longer."

"Hahaha." Boitata suddenly laughed. "Husband, with our current cultivation, we can live for several thousand years. Moreover, we are close to breaking through to the Seven Divine Realms, and we can live for tens of thousands of years after that. Additionally, we have you, so we don’t have to worry about our lifespan, right?"

"Boitata is right." Liu Qingyu then turned to Luo Yunxiao. "Since the flow of time in this place has become four times faster than in the Paradise Realm, she no longer needs to stay in the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, and she has to stay with us here."
Luo Yunxiao smiled at that. "I will marry Zhang Fei soon, and a wife should follow her husband wherever he goes. Even without the flow of time that fast, I will definitely stay here with all of you."
"So, when are you two getting married?" Zhong Yan asked.

"My mother is preparing everything now, so we still have to wait a while. All of you must be present at our wedding, okay?" They immediately agreed with Luo Yunxiao. "I still want to talk to you all, but I still miss our husband, so I hope you’ll be willing to lend him to me for a while."
"Big Sis Goddess! You don’t need to ask our permission!" Wu Lianzhi then pointed to the main room. "You can take him there and spend time together."
Luo Yunxiao approached Wu Lianzhi and rubbed her head. "You are also married to him, right? Since we are his wife, you should address me as Sister Yunxiao, okay?"
"Hehe." Wu Lianzhi giggled as she nodded. "Go on, Sister Yunxiao. We won’t disturb you two, and we will focus on our cultivation."
"Yes." Luo Yunxiao immediately took Zhang Fei’s hand and hurriedly took him to the main bedroom.

After that, the women returned to their respective rooms and began their cultivation again, except for Duanmu Luolan, Shangguan Yan, Qian Shuang, Wei Xiaoya, and Leng Xueyan, who returned to the training ground.
Luo Yunxiao was already sitting at the foot of the bed, but she felt something strange about it. "Where did you get this bed? This bed isn’t the one from Earth, right?"

"No." Zhang Fei sat beside Luo Yunxiao and held her hand. "I don’t want to hide it from you, but I can’t reveal its origin right now. This bed is the Yin-Yang Union Bed, and its effect is to increase the amount of Yin and Yang Qi by twofold, so we usually dual cultivate here."

Luo Yunxiao immediately stood up and faced Zhang Fei. "Fei, you know I’m not a fool, right? This training space, the bed, and everything you own are gifts from the little girl who killed you, right? Moreover, everything is much more advanced than any item in this universe, so I can guess that she is not an ordinary woman, and she gave you something special, which can give you all these items, right?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei pulled Luo Yunxiao onto his lap. "You’re absolutely right about that, and the little girl gave me something special. However, I can’t show it to you because it’s inside me, and I can’t take it out."
"Forget it! I don’t want to talk about it anymore, and I’d rather spend my time with you." Luo Yunxiao hugged his neck again. "Do you want to do it with me?"

This training space, the bed, and everything you own are gifts from the little girl who killed you, right?

Moreover, everything is much more advanced than any item in this universe, so I can guess that she is not an ordinary woman, and she gave you something special, which can give you all these items, right?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei pulled Luo Yunxiao onto his lap.
"You’re absolutely right about that, and the little girl gave me something special.
However, I can’t show it to you because it’s inside me, and I can’t take it out."
"Forget it!
I don’t want to talk about it anymore, and I’d rather spend my time with you." Luo Yunxiao hugged his neck again.
"Do you want to do it with me?"

paragraphs: "Naturally, I want to do it with you, but I don’t want to do it now." Zhang Fei then pulled Luo Yunxiao to the middle of the bed, released his soul, and imparted the soul technique to her. "I’ll teach you a few things first, especially since they’ll be useful to you. "Hehe." Luo Yunxiao giggled as she released her soul. "I don’t need to read it, and you don’t need to teach me to create it."
"Eh?" Zhang Fei was surprised. "Did you understand the technique right away?"

Luo Yunxiao nodded at him. "Honestly, I don’t know how my mind does that, but everything that enters my mind is imprinted in it instantly, and I can understand everything without needing to read them. I will prove it to you by forming my black lotus by myself."

"Yeah." Zhang Fei kept staring at Luo Yunxiao, who had already closed her eyes and begun the process of forming the black lotus. ’How much of a genius is she really? How could she grasp the technique as soon as I imparted it to her?’
[Evan Zhang Lin and Xu Ling’er’s talents cannot be compared with Luo Yunxiao’s, Master.]
Zhang Fei nodded in agreement with Mei. ’This universe is so vast with many dragons hidden within it, and many of them have talents that are no less extraordinary than Luo Yunxiao’s.’

In less than ten minutes, Luo Yunxiao had already created her black lotus and looked at Zhang Fei, who was dazed by the black lotus in her soul. She pounced on him and kissed him, bringing him back to his senses. "What do you think? Am I amazing?"

"You are awesome!" Zhang Fei cupped her cheeks. "I’ve met quite a few geniuses before, but I’ve never met one as genius as you before. Ling’er is a genius, and she created her black lotus faster than I did, but she took longer to create it than you."
Luo Yunxiao smiled in response. "So, what other techniques do you want to teach me?"

Zhang Fei immediately shared several techniques with Luo Yunxiao, such as the Scarlet Furnace Body Method and the Heavenly Lightning Body Cultivation Technique, particularly because she possessed both elements. She still has the ice element, but he didn’t have an ice body cultivation technique. He also shared the Indestructible Vajra Immortal Body, the Flawless Yin-Yang Arts, and the Yin-Yang Avatar Technique with her.

"I can master both dual cultivation techniques easily, but I need to take my time to master all three body cultivation techniques, especially since they require special training." Luo Yunxiao then did something that caused Zhang Fei to be stunned once again, especially since she directly created her avatar. "Your avatar technique is excellent, but we can only create one avatar, so I think it’s not optimal. Instead, you can use my avatar technique, and you’ll like its effects, even if you can’t use it in combat."
[You have obtained the Nine Heavens Illusory Avatar Technique. Grade: Immortal.]
Zhang Fei abruptly sat down as soon as Luo Yunxiao shared her avatar technique with him, mainly because of its grade. "An immortal-grade technique."

"Hehe." Luo Yunxiao giggled as she summoned another nine avatars using her technique, which amazed him. "All my family members learned that technique, but not all of them could create too many illusory avatars. My father could only create five, and my mother managed to create four. Meanwhile, my two brothers and sisters-in-law only managed to create one or three, so their cultivation was far behind mine, even though they got the same resources as me."
"I see." Zhang Fei immediately crossed his legs. "I’ll learn it first."

[The Nine Heavens Illusory Body Technique: It allows cultivators to create up to nine simultaneous illusory avatars; even divine sense struggles to distinguish real from false. These avatars are not just afterimages but semi-tangible manifestations composed of spirit essence and illusion laws drawn from the Nine Heavens, and the qi absorbed by them will be directly channeled into the real body. The downside is that the user must be next to the avatars and stay still, or the avatars will disappear by themselves.]

’No technique is perfect, and each has its own downside.’ Zhang Fei and his five clones immediately started learning the technique. ’This technique is quite complicated compared to the Yin-Yang Avatar Technique, but it’s not a big deal for me.’

Luo Yunxiao hugged both of her legs, placed her head on her knees, and looked at Zhang Fei’s serious expression with a full smile. ’He hasn’t changed, and he’s always been serious in doing everything since we were little.’
After some time passed, Zhang Fei began summoning his avatar, which made Luo Yunxiao smile proudly, especially since he managed to create nine at once.

Zhang Fei did not open his eyes immediately; instead, he used his nine illusory avatars to cultivate. He could immediately feel the flow of qi entering his body as soon as they started cultivating, and the flow became faster every time they accelerated their absorption rate.

Zhang Fei was satisfied with the results, and he opened his eyes without stopping his illusory avatars from cultivating. "Amazing! Your technique is truly amazing! Where did your family get the technique from?"

"One of our ancestors got it, and it has passed down in our family ever since." Zhang Fei nodded to Luo Yunxiao. "Naturally, we won’t teach it to outsiders, but you’ll be part of my family after we get married. Therefore, I gave it to you, and you can share it with them later. If they master the technique, their cultivation speed will accelerate even more, but the number of their illusory avatars will affect the result. If they manage to create nine illusory avatars like us, all of you will reach the Five Celestial Realms in no time."

"I will ask Ling’er here to study the technique, and you will be impressed by her." Zhang Fei immediately contacted Xu Ling’er and asked her to go to the room. "Have you ever tried cultivating using this avatar while sleeping?"
Luo Yunxiao was confused by his question. "Can you cultivate while you sleep?"

"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled. "The method is easy because we only need to seal our senses, and we will be completely cut off from the outside world. However, we can’t use it in public, or we will die if there are bad people around us."

"I see." Luo Yunxiao nodded in understanding. "To tell you the truth, I’ve thought about it, but I don’t think it’s feasible, considering that shutting off our senses prevents us from detecting our surroundings. Although I feel safe living in our sect, I still don’t feel comfortable with that idea, so I decided to forget about it."

"Danger can threaten us anywhere and at any time, including in our own home. However, you will be safe inside here, so you can try it later." Zhang Fei turned to Xu Ling’er, who had just walked in. "Come here, Ling’er. I will teach you a technique I just got from Yunxiao."
Xu Ling’er floated to the bed and sat in front of them. "The technique for creating these nine avatars, right, big brother?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei imparted the technique to her. "You can learn it now, and I’d like to see you create nine avatars like us."
"Uhm." Xu Ling’er hurriedly closed her eyes and excitedly learned the technique.
Luo Yunxiao immediately asked Zhang Fei, "Why did you marry this girl and Wu Lianzhi? They’re only thirteen and fourteen years old, right?"

"Haha." Zhang Fei rubbed his nose whenever he felt awkward, causing Luo Yunxiao to shake her head, as she knew his behavior by heart. "Actually, I didn’t want to marry them yet, but they insisted on marrying me, saving us time in the future. Even so, we haven’t done anything yet, and they still have to wait a few years to dual cultivate with me. So far, we only dual-soul cultivated, and they cultivated using my yang qi."
Luo Yunxiao directly faced Zhang Fei and held his hands, as did their two souls. "Let’s try dual-soul cultivation while waiting for Ling’er to finish."
"All right."

Meanwhile, Luo Fenghan, Ma Kuangyu, and Zhuang Qihong were gathered together. However, Fan Ning’s presence prevented them from speaking freely, especially since the old man kept urging them to tell him about Zhang Fei.

Luo Fenghan immediately spoke. "Senior Fan, I already told you that I won’t tell you anything about him, so I hope you return to your Fan Clan now, especially since we still have important matters to discuss. If you want to know about him, you should meet Empress Huo at the Flame Spirit Citadel and ask her directly, especially since he is her future husband."

"Tch! Sect Master Luo, you are asking me to commit suicide if you ask me to see Empress Huo, and she will roast me alive." Fan Ning let out a heavy sigh and rose from his seat. "Since you’re not willing to say anything, I won’t force you anymore, and I’ll go back now."

Luo Fenghan could only shake his head as he watched Fan Ning leave. "What are your plans next, Kuangyu? If you want, I can take you there, and I’ll prepare the ingredients. This way, you can reshape your body, and you can also take revenge on those people."

"No need," Ma Kuangyu politely declined. "I’m in no rush, and I still want to keep an eye on Zhang Fei. That kid is smart, but he’s often careless, which makes me and Nalan Yuzhu often remind him. Moreover, he met a strong opponent before he left here, and that person seems to be constantly monitoring him."
Luo Fengan raised an eyebrow. "Who is the strongest opponent you mean?"

"A woman from the Ancient Nether Clan." Luo Fenghan and Zhuang Qihong’s expressions turned serious after Ma Kuangyu mentioned that, and he explained to them about the meeting between Zhang Fei and the mysterious woman. "For now, we don’t have clear information about the woman’s purpose in doing all that to those people, especially since she altered their memories. Feng Yao previously told him that she had threatened her, but I have a feeling that they will meet again soon, so I decided to stay in his tiny soul world for now. Once he can be independent in this realm, I will immediately go to that place together with Nalan Yushu, and we will reshape our bodies at that time."

Luo Fenghan nodded in understanding. "Since you have made that decision, I will follow your plan, and I will try to dig up more information on the Spirit Temple. However, I did not expect that Zhang Fei had connections with a woman from the Soul-Devouring Demon clan, but he himself is a demon, so their relationship should be able to bring benefits to him."

"Haha." Ma Kuangyu laughed at that. "That kid is quite cunning, and he never hesitates to use anyone for his benefit. He actually has many slaves and prisoners, and most of them are powerhouses in the Three Mortal Realms. I still don’t know whether he will bring them here or not, but he has already planned to bring a lot of people, many of whom are from natural and beast races."

"I’m not surprised if he enslaves his enemies, but what do you mean by ’his prisoners’?" Ma Kuangyu immediately told the two about Zhang Fei’s slaves. "So, he can repeatedly break through several stages at once because of their Yin Qi?"

Ma Kuangyu nodded at them. "Apart from his prisoner, that kid repeatedly used his demon abilities to absorb the cultivation of other cultivators, which boosted his cultivation. If he didn’t do it, he wouldn’t have reached the Seven Divine Realms now. Back then, he was almost unrestrained in using those two abilities, but he rarely uses them now, especially since he realized the bad effects."
"That kid is crazy." Luo Fenghan sighed.
Ma Kuangyu then asked Zhuang Qihong. "Are my Ma Clan members still living there now?"

"Yes." Zhuang Qihong immediately told him. "The Gongsung Clan and the others have been constantly monitoring the movements of all your clan members, and they have threatened to kill any of them who dare to leave our domain, causing them to live like prisoners within the clan. Some of them managed to escape after news of your death reached them, but I don’t know their current whereabouts."

"It’s fortunate that some of them managed to escape, ensuring that my Ma Clan will survive even if those traitors kill the others." Even though he was frustrated, Ma Kuangyu remained calm in the face of reality. "Old Zhuang, please send people from your clan to track their whereabouts, especially since I have plans for them. However, I need Zhang Fei’s help with that, so I’ll talk to him first later."

Zhuang Qihong did not delay and contacted several people from his clan, ordering them to carry out Ma Kuangyu’s request. However, he didn’t tell them about his return, and he chose to wait for him to reshape his body first.
After that, the three men discussed other matters, which of course had to do with the Spirit Temple and their cronies.

In another area of the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, Beiming Youhuang sat leisurely on a chair, but her gaze kept drifting to the five women who were busy discussing Zhang Fei and Luo Yunxiao’s marriage. ’His big sister has the ice phoenix bloodline, and his little sister has the water dragon bloodline. However, she also has another beast bloodline besides her water dragon bloodline, but I can’t recognize its type. Moreover, I can feel the demon aura from her, so I’m sure her second beast bloodline is a demon beast’s bloodline.’
"Where did Zhang Fei take my daughter to?" Huang Xiaoyi suddenly asked.

"Hehe." Zhang Lin giggled. "Aunt Huang, you don’t need to worry about Sister Yunxiao because my brother took her to his training space, and he is teaching her some things, especially matters regarding dual cultivation."

Huang Xiaoyi nodded in understanding. "Honestly, I still find it hard to believe that Zhang Fei could be such a pervert, especially since he was so innocent when he was little. Not only did he have over a hundred women, but he also took three of you as his wives. Luckily, he didn’t take Aunt Chen as his wife too; otherwise, your family relationship would be completely messed up."

"Fei’er doesn’t have that kind of feeling for me, and she always regards me as her grandmother." Zhang Chen then turned to Qing Yi. "At first, he hated Yi’er because he followed Hai’er’s decision to disown him, and they met again at the time when his lust demon nature was not yet under control. In the end, he used his demon abilities on her, and she became his wife now."

"As for me, I’ve loved my big brother since we were little, and we often kissed back then. However, we hid our feelings from others, especially since we were biological siblings. Things changed after he turned into a lust demon, and I chose not to hold back my feelings anymore." Zhang Lin then embraced Zhang Yue. "Big Sis has also loved him for a long time, but she’s not as bold as me, and she never shows her feelings. Even so, I’ve long known about her feelings, and I forced Big Brother to take her as his wife too."

Zhang Yue was embarrassed when Huang Xiaoyi looked at her with a strange gaze. "You never change, Yue’er. In fact, you’re quieter than before, and that seems to be due to the influence of your ice phoenix bloodline. I’m not surprised that Lin’er has such a feeling for Zhang Fei, especially since their closeness since childhood was already unusual. However, I never expected that you also developed feelings for him, let alone be his wife."

"Aunt Huang, you should still remember Fei’er’s character when she was little, right?" Huang Xiaoyi nodded to Zhang Yue, who explained to her the beginning of his feelings for Zhang Fei and her decision to become his wife. "I no longer care about other people’s opinions, and I’m happy to be his wife."
"As long as you are happy with your decision, you don’t need to worry about other people’s opinions." Huang Xiaoyi then asked Zhang Chen. "When should we hold their wedding, Aunt Chen?"

"Big Sis has also loved him for a long time, but she’s not as bold as me, and she never shows her feelings.
Even so, I’ve long known about her feelings, and I forced Big Brother to take her as his wife too."
Zhang Yue was embarrassed when Huang Xiaoyi looked at her with a strange gaze.
"You never change, Yue’er.
In fact, you’re quieter than before, and that seems to be due to the influence of your ice phoenix bloodline.
I’m not surprised that Lin’er has such a feeling for Zhang Fei, especially since their closeness since childhood was already unusual.
However, I never expected that you also developed feelings for him, let alone be his wife."

"Aunt Huang, you should still remember Fei’er’s character when she was little, right?" Huang Xiaoyi nodded to Zhang Yue, who explained to her the beginning of his feelings for Zhang Fei and her decision to become his wife.
"I no longer care about other people’s opinions, and I’m happy to be his wife."
"As long as you are happy with your decision, you don’t need to worry about other people’s opinions." Huang Xiaoyi then asked Zhang Chen.
"When should we hold their wedding, Aunt Chen?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1059: Sects And Clans
paragraphs: After they finished discussing Zhang Fei and Luo Yunxiao’s wedding date, Huang Xiaoyi asked a servant to escort the three women to the guest rooms.
Beiming Youhuang immediately approached her. "Are you really going to let Yunxiao marry him?"

"Haven’t you seen his abilities for yourself? Do you think there is a man who can match him?" Huang Xiaoyi turned the question around. "You’ve known my daughter for a long time, so you should be able to see that she only loves him. Since we brought her back to this realm, she has never stopped thinking about him, and her feelings for him have deepened as she has grown up. Although my husband and I dislike his status as a dual cultivator with multiple wives, our daughter’s happiness is most important to us; thus, we decided to let them get married."
Beiming Youhuang nodded in understanding before turning to leave. "Tell Yunxiao that I will be away for some time."

"I’ll tell her as soon as she comes back." Huang Xiaoyi released a soft sigh after Beiming Youhuang left. "She must want to go to the Star Tower to find out information about Zhang Fei from Wan Jiang."

Zhang Fei and Luo Yunxiao decided to stop dual-soul cultivating once they sensed the changes in Xu Ling’er, and they saw that she had successfully created not just one but nine illusory avatars of her, just like them.

"Haha." Luo Yunxiao laughed after seeing Xu Ling’er’s nine avatars. "Ling’er, Fei was right that you’re a genius, and my brothers will be embarrassed by your avatars! They’ve tried for hundreds of years, but they only managed to create two and three, respectively. You were only 13 years old and tried it once, but you managed to create nine of them."

"Big Sis, they’ve never trained in the training space like me, and the comprehension feature not only helps me learn many techniques, but it also improves my basic understanding. If they had trained here, they would definitely have succeeded in creating nine like us." Xu Ling’er then canceled her technique and got out of bed. "You two have been apart for too long, so I won’t bother you guys any longer. I’m going out now, and I’ll teach the technique to the others."

"Yunxiao, I want to try something, and my soul level will be able to reach the divine soul level sooner if the results are as I hope." Zhang Fei then explained his plans to use his nine illusory avatars for dual soul cultivation to Luo Yunxiao. "I know that’s too extreme, but it’s not a problem for me, so I want to try it now."

Luo Yunxiao nodded in agreement. "I don’t dare to do something like that because my overall soul power is not yet as strong as yours, even though my soul level has long reached the divine soul level; instead, I will use my soul power to help you."

"Let’s do it, Yunxiao." After using his nine illusory avatars to absorb celestial qi from the air into his body and soul, Zhang Fei channeled it into his soul, including the hundreds of white lotuses within it.
At the same time, Luo Yunxiao channeled her Yin Qi into Zhang Fei’s body and her soul power into his soul, filling his body and soul with Qi.
Those white lotuses rotated in place and absorbed Zhang Fei and Luo Yunxiao’s Qi, and their rotation gradually became really fast, creating a big Yin-Yang diagram above them.

Luo Yunxiao looked up at the Yin-Yang diagram in amazement. ’His soul technique is truly amazing! Every white lotus in his soul continues to strengthen it, and his soul power far surpasses that of experienced soul cultivators. Perhaps Senior Hun Lingwu would be interested in recruiting him as his disciple, but that old man isn’t that nice, and he might be jealous of him. After this, I’ll tell him many things, especially about the forces in this realm.’

An hour later, Zhang Fei stopped his activities and opened his eyes again. "As expected! The effect becomes even more significant if I cultivate my soul at the same time as my nine avatars absorb the celestial Qi, so I will continue to use this method every time I dual-soul cultivate with them."
"Do you often dual-soul cultivate with several of them at once?"

Zhang Fei responded to Luo Yunxiao by transforming into his half-fox form and splitting his eight tails into dozens of tails, which left her speechless. "I can’t do it with my human form, but I can use this method in my half-fox or demon form. This way, we don’t have to waste too much time, and I can help all of them while increasing my soul power at the same time."

"I see." Luo Yunxiao nodded in understanding. "No wonder most of them have comparable soul power, and only those senior cultivators have higher soul power than theirs. Then, why is a pervert like you still not eating them?"
"Hahaha," Zhang Fei laughed and playfully pounced on Luo Yunxiao. "How dare you call your husband a pervert? Do you want to experience the punishment?"
Instead, Luo Yunxiao wore a flirtatious smile and wrapped her arms around his neck. "I wonder how you will punish me, my dear husband."
"Who taught you to be this flirtatious?"
"No one."

"I don’t believe you!" Zhang Fei shook his head at Luo Yunxiao. "Tell me, who taught you? Beiming Youhuang is not such a person, so I’m sure someone else taught you to act coquettishly. Otherwise, I will punish you with my deadly tickles."
"Ahh!" Luo Yunxiao screamed as soon as he started tickling her. "Hahaha! Ahhh! No! Stop it, husband! You’re going to tickle me to death!"
"Now tell me."

"Ahh! Stop! Hahah! I’m telling you the truth! No one taught me!" Luo Yunxiao pouted her lips as soon as Zhang Fei stopped. "Have you forgotten that I’ve been like this since we were kids? Have you forgotten that I used to tease you a lot?"

"Naturally, I remember all that because my memory was sharp even before I became a cultivator, and I just want to tickle you like before." Zhang Fei then cancelled his nine avatars, laid down beside her, and hugged her. "Tell me about your domain, Yunxiao. How many major powers are there? How many sects and major clans?"

"Right now, our Immortal Lotus Sanctuary is the best sect and the leader of this domain, and there are five other major sects beside us: the Nine Sword Hall, the Azure Immortal Peak, the Hidden Moon Sect, the Star Cloud Pavilion, and the Eternal Heaven Sect, all of which are supreme-grade sects."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow slightly because some of the sect names were overbearing. "Don’t tell me the Hidden Moon Sect is a female sect."
Luo Yunxiao glared at him. "Are you thinking of going to that sect and seducing the women there?"

"Haha," Zhang Fei awkwardly laughed. "I’m just asking, okay? Even though I have over a hundred women, not all of them can catch my eye. Otherwise, I’d have thousands, or even tens of thousands, right?"

"You’re right, the Hidden Moon Sect is a women-only sect, and they’re located in the eastern region." Luo Yunxiao nodded and continued her explanation. "In addition to that sect, there are many other sects in the eastern region; the same applies to other regions, which we have categorized into three grades. The Azure Immortal Peak is located in the northernmost area of this domain, where its members reside at the summit of the highest mountain, pursuing the Dao. The Nine Sword Hall is located in the southern region, and they are completely focused on the sword path. The Eternal Heaven Sect is located in the western region, and the sect is surrounded by deep valleys and ravines. Meanwhile, the Star Cloud Pavilion is located in the central region, and it is more universal than the other sects. Actually, the sect also has an academy for young cultivators, and the clans in this realm send their younger generations there to learn many things, starting from the age of 6."
"What is the focus of the Eternal Heaven Sect and the Hidden Moon Sect?"

"Many people believe that those from the Eternal Heaven Sect can learn and understand the secrets of heaven, and many go there to learn them." Zhang Fei himself did not believe that anyone could understand the secrets of heaven even if they had comprehended the Dao. "My father said that was nonsense because no one could understand the secrets of heaven, but the people in this domain believed in their abilities."

Zhang Fei nodded in agreement with that. "Honestly, I agree with your father, but I don’t underestimate them because there are many mysterious things in the world of cultivation. Perhaps they do have the ability to learn and understand them, but it is difficult to prove the truth because I myself don’t know the secrets of heaven, even though I have understood the dao."
"Have you truly comprehended the Dao?" Luo Yunxiao asked in surprise.

"I have only grasped the initial phase. The Dao is much deeper and more mysterious than people, including myself, tend to imagine." Zhang Fei told Luo Yunxiao directly about the tests in the Sovereign Heaven Realm, which surprised her. "Actually, understanding it isn’t as difficult as people think, but pursuing the true Dao isn’t as simple as breathing, and we must grasp its essence. I can’t explain the feeling after understanding it, but it brought about many changes in me. If you want, I will bring you to that realm, and you can try to understand the Dao there. With the speed at which you learn things, I’m sure it won’t take you long to understand the initial phase."

Luo Yunxiao thought about it seriously for quite some time. "In that case, I will go to that realm, but we will go there after our wedding. As for the Hidden Moon Sect, they focus more on everything related to Yin. In fact, they sell many items related to it, including their Yin Qi."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei was surprised to hear that. "You do realize that Yin is always associated with evil, right? Indeed, not all of them are evil, but many of them are."

"That’s true." Luo Yunxiao nodded in agreement. "Even though they focus on everything related to Yin, they are not heretics. In fact, they are the best assassins in this domain, and they are widely recognized by cultivators from other domains. Despite their profession, they always uphold righteousness and never kill innocent people. Whenever they receive a mission request, they will investigate their target’s background first, and they will refuse if their target turns out to have a clean background."
A broad smile appeared on Zhang Fei’s face after Luo Yunxiao said everything, causing her to raise her eyebrows.
"Ouch! Ouch!" Zhang Fei screamed in pain because Luo Yunxiao suddenly pinched his waist while glaring at him. "Ouch! Let me go, wife!"
Luo Yunxiao squinted her eyes and pinched his waist harder. "Tell me, what are you thinking? Why are you smiling to yourself after hearing about them?"

"Ouch! Wife! I have an assassin organization, okay?" Luo Yunxiao was taken aback, prompting Zhang Fei to explain to her about his organization. "The founder of the organization was Liu Hua, and she founded it to accommodate women who were victims of violence, either directly or indirectly. Wen Xuan and Wen Yuan took care of the organization after she fell under Pang Hong’s control, and I freed her from him when I came to the Sky Jade Realm the first time. After that, she changed the name to the Demon Fox Group because I was a demon and a fox, but I never took care of them directly, and the Wen Twins did it for me."
"How many members does your organization have now?"

"At first, there were around a hundred, but their number has reached thousands now." Luo Yunxiao then asked Zhang Fei another question. "I had planned to bring them to this realm, but I won’t do it anytime soon. I’ll probably bring them here after my cultivation reaches the Five Celestial Realms."

Luo Yunxiao nodded in understanding. "However, they will be too weak if you wait until your cultivation reaches the Five Celestial Realms to bring them to this realm, and they will be useless to you. Although this realm has many cultivators in the Seven Divine Realms, they are significantly stronger than those from the Three Mortal Realms. Additionally, the number of cultivators in the Five Celestial Realms is large; therefore, you need to consider an alternative method to bring them here as soon as possible. If they cultivate in this realm much earlier, they will be much more useful to you, and they can help you face your enemies here."

"Yeah, you’re right," Zhang Fei then continued. "Since the Hidden Moon Sect has an assassination organization, I’m afraid that our organizations will clash with each other in the future. Therefore, I will meet them before I deploy my organization’s members, and I want to persuade them to join me. However, it won’t be easy, especially since they are both experienced and native cultivators of this realm. If I’m careless, they will attack and annihilate my organization."
Luo Yunxiao smiled at that. "They won’t dare to touch you or your organization if they know you’re the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary’s son-in-law, so you don’t need to worry too much about them."

"You know I’m not that kind of person, right?" Zhang Fei gave her a kiss. "Even though I need a powerful backer in this realm, I will never bring up the name of the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary in my personal matters. Instead, I want to build my own force with the Demon Fox Group as its foundation, and if I can do that, people will hear my name and respect me."
"Yeah."
"Then, what about those clans? Who were the senior cultivators who came when I broke through before?"

Luo Yunxiao immediately provided an explanation to Zhang Fei. "Those four people are Fan Ning, Ru Yan, Zhi Yuan, and Chen Qi. They are one of the ancestors of the Fan, Ru, Zhi, and Chi main clans. They rarely appear in public, but your breakthrough was too frightening, forcing them to come out. Apart from those four clans and my Luo Clan, there are still two other major clans, the Qin and Jiang clans, but their ancestors did not appear before. The last person is Zhuang Qihong, and he seems to be a close friend of Uncle Ma. I don’t know much about him, so you can ask him directly about him. By the way, each clan leads ten second-grade clans, but you don’t need to care about them."

"I see." Zhang Fei then asked her again. "Are there alchemists from all those clans and sects? I plan to open my shop in this domain to collect cultivation resources more quickly, and I don’t want to have any contact with them."

"The Star Cloud Pavilion has a god-rank alchemist, and his alchemy skills are truly amazing." Zhang Fei wasn’t surprised to hear that from Luo Yunxiao, especially since Lin Jingxia was able to reach the god-rank despite living in the Three Mortal Realms, let alone a cultivator from the Paradise Realm. "Even so, Senior Bu Guo doesn’t open an alchemy shop, and people come to the sect to buy his pills. Apart from him, the Ru and Chi clans also have alchemists, and if I remember correctly, their ranks are at the celestial rank. Those two people have shops in every region, but my father doesn’t allow them to open a shop in our place."
"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled. "In that case, I will set up my first shop in the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, and I will collect jewels from the disciples."

"Since I’ve never left this domain, I don’t know much about other domains. If you want to get information about them, you can go to your parents, and they’ll definitely have a lot of information for you." Luo Yunxiao then lay prone on top of Zhang Fei. "For now, I want to enjoy my time with you, so we’ll stop talking about them now."
Zhang Fei smiled and cupped Luo Yunxiao’s face before kissing her, which she immediately reciprocated.

Zhang Fei hugged Luo Yunxiao and rubbed her head.
"Be patient, okay?
You’ve been waiting for me for hundreds of years, so a month is nothing, and our wedding day will arrive before we know it."
"Uhm." Luo Yunxiao nodded in response before getting up and moving to Zhang Lin’s side.
"Fei, go to your other women and help them learn the Nine Heavens Illusory Avatar Technique.
Meanwhile, I will learn the technique you gave me before, so my body will be stronger before our wedding."
"All right, you can learn those techniques, and I will go see them now."
Luo Yunxiao released a soft sigh once Zhang Fei left, but she was also amused to see him leaving naked.
"What a pervert husband!
Sigh!
I have to learn body techniques as soon as possible, or I’ll be exhausted on our wedding night."
After leaving his bedroom, Zhang Fei went straight to Ru Xue’s room, but he found her seriously studying the technique with Wu Lianzhi and Tasha, while Xu Ling’er assisted them in learning it.
Zhang Fei then visited all his women’s rooms, taught them the technique, and asked them to learn it first.
His four clones also taught it to their respective partners, but since his third clone was still in the Sovereign Heaven Realm, he went to his two partners and taught them.
Zhang Fei did not return to his bedroom and went to the main garden, where he focused on learning techniques that he had not had the chance to learn before.
[Master, you are too busy with them, and you haven’t opened the three rewards from the tower quest.]
’Open them, Mei.’

paragraphs: [You obtained the Stellar Shell Amulet.]
[You obtained the Nine Nether Spirit Lotus.]
[You obtained the Crimson Yang Flower.]
Zhang Fei momentarily raised an eyebrow. ’Show their description, Mei.’
[Yes, Master.]
[The Stellar Shell Amulet: A passive artifact that absorbs one full fatal strike, it will shatter afterward and must be recharged under starlight. Limit: once per month.]

[The Nine Nether Spirit Lotus: The Nine Nether Spirit Lotus once bloomed from the blood of a fallen Demon God betrayed by his race. Legend says the lotus carries his wrath, grudge, and resentment, granting unspeakable power to those willing to abandon light and walk the path of forbidden transcendence. Grade: Unknown.]

[The Crimson Yang Flower: A blazing flower with ten crimson petals, each edged with molten gold. According to the legend, it radiates intense yang Qi and contains a single drop of liquid flame known as the True Yang Liquid. Limit: one-time use. Effect: Boost a male Yang Qi for a long period. Downside: The ’flame’ is difficult to extinguish, and the man will burn to death if it is not extinguished.]

Zhang Fei immediately took the first item, which was a shell sparkling like a star. He observed it for a moment before putting it back into the inventory, and he took out the third item. ’The ’flame’ is no different from lust, right? How long is a long period? Days? Months? Or years?’

[Master, your wedding with Luo Yunxiao is in a month, so I think you should wait until then to consume this flower. This way, she will benefit too, and you can use that time to take the virginity of those who have reached the Seven Divine Realms.]

Zhang Fei himself had planned to take their virginity after his second clone arrived in the Paradise Realm, but he was busy with Luo Yunxiao and his breakthrough. Since everything was done, he intended to do so with those who had already broken through to the Seven Divine Realms, such as Xian Xianqin, Zhou Shenxin, Ling Long, Shang Yaolin, Shang Yumei, and several others, while also helping his other women.

Zhang Fei returned the flower to the inventory, but he was a little hesitant to take the Nine Nether Spirit Lotus, especially since it contained a fallen demon god’s wrath, grudge, and resentment. However, he was also curious about it, and he suspected that the fallen demon god came from the Nine Nether Demon Race, mainly because of the name of the item.

Zhang Fei decided to ask Nalan Yushu, who lives in his tiny soul world. ’Do you know anything about the Nine Nether Spirit Lotus? Has there ever been a demon god from the Nine Nether Demon Race who has fallen?’

’Master, I don’t know anything about the Nine Nether Spirit Lotus, but I’ve heard of a fallen demon god from that demon race. The fallen demon god was Jiu Mozu, and he was their leader from three generations above their current leader. According to legend, he was the strongest demon god ever born in the Nine Nether Demon Race, and his past strength was equivalent to the Celestial Demon God. I don’t know what really happened to his era or how he died, but rumors have been circulating for a long time that his race betrayed him, and only the demons of that race know the cause.’ Zhang Fei fell into deep thought after Nalan Yushu said all that. ’Why are you suddenly asking about that, Master?’

Zhang Fei decided to take out the Nine Nether Spirit Lotus, but a black thread of light immediately shot out from his chest, followed by nine more black threads of light that shot out from nine different rooms, all of which aimed at the black lotus in his hand.

Janette, Balena, Ilsath, Orith, Ursula, Yan Zhixiu, Angela, Eve, and Fyr immediately ran out of their room. They immediately approached Zhang Fei, especially since the black threads of light on their chests drew them to the Nine Nether Spirit Lotus.
"What’s wrong with this lotus, husband? Why do the demon seeds in our bodies react to it?" Angela asked.

Ursula squatted beside the lotus and touched it. "There is wrath, grudge, and resentment within this lotus, which attracts the attention of our demon seeds. Can you guys feel it? Our demon lotus is starting to absorb them from it."

"That’s true." Janette responded while nodding, as she felt the same way. However, she couldn’t feel any wrath, grudge, or resentment. Instead, she felt pure, powerful demon power flowing into her body, which slowly increased her demon power.
Balena then spoke. "These feelings give me a strange comfort."
"Me too." Ilsath and Orith nodded in agreement. "Where did you get this lotus?"
As always, Zhang Fei chose not to tell them anything, especially since he wasn’t ready to tell them about the system, making them sigh softly.
"Hey, Fei! We’ve become you and your clones’ wives, but you’re still being secretive with us." Fyr, the dark elf, complained.
Eve, the blood-sucking demon, nodded slightly. "Fei, please share the truth with us."

"One day, I will reveal everything to you, so please be patient until that time, okay?" Angela and the others sighed helplessly in response to Zhang Fei, and they immediately sat around the lotus while holding hands, speeding up the absorption of the demon seeds within their bodies. "I don’t know how long it will take or what will happen after we absorb the lotus’s negative feelings, but we can’t let our guard down, even though we don’t feel anything now. Otherwise, it will be a problem if they affect us."
"Yes."

Everyone else closed their eyes and focused, but Zhang Fei kept his eyes open and thought about the lotus. ’This is different from what I thought before, and I didn’t expect the ten demon seeds to react to this lotus. Moreover, they are absorbing the power within it equally, so their demon power will also increase after this.’

[Master, this lotus contains the ancient power of the Nine Nether Demon God, and it is too powerful for you in your current state. Perhaps this lotus will pave the way for you to break through to the advanced demon ranks, and if my guess is correct, your demon rank will immediately break through to the Demon Monarch Rank, and your demon power will increase significantly.]

Zhang Fei recalled his conversation with the late Primordial Demon in the era of the beginning about two and a half years ago. ’I think your guess is wrong, Mei. Back then, the primordial demon told me that I needed several items for my demon rank to break through to the advanced demon ranks, and he also shared the names of those items; however, this lotus was not among them. Therefore, this lotus can’t possibly help me find it, and I have to look for those items first.’

[Unfortunately, your cultivation is still at the 1-Moon Divine Expansion Realm, so you can’t go looking for them now, Master. Instead of worrying about those items, you should enter seclusion for a few years after your marriage to Luo Yunxiao. Once your cultivation breaks through to the Five Celestial Realms, you can travel freely in this realm, and you can look for them at that time.]

’Didn’t I already plan that? Otherwise, we wouldn’t be here and doing this, right? I do have ambitions to become strong, but I know which priorities are more important.’ Zhang Fei suddenly remembered something. ’I think I should go to Uncle Luo and Aunt Huang to ask if there’s a better place than the Life Pond in their domain, and I will move Zhang Xiaolong [3] from the Sovereign Heaven Realm to this realm.’
[Unfortunately, I haven’t detected any such place in the Empyrean Domain, Master. However, you can try asking them, and who knows, they might know of such a place in another domain.]
’Yeah, you’re right.’
Mei then reminded him of something. [Master, it’s been more than three months since Gu Changsheng created the Heart Gu, so he’s probably finished creating it by now.]
’Oh! That’s right! I’ll go see him now.’

Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was cultivating at the bottom of the life pond, immediately opened his eyes. After drying his body and getting dressed, he hurriedly left the place, but he didn’t go straight to the main city; instead, he checked the progress of the natural races, who were trained under Jin Zhongli’s guidance.

Two months had passed since they began their training, but their progress was too slow. Only a few of them could move slightly under the pressure of heavier gravity, such as Qian Chaoying, Ju Xing, and several others. Moreover, Jin Zhongli had not used all his abilities, and he had only increased his gravity by several times.
After that, Zhang Xiaolong [3] went to the Gu Clan to see Gu Changsheng, but the old man had not completed the Gu Heart, mainly because of the battle back then.
Gu Changsheng told Zhang Xiaolong [3] that the Gu Heart would be completed in a month or less, and he also told him about Tian Jingxuan and the others.

However, Zhang Xiaolong [3] already knew that the three old men did nothing after Tian Kui and Serpentera repeatedly thwarted their plans, and they had also told him about their plans regarding the two heavenly foxes, who were still struggling with their Dao test.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] then gave several teleportation portals to Gu Changsheng, and he asked the old man to send several members of his clan to realms that had not been visited by Feng Xishui to open his shop. Following this, he departed from the Gu Clan and went to a different location.
"How do you feel after transforming your divine Qi into Celestial Qi?" Serpentera asked Zhang Xiaolong [3] a question immediately after he appeared before him and Tian Kui.

"Amazing!" Zhang Xiaolong [3] clenched his fists. "At first, I didn’t feel any impact on my cultivation, but it felt much more amazing after I broke through to the 1-Moon Divine Expansion Realm, and my cultivation should be able to improve even faster if I continue cultivating using it."

"Hahaha." Tian Kui laughed at that. "Kid, you don’t need to worry about matters in these Three Mortal Realms, and we’ll take care of everything for you. Once you break through to the Five Celestial Realms, we’ll return to the Paradise Realm, and we’ll go on an adventure together there."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at him. "Honestly, I myself want to immediately go on an adventure in the Paradise Realm, especially since I need those five items to break through to the advanced demon ranks and become a demon monarch."
"You can find one here, right? The Abyssal Demon Heart, right?"

"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] sighed softly. "I’ve been waiting for the Abyssal Demon Heart to appear in the Wasteland Realm for a long time, but it still hasn’t appeared yet, and it looks like I’ll have to wait a few more years. I want to find one in the Paradise Realm, and I already have its location, but I have not dared to go there, especially since it’s in the Calamity Domain. The other four are the Infernal Blood Core, the Demon Essence Drop, the Demon Soul Elixir, and the Demon Ritual Sigil."

Tian Kui nodded in response. "That shouldn’t be difficult for you, right? You have Nalan Yushu by your side, and even though she’s only her soul now, she can still contact her demon race members. If she can contact them and ask them to search for those items, your demon rank could break through to the advanced ranks like ours sooner."

"You are too stupid, Old Kui! Nalan Yushu didn’t die without a reason, and that person even deliberately locked her soul in the Star Tower. If she comes out now, that person will definitely find out about her return, and that person will attack this kid." Serpentera then informed Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Actually, you don’t need to go to their domain to look for those items, and you can try looking for them on the black market."
"Black market?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] raised an eyebrow.

"Yes." Serpentera nodded. "Not only ordinary humans have black markets, but cultivators also have them, especially since many heretics move in secret. I don’t know their current locations because Old Kui and I have been in the realm for too long, and there should have been many changes in the realm since then. Since you’re in the Paradise Realm now, you can ask some of your acquaintances there. However, you must be extremely careful and don’t reveal your demon form or darkness element there, or the people of the winged race will hunt you down."
"Winged race, huh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] remembered Tian Huangjin. "Why didn’t Tian Huangjin take any action against me, despite knowing that I was a demon?
Serpentera could only shake his head. "By the way, you can’t use jewels there, and you have to use demon cores to make transactions there, especially since the items there are related to demons."
"I see." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding. "Okay then, I’ll look for information on those black markets, but I won’t search for them now. I’ll do so after I exit my isolation in a month."
"Only a month? Why don’t you go into seclusion for years at a time?"
"Hehe." Zhang Xiaolong [3] chuckled. "I will marry my childhood lover in a month, so I have to stop my seclusion temporarily, and I will continue after that."
After that, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately disappeared from the sight of the two ancient beasts; however, he did not return to the eastern forest right away and instead went elsewhere.
Tian Kui shook his head to himself. "That kid! He just arrived in the Paradise Realm, but he’s already found a new woman there!"
Tian Kui shook his head to himself. "That kid! He just arrived in the Paradise Realm, but he’s already found a new woman there!"

"Didn’t you hear him just now? He’s going to marry his childhood friend, so they should have known each other for a long time, but I wonder how the two of them met in the past." Serpentera then looked towards the location of the Dao test. "That female fox has already completed several stages, and she will probably finish soon. However, that male fox is quite stupid, and his progress is still stagnant."
"Just let them be because their fate is already sealed, and they will bear the consequences once they leave that place." Serpentera nodded in agreement with Tian Kui.

Meanwhile, Zhang Xiaolong [3] had arrived at the Sima Clan, but all the remaining clan members immediately avoided him, especially since he played a key role in the deaths of many of their clan members.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] showed no concern for them and went successfully to meet Sima Huiqing in the garden in front of her room.
Sima Huiqing was surprised by the arrival of Zhang Xiaolong [3], especially since he had not come to see him after the fight more than two months ago. "Why are you here, Master?"
"Follow me." Sima Huiqing followed Zhang Xiaolong [3] into her bedroom in confusion, but his next order shocked her. "Strip."
"Huh?" Sima Huiqing froze for a moment, but her hands moved on their own to remove her dress. ’Sigh! He is my master, and I cannot refuse his order because of his slave mark.’

Soon, Sima Huiqing was completely naked, and she approached Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was already sitting on her bed, and helped him remove his clothes, causing her to gasp as soon as he was naked. "What should I do now, Master?"

"Your body is impressive, despite your age." Zhang Xialong [3] pulled Sima Huiqing onto the bed, but he didn’t do anything to her. Instead, he imparted a method to convert the Divine Qi into the Celestial Qi. "Learn it first, and I’ll help you after."

"Yes, Master." Sima Huiqing immediately closed her eyes and read the method, but she was confused about the Celestial Qi. She decided to read and study it first, and she would ask Zhang Xiaolong [3] about it afterward.

If you don’t want that, we can try another way to separate your souls and give you your own bodies.

"Forget it for now, and we want you to accompany us here for a while."

"I’ve never met someone born with two souls before, so I don’t have the technique to separate them." Hun Di turned to his senior sister. "What do you think about that?"

"A living being with two twin souls is a unique phenomenon, and I’ve never encountered one in the past. I can create soul techniques, but a technique to do such a thing is impossible." Tang Ying then asked Zhang Fei. "Why don’t you try asking Nalan Yushu about your second plan?"

"Your second plan is also impossible, Master." They turned to Nalan Yushu, who had just appeared. "Even though Ursula’s two souls are separated from each other, they are actually a single entity, and it’s the same as killing them if you separate them. The only way is to unite their souls, and they might obtain something special if you do that."

"I will never merge their souls into one." Zhang Fei immediately walked away, leaving them. Nalan Yushu hurriedly returned to his tiny soul world, and she tried to persuade him, but he did not budge on his decision.
Hun Di then asked his senior sister again. "You should be able to do it, right?"

"Hehe." Tang Ying giggled. "Separating their souls actually isn’t that difficult, but as Nalan Yushu just said, their two souls are truly a single entity. I don’t know how their souls could be split in two, but she would die if I separated them, so I said that to reject him."
Hun Di nodded in understanding. "Let’s continue our training, and we will focus on our cultivation once we adapt perfectly to the gravity."
"Are you thinking of exploring the Paradise Realm?"
"Aren’t you thinking the same thing as me?"

Tang Ying nodded at him. "This place is indeed extraordinary, especially with its time flow four times faster than the outside world. However, we are experienced senior cultivators, and we will only be limiting ourselves if we continue to stay here; therefore, I will leave immediately after my cultivation breaks through to the Five Celestial Realms."

"Unlike you, I still have to break through three more minor stages before I can break through to that stage, so I have to wait a little longer to be able to explore the Paradise Realm." Tang Ying just smiled at Hun Di, and the two of them immediately continued their training.
In the room, Sima Huiqing had opened her eyes, and all the Divine Qi in her body had been converted into the Celestial Qi, making her feel much fresher and stronger than before.

However, Mei’s previous estimation was wrong because Sima Huiqing hadn’t broken through to the Five Divine Realms yet, but she wasn’t too far from breaking through either, and she only needed to cultivate for some time using Celestial Qi to be able to do so.

Sima Huiqing herself had heard that Zhang Fei [5] was already a master of the last technique, and she had tried to learn it in the past, but she had never succeeded. "Learn the dual cultivation technique first."
"Yes." Sima Huiqing closed her eyes again, but she was still confused by Zhang Fei [5]’s decision. Moreover, she clearly remembered that he had also enslaved Cao Feihong, but she was not with them.
Since the Flawless Yin-Yang Arts was an easy technique to learn, coupled with Sima Huiqing’s extensive experience as a cultivator, she had mastered it in a matter of minutes.
