Luo Yunxiao immediately climbed onto Zhang Fei’s lap, embraced his neck, and asked him. "What’s making you gloomy? Did something happen while I was focused?"

"Nothing happened." Zhang Fei immediately told Luo Yunxiao about the two souls inside Ursula’s body, which surprised her. "I wanted them to live as twins like the Amaris Twins, but unfortunately, that’s impossible because it would only kill them."

Luo Yunxiao nodded in understanding before telling her something. "Actually, there’s a powerful soul cultivator in the Samsara Domain, and he might be able to help you with that. His name is Hun Lingwu, and his cultivation has reached the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm; even his soul level has reached the perfection stage of the divine soul level. However, he’s not a completely good person; he might get jealous and do something bad to you if he finds out your secrets."
"Such a powerful soul cultivator! Even Tang Ying and my master can’t compare to him!" Zhang Fei exclaimed. "Is he really a bad person?"

"Not really." Luo Yunxiao then told Zhang Fei about Hun Lingwu’s character. "He’s actually a decent person, and he helps other cultivators a lot. However, you know for yourself that worldly emotions often influence us to do bad things, like what happened to Zhang He and Chen Xin. Despite his old age and seniority, he is no different from other people, and he is often influenced by his emotions, making him do many reprehensible things. Therefore, I don’t want you to have anything to do with him, especially since he has surpassed the current you in every way."

Zhang Fei gave Luo Yunxiao a gentle kiss. "Since you’ve said that, I won’t ignore your words. Moreover, I’m not in a hurry regarding Ursula’s two souls, and I’m sure I’ll find the most appropriate method to help them in the future. For now, I want to focus on reaching the Five Celestial Realms first, and I will explore the Paradise Realm after I reach that stage. By the way, have you heard of the black market in this realm?"

"Are you looking for items related to demons and heretics?" Zhang Fei immediately told Luo Yunxiao about the five items he needed to advance his demon rank to the advanced rank. "I don’t know anything about those items or the black market, but my father has an acquaintance who might be able to help you look for them. If you’re in a hurry to get those items, we can go see him now, and he can contact his acquaintance to help you."

"I’m not in a hurry to get them, so we’ll meet Uncle Luo during our wedding. Although I’ll become stronger if my demon rank rises to the next stage, it has nothing to do with my cultivation. Moreover, I can still store demon essence within my body, and my demon rank will immediately rise to the advanced ranks once I obtain them." Zhang Fei then released his soul, followed by Luo Yunxiao, who also released her soul. The two of them also summoned their nine avatars, and those avatars immediately absorbed the Celestial Qi from the air, flowing it into their bodies. "Let’s start now, Yunxiao."
"Yes."
Wan Jiang, who was chatting with his three disciples, was surprised by Beiming Youhuang’s arrival at their place. "What brought you here, Jia You?"

"Zhang Fei." Wan Jiang raised an eyebrow in response to Beiming Youhuang. "He arrived in the Paradise Realm a few days ago, and he has already broken through to the Divine Expansion Realm now. I heard that he’s challenged this tower before, so you should know a lot about him, right?"
Wan Jiang nodded to her. "I do know quite a lot about Zhang Fei, and he’s also helped me with some matters. However, I warn you not to be too curious about him, or you’ll get yourself into trouble."

"Senior Beiming, you must listen to my master." Beiming Youhuang turned to Zhang Fei directly. "That hateful guy isn’t a good person, and he has countless women. He even used his demon abilities on me and made me horny, but I immediately escaped from him, and my master removed the effect from me; otherwise, he would have done something indecent to me. Therefore, you should avoid him, or he will do the same to you."

"You’re Hua Xiang’er’s little sister, right?" Hua Mei’er nodded at Beiming Youhuang. "Actually, I asked about Zhang Fei not because I was curious about him, but because he’s going to marry Luo Yunxiao in a month. Although I’ve only met him once, I feel that he’s not a good man, so I want to know more about him."
"He-"

"Enough, Mei’er." Wan Jiang stopped his disciple. "You should stop badmouthing Zhang Fei, do you understand? Instead of badmouthing him, you should reflect on your rudeness and insults, which caused him to do that to you."
Hua Mei’er immediately shut her mouth after Wan Jiang said that, making Helian Xun’er and Sima Yun laugh.

Wan Jiang then spoke to Beiming Youhuang again. "I don’t know how close you are to Princess Luo, but you must remember that she is your disciple and not your daughter. Therefore, you have no right to interfere in her personal affairs, including her relationship with Zhang Fei. Moreover, Sect Master Luo and his wife have approved their relationship, so you should stop interfering in their affairs. Even though that kid is a demon, he isn’t as bad as you imagine, but he will be your worst nightmare if you interfere in his personal affairs."
"Hmm?" Beiming Youhuang frowned in response.
"You still don’t realize his true identity, huh?" Wan Jiang released a soft sigh. "Did you know that he is also a human and a heavenly fox?"
"Yes."
"Then, why do you still think he’s a bad person?"
"What do his three identities have to do with him being good or bad?"

Wan Jiang immediately created a qi screen, which showed a fox stone monument. "One day in the future, the ten-tailed fox will return to this realm once again. However, he is more than a heavenly fox because he is also a human and a demon, and he is the one who will bring peace to this universe."
"The writing of the ten-tailed fox." Beiming Youhuang’s eyes widened as she muttered to herself.

"That’s right." Wan Jiang nodded at her. "So far, I have never met anyone else who possesses three identities like Zhang Fei; therefore, I am certain that he is the man in the writing. In fact, many natural races also believe that he is the one, including the Fairy King."
"The Fairy King?" Beiming Youhuang’s expression turned ugly.

Wan Jiang then displayed another image on the Qi screen, which showed his conversation with Jia Yuyan sometime ago. "Her name is Jia Yuyan, the granddaughter of Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun. Jia Zizhen sent her under the pretext of hiding her from those who were targeting her, but he also ordered her to find the heir of the ten-tailed fox."
"Has she told Jia Zizhen about Zhang Fei?" Beiming Youhuang asked in a serious tone.

Wan Jiang shook his head. "I don’t know what kind of message that Jia Zizhen sent to that kid through Jia Yuyan, but he realized that the Fairy King wasn’t a good person. In fact, that little girl is one of his wives now, and he forbade her to tell that guy about him."
"I see." Beiming Youhuang nodded in understanding. "If Jia Zizhen obtains more information about Zhang Fei and finds out that he has arrived in our realm, I’m sure he’ll attack him immediately."

"That’s right." Wan Jiang then removed the Qi screen. "Since you already know that kid’s identity, you should stop interfering in his relationship with Princess Luo. While he may not have done anything to you yet, he will undoubtedly do so if you cross his boundaries, and you will bear the consequences of your actions."
Beiming Youhuang nodded slightly. "I will return to our realm now."
Wan Jiang let out a soft sigh before turning to Hua Mei’er with narrowed eyes, forcing her to flee the scene. "She’s old, but she still can’t distinguish between good and bad."
After she returned to the Paradise Realm, Beiming Youhuang did not go to the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, and she returned to her own sect, the Star Cloud Pavilion.

Days passed quickly in the Paradise Realm, and almost a month had passed. During this time, Zhang Fei never left the pavilion, and neither did his clones, except for Zhang Xiaolong [3], who stayed in the Sovereign Realm.

Zhang Fei focused entirely on assisting all his wives with their normal cultivation, soul cultivation, and body cultivation. Meanwhile, his four clones focused on other things like alchemy, blacksmithing, formation arrays, and more. Even so, they didn’t neglect their respective wives.
After cultivating using the Celestial Qi and dual cultivating with Zhang Fei [5] repeatedly, Sima Huiqing finally broke through to the Five Celestial Realms.

Of all Zhang Fei’s main harem members, only Feng Yichen and Huli Zhishen had broken through to the Five Celestial Realms, especially since their cultivation had long since reached the peak. At first, they wanted to hold back their cultivation to help him, but he forbade them from doing so and forced them to break through.

Since tomorrow is his wedding day with Luo Yunxiao, Zhang Fei decided to take her back to the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary to prepare herself. At first, he wanted to bring all his wives there, but they refused and instead asked him to summon them on their wedding day.

In the end, Zhang Fei only took Luo Yunxiao, Qing Yi, Zhang Yue, and Zhang Lin out of the training space. As soon as they appeared, Zhang Chen immediately took him away and interrogated him about the Cursed Demon Heart.

Given that his grandmother was already aware of it, Zhang Fei chose to reveal the truth to her, a decision that deeply worried her. "Grandma, I know you’re worried about me, but I can suppress the demon heart, and I will never succumb to its influence."

"Fei’er, I hope you can truly keep your promise and not succumb to the influence of the demon heart, okay?" Zhang Fei nodded to Zhang Chen, who immediately told him something else. "A month ago, Tian Huangjin came here looking for you, but she didn’t come alone, and she came with another woman named Tianshi Shengjie."

Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow after hearing the last name, as he was still annoyed with Tianshi Shengjie, who deliberately pitted him against the natural races in the Evergreen Spirit Heaven Realm. "Are those two women still in this domain?"

"I can’t sense their presence, so I don’t know if they’re still in this domain. However, they said they’ll come here again during your wedding with Luo Yunxiao, so you can meet them tomorrow." Zhang Chen then hugged his arm and led him to another area. "Your mother and I will help you prepare now."
"All right."

In the inn, Tianshi Shengjie stood by the window, smiling to herself. "Zhang Fei has appeared, Huangjin. That kid seems to still be angry with me, especially after I left him at the Evergreen Spirit Haven back then."
"Shall we go see Zhang Fei now?" Tian Huangjin walked to her side.

"No." Tianshi Shengjie dismissed it. "Let him prepare for his wedding first, and we’ll talk to him after their wedding is over. I hope no bothersome people show up tomorrow, so we can talk to him in peace."

Tian Huangjin shook her head. "Do you think those people would dare to appear in this place? The ancestors of the Luo Clan are not weak, and they are highly respected by the senior cultivators, including my father."
"Let’s wait for tomorrow, then."

"Shall we go see Zhang Fei now?" Tian Huangjin walked to her side.
"No." Tianshi Shengjie dismissed it.
"Let him prepare for his wedding first, and we’ll talk to him after their wedding is over.
I hope no bothersome people show up tomorrow, so we can talk to him in peace."
Tian Huangjin shook her head.
"Do you think those people would dare to appear in this place?
The ancestors of the Luo Clan are not weak, and they are highly respected by the senior cultivators, including my father."
"Let’s wait for tomorrow, then."

chapters.title: Chapter 1066: Wedding And Meeting
paragraphs: Early in the morning, the main hall of the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary was already filled with people, most of whom were members of the sect.

Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi still invited people from various supreme-grade sects and first-grade clans, but their invitations puzzled them because they had never heard that the two had a daughter, and very few people knew of Luo Yunxiao’s existence.
People from those clans decided to attend to find out about Luo Yunxiao, including their ancestors, such as Fan Ning, Ru Yan, Zhi Yuan, and Chen Qi.
The two ancestors of the Qin and Jiang clans, who did not appear when Zhang Fei broke through to the Divine Expansion Realm, also attended his wedding with Luo Yunxiao.

The sect masters of the Azure Immortal Peak, the Hidden Moon Sect, the Nine Sword Hall, the Eternal Heaven Sect, and the Star Cloud Pavilion were also present at the wedding. They were accompanied by several of the elders and disciples from their respective sects, primarily due to the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary’s status as the leader of the Empyrean Domain. Additionally, they were curious about Luo Yunxiao, whom they had never known before. Among them, only Beiming Youhuang and Hua Xiang’er knew her.

All of Zhang Fei, his clones’ wives, and family members were also present among the guests, but they did not sit separately to avoid arousing suspicion. However, those who were demons and demon beasts were not present with them, especially since their presence would only cause chaos.

Despite this, the guests were still curious about their identities and relationships with the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, especially since some of them were divine beasts, and the rest were mythical beasts from several different races, such as dragon, phoenix, golden crow, nian, and vermilion races.

"The representative of the Radiance Domain, Tian Huangjin. The representative of the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, Tianshi Shengjie, has arrived." A guard’s announcement startled the guests as they waited and wondered about the identities of the bride and groom.

The atmosphere in the main hall became noisy as soon as Tianshi Shengjie and Tian Huangjin walked in, dressed in the robes of their respective races. All the guests’ gazes were completely fixed on the two women, who walked with proud postures. ’Since when did this sect have a relationship with the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain and the Radiance Domain?’
Tianshi Shengjie and Tian Huangjin simply smiled at the guests as they followed the guard, who led them to the seats specially prepared by Luo Fenghan.
After waiting for some time, their questions about the bride and groom’s identities were answered as soon as Zhang Fei and Luo Yunxiao arrived in front of the main hall.

Zhang Fei chose not to wear a black wedding outfit, which is common for grooms on Earth, nor a red wedding outfit, which is traditional in his country. Instead, he wore a white wedding outfit with lotus and cloud embroidery, as did Luo Yunxiao.
They were accompanied by Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi, Luo Yunxiao’s parents, with their two sons and daughters-in-law behind them.
Meanwhile, Zhang Chen stood beside Zhang Fei, accompanied by Hun Di, with Qing Yi standing behind them with her two daughters.
Since Zhang Hai was not with them, Zhang Fei asked his master to replace his father’s position. Instead of his mother, he asked Zhang Chen to lead him, especially since Qing Yi was one of his wives.

Almost all the guests started whispering once they realized Zhang Fei’s bone age and cultivation, which were far inferior to Luo Yunxiao’s. Many of them mocked him because of his low cultivation, and they even said he was a toad wanting to eat swan meat.

In contrast to the mocking guests, the cultivators who had witnessed Zhang Fei’s breakthrough a month ago immediately recognized him, particularly the ancestors of the clans. None of them dared to underestimate him, especially after he broke through four minor stages and one major stage simultaneously, something they didn’t even dare to do.

The representatives of the sects did not look down on Zhang Fei either; instead, they thought about recruiting him. After all, he is currently almost 23 years old, but his cultivation has already reached the 1-Moon Divine Expansion Realm, a feat that is impossible for the majority of cultivators to achieve.

Beiming Youhuang stared at Zhang Fei, remembering the conversation she had with Wan Jiang a month ago. Hua Xiang’er was also curious about him because Luo Yunxiao had never mentioned him before, and her little sister often sent her messages about him, all of which were complaints about him.
With smiles on their faces, Luo Fenghan, Huang Xiaoyi, Zhang Chen, and Hun Di led Zhang Fei and Luo Yunxiao into the main hall to begin their wedding ceremony.
Qing Yi, Zhang Lin, Zhang Yue, Luo Zhenyu, Luo Jiaxuan, Cheng Mengyao, and Bing Xingying followed behind them.

On the way to the front area, Zhang Fei fiercely glared at Tianshi Shengjie, who responded to him with a playful smile on her face. Tian Huangjin, who was sitting next to her, could only shake her head at the behavior of the two.

Once they arrived at the front, an old man who served as the officiant immediately began the ceremony by introducing the bride and groom. All of the guests were shocked after they learned that Luo Yunxiao was the first child of Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi, and the two had managed to hide her from public view for hundreds of years.

All the guests were confused when the old man mentioned that Zhang Fei was Luo Yunxiao’s childhood friend, especially since their age difference was quite significant. However, the old man immediately eased their confusion by explaining that he had lived in the Three Mortal Realms before, and they met there because Luo Yunxiao was born there.

The old man’s explanation dealt a harsh blow to many of the guests, especially those belonging to the younger generation. Although they had never set foot in the Three Mortal Realms, they knew the place lacked Celestial Qi, yet Zhang Fei was able to achieve his current cultivation so quickly.

This revelation made the sect masters of various sects even more eager to recruit Zhang Fei into their sects, but they knew that would be impossible because he would become the son-in-law of the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary after his marriage to Luo Yunxiao.

The old man immediately started their wedding ceremony, which took place quite quickly. In a few minutes, Zhang Fei and Luo Yunxiao officially became husband and wife, making both of them smile with joy.

Once the ceremony concluded, the guests stepped forward to present the bride and groom with the gifts they had prepared. The first step forward was Tianshi Shengjie, and she took out several items, including a scroll.

"My Dragon Emperor noticed that you had arrived in this realm, and he sent me here especially to meet you." Tianshi Shengjie spoke as she handed those items to Zhang Fei, but her words shocked all the guests present at that place. All of them looked at him with expressions full of questions, especially regarding his relationship with the Dragon Emperor, Long Wuzhao. "He has been waiting for you for a long time, and he can’t wait to see you again. He wants to discuss many things with you, so he hopes you can go to our Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain as soon as possible."

Zhang Fei still glared fiercely at Tianshi Shengjie because of his past annoyance with her, but he quickly ignored it and accepted those items. "A lot of time has passed for the Dragon Emperor, but for me, our last meeting was two and a half years ago. Honestly, I can’t wait to see him again, but I have to keep him waiting because I’m going into seclusion after this, and I won’t be coming out for the next few years."

"Hehe." Tianshi Shengjie chuckled in response. "My emperor naturally already knows about it, and he will be waiting for you to come to him. By the way, I want to talk to you about important matters after this, so I hope you can spare me some time."
"Alright." Zhang Fei then turned to Tian Huangjin, who was walking beside Tianshi Shengji. "Long time no see."

"Two and a half years for you, and over a hundred years for me." Tian Huangjin then handed an item to Zhang Fei. "Shengjie didn’t tell me that you had arrived in this realm, so I didn’t prepare anything for your wedding gift. This item will be useful to you in the future, and it will also let you enter my Radiance Domain. I already told my father about you, and he wanted to chat with you about some things, so he was looking forward to your arrival in our domain."

Once again, the guests were shocked after listening to Tian Huangjin’s words. Judging from her attire, her status in the Radiance Domain should not be ordinary, and she should come from the highest caste of the winged race.
Zhang Fei nodded to Tian Huangjin. "Just like the Dragon Emperor, I was forced to make your father wait a little longer, and I will go see him after I complete my seclusion."
"No worries." The two women did not return to their seats, and they left the place directly, returning to their inn and waiting for Zhang Fei there.
Afterward, people from the sects began to come forward one by one to present their gifts to the bride and groom, followed by people from the clans, and ended by the other invited guests.
Once everyone was finished, Luo Fenghan immediately ordered the maids to bring out the dishes they had prepared for the wedding banquet.

Those people seemed confused by the dishes, especially since they could smell unusual aromas. Over the past month, Zhang Chen had trained several chefs from the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary to cook earthy dishes, and he left them plenty of spices to use in those dishes.

Although her grandson had not discussed it with her, Zhang Chen knew that Zhang Fei intended to open his shop and restaurant. Therefore, she wanted to use the dishes at her wedding banquet with Luo Yunxiao as a stepping stone to smooth out his plans.

Although they were curious and wanted to talk to Zhang Fei, they knew that it wasn’t the right time to do so. Therefore, they held back and waited for a good opportunity to meet him, but they knew that wouldn’t happen anytime soon, especially with his decision to enter seclusion.

A few hours later, their wedding ceremony was over, and Zhang Fei sent everyone back to the training room, including Luo Yunxiao. However, he didn’t join them immediately; instead, he went to see Tianshi Shengjie and Tian Huangjin at their inn.

"Haha." Tianshi Shengjie softly laughed at his expression. "Hey, it’s your wedding day, so you don’t have to keep putting on such a fierce appearance, right? Moreover, I know you won’t have any trouble facing those natural races, and I wanted them to be your sparring opponents, so I deliberately didn’t tell you about them."
Zhang Fei could only sigh. "Why are you deliberately discussing my relationship with Long Wuzhao in public?"
"Are you afraid of those people?" Tianshi Shengjie turned the question around with a playful smile.

"Do I need to be afraid of them?" Zhang Fei then sat down in an empty chair. "I’m not afraid of them, but I also don’t dare be arrogant enough to fight them with my current strength, so I want to keep a low profile for now. So, what serious problem do you want to discuss with me?"

"The first problem is Long Zhaihuo, and the second is your cursed demon heart." Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow at Tianshi Shengjie. "One of the items I gave you earlier was a gift from my emperor, and you can use it to defeat the Calamity Demon Dragon. My emperor wants to remove him from the Three Mortal Realms, but he can’t descend there himself. He can use his avatar, but that will only bring disaster to the Sky Dragon Realm. Therefore, he wants you to eliminate the dragon so there is no longer any threat in the Three Mortal Realms."

Zhang Fei himself had wanted the Calamity Demon Dragon for a long time, but he didn’t have the strength to face Long Zhaihuo yet. However, his current situation is different, and Long Wuzhao now gives him the item to defeat the dragon. "What do you mean by my cursed demon heart?"

"Isn’t it affecting you more now?" Zhang Fei nodded to Tianshi Shengjie. "My emperor killed the heart’s previous owner, so he knows the risks if someone obtains the heart and merges with it. Since the heart has been fused with you, we can’t remove it from your body because you will die. The only solution to overcome the Cursed Demon Heart is to find the Supreme Bodhi Heart, but the latter’s existence has yet to be proven. For the time being, my emperor asks you not to absorb too much demon power or cultivation of other demons, especially since it will speed up the awakening of the heart. With your current strength and abilities, you won’t be able to control the heart once it fully awakens, and it will control you instead."

"Phew." Zhang Fei released a heavy sigh and squeezed his chest area. "To tell you the truth, I never wanted this heart, but it immediately merged with me as soon as I found it, and I can’t stop it from replacing my human heart."

Tianshi Shengjie nodded in understanding. "It’s too late to regret it, so you should listen to my emperor’s advice and stop using your absorption or devouring abilities to absorb demon powers or cultivations from other demons unless you want to become a pure evil being. If that happens, all cultivators in the Paradise Realm will become your enemies, including my emperor. Even if you manage to escape to the Three Mortal Realms, they can still find you there, and your presence there will bring destruction to its inhabitants."

"All right, I won’t do that for now. Moreover, my demon rank is still stuck at the ten mortal demon ranks, and I don’t have the items to upgrade it to the advanced ranks yet." Zhang Fei then asked Tian Huangjin. "Do you know what problem your father wants to discuss with me?"

Tian Huangjin shook her head in response. "My father didn’t say anything to me, but I think the matter has something to do with your status as the heir of the ten-tailed fox. Although our race has no direct connection with the old fox, we shared some similarities with him in some matters in the past, especially regarding demons."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei frowned after hearing that, especially since Luo Yunxiao had already told him some things about the winged race in the Paradise Realm. "Is Tian Qiye still alive?"

"How do you know about her?" Tian Huangjin asked back in surprise, but Zhang Fei chose not to answer her. "Tian Qiye is one of the grand elders of my race, along with my father and three others. I don’t know how you found out about her or what kind of problems you have with her, but I advise you to avoid her wherever or whenever you encounter her. She is indeed a woman, but your demon abilities will never work against her, especially since she inherited a special bloodline of our race. Additionally, your cultivation is too insignificant when compared to hers, especially since her cultivation has already reached the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm. Therefore, you will never be able to defeat her, and you will die in her hands instead."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "Does that mean Tian Qiye’s cultivation is on par with Long Wuzhao and the ten demon gods?"

"Her cultivation is on par with several demon gods." Both Tian Huangjin and Tianshi Shengjie answered Zhang Fei. "The cultivation of my emperor and two of the ten demon gods has already reached the Celestial God Realms."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei was shocked to hear that. "Which two of the demon gods have reached that stage?"
"The Celestial and Asura Demon Gods."

chapters.title: Chapter 1067: Xian Xianqin*
paragraphs: "The Celestial and Asura Demon Gods, huh?" Zhang Fei then asked them again. "What about Jia Zizhen’s cultivation?"
"The Fairy King?" Both women were surprised by that. "His cultivation has also reached the Three-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm, like Grand Elder Qiye."
"Do you have any problems with Jia Zizhen?" Tianshi Shengjie asked him.

"I haven’t had any problems with Jia Zizhen yet, but I might have one in the future." Both women looked at Zhang Fei in astonishment, especially since he had just arrived in the Paradise Realm a little more than a month ago. "That guy sent me a message through someone, but I’m not going to tell you two about it. Actually, the message was for the heir of the ten-tailed fox, and his messenger gave it to me because she believed that I was the one. "I have always believed in my abilities, but I am not so stupid as to enter the lion’s den with my current strength.
By the way, is the Ocean Lotus Domain far from this domain?"
"Yes." Luo Fenghan nodded at him.
"To reach the Ocean Lotus Domain, you must first go to the border and enter the gate that connects to the Divine Origin Main Domain, just like when you go to this Empyrean Main Domain.
There, you will find that domain and several other domains, including the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain and the Radiance Domain."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei was surprised to hear that.
"Actually, I want to meet Long Wuzhao, but I’m not ready to meet him yet.
Moreover, he asked me to do something in the Three Mortal Realms, and I haven’t fulfilled it yet."
"The Calamity Demon Dragon."
"Did Old Ma tell you about that, Father?" Luo Fenghan nodded to Zhang Fei.
"Actually, my third clone is already in that realm now, and he will face the Calamity Demon Dragon, but I still have many doubts."
Luo Fenghan immediately stood up, walked in front of Zhang Fei, and grabbed his shoulders.
"Kid, Kuangyu told me about your Cursed Demon Heart, and those two women should have warned you about it, right?
You’re not a fool, so I believe you will never submit to your heart.

Even so, I hope you will always be careful with it; otherwise, the Golden Dragon Emperor and the Winged Race will turn into your enemies, and the righteous cultivators in this realm will also hunt you down.
Do you understand?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei then took out the Spirit Willow Seed, which shocked Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi.
"Do you both know about this seed?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1071: The Spirit Willow Tree

"From the girl who killed and revived me." Zhang Fei chose that answer because he didn’t need to go through the hassle of explaining in more detail.
"I see." Huang Xiaoyi nodded in understanding. "This Spirit Willow Seed should be the last one in this universe."
"The last one?" Zhang Fei was shocked.

"Since you came from the Three Mortal Realms, you must have never heard of the Jiangshen Domain before." Huang Xiaoyi then explained. "According to the legend, the Spirit Willow Tree thrived in that domain, and its branches stretched across the realm, whispering songs of rebirth and forgotten serenity. Their songs would guide spirits who had lost their way after their deaths, and they would purify any negative emotions remaining in their souls, allowing them to reincarnate without their past karma. Unfortunately, a great calamity struck the domain, resulting in the destruction of all the Spirit Willow Trees. Since then, there is no one to guide those spirits, and those who have lost their way gather in that domain, waiting for their guidance. Today, that domain is no longer the Jiangshen Domain but the Ghost Domain, full of countless ghosts. They could not be reincarnated, and the negative emotions that gathered there turned them into vengeful ghosts, led by the Ghost Emperor, whose strength is not inferior to the Celestial Demon God from the Ten Demon Gods."
Zhang Fei was speechless in response. "How did you know that this seed was the Spirit Willow Seed? How did you know it was the last in the universe, Mother?"

"Although the Spirit Willow Tree has been extinct for a long time, images of them and their seeds still exist, and I’ve seen them in some ancient records." Huang Xiaoyi then returned the seeds to Zhang Fei. "According to stories from the past, there was a little boy who dreamed about the seed. He said that one day in the future, the Spirit Willow Tree would return to the Jiangshen Domain through its last seed, and it would purify those vengeful ghosts before guiding them into the cycle of reincarnation. However, people didn’t believe in the little boy’s dream, so they ignored him and regarded his words as nonsense. Even though no one believed him, he still believed in his dreams. He disappeared when he was old enough, and people in the past guessed that he went to that domain to prove his dream. Since the domain was full of vengeful ghosts, they believed that he died as soon as he set foot there."

Luo Fenghan then pointed to the seed. "Since this seed is in your hands now, that boy’s dream has a chance to come true. The best place to grow the Spirit Willow Tree is the Ghost Domain, but you won’t be able to go there now. Even Xiaoyi and I don’t dare to approach that domain with our cultivation level at the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm, especially since the Ghost Emperor is truly powerful, with his cultivation already reaching the Celestial God Realm. The only people who can take you there are people from the Winged Race, especially their Grand Elders, such as Tian Qiye and Tian Yizu."
"I understand." Since Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi were already that powerful, Zhang Fei naturally would not take their warning lightly. "Who is Tian Yizu?"

"Tian Huangjin’s father." Zhang Fei remembered that her father was indeed a grand elder of the Winged Race. "Since you have a favorable relationship with his daughter, your best choice is Tian Yizu. However, I forbid you from going to the Ghost Domain before your cultivation breaks through to the Five Celestial Realms, and you must focus on yourself until then."
"I do intend to enter seclusion again, and I will bring Yunxiao with me." Zhang Fei then asked them again. "Do you two have any information about the entrance to the Forgotten Land?"
Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi exchanged glances for a moment. "Did Feng Yao tell you about that place?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded at them. "Feng Yao shared extensive information with me about the Forgotten Land, the Temple of Forgotten Flame, the mysterious merchant, and the auction. According to her, the merchant and the auction sold a lot of extremely rare items, and many of them were immortal grade. Therefore, I want to go there to see both of them, and who knows, I might get interesting items for Yunxiao and my other wives."

"Feng Yao is not wrong about that, and these two are indeed targets for other cultivators to enter that place. However, you need the merchant token and auction tokens for that." Zhang Fei naturally knew that, especially since he had gotten both of them. Then, Luo Fenghan continued. "The entrance to the Forgotten Land is in the Heavenlight Domain, but the situation is very different now. The entrance is heavily guarded by the alliance of several sects, the Divine Samsara Sect, mainly because of the mass riots that occurred there thousands of years ago. Therefore, not many cultivators can enter that place, and rogue cultivators who wish to enter must undergo a series of tests first."
"Even so, you can bring my husband to enter that place without going through those tests, right, Father?" Luo Yunxiao asked her question while smiling sweetly.

"Haha." Luo Fengyan laughed at that. "Naturally, I’ll take Zhang Fei to the Forgotten Land if he really wants to meet the merchant and attend the auction. Unfortunately, he’ll have to wait for a while longer to go there, especially since the entrance won’t open until five years later."

"I’m not in a rush to go to the Forgotten Land either, Father." Zhang Fei clenched his fists before continuing. "Moreover, five years is too short for cultivators like us, especially if we are fully focused on our cultivation. Right now, my cultivation is still at the Divine Expansion Realm, but five years is enough for me to reach the Five Celestial Realms, and I will go there with you then."
"Brother-in-law! Are you sure you can reach the Five Celestial Realms in five years?" Luo Zhenyu suddenly asked.

Luo Jiaxuan then spoke. "Brother-in-law, I admit that you are indeed impressive to have reached the Seven Divine Realms in three and a half years. However, breaking through to the Divine Ascension Realm will not be easy, and the Qi you need is even greater, so I am not confident that you can reach it in five years."

"Don’t compare my husband with lazy people like you two!" Luo Jiaxuan and Luo Zhenyu’s lips twitched because of Luo Yunxiao’s words. "As you can see, my husband has already broken through to the 1-Moon Divine Expansion Realm, so only six major stages remain. Instead of you two worrying about his cultivation, you guys should focus on yours; otherwise, he will surpass you both in five years, especially since you are too lazy!"
"Big Sis, you are not fair to us!" Luo Zhenyu immediately protested.

Luo Jiaxuan nodded in agreement with his brother. "Big Sis, my brother-in-law is a dual cultivator, and he has over a hundred women by his side. Therefore, you can’t compare his cultivation speed with ours, especially since it will never be comparable."

"Humph!" Luo Yunxiao snorted at them. "My husband has only been cultivating for three and a half years, and you’ve been cultivating for five hundred years! If he manages to surpass you, you should feel ashamed!"
’Tch! Our big sis is acting like a mother hen protecting her chicks!’ Both of them grumbled in their hearts instead of contradicting Luo Yunxiao.
Their two wives, Cheng Mengyao and Bing Xingying, smiled to themselves at their behavior.

Bing Xingying’s heart skipped a beat as soon as she noticed Zhang Fei’s strange gaze at her, and his next words shocked her. ’Sister-in-law, I don’t mean to pry into your personal affairs, but I’m curious where your real body is. Why did you enter this family using a clone?’
’I don’t know what you mean by that, brother-in-law.’ Bing Xingxing decided to ignore ignorance.

’Sister-in-law, I have five clones, and I’ve met several powerful avatars, one of which is the Golden Dragon Emperor. Therefore, I can discern between the original body and the clone, and your current body is just your clone.’ Although Zhang Fei said that, Bing Xingying remained calm and pretended to be confused. ’Sister-in-law, I don’t know your purpose for doing this, but I warn you not to harbor any ill intentions towards them. They are my family now, and I will do anything to protect them. If I discover that you harbor malicious intentions towards them, especially towards Luo Yunxiao, I promise you that I will become the worst nightmare of your life.’
Zhang Fei’s threat caused Bing Xingying to flinch, but she didn’t show any reaction on her face, as she was afraid that her parents-in-law would notice.

’Trust me, I have the ability to do something to you, even though my cultivation is still far below yours.’ Zhang Fei then turned his attention back to Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi and asked them another question. "Have you two heard of the Moonlit Passion Temple?"
"Hmm?" Huang Xiaoyi frowned immediately. "Are you related to those perverted women?"

"No." Zhang Fei told them about the mysterious woman who appeared at the Star Tower and gave him the Forbidden Lotus Codex, and he summoned his soul from his body, shocking them with those white lotuses. "These lotuses are a symbol of my relationship with all my wives, including Yunxiao. I created these lotuses from the technique that woman gave me, but I never knew her identity, especially since she had already disappeared when I regained consciousness."

Huang Xiaoyi and the others immediately counted the number of lotuses, and there were indeed more than a hundred of them. "I didn’t expect the people from the Moonlit Passion Temple to possess such a powerful soul technique, especially considering their reputation as perverted women; it’s no wonder you were able to suppress Beiming Youhuang’s soul before your final breakthrough. Unfortunately, we don’t know them, so we can’t give you much information about them. However, that sect resides in the Twin Flames Domain along with hundreds of other dual cultivation sects, but that sect is the strongest among them."
"Huh?" Zhang Fei was surprised to hear that. "Are there really hundreds of dual cultivation sects in that domain, Father?"

Luo Fenghan nodded at him. "In this realm, dual cultivators had a bad reputation in the past, which led most domains to reject them, including the inhabitants of this Empyrean Domain. In the end, they gathered together in the Twin Flames Domain, and they founded those sects afterward."
"Are you thinking about joining the Moonlit Passion Temple, son?" Huang Xiaoyi asked with narrowed eyes.

"Hahaha." Zhang Fei responded to her with a laugh. "Mother, I’m no longer interested in joining any sect now, and I asked about the Moonlite Passion Temple simply because I was curious about that woman’s reason for imparting her technique to me, especially since we’ve never met or known each other before. Moreover, her technique isn’t just any technique, and I can suppress Beiming Youhuang’s soul with my current soul power because of it."

Huang Xiaoyi breathed a sigh of relief. "I don’t care if you have many wives, but I forbid you from having any relationship with the people from the Moonlit Passion Temple, especially since they are not good women. Many rumors circulate about them, claiming that they kidnap numerous men and use them as cultivation furnaces until their deaths. I can’t guess the woman’s reason for imparting her technique to you, but you must always remember that there is no free lunch in this world, and everything has its trade-offs. Perhaps she deliberately gave it to you to lure you to come to him, and she might have prepared a trap for you in his sect."

"Mother, your worries are excessive and unfounded." Huang Xiaoyi looked at Luo Yunxiao with raised eyebrows. "You still don’t know my husband’s abilities in dual cultivation, and I can tell you that no woman can stand against him if he uses his abilities on them. That woman may be strong, but I believe that she will submit to him if she thinks she can trap him. If you don’t believe me, let Sister Xingying try his abilities, and you can see the effects for yourself."
"Huh?" Bing Xingying was taken aback for a moment before refusing. "Big Sis, I don’t want to test your husband’s abilities, and you can ask Mengyao to try."
"No!" Cheng Mengyao firmly shook her head. "I don’t want to try either, Big Sis."
"Stand up, Xingying." Bing Xingying shuddered when Luo Yunxiao shot a fierce glare at her, forcing her to comply. "Try some of your abilities on her, husband."
Zhang Fei touched Bing Xingying’s shoulder with one finger and used his demonic touch on her, causing her to let out a loud moan that startled Luo Zhenyu and the others.
"Ahhh!" Luo Yunxiao immediately supported Bing Xingying, preventing her from falling. "Hah... Hah... What kind of technique is that?"

"Hehe." Luo Yunxiao chuckled. "That was just his finger technique, and the effects are just like you experienced. If he used his other abilities, you would immediately fall under the control of your lust, and you would pounce on my brother straight away."

Bing Xingying looked at Zhang Fei, who immediately activated his lust domain, enveloping them all. Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi were shocked to see that, especially since he had already used a soul and elemental domain before. "Another domain? How many domains do you actually have?"

"Eight elemental domains, a sword domain, a soul domain, and this lust domain." They all stared at Zhang Fei wide-eyed because creating one domain was already difficult, but he had managed to create so many. "This lust domain is not only for dual cultivation, but I can also use it for offense and defense. If I want, I can kill everyone caught in this domain."
"Show them a bit, husband."

"Please forgive me." After Zhang Fei said that, Luo Fenghan and the others immediately felt that their Qi was absorbed by the domain and channeled into his body, even though he only did it for a few seconds before canceling it. "Just like what you guys experienced just now, this domain can absorb the Qi of all people, whether they are men or women."

Luo Fenghan let out a heavy sigh afterward. "Kid, I know you’re a demon, but this domain ability of yours is too evil. Moreover, using such a shortcut in the long run isn’t a good thing, so you should restrain yourself and cultivate the correct path."
"I understand, Father." Zhang Fei dispelled his lust domain and grabbed Luo Yunxiao’s hand. "In that case, we will leave now, and we will not come out of our isolation before five years."
After they disappeared, Luo Fenghan turned to his two sons. "You two had better work hard in your cultivation; otherwise, your brother-in-law will overtake you both."
"Yes, Father." Both of them immediately took their respective wives away.
"Do you think Zhang Fei can really reach the Five Celestial Realms in five years, husband?" Huang Xiaoyi asked in a doubtful tone.

"I’m a little doubtful about that myself." Luo Fenghan then led his wife away. "We don’t need to think about that, and we will know the results once they emerge from their seclusion. I hope Zhang Fei will truly succeed in reaching that stage within five years, especially since I have a feeling that many extraordinary and dangerous things await him in this realm."
"I feel the same as you."

After returning to the pavilion, Zhang Fei had all his women gather in the main bedroom. However, he didn’t immediately swallow the Crimson Yang Flower, and he began dual cultivating with them as usual, especially since it would affect his third clone.

Meanwhile, Zhang Xiaolong [3] was already standing in front of the prison of the Calamity Demon Dragon. However, the place was already filled with an evil aura filled with hatred, grudges, and resentment again, especially since he hadn’t gone to that realm to absorb them in a long time.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] was not alone, and he was accompanied by Serpentera and Tian Kui. Even though they were ancient beasts, and their cultivation was far above the Calamity Demon Dragon, they felt quite oppressed by Long Zhaihuo’s aura.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] took out the key given by Tianshi Shengjie to open the seal, and Long Zhaihuo’s aura immediately shot towards them, pushing them several steps back. "Incredible! He’s been sealed here for millions of years, but his aura is still so powerful! Would you two like to come in with me?"
"Let’s go in."
- To Be Continued

"Please forgive me." After Zhang Fei said that, Luo Fenghan and the others immediately felt that their Qi was absorbed by the domain and channeled into his body, even though he only did it for a few seconds before canceling it.
"Just like what you guys experienced just now, this domain can absorb the Qi of all people, whether they are men or women."
Luo Fenghan let out a heavy sigh afterward.
"Kid, I know you’re a demon, but this domain ability of yours is too evil.
Moreover, using such a shortcut in the long run isn’t a good thing, so you should restrain yourself and cultivate the correct path."
"I understand, Father." Zhang Fei dispelled his lust domain and grabbed Luo Yunxiao’s hand.
"In that case, we will leave now, and we will not come out of our isolation before five years."
After they disappeared, Luo Fenghan turned to his two sons.
"You two had better work hard in your cultivation; otherwise, your brother-in-law will overtake you both."
"Yes, Father." Both of them immediately took their respective wives away.
"Do you think Zhang Fei can really reach the Five Celestial Realms in five years, husband?" Huang Xiaoyi asked in a doubtful tone.
"I’m a little doubtful about that myself." Luo Fenghan then led his wife away.
"We don’t need to think about that, and we will know the results once they emerge from their seclusion.
I hope Zhang Fei will truly succeed in reaching that stage within five years, especially since I have a feeling that many extraordinary and dangerous things await him in this realm."
"I feel the same as you."
After returning to the pavilion, Zhang Fei had all his women gather in the main bedroom.
However, he didn’t immediately swallow the Crimson Yang Flower, and he began dual cultivating with them as usual, especially since it would affect his third clone.
Meanwhile, Zhang Xiaolong [3] was already standing in front of the prison of the Calamity Demon Dragon.
However, the place was already filled with an evil aura filled with hatred, grudges, and resentment again, especially since he hadn’t gone to that realm to absorb them in a long time.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] was not alone, and he was accompanied by Serpentera and Tian Kui.
Even though they were ancient beasts, and their cultivation was far above the Calamity Demon Dragon, they felt quite oppressed by Long Zhaihuo’s aura.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] took out the key given by Tianshi Shengjie to open the seal, and Long Zhaihuo’s aura immediately shot towards them, pushing them several steps back.
"Incredible!
He’s been sealed here for millions of years, but his aura is still so powerful!
Would you two like to come in with me?"
"Let’s go in."
- To Be Continued

chapters.title: Chapter 1072: Long Zhaihuo
paragraphs: Just as Tian Kui and Serpentera prepared to follow Zhang Xiaolong [3] inside, an unexpected blast blew them away, leaving them both stunned. Before they could react, the barrier closed by itself. "Shit!"

Tian Kui launched an immediate attack on the barrier, but his own attack knocked him back. "What the hell is this barrier? The Golden Dragon Emperor made this barrier before he was as powerful as he is now, but it can withstand and reverse my attack."

"Hmm?" Serpentera approached the barrier and touched it. "I don’t understand formations, but this barrier seems to have an absorption and counterattack mechanism, preventing anyone from destroying it."

"So, what should we do now? How will that kid deal with that dragon by himself?" Tian Kui and Serpentera turned to Zhang Fei [1], who suddenly appeared there. "Are you going to bring this clone in there too?"

"No." Zhang Fei [1] shook his head in response. "I anticipated that this situation would occur, so I have already made preparations. I can’t possibly face Long Zhaihuo alone, so I’ll send you two into my beast space now."
Serpentera and Tian Kui exchanged glances for a moment before nodding in agreement. "Alright, send us inside now."

After he sent Serpentera and Tian Kui into his beast space, Zhang Fei [1] approached the barrier and touched it. He then entered the training space again before sending all the female beasts in the pavilion into the beast space. He also asked both ice phoenixes, Feng Xueying and Feng Jinqiu, to enter there.

Behind the barrier, Zhang Xiaolong [3] quickly summoned the demon extermination sword and the light angel, and he also used his light domain to light up the place, especially since Long Zhaihuo’s hatred and resentment caused the area inside to become completely dark.

"Shit." Zhang Xiaolong [3] cursed as soon as he saw that the golden chains had fallen off the body of the Calamity Demon Dragon. He immediately channeled his light element into his sword and slashed it. "Severing Slash!"
However, Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s attack vanished on its own before striking the dragon, which quickly shrank and transformed into a human—none other than Long Zhaihuo himself.

Long Zhaihuo stared at Zhang Xiaolong [3] with his blood-red eyes. "I haven’t seen the outside world for a long time after Long Wuzhao sealed me in this place, so I didn’t expect to meet a unique living being like you today."
"How did you manage to free yourself from those golden chains?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked with full vigilance.

"Hahaha! Do you think people call me the Calamity Demon Dragon for nothing?" Long Zhaihuo kicked the golden chains towards Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Honestly, I could have freed myself from those chains a long time ago, but I couldn’t break this barrier because Long Wuzhao created it with a special method, assisted by those beast ancestors. Therefore, I pretended to be sealed in this place for millions of years, and I deliberately weakened myself so that he wouldn’t suspect me. He underestimated my abilities too much, and he sent you here to kill me. By the way, you don’t need to bother summoning the two powerful souls of the cultivators who helped you back then, especially since you’re in my domain now."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] frowned at that. He tried calling Ma Kuangyu and Nalan Yushu, but neither of them responded to him, nor did Mei. "I guess I’ll have to fight you myself."

"Do you think you can fight me with your current strength?" Long Zhaihuo asked with a smirk as he summoned a black spear with a dragon’s head at the end of the hilt. He dashed toward Zhang Xiaolong [3] and thrust his spear at him, but he disappeared from his sight. "Hmm?"

"Being locked up in this place for millions of years has made you senile." Long Zhaihuo turned to Zhang Xiaolong [3], who immediately activated the soul link, causing his strength to soar and instantly reach the Five Celestial Realms, especially since Serpentera and Tian Kui’s cultivation was already at that stage. Not to mention, there were dozens of powerful beasts in his beast space, and his strength surpassed the two ancient beasts. "Do you think I would have come here if I wasn’t confident in my abilities?"
"I see." Long Zhaihuo nodded in understanding. "No wonder Long Wuzhao chose you to kill me, especially since you are really special. Can you tell me what level your cultivation is at now?"

"You must have never heard of it, but my cultivation is at the Five Celestial Realms now." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately teleported in front of Long Zhaihuo and slashed his sword at him, but the dragon smirked faintly and countered his attack right away, blowing him back really hard. "Cough... Cough... What the hell is that?"

"Hahaha!" Long Zhaihuo laughed at his shocked expression. "Long Wuzhao didn’t tell you anything about my abilities, huh? Are you still unaware of why he chose not to end my life and instead decided to confine me here? He can’t kill me because I can counter all his attacks, and he himself will die if he attacks me with his full strength."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] frowned at that, and he was certain Long Zhaihuo wasn’t bluffing after experiencing the effects of his ability just now, which made him furious with Long Wuzhao for not telling him anything.

Long Zhaihuo spoke to him again. "I don’t know how you managed to raise your cultivation to such a high level, but you will never be able to kill me. As long as you can’t defeat me, you won’t be able to leave this place, and you will accompany me here for the rest of your life."

"Is that so?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked with a calm expression, confusing Long Zhaihuo. "You might be able to stop me from summoning Old Ma and Nalan Yushu, but you won’t be able to stop me from escaping this place. I can escape whenever I want, but I’ve never met an opponent as interesting as you. Therefore, I won’t escape from this place; instead, I’ll use you as a stepping stone, and I’ll defeat you by bypassing your abilities."

"Tch... Tch... Tch...! Do you think that is the extent of my abilities? From the moment you set foot in my Calamity Domain, you were doomed to die. Once you die, I will devour your body and abilities, and I will go look for Long Wuzhao afterwards." Zhang Xiaolong [3] experienced a sudden halving of his strength and body, particularly after Long Zhaihuo activated his domain’s effects. "Hahaha! Have you noticed? No matter how strong you are, your strength will weaken significantly in my domain, and your physique will continue to weaken as time passes. Therefore, I don’t need to waste my energy to kill myself, especially since you will eventually die."
"I see." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded to himself. "Now, I understand why Long Wuzhao sent me to kill you, especially since I am your nemesis."
Long Zhaihuo frowned at that, but he was shocked when Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s body condition returned to normal, even though his cultivation was still cut in half.

"You are too confident in your domain’s abilities, old dragon. Others might die if they stay in here too long, but I am not them, and I am a unique individual, as you said before." Zhang Xiaolong [3] instantly transformed into his transcendent lust demon form. "As you can see, I am a demon like you. However, I am a lust demon, and all lust demons have absolute condition ability. Therefore, your domain’s ability to weaken my body is meaningless to me, especially since I will never weaken as long as my ability is active."
"You—" Long Zhaihuo immediately spun around as soon as Zhang Xiaolong [3] disappeared, but he misjudged his movements because he didn’t appear there.

Instead, Zhang Xiaolong [3] stood behind Long Zhaihuo and attacked him without using any abilities. As he expected, the demon dragon’s ability couldn’t counter his attack, and the attack left a slash wound on his back.
"Gahh!" Long Zhaihuo screamed loudly as he staggered forward, but he immediately slammed the end of his spear into the ground before counterattacking Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Tch!"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already returned to his previous position, much to Long Zhaihuo’s annoyance. "Haha! You don’t have to be so upset that your speed is too slow compared to mine, especially since I’ve been living in the Paradise Realm with its heavy gravity for some time. On the other hand, you’ve spent millions of years trapped in this place, making it impossible for you to match my speed. As for your ability to counter any attack, I’ve found its weakness now. You won’t be able to counter my attacks as long as I use normal attacks, right?"

’Fuck! This kid isn’t stupid like Long Wuzhao! He could realize the weakness of my abilities just by experiencing it once!’ Long Zhaihuo grinned once more before activating another ability from his domain.
Badump... Badump...

Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s cursed demon heart suddenly beat so fast in response to Long Zhaihuo’s ability, but he immediately suppressed it by covering it with his light element. He then stretched his hand forward and used all his flames, shocking the demon dragon.

"Shit! Golden Crow Flame!" Long Zhaihuo immediately jumped out of the way as soon as Zhang Xiaolong [3] threw the small annihilation flame at him, causing it to hit the area behind him before exploding.
Boom

Zhang Xiaolong [3] deliberately restrained the power of his annihilation flame; otherwise, the entire mountain would explode, and Long Zhaihuo would cause trouble in the Sky Dragon Realm if he managed to escape.

Long Zhaihuo stared at Zhang Xiaolong [3] in shock, not expecting that he possessed the Golden Crow Flame. ’How could he possess that flame? Moreover, he also possesses the phoenix flame, the vermilion flame, and several other types of flames that I can’t recognize.’

"Are you surprised by my technique? I didn’t expect that the mighty Calamity Demon Dragon would be afraid of the Golden Crow Flame." Soon, the silhouettes of eleven mythical beasts appeared behind Zhang Xiaolong [3]: Heavenly Fox, Golden Crow, Dark Phoenix, Vermilion Bird, Golden Fox, Flame Dragon, Mythical Dee, Azure Emperor Roc, Rainbow-Shelled Tortoise, Azure Dragon, and White Tiger.

Followed by Golden Crow Flame, Phoenix Flame, Dragon Flame, Vermilion Flame, Soul Flame, Earth Flame, Sky Flame, Dark Flame, and Blood Flame that suddenly appeared and revolved around Zhang Xiaolong [3].
Long Zhaihuo was completely shocked after seeing all that; not even Long Wuzhao, who had always been his rival, had all that.

"Where was your confidence earlier?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] calmly asked, but the slight smirk on his face made Long Zhihao feel humiliated. "You previously said that I was doomed to die the moment I set foot in your domain, but you became so afraid of me. Long Wuzhao and the others were afraid of you in the past, but millions of years have passed since they locked you up here, and many things have changed out there. Your rival is no longer an ordinary mythical beast, but he has become the leader of all the beast races, and they nicknamed him the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon Emperor. As for you, you haven’t made any progress since then, which makes you no different from an ordinary mythical beast."

"I will kill you!" Long Zhaihuo dashed toward Zhang Xiaolong [3], but he was forced to dodge as soon as the nine flames shot at him. He was not particularly afraid of the other eight flames, but the Golden Crow Flame terrified him.

"Since you are so afraid of my Golden Crow Flame, I will call one of my wives to help me." Soon, Yan Jinwu appeared by Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s side. "As expected, your domain couldn’t seal my beast space; otherwise, I wouldn’t be able to summon her now. By the way, meet one of my wives, and you should be afraid of her."
Long Zhaihuo was fully alert as he kept his distance from the two of them, but he hit a dead end as the door and barrier stopped him. ’Shit! A Golden Crow!’

"Is he the Calamity Demon Dragon that was sealed by the Golden Dragon Emperor, husband? Why is he so pathetic?" Yan Jinwu’s questions enraged Luo Zhaihuo, but he didn’t dare to attack her after realizing her identity as the true Golden Crow.
"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed as he squeezed his buttocks. "Don’t underestimate him, Jinwu. You’re not his opponent if I’m not here, and his domain will make you miserable."

Yan Jinwu looked around them, but she couldn’t feel the effects of Long Zhaihuo, especially since Zhang Xiaolong [3] used the harem feature to share his strength and vitality with her. "What are we going to do now? Are we going to gang up on him?"

"Somehow, he was afraid of my golden flame, so your golden flame should be even more frightening to him." After Zhang Xiaolong [3] said that, Yan Jinwu summoned several flames, causing Long Zhaihuo to break out in a cold sweat. "See? Your flame frightened him."
"Hehe." Yan Jinwu giggled and launched her flames directly at Long Zhaihuo, forcing him to flee like a cowardly dragon. "Let’s burn him alive, husband!"

’Fuck! Why do I have to meet this monster and golden crow? If her flames strike me, I will definitely die!’ Long Zhaihuo kept running and dodging, especially since Yan Jinwu kept shooting her flames at him. ’Damn it! I’ll use that and take them to death with me!’

"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3], who noticed Long Zhaihuo’s plan, immediately made his move. He thrust the demon extermination sword imbued with his light element toward the demon dragon, piercing through its chest directly.
"Gah!" Long Zhaihuo thrust his black spear towards Zhang Xiaolong [3], but Yan Jinwu’s Golden Crow Flame quickly shot towards him and hit him in the face. "Arghhh!"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] kicked Long Zhaihuo’s chest and pushed him back, causing the demon extermination sword to slip out of Long Zhaihuo’s chest and black blood to spurt from the wound.

Their attacks caused Long Zhaihuo’s domain to disappear by itself, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately summoned Nalan Yushu out of his tiny soul world, followed by Ma Kuangyu. "Possess his soul, Yushu!"
"Yes, Master." Nalan Yushu quickly entered Long Zhaihuo’s body and took over control of his body. "Ouch! Both of your attacks caused me pain, Master."

"Haha." Ma Kuangyu laughed before speaking to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "You’re really lucky because this guy’s cultivation has stagnated for millions of years; otherwise, you wouldn’t be able to defeat him this easily."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in agreement with him. "Yes, you are correct, Old Ma. I am indeed fortunate, but what should I do with him now?"
"Didn’t you want to take his bloodline, soul, physique, and cultivation core?" Ma Kuangyu asked back.

Long Zhaihuo, who was under Nalan Yushu’s control, immediately spoke. "Master, you shouldn’t absorb his soul now, especially since it is full of negative emotions. If you do that, you’ll inherit his negative emotions, and they’ll have a detrimental effect on your Cursed Demon Heart."
"Yeah." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then asked. "So, what do you two think?"

"Hmm?" They thought for a while before Ma Kuangyu told him. "You can use his bloodline, core, and physique after you kill him, but you have to purify his soul first. Unfortunately, those with the light element on your side can’t do that, so you must take his soul to the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, and Luo Fenghan will help you to purify it."

"Master, I think that’s the best solution," Long Zhaihuo then asked him. "Do you want to do it now? If you wish, I will extract his soul from his body and transfer it into your tiny soul world. This way, his physique, bloodline, and core will remain intact, and if you inherit them all, you’ll become even more terrifying."

"Wait a minute, husband." They turned to Yan Jinwu. "Are you sure it’s okay if you want to do that? After all, Long Wuzhao asked you to kill this dragon, and he’ll probably be furious if he finds out that you transformed yourself into this dragon."

"Long Wuzhao should already be aware of my intentions towards this guy; otherwise, Tianshi Shengjie wouldn’t have asked me that." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then asked the other two. "What do you two think will happen if I transform into him and implant his core into my body?"

"Somehow, he was afraid of my golden flame, so your golden flame should be even more frightening to him." After Zhang Xiaolong [3] said that, Yan Jinwu summoned several flames, causing Long Zhaihuo to break out in a cold sweat.
"See?
Your flame frightened him."
"Hehe." Yan Jinwu giggled and launched her flames directly at Long Zhaihuo, forcing him to flee like a cowardly dragon.
"Let’s burn him alive, husband!"
’Fuck!
Why do I have to meet this monster and golden crow?
If her flames strike me, I will definitely die!’ Long Zhaihuo kept running and dodging, especially since Yan Jinwu kept shooting her flames at him. ’Damn it!
I’ll use that and take them to death with me!’
"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3], who noticed Long Zhaihuo’s plan, immediately made his move.
He thrust the demon extermination sword imbued with his light element toward the demon dragon, piercing through its chest directly.
"Gah!" Long Zhaihuo thrust his black spear towards Zhang Xiaolong [3], but Yan Jinwu’s Golden Crow Flame quickly shot towards him and hit him in the face.
"Arghhh!"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] kicked Long Zhaihuo’s chest and pushed him back, causing the demon extermination sword to slip out of Long Zhaihuo’s chest and black blood to spurt from the wound.
Their attacks caused Long Zhaihuo’s domain to disappear by itself, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately summoned Nalan Yushu out of his tiny soul world, followed by Ma Kuangyu.
"Possess his soul, Yushu!"
"Yes, Master." Nalan Yushu quickly entered Long Zhaihuo’s body and took over control of his body.
"Ouch!
Both of your attacks caused me pain, Master."
"Haha." Ma Kuangyu laughed before speaking to Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"You’re really lucky because this guy’s cultivation has stagnated for millions of years; otherwise, you wouldn’t be able to defeat him this easily."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in agreement with him.
"Yes, you are correct, Old Ma.
I am indeed fortunate, but what should I do with him now?"
"Didn’t you want to take his bloodline, soul, physique, and cultivation core?" Ma Kuangyu asked back.
Long Zhaihuo, who was under Nalan Yushu’s control, immediately spoke.
"Master, you shouldn’t absorb his soul now, especially since it is full of negative emotions.
If you do that, you’ll inherit his negative emotions, and they’ll have a detrimental effect on your Cursed Demon Heart."
"Yeah." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then asked.
"So, what do you two think?"
"Hmm?" They thought for a while before Ma Kuangyu told him.
"You can use his bloodline, core, and physique after you kill him, but you have to purify his soul first.
Unfortunately, those with the light element on your side can’t do that, so you must take his soul to the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, and Luo Fenghan will help you to purify it."
"Master, I think that’s the best solution," Long Zhaihuo then asked him.
"Do you want to do it now?
If you wish, I will extract his soul from his body and transfer it into your tiny soul world.
This way, his physique, bloodline, and core will remain intact, and if you inherit them all, you’ll become even more terrifying."
"Wait a minute, husband." They turned to Yan Jinwu.
"Are you sure it’s okay if you want to do that?
After all, Long Wuzhao asked you to kill this dragon, and he’ll probably be furious if he finds out that you transformed yourself into this dragon."
"Long Wuzhao should already be aware of my intentions towards this guy; otherwise, Tianshi Shengjie wouldn’t have asked me that." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then asked the other two.
"What do you two think will happen if I transform into him and implant his core into my body?"
