paragraphs: "Master, I can’t be sure about that, especially since you already have three forms now. If you transform into him, it might affect one or even all three."
Ma Kuangyu nodded in agreement. "Yushu is right, kid. Your transformation might affect one or all three of your forms, or you might create your fourth form."
"Why don’t you use this guy to transform one of them into him, husband?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head at Yan Jinwu. "The Calamity Demon Dragon is no ordinary beast, remember? Even Long Wuzhao couldn’t kill him in the past, and he was forced to seal him in this place. If I turn one of them into one, she won’t be able to live peacefully outside, and people will hunt her down if they know that she is the calamity bringer. Therefore, I considered transforming myself into him, as I believe his abilities will be beneficial to me in the future."
"Doesn’t that mean you’ll be the calamity bringer yourself?" Yan Jinwu curiously asked.

"Hahaha." Long Zhaihuo laughed at that. "Little girl, even without transforming into the Calamity Demon Dragon, he’s no different from a walking calamity, and he always brings calamity wherever he goes."

"You’re right, he is indeed a walking calamity." Yan Jinwu immediately agreed. "Before he came to this realm, all the beast races lived peacefully. Everything changed because of his arrival, and some of them have become his slaves now."
[Master, you don’t need to think about that and can leave everything to the system. I believe the system knows what’s best for you, and it will give you the results that match your expectations.]

Zhang Xialong [3] nodded slightly before taking out the item Long Wuzhao had given him, which Tianshi Shengjie had given him some time ago. The item looked more like a dagger made from a golden dragon scale. "I don’t think I need to use this dagger to kill this guy."

"This dagger is clearly made from the scales of Long Wuzhao, husband. However, I don’t understand why he chose to use his precious scales to make this dagger." Yan Jinwu spoke as she seriously looked at the dagger.

"I don’t know Long Wuzhao’s reasons, but this dagger is mine now. Therefore, I will keep it, and who knows, it will be useful in the future." Zhang Xiaolong [3] kept the dagger again. "Yushu, release his soul now, and you can confine him in my tiny soul world after I separate it from his body."

Long Zhaihuo first reverted to his dragon form before releasing his soul, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately used his soul domain. He then used his soul manipulation ability to separate the dragon’s soul from his body, causing his body to fall lifeless to the ground.
Since Long Zhaihuo’s soul was still under her control, Nalan Yushu immediately brought him into Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s tiny soul world, imprisoning him there.

Ma Kuangyu looked at Long Zhaihuo’s corpse for a moment before following Nalan Yushu, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] summoned Tian Kui and Serpentera out of the beast space after he sent Yan Jinwu back to the training space.
"Oh?" Tian Kui and Serpentera were taken aback as soon as they saw Long Zhaihuo’s corpse. "Hey! I didn’t expect you to beat him this fast, kid!"

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed at that. "Old Kui, I wouldn’t have been able to defeat him if I hadn’t borrowed your and Serpentera’s strength, okay? Moreover, he was so afraid of the Golden Crow Flame, and Nalan Yushu also helped me control his soul, which made it easier for me to defeat him."

Serpentera immediately squatted by the side of Long Zhaihuo’s corpse, and he extracted his Calamity Demon Dragon Bloodline before taking his cultivation core. He gave the Calamity Demon Dragon Bloodline and cultivation core to Zhang Xiaolong [3], who immediately stored them in the system inventory.
After Serpentera finished, Tian Kui dissected Long Zhaihuo’s corpse, separating several important parts of his body, such as his eyes, heart, nails, mane, bone marrow, and skeleton.
"Are you really going to turn yourself into this dragon, kid?" Tian Kui asked as he destroyed the unused remains of Long Zhaihuo’s corpse.

"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in reply. "The Calamity Demon Dragon is no ordinary mythical beast; his aura caused you two to tremble before, right? Therefore, I will not waste the opportunity to strengthen myself by transforming into him, and I will implant his cultivation core into my body after I transform."

Serpentera immediately voiced his concern. "Won’t that affect your other three forms? If you transform from a heavenly fox into another demon form, you might never be able to evolve to ten tails, and the writing left behind by the ten-tailed fox will never be fulfilled."

"Honestly, I’m worried about that too, but I trust the thing within me, and I’m sure everything will be fine." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then opened the gate to the Sovereign Realm. "You two can return to that realm first, and I’ll go to my private place to go through the process."
After Serpentera and Tian Kui left, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately closed the gate. However, he sensed something from the mountaintop, so he hurriedly left the place and went there.
Sometime later, Zhang Xiaolong [3] arrived at the mountaintop and rushed into the Golden Shrine all the way to the final chamber, where he found Long Wuzhao’s avatar waiting for him.

Unlike their first encounter, Long Wuzhao’s avatar wasn’t his complete dragon form but his human form. However, Zhang Xiaolong [3] didn’t expect him to look so young, appearing more like a teenage boy with waist-length golden hair. "You came because you sensed Long Zhaihuo’s death, right?"
"That’s right." Long Wuzhao nodded at him. "I sensed Long Zhaihuo’s death, but you didn’t kill him using my dagger, and you killed him using another method."

"Why do you seem disappointed that I didn’t kill him using your dagger?" Zhang Xiaolong asked as he showed the golden dagger to Long Wuzhao. "This dagger is made from your golden scales, so it’s too valuable to just kill it. Since you gave it to me, it’s mine now, and I won’t give it back to you."

"Hahaha," Long Wuzhao laughed in response. "I will never ask for anything I’ve given to others back, so you can keep the dagger and use it as you wish. If you sell it at auction in the Forbidden Realm, you’ll likely get billions or even trillions of golden jewels."

"Selling a gift from someone else is an act of disrespect, and I would never do that. Furthermore, this golden dagger is still useful for other things, right?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] put the dagger away before he asked the golden dragon a question. "Since I’ve helped you sort out the mess you left behind in this realm millions of years ago, I can at least ask one favor of you, right?"
"You want to take advantage of me, eh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] responded to Long Wuzhao with a broad smile. "What do you want as a reward?"

"Tianshi Shengjie." Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s request took Long Wuzhao aback. "That female dragon toyed with me a few years ago, and I couldn’t possibly defeat her with my current strength. However, you are different from me, and you can force her to come to me, so I ask for her from you."

Long Wuzhao had naturally heard about the matter from Tianshi Shengjie’s report, but he immediately refused Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Unfortunately, I cannot fulfill your request regarding her, especially since she is the princess of the Celestial Dragon Race. Indeed, I can order her to come to you and stay with you, but her race members will never be willing to let her go. If I force your wishes on her, they will consider you an enemy and attack you directly. Furthermore, she is the goddaughter of the Void Dragon Race, and they are the second strongest dragon after me. If you want her, you must increase your strength and evolve to the ten tails first; otherwise, you’ll never be able to get through them to get to her."
"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] frowned deeply when Long Wuzhao revealed this information. "How strong is the Void Dragon Race?"

"Long Xukong’s cultivation is at the Celestial God Realm, just like mine. He dotes on Tianshi Shengjie very much, and he will do anything to give her the best. Apart from him, the Void Dragon Race still has ten dragons with cultivation at the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Stage. Moreover, you already understand the power of the Void Element, so you should be able to guess their strength, right?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] exhaled softly before nodding to Long Wuzhao. "So, what are your plans for Long Zhaihuo next? Do you truly intend to transform yourself into the Calamity Demon Dragon?

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in acknowledgment. "Just like you and the ten-tailed fox, there is only one Calamity Demon Dragon in this universe. Therefore, I will never let his race vanish, and I will become the second dragon of his race. Moreover, I know more about this universe than you do, and my gut feeling is that we’re going to face some incredibly big challenges in the distant future. Thus, I want to be a living being that is different from all other living beings in this universe; only then can I face all those challenges."
"You mean the Primordial Nihility Beast and the Primordial Genesis Beast, right?"

"No." Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head at Long Wuzhao. "Those two primordial beasts are indeed powerful, but there are still some people who are much stronger than them. I know two people whose strength surpasses those two beasts, and they are fully capable of eradicating them without breaking a sweat. However, I can’t say too much about them for now because one of them keeps watching me, but I have a feeling that they will come to you someday, so you just have to wait for the day to come."
"At least, you can give me a name, right?"
"Empress Huo Yanling."
Long Wuzhao took a deep breath after Zhang Xiaolong [3] mentioned the name. "So, you’ve met Empress Huo Yanling’s reincarnation before, huh?"
"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at him. "Not only have I met her reincarnation before, but we have quite a close connection, and she has helped me too many times."

"Empress Huo Yanling defeated me too many times in the past, and I couldn’t move a step when facing her. Before I realized her movement, I was already lying on the ground. Therefore, I don’t understand why she chose to reincarnate even though her strength was already that high, and no one in the Paradise Realm could defeat her." Long Wuzhao fell into contemplation for quite some time. "Since she has returned, she will come to me soon, and I’m looking forward to it. I will return now, and I hope that your decision to become the next Calamity Demon Dragon will not bring disasters to you or those closest to you."
"Hmm?" Long Wuzhao instantly disappeared from Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s sight, causing him to let out a soft sigh. "What does he mean by his last sentence? What kind of disaster is he referring to?"
After that, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately returned to the Sovereign Heaven Realm, continuing his cultivation within the Life Pond.

Zhang Fei, who was previously dual cultivating with one of his women, decided to stop and go to the main garden. All of his women immediately followed him there and saw him take out the science capsule.
All of them were surprised once Zhang Fei took out Long Zhaihuo’s skeleton, and Jia Yuyan questioned him directly. "Are you going to merge this skeleton with your body, husband?"
"How do you plan to merge such a large skeleton with your body, husband?" Shangguan Yan asked.
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei softly laughed before squatting beside the skeleton and touching it. "Isn’t that easy? I can even manipulate my bone age, so it’s not difficult for me to do it, right?"
"That’s true." Murong Qianying nodded in agreement. "The first time I met him, he was a ten-year-old boy, but that was just his trick, and he turned out to be a grown-up man."

"Our husband lied to us for so long." Hong Xinxin then embraced Shang Yaolin. "She intentionally brought him to the Wasteland Realm because he was such a cute little boy, but she didn’t realize that she had fallen into his trap from the start because of his innocent demeanor."
Shang Yaolin released a soft sigh. "Mother! Aunt Xinxin! That matter has long passed, and we don’t need to bring it up again."
"Our husband is indeed a cunning fox, and he always manages to deceive many people, especially women." Shang Yumei spoke, followed by a nod of agreement from Shang Xinyu.

"Haha." Murong Mengying laughed at that. "Unlike you guys, I’ve realized that he was a grown-up man since he arrived in the Wasteland Realm, but I wasn’t interested in interfering in his affairs because I felt I needed him to defeat the Shang Clan, so I didn’t say anything to you."
Murong Qianying, Hong Xinxin, Shao Yaolin, Shang Yumei, and Shang Xinyue glared at Murong Mengying, who responded with a shrug. "Husband, do it now, and we will continue our seclusion again."

"You’re addicted to my dick after having sex with me once, huh?" Zhang Fei shrank Long Zhaihuo’s skeleton until it fit into the hole of the science capsule, and he also did the same with his bone marrow. He then handed over all the other body parts and bloodline to some of his women, but he took the cultivation core with him into the capsule. "Put them into the ten holes, and I’ll start the process."

After Zhang Fei closed the capsule lid, they immediately placed those items into the ten different holes. Once everything was ready, Mei immediately began the process, making all the women anxiously await the results.
"What do you guys think will happen next? Will Fei turn into a new beast species?" Chu Qing asked them, but none of them had an answer for her.
Luo Yunxiao then spoke to them. "I suspect that our husband will not transform into a new beast species, and he will probably obtain a fourth form."
"Fourth form?"

"Yes." Luo Yunxiao nodded to them. "Our husband’s three identities are clearly separated from each other, unlike the new beast species that Lin’er, Sister Xue, Sister Lingxue, and the others became after their transformation. Therefore, I am more inclined to believe that he will obtain a fourth form rather than become a new beast species; however, we do not need to overthink this. We only need to wait for the process to complete, and we will know the result after that."

Unlike when Mei helped Zhang Lingxue and several other women, Zhang Fei’s transformation process was much more complicated, especially since he not only wanted to use Long Zhaihuo’s Calamity Demon Dragon Bloodline, but he also intended to merge his skeleton, bone marrow, and dragon core into his body.
In the end, Zhang Fei’s transformation process lasted two full months in the pavilion, and all his women immediately crowded around the capsule once they realized it had stopped operating.
[Ding]
[The Calamity Demon Dragon’s bloodline has merged with the host’s body.]
[The Calamity Demon Dragon’s skeleton has merged with the host’s body.]
[The Calamity Demon Dragon’s bone marrow has merged with the host’s body.]
[The host obtained the fourth form: the Calamity Demon Dragon.]
[The host obtained the Calamity Demon Dragon’s abilities.]
[The host’s transformation process is complete.]

A while later, Zhang Fei opened the lid and got out of the capsule, and they immediately scrambled to check him. However, they did not find any changes in him, and he still looked like a human in general.

"You guys don’t need to be curious like this, okay?" Zhang Fei immediately used his new form. Two large, black dragon horns appeared above his head. Two large, black dragon wings appeared on his back, with a dragon tail behind his hips.

Zhang Fei’s skin turned black and displayed strange symbols on various parts of his body, mixed with black dragon scales. His eyes turned even redder compared to his usual demon eyes, and his ears turned pointed like an elf’s. His hands and legs turned into dragon hands and feet.

"Woah! Your new form is amazing, Big Brother!" Xu Ling’er was the first to react, and she groped around her body, feeling her tough skin full of dragon scales. "Does this form of yours not affect your other three forms, Big Brother?"

"I had the help of two ancient beasts, Father. However, I won’t discuss them for now, especially since the sky has eyes and walls have ears." Luo Fenghan nodded in understanding. "So, why hasn’t your cultivation improved even though you’ve become the Calamity Demon Dragon?"
"That’s—"

Ma Kuangyu came straight out of Zhang Fei [1]’s tiny soul world. "This kid hasn’t absorbed Long Zhaihuo’s soul yet, Fenghan. Nalan Yushu has already stored that dragon’s past strength in his soul, but it was filled with negative emotions. Therefore, I asked this kid to come here and ask for your help in cleansing the dragon’s soul first, and he will absorb it after that."
"Let’s go." Luo Fenghan immediately led the two to another area.

A while later, they arrived at a room where a large white crystal rotated by itself in the center. Zhang Fei [1] and Ma Kuangyu could feel a powerful light element in the room, which continued to flow into the white crystal.

"This place is the core of my Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, and that crystal can help you purify Long Zhaihuo’s soul. However, I don’t know where my ancestors found that crystal, and it’s been here for millions of years." Luo Fenghan then led them to approach an old man who was standing in front of the crystal. "Uncle Zhenhai, my son-in-law needs your help to purify a soul, but the soul is not an ordinary one."
"Hmm?" Luo Zhenhai immediately turned to Zhang Fei [1]. "What kind of soul do you want to purify?"

"A dragon soul filled with negative emotions." Nalan Yushu immediately brought Long Zhaihuo’s soul out of Zhang Fei [1]’s tiny soul world, causing Luo Zhenhai to frown. "He used to be the Calamity Demon Dragon, and Long Wuzhao asked me to eradicate him, but it would be a shame if I just eliminated him because his soul power and past strength were quite powerful. Thus, I asked Yushu to control his soul, and I wanted to absorb his soul to strengthen my soul and obtain his past strength."

Although he didn’t appear at Zhang Fei [1]’s wedding to Luo Yunxiao, Luo Zhenhai still received some information revealed at their wedding, including Tianshi Shengjie’s revelation of his relationship with Long Wuzhao, so he wasn’t surprised to hear it.

"Ask your friend to release this dragon’s soul first." Nalan Yushu immediately released Long Zhaihuo’s soul from her control, but her appearance surprised Luo Zhenhai. He immediately moved to confine the dragon’s soul, which was trying to escape from the room. "A demon from the Soul-Devouring Demon Race, huh? Moreover, you’re not an ordinary member of that demon race, are you?"
"I don’t want to discuss my identity with you, old man." Nalan Yushu immediately returned to Zhang Fei [1]’s tiny soul world.

"How do you know that female demon, kid?" Luo Zhenhai asked as she sent Long Zhaihuo’s soul into the white crystal, and he immediately began the process of purifying his soul, making the dragon’s soul scream hysterically. "The negative emotions in his soul have accumulated for so long and have become extremely thick, so the process won’t be completed in a short time, and it might take several years for all the negative emotions to completely disappear."

"I’m in no rush with that, so you can take it slow, Senior." Zhang Fei [1] then told Luo Zhenhai about his meeting with Nalan Yushu and Ma Kuangyu at the Star Tower. "Tian Qiye killed her and sent her soul to the tower."

Luo Zhenhai nodded in understanding. "I’ve met and fought with Tian Qiye several times in the past, so I can tell you that she’s one of the strongest among all the Winged Race’s grand elders. She’s always hated and held enmity towards all demon races, and she’ll kill any demon that appears before her indiscriminately. I can’t confirm your friend’s identity, but that woman’s decision not to destroy her soul and imprison her proves her extraordinary status within the Soul-Devouring Demon Race. Since the relationship between the two of you is so close, I advise you to be prepared to face that woman, especially since she will attack you if she knows the presence of your friend by your side."

"Thank you for your advice, Senior." Zhang Fei [1] sincerely replied. "For now, I don’t have the strength to fight a cultivator as powerful as Tian Qiye, but I will never stop improving myself, and I will reach his level one day."

Your determination is much stronger and firmer than many of the younger generation in this sect, including those two lazy brats, Luo Zhenyu and Luo Jiaxuan. Moreover, you’re still so young, and your path still has a long road ahead. Even a cultivator of Long Wuzhao’s caliber is willing to form a relationship with you, so I believe you will become a renowned cultivator in the future. However, you must never waver on your path of cultivation, and you must maintain your strong determination to achieve it."
"I understand, Senior." Zhang Fei [1] then asked Ma Kuangyu into his tiny soul world. "Senior! Father! I will leave Long Zhaihuo’s soul to the two of you, and I will return to my seclusion now."

"Yes." Luo Fenghan nodded at him. "After their wedding, I’ve met the others and informed them about him, and they should have started monitoring him."

"That’s good." Luo Zhenhai nodded slightly in response. "Our relationship with that kid could be a blessing or a disaster for us, so you must be prepared for all possibilities. That kid may have faced many major problems in the Three Mortal Realms, but this Paradise Realm is completely different, and his talent will arouse envy wherever he goes. If he manages to overcome all the obstacles that lie ahead, we will also gain many benefits. However, there are many sects and clans that are far stronger than us in other domains, and we won’t be able to protect him forever. If he makes a wrong move and becomes their enemy, he will likely drag us down with him."

Luo Fenghan released a soft sigh. "I’m worried about that too, but I’m sure he won’t be so foolish as to cause trouble with those people. Moreover, he won’t be coming out anytime soon, especially since he’s already planning to go into seclusion for five years. I don’t know how far his progress will be in the next five years, but I hope he’ll have already broken through to the Five Celestial Realms by the time he comes out. Moreover, I can see quite a strong arrogance in his eyes, so you must warn him to restrain himself when you bring him there, especially since we are not strong enough to fight them."

Luo Fenghan nodded in agreement with him. "Five years is still quite a long time, but I will definitely advise him at that time. Uncle, please try to complete the purification of this dragon’s soul as soon as possible, so he can absorb it to gain his past strength."
"Alright."

After his clone returned to the pavilion and there were no more problems at hand, Zhang Fei decided to swallow the Crimson Yang Flower, which caused his Yang Qi to overflow rapidly. "Damn it! I already guessed that the effects would be too strong!"

"Husband."

"The Calamity Demon Dragon is indeed extraordinary, and our husband’s Yang Qi changed completely." Huli Zhisen spoke as she observed them.

Feng Yichen nodded in agreement with her. "Unlike our beast races, there is only one Calamity Demon Dragon in this universe, like the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon. Fortunately, Long Zhaihuo has been sealed for a long time and hasn’t developed at all, and our husband has powerful supporters like Tian Kui and Serpentera; otherwise, he would never have been able to defeat him, let alone become his successor."

"What do you guys think will happen if the other beast races in the Paradise Realm learn of our husband’s identity as the Calamity Demon Dragon? Will they become hostile to him?" Nu Qichen asked the other female beasts.

’The problem lies not with the other beast races, but with Long Wuzhao.’ They turned to Zhu Lingyao, the vermilion bird. ’In the past, the golden dragon wanted to kill the Calamity Demon Dragon, but he was unable to do so and instead sealed him in the Sky Dragon Realm. He hasn’t said anything about our husband’s decision to become Long Zhaihuo’s successor, but I won’t trust him completely. Perhaps he will change his mind one day, and he might turn against our husband because of his decision; thus, we cannot trust him completely, and we must always be wary of him.’

"I agree with Lingyao," Huli Haohao spoke, nodding in agreement. "Long Wuzhao is truly powerful, and there are so many powerful beasts under his command. Fortunately, our husband has many advantages that no one else has, especially this training space. He has decided to enter seclusion for the next five years, which means we will be in seclusion for twenty years here. Since the people who might become our enemies are too powerful, we must fully focus on our seclusion, and all of us must successfully break through to the Five Celestial Realms before we end our seclusion. Otherwise, we won’t be able to survive if we have to face them, and we will only become his burden."

Feng Qingmeng then spoke. "Since our husband’s Yang Qi has completely transformed and become much stronger thanks to his merging with Long Zhaihuo’s body parts, I think our cultivation will accelerate further. This way, the Five Celestial Realms will be even closer to our reach, but we can’t be satisfied with just reaching that stage because those people have already reached several higher stages, so we must also strive hard in the next twenty years to reach the highest level possible."
"Let’s stop talking and start cultivating, especially since our husband still has to take care of our other sisters," Huli Xianniang said as she summoned her seven avatars.

Feng Yichen and all the women present in the bedroom did the same, making it completely crowded. They and their avatars immediately started their cultivation, waiting for their turn to dual cultivate with Zhang Fei.

Only Luo Yunxiao didn’t summon her nine avatars, and she looked at them one by one with a faint smile on her face. ’Twenty years, huh? In his castle, Long Wuzhao stood on the balcony and stared into the distance with a calm expression. "You have finally arrived, Shengjie."

Long Wuzhao then spoke again. "That kid is quite persistent, so I’m sure he’ll come here to pick you up someday."
"That’s true," Tianshi Shengjie replied with a helpless sigh. "In that case, I will leave to resume that task, Emperor."
"Yes."

Both her body and the black lotus within her soul began to absorb his Yang Qi, even though they were not engaged in dual cultivation.
At the bedside, her six avatars had begun absorbing the Celestial Qi from the air before channeling it into her body, which slowly increased her cultivation.
Zhang Yue could feel something different from Zhang Fei’s Yang Qi, which had indeed become stronger after he merged with the bloodline, cultivation core, and bone marrow of the Calamity Demon Dragon.

Although they were only watching from the sidelines, Luo Yunxiao could also sense the changes in Zhang Fei’s Yang Qi within Zhang Yue’s body, and they impatiently awaited their turn to have upgraded his Yang Qi within their bodies.
"The Calamity Demon Dragon is indeed extraordinary, and our husband’s Yang Qi changed completely." Huli Zhisen spoke as she observed them.
Feng Yichen nodded in agreement with her.
"Unlike our beast races, there is only one Calamity Demon Dragon in this universe, like the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon.

Fortunately, Long Zhaihuo has been sealed for a long time and hasn’t developed at all, and our husband has powerful supporters like Tian Kui and Serpentera; otherwise, he would never have been able to defeat him, let alone become his successor."
"What do you guys think will happen if the other beast races in the Paradise Realm learn of our husband’s identity as the Calamity Demon Dragon?
Will they become hostile to him?" Nu Qichen asked the other female beasts.

’The problem lies not with the other beast races, but with Long Wuzhao.’ They turned to Zhu Lingyao, the vermilion bird. ’In the past, the golden dragon wanted to kill the Calamity Demon Dragon, but he was unable to do so and instead sealed him in the Sky Dragon Realm.
He hasn’t said anything about our husband’s decision to become Long Zhaihuo’s successor, but I won’t trust him completely.
Perhaps he will change his mind one day, and he might turn against our husband because of his decision; thus, we cannot trust him completely, and we must always be wary of him.’
"I agree with Lingyao," Huli Haohao spoke, nodding in agreement.
"Long Wuzhao is truly powerful, and there are so many powerful beasts under his command.
Fortunately, our husband has many advantages that no one else has, especially this training space.
He has decided to enter seclusion for the next five years, which means we will be in seclusion for twenty years here.

Since the people who might become our enemies are too powerful, we must fully focus on our seclusion, and all of us must successfully break through to the Five Celestial Realms before we end our seclusion.
Otherwise, we won’t be able to survive if we have to face them, and we will only become his burden."
Feng Qingmeng then spoke.
"Since our husband’s Yang Qi has completely transformed and become much stronger thanks to his merging with Long Zhaihuo’s body parts, I think our cultivation will accelerate further.

This way, the Five Celestial Realms will be even closer to our reach, but we can’t be satisfied with just reaching that stage because those people have already reached several higher stages, so we must also strive hard in the next twenty years to reach the highest level possible."
"Let’s stop talking and start cultivating, especially since our husband still has to take care of our other sisters," Huli Xianniang said as she summoned her seven avatars.
Feng Yichen and all the women present in the bedroom did the same, making it completely crowded.
They and their avatars immediately started their cultivation, waiting for their turn to dual cultivate with Zhang Fei.
Only Luo Yunxiao didn’t summon her nine avatars, and she looked at them one by one with a faint smile on her face. ’Twenty years, huh?

With all of them by his side, my husband’s cultivation will definitely reach the Five Celestial Realms by the end of our seclusion, and he will be ready to face all the obstacles that will come his way in the Paradise Realm then.’
In his castle, Long Wuzhao stood on the balcony and stared into the distance with a calm expression.
"You have finally arrived, Shengjie."
"Why did you suddenly summon me to return, Emperor?" Tianshi Shengjie asked respectfully.
Long Wuzhao immediately turned to face her.
"Zhang Fei has already killed Long Zhaihuo, and you are correct in guessing that he killed him using another method.
He openly stated that he would use him to strengthen himself, which means the Calamity Demon Dragon will be reborn through him."
Tianshi Shengjie released a soft sigh.
"What is your decision regarding this matter, Emperor?"
"Nothing." Long Wuzhao’s answer surprised Tianshi Shengjie.
"Zhang Fei is the future heir of the ten-tailed fox, and we need him to bring peace back to this universe.

I can only hope that he can control himself if he truly becomes Long Zhaihuo’s successor; otherwise, I will have to make a move against him, and I might kill him if he brings great calamity to this realm."
In her heart, Tianshi Shengjie also hopes the same, especially since peace would never return if Zhang Fei died.
"Is there anything else you wish to tell me, Emperor?"
"Hahaha." Long Wuzhao laughed heartily as he remembered Zhang Fei’s request.
"Shengjie, that kid wants you, and he previously asked me to send you to him.
However, I refused him because of your status in the Celestial Dragon Race and your relationship with the Void Dragon Race."
Tianshi Shengjie smiled wryly in response, as she was already aware of Zhang Fei’s desire for her since she disguised herself as Li Mengmeng many years ago.
Long Wuzhao then spoke again.
"That kid is quite persistent, so I’m sure he’ll come here to pick you up someday."
"That’s true," Tianshi Shengjie replied with a helpless sigh.
"In that case, I will leave to resume that task, Emperor."
"Yes."

chapters.title: Chapter 1075: Ice Phoenix Trials
paragraphs: Time passed so quickly inside the Pavilion that two years had already elapsed since they re-entered seclusion, which equated to a little over six months in the outside world.

At first, Zhang Fei wanted to wait for all his virgin wives to break through to the Seven Divine Realms before taking their virginities. However, he changed his mind because their cultivation was progressing too slowly under normal circumstances, and he couldn’t use the system’s harem-sharing feature with them, as their names weren’t registered in it.

Zhang Fei ultimately decided to take all his virgin wives, such as Guo Lan, Shi Wu, Shi Xi, Wen Xuan, Wen Yuan, Ming Yanyu, Wang Zhuxian, Angela, Jiang Yinghua, Meng Tianshi, Daniella, Lin Dong’er, Mu Lingshu, Balena, Huangfu Xiaoying, Huangfu Xiaomei, Ling Xiannu, Tasha, Ning Zhuan’er, and Chang Wenjie. He registered their names into the system, which allowed him to use the harem-sharing feature with them.

Although he still had not found a solution to cure Mu Lingshu’s body abnormality, Zhang Fei still decided to take her into his harem to accelerate her cultivation. Since she couldn’t feel sexual pleasure, their first night wasn’t that exciting. However, she was relieved because her husband was so understanding, and he treated her so gently during their sex session.

Considering that all of his wives who came from the middle and upper realms had already reached the Seven Divine Realms, Zhang Fei was fully focused on helping all of his wives from the Earth and the Sky Jade Realm, especially since they had not yet reached that stage.

Since he had decided to enter a long period of seclusion, Zhang Fei didn’t care much about his cultivation, and he sacrificed a lot of the Qi he got from all his wives, who had already reached the Seven Divine Realms long ago, for those who hadn’t reached that stage through the harem-sharing feature.

When his Qi was insufficient, Zhang Fei used the Qi from his prisoners inside the Yin-Yang Space. The amount of Qi in the Yin-Yang Space was obviously much greater than the amount from his wives, especially since most of his prisoners were cultivators in the Divine Ascension Realm.
Additionally, Zhang Fei kept consuming pills and several other items, especially those that had the effect of increasing his Yang Qi.

Furthermore, all of them had mastered the Nine Heavens Illusory Avatar Technique, and most of them had successfully created five or more avatars. Additionally, each of them had one avatar created using the Yin-Yang Avatar Technique, which significantly accelerated their cultivation speed.

Angela, Shi Xi, and Shi Wu were the first to reach the Seven Divine Realms, especially since their previous cultivation had shot up to the Quasi Divine Realms after they transformed into the Rainbow-Shelled Tortoise, the White Tiger, and the Azure Dragon.

After the three women reached the Seven Divine Realms, Shen Huang, Zhang Lingxue, Hu Lili, Hu Yue, and Lian Xing followed suit and also achieved this level. Once they reached that stage, Zhang Fei lessened his focus on them and focused more on helping his other wives, such as Liu Qingyu and the others.

In the end, all of Zhang Fei’s wives from the Earth and the Sky Jade Realms managed to reach the Seven Divine Realms, except for Xu Ling’er and Wu Lianzhi, who were still sixteen and seventeen years old, which was because the flow of time in the training space was four times faster than the outside world and affected their lifespan.

Although Xu Ling’er and Wu Lianzhi were not yet able to dual cultivate with Zhang Fei directly, their cultivation also increased significantly because they continued to ingest his Yang Qi through the bottle, and they managed to reach the Quasi-Divine Realm in the past two years.

Unlike his official harem members, Zhang Fei’s five clones rarely used the harem-sharing feature with their respective wives. Despite this, their cultivation also increased significantly, especially since all the items he ingested also affected his clones. They were not far from breaking through to the Seven Divine Realms, except for those who were not cultivators, like the Black Amaris, the White Amaris, and Nadea.

Among the wives of all his clones, Xie Jingxuan and Ba Shuxiang progressed the slowest because they dual cultivated with Zhang Xiaolong [3] in the Sovereign Heaven Realm, where the time flow was much slower than the training space, especially since the time flow in the space followed that of the Paradise Realm.

Although he focused on his cultivation, Zhang Fei sent Zhang Chen, Zhang Hanzi, Qing Tan, and Zhu Yan out of the training space several times. Huang Xiaoyi helped the four of them open their shop and restaurant in the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary. As in the other realms, sales at their shop and restaurant have been good since their opening, with both being flooded with customers daily.

The biggest-selling items in his shop were his pills, especially his basic pills, healing pills, Qi restoration pills, and various other pills. Unlike his shop in the Three Mortal Realms, he didn’t sell earth goods in his new shop, especially since their production would not meet the needs of his new buyers with the time flow difference being too large.

At Zhang Fei’s restaurant, Zhang Chen and the three women served earth dishes similar to those in his other restaurant in the Three Mortal Realms, with Zhu Yan continuing to act as the head cook. Like in other realms, earth dishes were popular with the diners, who not only came from the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary but also those who came from other sects and clans.

Since the Qi and time flow within the training space would change again if his real body descended to the Three Mortal Realms, Zhang Fei decided to use his fifth clone to accompany Zhang Yue to the Phoenix Realm.
Zhang Fei [5] took Zhang Yue, Feng Xueying, and Feng Jinqiu to that realm.

"Even though your progress is much slower than your husband’s, it is still much faster than ordinary cultivators," Feng Jinqiu spoke to Zhang Yue as they followed Feng Xueying to the Frozen Lotus Basin.
Zhang Yue nodded to her. "Fortunately, Fei’er has so many women by his side, and his cultivation is quite high now, so he can help us all reach this stage."
"That’s true." Feng Jinqiu then looked at Zhang Fei. "Why hasn’t your cultivation broken through yet? Even if you help them, your cultivation should still improve, right?"

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head in response. "Senior Jinqiu, you already know that I have eight cultivation cores, which means the amount of Qi required for me to break through to the next minor stage is eight times greater than what other cultivators need; therefore, my cultivation has been progressing more slowly than it did before I broke through to the Seven Divine Realms. Besides, I’m too lazy to break through one stage at a time, so I’m holding back my cultivation, and I’ll break through several stages directly, like my previous breakthroughs. Only two years have passed from the total long period of seclusion that I planned, so I still have a lot of time to improve my cultivation. If necessary, I will extend my seclusion period, and we will exit after I reach the Five Celestial Realms."

"I see." Feng Jinqiu nodded in understanding. "With your number of women and all the advantages you have, it is not impossible for you to reach the Five Celestial Realms within the next eighteen years, and you might already achieve it before the time limit you set is up. What are your plans after you break through to that stage?"

Zhang Fei [5] thought for a moment before answering her. "I plan to explore our current domain first, especially since Luo Yunxiao told me there are many interesting places there. After that, I will go with my father-in-law to the Forgotten Realm to look for the mysterious merchant and attend the auction that is held once every hundred years."
"An auction that is held once every hundred years?" Both Feng Xueying and Feng Jinqiu were surprised to hear that.

Zhang Fei [5] nodded at them. "If you two want to look around there, you guys can join us then. Since your cultivation has already reached the 1-Sun Celestial Lord Realm, I think there’s no problem if you want to join us, Senior Xueying. However, Senior Jinqiu’s cultivation is still at the Divine Fusion Realm now, and she will probably be quite pressured by the presence of those powerful cultivators there."
"Do you think I can reach the Five Celestial Realms in eighteen years?" Feng Jinqiu asked.

Zhang Fei [5] turned to Feng Jinqiu and gave her several bottles of his Yang Qi. "If you want to reach that stage in eighteen years, you have no other choice but to cultivate using my Yang Qi. Additionally, you can stay in my pavilion, like Senior Sister Jing Qiuyue, if you want your cultivation to be faster."

’This guy!’ Feng Jinqiu accepted Zhang Fei’s Yang Qi and stored the bottle in her storage ring, but she had not yet decided whether to use it. "Since Jing Qiuyue lives in your pavilion, I will live there with her from the future."

"Yeah," Zhang Fei [5] then asked Feng Xueying. "How about you also live with them, Senior Xueying? Your cultivation has indeed reached the 1-Sun Celestial Lord Realm, but there are too many cultivators far stronger than you there. If you cultivate in my pavilion for the next eighteen years, you might have broken through several minor stages by the time we leave."
Feng Xueying nodded slightly. "I’ll be staying with Feng Jinqiu and Jing Qiuyue there."
"That’s good." Zhang Fei and the others immediately looked up at Feng Shen, who was flying toward them.
The ancestor of the Fire Phoenix race was shocked when he couldn’t detect Feng Xueying’s cultivation. "Have you broken through to that realm?"
"My cultivation is at the 1-Sun Celestial Lord Realm now." Feng Xueying replied with a nod.
Feng Shen was jealous after hearing that, especially since their previous cultivation was equal, but Feng Xueying had already surpassed him now.

Zhang Fei [5] directly spoke to him. "You don’t need to be jealous of her, especially since I plan to bring all the phoenixes, whether the fire phoenix or ice phoenix, to the Paradise Realm in the future. At that time, your cultivation will also break through to the Five Celestial Realms. However, I still don’t have a strong foundation there, so I won’t do it anytime soon, so you have to wait patiently."
"Are you really going to bring all the phoenixes to that realm? Where will we live then?"

"Do I need to lie to you?" Zhang Fei [5] shook his head in return. "Feng Tian and Feng Jiu have already handed over the phoenix race to me, so they are my family too, and I will take you all to that realm in the future. As for your next residence, I will discuss this matter with Feng Yao first. She is the leader of the Blazing Nirvana Domain, so I think she will probably place you all there. We will discuss this matter again in the future, especially since I returned here to accompany my big sister through the ice phoenix ritual."
Feng Shen turned directly to Zhang Yue, and he was shocked to learn that her cultivation had already reached the 1-Moon Divine Transcend Realm.
Zhang Fei [5] simply shook his head at Feng Shen’s expression and then asked Feng Xueying to lead them again.

A while later, they arrived at Feng Xueying’s frozen lake, but the Frozen Lotus Basin wasn’t there. She led them through the frozen lake until they reached the edge of the clearing, but there was nothing there except a frozen flower crystal.

Feng Xueying directly spoke to Zhang Fei [5]. "The Frozen Lotus Basin is a separate dimension built by the first Ice Phoenix, so I’ll send Zhang Yue there now, and the Ice Phoenix ritual will begin as soon as she arrives."
"Can I accompany her in there?" Zhang Fei [5] asked this, observing the frozen flower crystal.

"No." Zhang Fei [5] turned to Feng Xueying directly. "Only ice phoenixes and those with ice phoenix bloodlines can enter that place, so you can’t accompany her there. Moreover, her cultivation is quite high now, and she has surpassed those who have undergone the ritual in the past, so you shouldn’t need to worry about her, right?"

"Senior Xueying, you have lived with me for so many years, so you should already understand my character, right?" Zhang Yue wanted to stop Zhang Fei [5], but instead, he prevented her from intervening. "Even though my big sister’s cultivation is quite high, I can’t possibly allow her to undergo such risky trials by herself. Since the only requirement to enter that place is to possess the ice phoenix bloodline, I hope you are willing to give me ten drops of your origin bloodline. This way, I can accompany her there, and I will help her complete the trials."

Feng Xueying let out a soft sigh because Zhang Fei [5] was being overly protective of Zhang Yue, but she immediately agreed to his request by taking ten drops of her origin Ice Phoenix Bloodline before handing it to him. "Usually, I wouldn’t give my bloodline to anyone, but you’ve helped me so much in getting me to my current stage, so I’m giving it to you."

"Thank you." Zhang Fei [5] immediately stored Feng Xueying’s bloodline in a bottle and stored it in the system’s inventory, which allows his real body or other clones to use it in the pavilion, speeding up the merging of his bloodline. "Let’s wait for a while."

As they waited, Feng Xueying explained to them about the Ice Phoenix Trials. "The trials are divided into five stages, but no one has ever made it past the third stage. The first is the Frozen Soul Gate, and you must walk through a corridor of glacial winds that freeze one’s soul and endure the chilling pressure of the Ice Phoenix’s aura, but weak-willed or impure souls will be instantly expelled. The second is the Mirror of the Heart, which will test your heart clarity and emotional balance. The third is the Flame Within Ice, and it—"
"Flame within the ice?"

"Even though the Ice Phoenix’s basic element is the ice element, we can also awaken our flames, specifically the Cold Flame." Feng Xueying then stretched out her right hand, and a light blue flame appeared above her palm. However, it didn’t feel hot in the slightest, but instead, it emitted a cold aura. "This cold flame can freeze almost anything in this universe, except for the flame of the Fire Phoenix and the golden flame of the Golden Crow."
"What are the fourth and fifth trials, Senior?" Zhang Yue asked.

"The fourth is Silent Meditation, but I’m sure you won’t have any trouble passing it. The third trial is the most challenging, and if you fail, you will face the same fate as your predecessors." Zhang Yue took a deep breath after Feng Xueying said that. "The fifth and final trial is the Bloodline Awakening; you must endure the baptism of divine cold and ancestral cry. Once you merge with the remnant soul or blood essence of the Ice Phoenix, your ice phoenix bloodline will be fully awakened, and your strength will increase significantly."
"What will happen if she fails to awaken her bloodline?" Zhang Fei [5] asked.

"She will freeze to death." Feng Xueying’s answer caused Zhang Fei [5] to frown. "Since you will inherit my Ice Phoenix bloodline soon, you will also face the rituals inside, so I don’t think you will have a chance to help Zhang Yue."

Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "Even though you say that, I believe I can help her. The cold of the ice phoenix is indeed terrifying, but you surely remember that I possess the phoenix flame and the golden crow flame, right? Since you said that the cold cannot freeze those two flames, I should have no difficulty in facing my trials, and I will help my big sister pass hers."
"Yes." Feng Xueying nodded at him. "Tell me when you’re ready, and I’ll send you both in there straightaway."

Zhang Fei [5] simply shook his head at Feng Shen’s expression and then asked Feng Xueying to lead them again.
A while later, they arrived at Feng Xueying’s frozen lake, but the Frozen Lotus Basin wasn’t there.
She led them through the frozen lake until they reached the edge of the clearing, but there was nothing there except a frozen flower crystal.
Feng Xueying directly spoke to Zhang Fei [5].
"The Frozen Lotus Basin is a separate dimension built by the first Ice Phoenix, so I’ll send Zhang Yue there now, and the Ice Phoenix ritual will begin as soon as she arrives."
"Can I accompany her in there?" Zhang Fei [5] asked this, observing the frozen flower crystal.
"No." Zhang Fei [5] turned to Feng Xueying directly.
"Only ice phoenixes and those with ice phoenix bloodlines can enter that place, so you can’t accompany her there.
Moreover, her cultivation is quite high now, and she has surpassed those who have undergone the ritual in the past, so you shouldn’t need to worry about her, right?"

"Senior Xueying, you have lived with me for so many years, so you should already understand my character, right?" Zhang Yue wanted to stop Zhang Fei [5], but instead, he prevented her from intervening.
"Even though my big sister’s cultivation is quite high, I can’t possibly allow her to undergo such risky trials by herself.
Since the only requirement to enter that place is to possess the ice phoenix bloodline, I hope you are willing to give me ten drops of your origin bloodline.
This way, I can accompany her there, and I will help her complete the trials."

Feng Xueying let out a soft sigh because Zhang Fei [5] was being overly protective of Zhang Yue, but she immediately agreed to his request by taking ten drops of her origin Ice Phoenix Bloodline before handing it to him.
"Usually, I wouldn’t give my bloodline to anyone, but you’ve helped me so much in getting me to my current stage, so I’m giving it to you."

"Thank you." Zhang Fei [5] immediately stored Feng Xueying’s bloodline in a bottle and stored it in the system’s inventory, which allows his real body or other clones to use it in the pavilion, speeding up the merging of his bloodline.
"Let’s wait for a while."
As they waited, Feng Xueying explained to them about the Ice Phoenix Trials.
"The trials are divided into five stages, but no one has ever made it past the third stage.

The first is the Frozen Soul Gate, and you must walk through a corridor of glacial winds that freeze one’s soul and endure the chilling pressure of the Ice Phoenix’s aura, but weak-willed or impure souls will be instantly expelled.
The second is the Mirror of the Heart, which will test your heart clarity and emotional balance.
The third is the Flame Within Ice, and it—"
"Flame within the ice?"

"Even though the Ice Phoenix’s basic element is the ice element, we can also awaken our flames, specifically the Cold Flame." Feng Xueying then stretched out her right hand, and a light blue flame appeared above her palm.
However, it didn’t feel hot in the slightest, but instead, it emitted a cold aura.
"This cold flame can freeze almost anything in this universe, except for the flame of the Fire Phoenix and the golden flame of the Golden Crow."
"What are the fourth and fifth trials, Senior?" Zhang Yue asked.
"The fourth is Silent Meditation, but I’m sure you won’t have any trouble passing it.
The third trial is the most challenging, and if you fail, you will face the same fate as your predecessors." Zhang Yue took a deep breath after Feng Xueying said that.
"The fifth and final trial is the Bloodline Awakening; you must endure the baptism of divine cold and ancestral cry.
Once you merge with the remnant soul or blood essence of the Ice Phoenix, your ice phoenix bloodline will be fully awakened, and your strength will increase significantly."
"What will happen if she fails to awaken her bloodline?" Zhang Fei [5] asked.
"She will freeze to death." Feng Xueying’s answer caused Zhang Fei [5] to frown.
"Since you will inherit my Ice Phoenix bloodline soon, you will also face the rituals inside, so I don’t think you will have a chance to help Zhang Yue."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding.
"Even though you say that, I believe I can help her.
The cold of the ice phoenix is indeed terrifying, but you surely remember that I possess the phoenix flame and the golden crow flame, right?
Since you said that the cold cannot freeze those two flames, I should have no difficulty in facing my trials, and I will help my big sister pass hers."
"Yes." Feng Xueying nodded at him.
"Tell me when you’re ready, and I’ll send you both in there straightaway."

chapters.title: Chapter 1076: The Ice Phoenix
paragraphs: [Obtained Ice Phoenix Origin Bloodline.]
"Finally!" Zhang Fei [5] then spoke to Feng Xueying. "I’m ready, so please send us there now, Senior."
Feng Xueying first observed his body before touching the frozen flower crystal, which immediately sucked Zhang Fei [5] and Zhang Yue into it. "Now it’s up to them."
"I think they will have no trouble passing those trials, ancestors." Feng Xueying nodded in agreement with Feng Jinqiu. "The question now is which of the two of them will receive the inheritance."

"That kid possessed many things in his body, and he transformed into the Calamity Demon Dragon two years ago. Therefore, I believe that he will refuse to accept the inheritance; instead, he will pass it on to Zhang Yue." Feng Xueying then stretched out her hand to Feng Jinqiu. "Give me a bottle of his Yang Qi."
"Eh?" Feng Jinqiu was surprised to hear that. "Do you really want to swallow his Yang Qi, Ancestor?"

"Yes." Feng Jinqiu felt strange about Feng Xueying’s decision, but she still gave her a bottle of Zhang Fei [5]’s Yang Qi, which she immediately swallowed clean. "If you want to reach the Five Celestial Realms before we end our seclusion, you must swallow his Yang Qi, and it would be even better if you cultivate it using his dual cultivation technique."
Feng Jinqiu smiled wryly at that. "Why did you suddenly decide to swallow his Yang Qi, Ancestor?"

"My cultivation has indeed reached the 1-Sun Celestial Lord, but all this time I felt that there was something lacking in me." Feng Xueying then opened her palm and used her ice element. "As I expected, even though I’ve only swallowed it once, his Yang Qi has already given me a slight improvement. If I continue to consume it, it will make up for my deficiencies. Try to digest his yang Qi first, and you’ll understand what I mean."

Feng Jinqiu knew that Zhang Fei’s Yang Qi was indeed powerful for all women, especially female beasts like them, but she was reluctant to swallow it. She knew that he had been interested in her since their first meeting in the Sky Jade Realm, and Feng Yao had also informed her of his intentions. However, she was not interested in him, and she chose to keep her distance from him.

Feng Xueying shook her head before speaking to Feng Jinqiu again. "Trust me, you will never be able to compete with cultivators in the Paradise Realm, even if your cultivation has reached the Five Celestial Realms. The only item that can strengthen us is his Yang Qi, so you just need to swallow it without thinking about anything else, and you will understand the changes I just mentioned."

Out of curiosity, Feng Jinqiu grabbed a bottle of Zhang Fei [5]’s Yang Qi and swallowed it directly. Moments later, she felt a subtle change in her body, and she immediately opened her palm before using her ice element.
"Did you feel it?"
Feng Jinqiu nodded at Feng Xueying. "The change was subtle, but I could still feel it. What do you think influenced his Yang Qi to become like this, Ancestor?"

"I don’t have the exact answer, but I guess it’s because of his Calamity Demon Dragon bloodline." Feng Jinqiu looked at Feng Xueying with surprise. "That kid may be the future heir of the ten-tailed fox, but he hasn’t evolved into one yet, and he’s still no different from those heavenly foxes. Meanwhile, that dragon is no ordinary dragon, and he’s the only one of his kin in this universe. His existence is special, and it may be comparable to the ten-tailed fox."

Feng Jinqiu seemed doubtful about that. "Isn’t that impossible, Ancestor? Zhang Fei [5] said that the ten-tailed fox is a primordial beast that has lived for a very long time, and the Calamity Demon Dragon lived in a distant era, so I find it hard to believe that the two are comparable."

"I only said maybe, so I’m not sure about it myself." Feng Xueying then sat in her spot. "Go to our people and tell them to prepare from now on, so they won’t be shocked if that kid takes them to the Paradise Realm in the future."
"Yes, Ancestor."
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [5] and Zhang Yue arrived at the first trial site, a corridor filled with glacial winds. He held her hand, activated his fire element, and led her into it.

As soon as they entered the corridor, a powerful pressure fell upon them out of nowhere. Zhang Yue was not particularly affected by the pressure, but Zhang Fei [5] felt pressured by it, despite his strong will, mainly because he was too bloody.
"Fei’er."

"It’s okay, Big Sis." Zhang Fei [5] activated the soul link and countered the pressure, which instantly dispelled it. "The pressure just now is powerful, but it won’t be able to stop me. Let’s continue."
"Yes."

Although the glacial winds inside the corridor continued to sweep over the two of them, they didn’t feel the slightest chill, mainly because of Zhang Fei [5]’s phoenix flame and golden flame constantly warming their bodies.

Unbeknownst to Zhang Fei [5] and Zhang Yue, a pair of light blue eyes was observing them with a look full of seriousness. ’He is not an ordinary heavenly fox, and he is the one mentioned by the ten-tailed fox. However, he no longer has three identities but four, and he has eleven other bloodlines, including my ice phoenix bloodline. His golden crow bloodline and flames rendered these trials useless, and he would not have the slightest difficulty completing them.’
In a few minutes, they arrived at the end of the corridor, and Zhang Fei [5] immediately led Zhang Yue to the second trial location, where they found two large ice mirrors.
They immediately stood in front of their respective ice mirrors, but the mirror in front of Zhang Fei [5] suddenly shattered into tiny ice flakes, confusing him.

’Hmm? What exactly happened? Why did this mirror shatter by itself?’ Zhang Fei [5] then turned to Zhang Yue, who had already closed her eyes. He smiled in satisfaction, seeing her expression so calm. ’Heart clarity and emotional balance, huh? I’m sure big sis won’t have any trouble getting through the second trial.’
As Zhang Fei [5] expected, Zhang Yue did not have any difficulty in completing the second trial, especially since her heart was clear and her emotions were balanced from the start.

Zhang Fei [5] and Zhang Yue hurriedly went to the location of the third trial, and they found a large, light blue flame hovering in the center of the room. Although it didn’t release any heat, the chill it emitted penetrated to the core of the body.
Zhang Fei [5] wanted to envelop Zhang Yue with his fire element, but she refused him and walked under the icy blue flame, where she sat cross-legged with her eyes closed.
In an instant, a light blue phoenix-shaped mark appeared on Zhang Yue’s forehead, and the light blue flame shot something into it, causing her to grimace as her body shivered violently.

Zhang Fei [5] frowned at that, and he hurriedly sat by Zhang Yue’s side. He wanted to envelop her with his fire element, but he saw that her expression had turned calmer, even though her body was still shivering from the chill.

Zhang Fei [5] exhaled softly and stared at the light blue flame before closing his eyes. The flame immediately shot something at the light blue mark that appeared on his forehead, like Zhang Yue’s. Unlike his big sister, he does not feel cold or shivering, mainly due to the many types of flames in his body, including his golden crow flame.

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] opened his eyes as he felt something different about the situation. He saw a woman with waist-length light blue hair standing in front of him. Despite the thick veil covering her face, he could still perceive her beauty.

The woman has a beautiful, mature face with smooth, pale skin, with a small blue jewel adorning her forehead. Her eyes were large and almond-shaped, glowing with a calm and wise look. Her lips were full and softly curved. She has a slender and tall figure, with a posture that looks calm and graceful. Her chest was modest and naturally shaped, proportionate to her figure. Her light blue and white robe with layered sheer fabric was not overly revealing, maintaining a distinguished style.
Zhang Fei [5] then asked her. "Are you the ancestor of the Ice Phoenix Race?"
"My name is Feng Shizhu." The woman answered briefly.
Zhang Fei [5] raised his eyebrows for a moment. "Is this a strand of your consciousness? Or is this a strand of your soul?"
"Both of your questions are correct." Feng Shizhu nodded in response. "I shouldn’t have appeared in front of you, but I wanted to make sure of something, and I’ve found the answer."
Feng Shizu’s answer confused Zhang Fei [5]. "What do you want to know about me?"

"Long Wuzhao just told me that the Calamity Demon Dragon had died in your hands, but he also told me that you used the dragon to turn yourself into one, which means you are his successor." Zhang Fei [5] frowned upon hearing that, and he immediately realized that Feng Shizhu was actually still alive and living in the Paradise Realm. "Your guess is correct; I am indeed still alive, and I live in the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain. In the past, I, Long Wuzhao, and several other beasts sealed Long Zhaihuo in the Sky Dragon Realm."
