chapters.title: Chapter 1077: Ice Phoenix Inheritance
paragraphs: "I see." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "Why didn’t you guys kill Long Zhaihuo at that time? You all should already know that he was afraid of the Golden Crow, and their race also existed in that era. Therefore, you should have been able to kill him at that time, right?"
Feng Shizhu nodded to him. "We actually could have killed Long Zhaihuo back then, but someone asked us not to."
"The ten-tailed fox."

"That’s right." Feng Shizhu confirmed it immediately. "Back then, the ten-tailed fox came to see us and showed off his strength, rendering all of us powerless before his immense power. At that time, we didn’t understand why he asked us to spare Long Zhaihuo’s life, but we finally understood that he was preparing the dragon for you, and you have now become the new Calamity Demon Dragon."

"Why did you choose to tell me about this matter?" Zhang Fei [5] asked in confusion. "Long Wuzhao didn’t tell me anything about this matter, and he only told me that he couldn’t kill Long Zhaihuo because their strength was equal, and he asked all of you to help him seal the dragon."

"I don’t know why Long Wuzhao didn’t tell you the truth, but I came here to warn you to control your nature as the Calamity Demon Dragon, especially with the Cursed Demon Hearth inside your body." Zhang Fei [5] took a deep breath as soon as Feng Shizhu mentioned his heart. "I once fought with the previous owner of the heart, and I almost died at his hands. Fortunately, Long Wuzhao came to my aid and killed the demon, but a mysterious person stole the heart before he could destroy it. We had been looking for the heart for a long time, but we never succeeded in finding it, and he told me that it had merged with you. Both the dragon’s nature and your heart are evil, and their combination is deadly. If you’re not careful, the dragon’s nature will affect your heart, and you should know the risks."

Zhang Fei [5] let out a soft sigh. "So many people have warned me about it, so how could I not know the risks? Even so, you don’t have to worry too much about me; I assure you that I have both of them under control. After all, I have so many people who love me by my side, and I will never let them suffer because of me."
"I hope you’re right about that."
Zhang Fei [5] then asked her again. "So, what’s your other purpose in seeing me? I’m sure you came to see me, not just to warn me about those two, right?"

"Do you want to inherit my phoenix race inheritance stored at the end of this place?" Zhang Fei [5] was surprised to hear that from Feng Shizhu. "The purpose of these trials is to find the right heir to my phoenix race inheritance, but unfortunately, no human with the ice phoenix bloodline has ever succeeded in passing through them. With all your advantages, I believe you will complete the trials."

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head in refusal. "I don’t mean to look down on your ice phoenix race, but I don’t need the inheritance. As you said, I have many advantages in my possession, and I am already completely satisfied with them. Moreover, my big sister won’t fail those trials, so you can wait for her to complete everything, and then you can pass the inheritance on to her."
"I see." Feng Shizhu nodded in understanding. "In that case, I will leave now, and I will wait for you two at the end of this place."

Zhang Fei [5]’s eyelashes trembled slightly as he returned to his body, but he felt something entering his body, which came from the light blue flame. He immediately absorbed it and circulated it throughout his body, causing him to be enveloped in the light blue flame.
[Ding]
[The host obtained the Icy Cold Flame.]

Unlike him, Zhang Yue seemed to have difficulty doing it, and her body started to freeze because of the chilling aura from the light blue flame. Zhang Fei [5] immediately moved behind his big sister, pressed his palm to her back, and helped her flow the chilling aura throughout her body.

A few hours passed quickly, and Zhang Yue finally passed the third trial with Zhang Fei [5]’s help; otherwise, she would have suffered the same fate as the challengers before her, who froze to death due to the light blue flame.

Zhang Yue opened her eyes and breathed a sigh of relief. She turned to face Zhang Fei [5] and wanted to kiss him, but she immediately remembered that he was only a clone, so she held back her excitement. "Thank you, Fei’er."

"What are you thanking me for?" Zhang Fei [5] immediately pulled Zhang Yue to her feet and led her away to the next trial. "There are only two trials left, so we should go now. However, you should prepare yourself for the last trial because it will be the hardest, and I might not be able to help you pass it. Therefore, you must prepare to face the last trial on your own, and if you succeed, you might receive something extraordinary."
"What do you mean by that, Fei’er?"
"You’ll find out later, big sis."

Sometime later, they arrived at the fourth trial, where they found two light blue lotus platforms. Zhang Fei [5] and Zhang Yue immediately took their respective seats, and they began to meditate there according to Feng Xueying’s previous explanation.
Shortly after they began, the light blue lotus platforms began to glow, and a light blue pillar shot out from both of them, enveloping Zhang Fei [5] and Zhang Yue within and lifting them into midair.

After that, snowflakes appeared from above, raining down on Zhang Fei [5] and Zhang Yue. Unlike previous trials, they didn’t feel the slightest cold, but they could sense that something was entering their bodies and souls. Gradually, a light blue symbol appears all over their skin, forming lines that merge with the mark on their forehead.
Zhang Fei [5] and Zhang Yue utilized it to improve their ice element and elemental law, especially since the ice element that appeared within the pillar was extremely pure and strong.

Unlike the third trial, the fourth trial did not last too long. Once the pillar disappeared, Zhang Fei [5] and Zhang Yue returned to the top of the lotus platform, where the symbols that had previously appeared on their bodies vanished on their own.
[Congratulations! The host’s ice element has been upgraded to the advanced stage.]
[Congratulations! The host’s ice elemental law has been upgraded to the half-perfection stage.]

Not only Zhang Fei [5], but Zhang Yue also experienced significant improvements in her ice element and elemental laws. Both of them immediately opened their eyes and smiled with satisfaction. "Only the final trial remains, Fei’er."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] immediately jumped down from the platform, followed by Zhang Yue. The two of them rushed to the final trial, which would awaken the ice phoenix within their bodies.
When they arrived there, Feng Shizhu was already waiting for them, and she gestured for Zhang Yue to sit in front of her. "I’ll start with you first, little girl."
Zhang Yue turned to Zhang Fei [5], who smiled at her and pushed her forward. She immediately sat cross-legged in front of Feng Shizhu and closed her eyes. "I’m ready, Senior."

"Calm your mind and accept everything." Feng Shizhu shot a blood clot at Zhang Yue, causing her body to gradually freeze as soon as it entered. The female phoenix waved her hand, and an extremely cold aura descended from above, enveloping her and baptizing her.
Zhang Fei [5] frowned when Feng Shizhu took out a huge pale skeleton and a soul. "Who was the previous owner of the soul and skeleton?"
"The first ice phoenix born in this universe." Zhang Fei [5] was completely shocked to hear that from Feng Shizhu.

Zhang Fei himself had met the soul of the first fire phoenix, who gave his inheritance to Zhang Lingxue. However, he did not expect that the first ice phoenix left not only her soul but also her skeleton. Even so, her soul appeared different from the first fire phoenix’s soul, especially since it did not possess consciousness. "Why don’t you inherit both of them yourself?"

"No." Feng Shizhu shook her head in response. "I am an ice phoenix myself, so I don’t need my ancestor’s skeleton. As for her soul, she divided it into four parts in the past, and I have already inherited one of them. Apart from me, Feng Xueying and Feng Jinqiu have already inherited two of them, and the last one is prepared for the person who passed the previous four trials. Since you don’t want to inherit either of them, I will give them to this little girl, and she will transform into a true ice phoenix after this."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei [5] was surprised. "Can you really turn my big sister into the true ice phoenix?"

"Just wait and see the results later." After saying that, Feng Shizhu enveloped the skeleton and the soul with her aura before sending both into Zhang Yue’s body, surprising Zhang Fei [5] again as soon as the two entered her body. "Fortunately, your big sister had already obtained another complete phoenix soul before, and your Yang Qi also strengthened her body. Otherwise, she wouldn’t have been able to accept the skeleton, and it would have rejected her."
"Where did you get such a method?" Zhang Fei [5] curiously asked.

sentences.text: "I see." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding.
"Why didn’t you guys kill Long Zhaihuo at that time?
You all should already know that he was afraid of the Golden Crow, and their race also existed in that era.
Therefore, you should have been able to kill him at that time, right?"
Feng Shizhu nodded to him.
"We actually could have killed Long Zhaihuo back then, but someone asked us not to."
"The ten-tailed fox."
"That’s right." Feng Shizhu confirmed it immediately.
"Back then, the ten-tailed fox came to see us and showed off his strength, rendering all of us powerless before his immense power.

At that time, we didn’t understand why he asked us to spare Long Zhaihuo’s life, but we finally understood that he was preparing the dragon for you, and you have now become the new Calamity Demon Dragon."
"Why did you choose to tell me about this matter?" Zhang Fei [5] asked in confusion.
"Long Wuzhao didn’t tell me anything about this matter, and he only told me that he couldn’t kill Long Zhaihuo because their strength was equal, and he asked all of you to help him seal the dragon."

"I don’t know why Long Wuzhao didn’t tell you the truth, but I came here to warn you to control your nature as the Calamity Demon Dragon, especially with the Cursed Demon Hearth inside your body." Zhang Fei [5] took a deep breath as soon as Feng Shizhu mentioned his heart.
"I once fought with the previous owner of the heart, and I almost died at his hands.
Fortunately, Long Wuzhao came to my aid and killed the demon, but a mysterious person stole the heart before he could destroy it.
We had been looking for the heart for a long time, but we never succeeded in finding it, and he told me that it had merged with you.
Both the dragon’s nature and your heart are evil, and their combination is deadly.
If you’re not careful, the dragon’s nature will affect your heart, and you should know the risks."
Zhang Fei [5] let out a soft sigh.
"So many people have warned me about it, so how could I not know the risks?
Even so, you don’t have to worry too much about me; I assure you that I have both of them under control.
After all, I have so many people who love me by my side, and I will never let them suffer because of me."
"I hope you’re right about that."
Zhang Fei [5] then asked her again.
"So, what’s your other purpose in seeing me?
I’m sure you came to see me, not just to warn me about those two, right?"
"Do you want to inherit my phoenix race inheritance stored at the end of this place?" Zhang Fei [5] was surprised to hear that from Feng Shizhu.
"The purpose of these trials is to find the right heir to my phoenix race inheritance, but unfortunately, no human with the ice phoenix bloodline has ever succeeded in passing through them.
With all your advantages, I believe you will complete the trials."
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head in refusal.
"I don’t mean to look down on your ice phoenix race, but I don’t need the inheritance.
As you said, I have many advantages in my possession, and I am already completely satisfied with them.
Moreover, my big sister won’t fail those trials, so you can wait for her to complete everything, and then you can pass the inheritance on to her."
"I see." Feng Shizhu nodded in understanding.
"In that case, I will leave now, and I will wait for you two at the end of this place."
Zhang Fei [5]’s eyelashes trembled slightly as he returned to his body, but he felt something entering his body, which came from the light blue flame.
He immediately absorbed it and circulated it throughout his body, causing him to be enveloped in the light blue flame.
[Ding]
[The host obtained the Icy Cold Flame.]
Unlike him, Zhang Yue seemed to have difficulty doing it, and her body started to freeze because of the chilling aura from the light blue flame.
Zhang Fei [5] immediately moved behind his big sister, pressed his palm to her back, and helped her flow the chilling aura throughout her body.

A few hours passed quickly, and Zhang Yue finally passed the third trial with Zhang Fei [5]’s help; otherwise, she would have suffered the same fate as the challengers before her, who froze to death due to the light blue flame.
Zhang Yue opened her eyes and breathed a sigh of relief.
She turned to face Zhang Fei [5] and wanted to kiss him, but she immediately remembered that he was only a clone, so she held back her excitement.
"Thank you, Fei’er."
"What are you thanking me for?" Zhang Fei [5] immediately pulled Zhang Yue to her feet and led her away to the next trial.
"There are only two trials left, so we should go now.
However, you should prepare yourself for the last trial because it will be the hardest, and I might not be able to help you pass it.
Therefore, you must prepare to face the last trial on your own, and if you succeed, you might receive something extraordinary."
"What do you mean by that, Fei’er?"
"You’ll find out later, big sis."
Sometime later, they arrived at the fourth trial, where they found two light blue lotus platforms.
Zhang Fei [5] and Zhang Yue immediately took their respective seats, and they began to meditate there according to Feng Xueying’s previous explanation.
Shortly after they began, the light blue lotus platforms began to glow, and a light blue pillar shot out from both of them, enveloping Zhang Fei [5] and Zhang Yue within and lifting them into midair.
After that, snowflakes appeared from above, raining down on Zhang Fei [5] and Zhang Yue.
Unlike previous trials, they didn’t feel the slightest cold, but they could sense that something was entering their bodies and souls.
Gradually, a light blue symbol appears all over their skin, forming lines that merge with the mark on their forehead.
Zhang Fei [5] and Zhang Yue utilized it to improve their ice element and elemental law, especially since the ice element that appeared within the pillar was extremely pure and strong.
Unlike the third trial, the fourth trial did not last too long.
Once the pillar disappeared, Zhang Fei [5] and Zhang Yue returned to the top of the lotus platform, where the symbols that had previously appeared on their bodies vanished on their own.
[Congratulations!
The host’s ice element has been upgraded to the advanced stage.]
[Congratulations!
The host’s ice elemental law has been upgraded to the half-perfection stage.]
Not only Zhang Fei [5], but Zhang Yue also experienced significant improvements in her ice element and elemental laws.
Both of them immediately opened their eyes and smiled with satisfaction.
"Only the final trial remains, Fei’er."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] immediately jumped down from the platform, followed by Zhang Yue.
The two of them rushed to the final trial, which would awaken the ice phoenix within their bodies.
When they arrived there, Feng Shizhu was already waiting for them, and she gestured for Zhang Yue to sit in front of her.
"I’ll start with you first, little girl."
Zhang Yue turned to Zhang Fei [5], who smiled at her and pushed her forward.
She immediately sat cross-legged in front of Feng Shizhu and closed her eyes.
"I’m ready, Senior."
"Calm your mind and accept everything." Feng Shizhu shot a blood clot at Zhang Yue, causing her body to gradually freeze as soon as it entered.
The female phoenix waved her hand, and an extremely cold aura descended from above, enveloping her and baptizing her.
Zhang Fei [5] frowned when Feng Shizhu took out a huge pale skeleton and a soul.
"Who was the previous owner of the soul and skeleton?"
"The first ice phoenix born in this universe." Zhang Fei [5] was completely shocked to hear that from Feng Shizhu.
Zhang Fei himself had met the soul of the first fire phoenix, who gave his inheritance to Zhang Lingxue.
However, he did not expect that the first ice phoenix left not only her soul but also her skeleton.
Even so, her soul appeared different from the first fire phoenix’s soul, especially since it did not possess consciousness.
"Why don’t you inherit both of them yourself?"
"No." Feng Shizhu shook her head in response.
"I am an ice phoenix myself, so I don’t need my ancestor’s skeleton.
As for her soul, she divided it into four parts in the past, and I have already inherited one of them.
Apart from me, Feng Xueying and Feng Jinqiu have already inherited two of them, and the last one is prepared for the person who passed the previous four trials.
Since you don’t want to inherit either of them, I will give them to this little girl, and she will transform into a true ice phoenix after this."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei [5] was surprised.
"Can you really turn my big sister into the true ice phoenix?"

"Just wait and see the results later." After saying that, Feng Shizhu enveloped the skeleton and the soul with her aura before sending both into Zhang Yue’s body, surprising Zhang Fei [5] again as soon as the two entered her body.
"Fortunately, your big sister had already obtained another complete phoenix soul before, and your Yang Qi also strengthened her body.
Otherwise, she wouldn’t have been able to accept the skeleton, and it would have rejected her."
"Where did you get such a method?" Zhang Fei [5] curiously asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 1078: Luo Yunxiao Beat Zhang Fei
paragraphs: Feng Shizhu smiled and turned to ask, "Don’t you already know the answer, heir of the ten-tailed fox?"

"Yes," Zhang Fei [5] replied with a nod. "I don’t know all of the old fox’s abilities yet, but since he was once a primordial being who could scare off the Primordial Genesis Beast and the Primordial Nihility Beast with his mere presence, I shouldn’t be surprised if he possesses such an ability."
"The ten-tailed fox’s abilities are far greater than you can imagine, but they will be yours once you obtain all of his inheritance."

Zhang Fei [5] chose not to comment on that, especially since everything was still far beyond his reach. "So, how long will my big sister’s change process take to complete? This realm is in the Three Mortal Realms, and we will waste too much time if the process takes too long."
"I can’t say for sure."

Zhang Fei [5] could only sigh upon hearing that, and he immediately sat cross-legged before cultivating by using the ice Qi in the place to increase his ice element and elemental laws again, especially since both of them had not yet reached their peak.

Seeing this, Feng Shizhu flicked her fingers, and an ice crystal enveloped Zhang Fei [5]’s body. Her actions caused the air temperature around him to become even colder, which was suitable for him to cultivate both. ’His path would become increasingly steep and rocky, especially after he became Long Zhaihuo’s successor. I don’t know what his next plans are in the Paradise Realm, but he will face many big obstacles there.’
In the training ground, the sound of fighting continued to be heard on every side, especially with the large number of people sparring with each other there.

In the past two years, Shangguan Yan, Duanmu Luolan, and Leng Xueyan had broken through to the Five Celestial Realms, making them the strongest among them along with Jia Yuyan, Feng Yichen, and Sima Huiqing, who had broken through before them.
Since the six of them rarely dual cultivate with Zhang Fei due to their cultivation, he asked them to focus on training everyone who stayed inside the training space.

Zhang Fei’s three clones sparred with Lin Moxian, Xi Hongyan, Qiao Liangren, Yan Yinqing, Jing Qiuyue, and Xi Qiuwei. He didn’t use the soul-link, which caused his three clones to feel quite overwhelmed when facing their opponents.
Some of Zhang Fei’s wives sparred with those who lived in the training space with them, such as members of the Yuan, Wang, Yan, Duanmu, Shangguan, and Hong Clans.

Zhang Chen, who had never fought before, also joined them. Zhang Fei actually didn’t want her grandmother to get involved in any fights, but she insisted on improving her fighting abilities like the others, to which she reluctantly agreed.

People from the Liu, Ye, Zhang, and Chang Clans who came from the Sky Jade Realm, as well as people from the Xian and Yun Clans from the Nine Stars Realm, also learned a lot from the clan members of the other realms.
Several of Zhang Fei’s wives, such as Boitata, Shen Huang, Hu Lili, Hu Yue, Shen Xueyi, and Shen Yu, sparred with the people from the natural races of the Sovereign Heaven Realm.

Zhang Fei’s young wives, such as Zhang Lin, Chu Xing, Chu Ying, Chu Qing, and several others, sparred with people from the Hidden Sea Palace, the Yin-Yang Pavilion, and the Heavenly Sword Sect. However, the people from the three sects were obviously no longer their opponents, including Hai Dongying, Hai Dongxin, and Qing Zhen, mainly because of the differences in their training and cultivation.
Additionally, Zhang Fei brought several beasts who usually lived in the beast space to the training ground, especially since he had too many wives and families.

The three female beasts of the Nian Clan, the four female beasts of the Golden Crow Clan, Lei Huoting of the Qilin Clan, and Yuwen Xingyuan of the Kunpeng Clan fought against senior female cultivators, such as Tang Ying, Lin Jingxia, and several others.

The four male mythical beast ancestors fought against Hun Di, Xia Tian, Hong Chong, Yan Leibao, and several others. Just like Feng Yichen and several others, Huli Jinhu, Long Jiutian, Wang Yitao, and Dai Yishu had also broken through to the Five Celestial Realms.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei sat at the side of the training ground, watching his three clones spar with their opponents while doing alchemy.

"If you don’t focus on your alchemy, then you should stop, husband." Zhang Fei turned to Luo Yunxiao, who immediately sat on his lap and embraced him. "What about Big Sis Yue? Did she successfully complete her trials?"

"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled in response. "My fifth clone is with my big sister, so she managed to get through everything, and she’s in the process of awakening her bloodline to complete the final trial. However, she will change after this, and she will become the true ice phoenix."

"Oh?" Luo Yunxiao was surprised to hear that, and Zhang Fei explained to her about Feng Shizhu and her actions. "I see. Big Sis Yue will be scary if she inherits a quarter of the first ice phoenix’s soul, let alone inherits her skeleton and becomes the true ice phoenix."

"I think so." Zhang Fei then asked her. "Do you know a domain that would be convenient for us to live in in the future? Although this training space offers more benefits than the outside world, I don’t want to live here forever, considering that I will have many children with all of you in the future. Naturally, I want them to become powerful cultivators when they grow up, but childhood will never be repeated. Therefore, I want them to live outside, and they can enjoy their lives without being restrained. Once they are ready to cultivate, I will send them here, and they can start their training like us now."

Luo Yunxiao answered him directly. "Actually, I really want to live in the Thousand River Domain, especially since it’s one of the most beautiful domains in this realm. Although the domain contains a thousand rivers, it remains very vast, with many landmasses that are separated from one another. There’s an island in the eastern part of the domain that I really want because of its beautiful scenery, and my father has already bought it for me."
"Huh? Did my father-in-law really buy that island?" Zhang Fei asked in surprise.

"Yes." Luo Yunxiao nodded at him. "I fell in love with the scenery on that island ever since they brought me to that domain the first time, and my father bought the island as a gift for me when my cultivation broke through to the Five Celestial Realms. I don’t know how much the island cost, but I’m sure it cost around millions or billions of golden jewels."
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed wryly at that. "My father-in-law is truly rich, huh? I’ve opened so many shops and restaurants in various realms, but I don’t have that many golden jewels yet."

Luo Yunxiao stuck out her tongue before kissing him. "Even though you don’t have that many golden jewels yet, you have many things far more valuable than jewels, right? This training space is one of them, and no one has such a place, except the young girl who gave it to you."
"Yeah, you’re right." Zhang Fei then turned his attention to the two female beasts. "What do you think about Lei Huoting and Yuwen Xingyuan?"

"Hehe." Luo Yunxiao giggled in response. "Lei Huoting and Yuwen Xingyuan are completely different from all the women who have become your wives, and their stance is extremely firm. They’ve consistently rejected you, even though you’ve been courting them for over six years. They are worthy of being members of your harem, but you cannot use your demon abilities against them. If you use them on them, they will hate you for the rest of their lives, and they might even choose to commit suicide. Therefore, you must be patient and find subtle ways to win their hearts; I am confident that they will eventually fall for you."
Zhang Fei immediately stopped his alchemy and tidied everything up before lifting Luo Yunxiao to her feet. "Since they’re busy sparring with each other, I want to spar with you now."
Luo Yunxiao smiled mischievously in response. "Don’t blame me if I beat you, okay?"

"Hahaha!" Zhang Fei burst into laughter when he heard that. "Why would I blame you? You’re the strongest among us, so I want you to fight me at your full strength. Only then can I gauge my ability to face cultivators in the Five Celestial Realms."
"Get ready then." As soon as she said that, Luo Yunxiao immediately attacked Zhang Fei, throwing him far back before falling heavily on the floor.
*Bam*
"Cough... Cough." Zhang Fei coughed hard as he looked at Luo Yunxiao in shock.

All of them stopped fighting and turned to Zhang Fei, who looked in pain as he stood up. However, Luo Yunxiao had moved in front of him again, and she launched a barrage of attacks using her full strength, forcing him to use his teleportation ability to escape. "Holy crap! Your punch hurts so much, wife!"
"Hahaha!" Luo Yunxiao laughed loudly and disappeared from Zhang Fei’s sight before reappearing behind him. "Don’t let your guard down, husband."
"Crap!" Zhang Fei wanted to use his teleportation again, but Luo Yunxiao quickly grabbed his leg and threw him to the floor with full force, slamming him there.
*Bam*
"Gahhh!"
After that, Luo Yunxiao threw Zhang Fei into the air before flying towards him, and she launched another series of attacks, which he couldn’t dodge.

The people, who watched Luo Yunxiao beat Zhang Fei so hard, could only swallow their saliva. They had seen him fighting his enemies many times, but this was the first time they had witnessed him being beaten by other people without even being able to retaliate. ’He is a monster, but his wife is an even stronger monster!’

chapters.title: Chapter 1079: Zhang Yue’s Change
paragraphs: Zhang Fei sparred with Luo Yunxiao for quite some time, but their fight was completely one-sided, and he was just an easy target for his wife.

As Zhang Fei had previously requested, Luo Yunxiao didn’t hold himself back and kept attacking him with his full strength, especially since he wanted to measure the gap between their true strengths. Without his passive regenerative healing factor, all of her attacks would have severely injured him.

Zhang Fei’s passive regenerative ability continued to heal his body, yet bruises and blood still covered him. Additionally, they sparred without using any techniques and relied solely on their raw speed and strength, which led the witnesses of their fight, including Hun Di and the other senior cultivators, to begin fearing Luo Yunxiao.
Luo Yunxiao stopped attacking Zhang Fei once he was lying on the floor and couldn’t move anymore, and his face was almost unrecognizable due to the bruises and blood covering it.
Zhang Chen, who saw that from a distance, could only shake her head. Unlike in the past, she was no longer worried about Zhang Fei, especially since he was much stronger and could protect himself.

"Hah... Hah..." Zhang Fei panted heavily as he channeled his light element throughout his body, accelerating the effects of his regenerative abilities. "I haven’t experienced this kind of situation since Xinxin beat me up back then, and you beat me much harder than she did."

"Hahaha." Luo Yunxiao softly laughed as she landed beside Zhang Fei, and she immediately lifted him into her arms, causing the people watching them to laugh out loud. "Don’t mind them, husband. I will take you back to the pavilion; you can speed up your recovery there."
"Yeah." After Luo Yunxiao took Zhang Fei away, the people immediately continued their sparring.

Luo Yunxiao had already brought Zhang Fei to the celestial spring pool, and she hurriedly took off their clothes before carrying him inside. She then used her qi to speed up her recovery, but he stopped her because he didn’t need it.

Instead, Zhang Fei swallowed several healing pills and the spirit spring water. He also handed golden lotus paste to Luo Yunxiao, asking her to apply it to some of his wounds. "If I were to explore the Paradise Realm now, I would definitely die if I encountered a cultivator as strong as, or even stronger than, you."

"Hehe." Luo Yunxiao chuckled and began to apply the paste to his wounds. "When you lived in the Three Mortal Realms, your speed was very helpful to you against your enemies. chapters.title: Chapter 1081: Gu Heart
paragraphs: Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was cultivating at the bottom of the life pond, immediately opened his eyes when he received a voice transmission from someone.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately got out of the pond and dressed. He summoned several natural races from the training space, such as Ju Tan, Ju Ning, and their three sons. However, they asked Ju Zhu to stay there.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] also summoned Ren Shuo and Shangguan Wan’er out of the training space, but he left Ren Xiyi there because her cultivation was still far from the Five Celestial Realms, even though she had broken through several minor stages in two years of cultivation using the Celestial Qi.

Meanwhile, Ju Tan, Ju Ning, Ju Lai, Ju Ming, Ju Tai, Ren Shuo, and Shangguan Wan’er’s cultivation had already broken through to the 1-Sun Celestial Lord long ago. Therefore, Zhang Xiaolong [3] wanted them to help Jin Zhongli in training the natural races that still lived in the Eastern Forest.
They immediately met the members of their race, except for Shangguan Wan’er, who decided to leave the Eastern Forest with Zhang Xiaolong [3].

When they arrived outside, Gu Changsheng was already waiting for Zhang Xiaolong [3] there, carrying a small chest with him. Shangguan Wan’er hurriedly left them and went to the main town before going to the Shangguan Clan.

Gu Changsheng immediately explained the reason for his visit to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Master, I’m sorry to interrupt your cultivation, but the Gu Heart was completed faster than I originally expected. Therefore, I came here directly to see you in person, and I will help you implant it into your body."
"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] opened the chest in Gu Changsheng’s hand and peeked at it a little. "Oh? How are you going to implant this Gu Heart into my body? It’s quite big!"

"Hahaha." Gu Changsheng laughed and summoned a Gu insect. "Even though this Gu Heart is quite big, this insect has the ability to store it in a kind of space, and it will bring it into your body. Once it has reached the right position, I will order it to release the heart, and I will merge it with your body. Once everything is done, you can create your own Gu insects with the Gu Creation Technique and place them inside your Gu Heart, nourishing them with your Qi."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] rubbed his chin as he observed the Gu insect that was the size of a cockroach in Gu Changsheng’s hand. He felt nauseous at the thought of the insect entering his body. "I might not have time to create my Gu Insects, and I need your help to create them. Is that possible?"

"Yes, Master." Gu Changsheng nodded in response. "There are many types of Gu in the Gu Creation Technique, so you just need to choose them and tell me what kind of Gu you want, and I will create them according to your wishes."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in satisfaction with that. "Speaking of the Gu Creation Technique, were you the one who imparted that technique to the Gu Clan of the Sky Jade Realm in the past?"

"Hmm?" Gu Changsheng searched his memories for it before shaking his head a few minutes later. "Master, I don’t remember ever going to that realm, so I’m sure I’ve never encountered them before. Moreover, the Gu Creation Technique is actually a common technique, and there are many Gu Cultivators out there, so I think one of them gave that technique to the Gu Clan of that realm. Can you help me break through to the Five Celestial Realms, Master? If I break through to that stage, I can create much stronger Gu Insects for you."

"After you implant this Heart Gu in me, I’ll take you to my private place to cultivate." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then turned to Tian Shuixiang and Ye Zhiye, who were walking towards them. "Do you two need anything from me?"

"We want to return to the Paradise Realm, so I hope you are willing to send us there." Zhang Xiaolong [3] was surprised by Tian Shuixiang’s request. "We thought the people of our two clans had long forgotten about us, especially since tens of thousands of years have passed since we fled to the Three Mortal Realms. Moreover, our cultivation has been halted for a long time since we came here, so we want to return there to continue our cultivation. If you need our help in the future, you can contact us, and we will definitely assist you."

"Are you two sure about that?" Both Tian Shuixiang and Ye Zhiye answered Zhang Xiaolong [3] with serious nods. "Alright, I will send you two to the Paradise Realm, but my true body is still in the Empyrean Domain, so I can only send you two there."
After Zhang Xiaolong [3] opened the gate leading to the Empyrean Domain, Tian Shuixiang immediately grabbed his wife. "See you again, Zhang Fei."

"Yeah." Zhang Xiaolong [3] closed the gate again after the two disappeared, but Zhe Wuming and the others immediately approached him. "Do you guys want to go to that realm too? I can send you all there, but I’m currently in seclusion, so I won’t be able to help you guys there."

"Why don’t you let them train and cultivate in your private quarters, kid?" Cheng Gaoji asked. "Once they break through to the Five Celestial Realms, you can let them go adventuring in the Paradise Realm by themselves."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] fell into deep thought after hearing that. He had never really wanted to bring Zhe Wuming and the others into his training space, but after sparring with Luo Yunxiao, he slightly changed his mind and believed that having more powerful allies would be beneficial. "Alright, I’ll send you all to my private place, and you guys can start your training there. However, I’m in a long seclusion process, and I won’t be coming out any time soon, so you guys are the same."
"How long will you be in seclusion?" Zhe Wuming asked him.

"I can’t say for sure how long my seclusion will last, but I will come out once my cultivation reaches the Five Celestial Realms." All of them were shocked by that because Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s cultivation was still at the 1-Moon Divine Expansion Realm, and they were sure that he would be in seclusion for several years if he wanted to break through to the Five Celestial Realms. "I already have some idea of the strength of the cultivators in the Paradise Realm, and you all know that I have so many wives now, so I want to help them to reach the highest level possible before I break through to that stage."
"Are their strengths too far above us, kid?" You Shen questioned him.

"The difference is as stark as the difference between the bottom of the sea and the sky." Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s response prompted everyone to inhale deeply. "One of my wives is a native of the Paradise Realm, and her cultivation is at the mid-level of the Five Celestial Realms. I had a spar with her before, and the result was that she beat me black and blue. Therefore, I don’t want to think about that realm, and I will focus fully on my cultivation for the next few years. Oh, by the way, the flow of time here is four times faster than the outside world, so you guys should already understand the advantages of practicing there."
"Four... four times faster? Where did you get that kind of place, brother?" Du Yuanjia asked with a stutter.
"I got it by luck." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately opened a portal leading to the training space. "You guys can come in now; my master and the others will explain everything to you all."

"Alright." Zhe Wuming was the first to enter, followed by Cheng Gaoji, Gong Ren, and Ji Changlan. After that, You Shen led his daughter and son-in-law, You Xinglan and Jian Wufeng, followed by Du Yuanji and Zhu Zhen.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] spoke to Gu Changsheng. "Send your insect to my body, implant the Gu Heart in me, and then you can start your practice."
"Yes, Master." Gu Changsheng whispered something to the Gu Insect in his hand, and it immediately jumped into his chest before storing the Gu Heart in its personal space.

After that, the Gu Insect entered Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s body through his mouth, causing him to almost vomit. It quickly moved to the right location to implant the Gu Heart, which was around his dantian. Even though its name was the Gu Heart, it was not a real heart, and it was more like a cage for breeding and strengthening Gu Insects.

Once the Gu Heart was in the right position, Gu Changsheng touched Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s chest, but he couldn’t feel anything. However, a thin symbol gradually appeared on his chest, and it fully formed a few minutes later.

Gu Changsheng immediately pulled his hand back and ordered his Gu Insect out of Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s body. "Master, the Gu Heart is already implanted in your body, but it’s still empty now. Gu insects are similar to beasts, and we must form a contract with them before we can command them. The difference is that they will die if we break the contract, so I can’t give you my Gu insects. Once my cultivation breaks through to the Five Celestial Realms, I will immediately help you create Gu insects of your choice."
"How many ranks of Gu insects are there exactly?"

Gu Changsheng immediately explained to him. "Master, Gu insects are divided from Rank 1 to 10, but I don’t have any Gu insects at level 9 or 10 yet. Once my cultivation breaks through, I will try to create Gu insects at those two levels."
"I see." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding. "Go in and begin your training, and my two acquaintances will take care of all matters in this realm."
"Yes, Master."

After Gu Changsheng disappeared, Zhang Xiaolong [3] closed the portal and went to the Dao Test area, where Mu Ling was still waiting for Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing, who were undergoing their tests. "Your cultivation has already broken through to the Divine Expansion in two and a half months, huh?"

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed at that. "Old Mu, it’s only been two and a half months for you, but I’ve actually been cultivating for several years, so you don’t need to be surprised by my cultivation. By the way, how are they doing?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1082: Bing Xingying’s Identity
paragraphs: Mu Ling pointed at Tian Baixing. "The female fox will complete her Dao Test soon, but the male fox is far from finished. Will you make a move on her after this?"

"Yeah." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at him. "Back then, I intentionally let her go because I wanted her to complete the Dao Test first, so I won’t waste any more time and capture her directly while her brother is busy with his test. Do you want to train in my private place after this, Old Mu? Your master is there now, enjoying her life."
"Have you done it with my master?"
"What do you think?"
Mu Ling could only sigh softly. "My master asked me to watch over these two foxes, but since you plan to capture the female fox, I will follow her and practice in your private space."
"That’s good."
"Do you need my help to face her?"

"No need." Zhang Xiaolong [3] responded with a shake of his head before extending his palm, and Tian Baixing’s soul appeared above his palm. "With Nalan Yushu’s help, I replicated her soul at our first meeting, and I can use it to control her, so she is no longer my opponent."
Mu Ling nodded in understanding. "Let’s wait then; she’s already at the final stage, and you can move straight away once she finishes her test."
"Yeah."
In his private residence, Luo Yunxiao sat opposite the three women from her family, who continued to look at her with suspicion and curiosity.
"Sister-in-law, have you been dual cultivating with your husband frequently these past few months?" Cheng Mengyao asked curiously.
Bing Xingying also expressed her curiosity. "How can you dual cultivate with him while still maintaining your virginity, Sister-in-law?"
"Tell us the truth, Yunxiao." Huang Xiaoyi urged her daughter.

"Haha." Luo Yunxiao chuckled in response. "To be honest, I’m still a virgin, but I’m also no longer a virgin. We dual cultivated for the first time on our wedding night, and we’ve done it countless times over the past few months. My husband has a special ability to modify other people’s bodies, and he modified my hymen, which allows us to dual cultivate without losing my virginity."
"What kind of ability is that? How can a human do such a thing?" Cheng Mengyao and Bing Xingying expressed their confusion.
Luo Yunxiao did not answer their questions; instead, she asked one of her sisters-in-law. "Isn’t it time for you to admit the truth, Xingying?"
"Huh?" Bing Xingying looked at her in confusion. "What do you mean by that, sister-in-law?"
Luo Yunxiao’s question made Huang Xiaoyi immediately realize that something was wrong with Bing Xingying. "Are you hiding something from us, Xingying?"
"Mother, I—"

"The current Xingying is her clone." Huang Xiaoyi and Cheng Menghao glared at Bing Xingying as soon as Luo Yunxiao said that. "Xingying, you can fool us, but you can’t fool my husband’s eyes. Therefore, you should confess the truth to us; otherwise, I won’t be so merciful to you."

"Sister-in-law, I—" Luo Yunxiao immediately restricted Bing Xingying and chained her using the Yin-Yang Absorbing Shackle that Zhang Fei gave her. ’Shit! What kind of artifact is this? It not only seals my cultivation, but it also absorbs my qi.’
"Yunxiao."
"Mother, I will never doubt my husband’s words, and the current Xingying is really her clone." Luo Yunxiao then turned to look outside. "Uncle Ma, I know you are there, and I need your help now."

"Haha." Ma Kuangyu laughed as he floated towards them. "Xiaoyi, I’ve lived with Zhang Fei for several years, so I know his abilities, including his eye ability. Moreover, he is used to using his five clones, so it’s not difficult for him to see that she is her clone. His eye ability can penetrate a person’s soul to discover that person’s deepest secrets, but she uses something to hide everything neatly."

Huang Xiaoyi noticed a light tremor on Bing Xingying’s body, which convinced her that Luo Yunxiao and Ma Kuangyu’s words were true. "Xingying, please reveal the truth to us. If you still keep your mouth shut, I will ask Uncle Zhenhai to check on you, and you won’t like it."
"Crack*

Bing Xingying broke out in a cold sweat as soon as Luo Fenghan entered the room, and his sharp gaze was solely fixed on her. "Xingying, we have always treated you well, but you returned our kindness by deceiving us. If you still don’t want to admit the truth, I will destroy your clone, and I’m sure your real body out there will suffer severe injuries."

"You don’t have to do that, Father. My husband has a better method of punishing her, and her real body will suffer for the rest of her life." Luo Yunxiao crossed one leg over the other, propped her chin, and stared at her sister-in-law. "Trust me, you won’t like it if my husband makes a move against you, and you will experience suffering that you have never imagined before."
"Xingying." Cheng Mengyao called out softly. "Please tell us the truth."
*Swoosh*
Luo Fenghan and the others turned to the crack in the air that appeared out of nowhere, but another Bing Xingying walked out of it.
"The void element."

Bing Xingying let out a soft sigh before kneeling on the floor. "Father! Mother! Sister-in-law! I didn’t use my clone to deceive you all, and I was forced to use it because I couldn’t stay outside for too long. If I stayed outside for too long, my body would weaken, and I would die. You all might not believe me, but you guys should be able to feel my husband’s Yang Qi inside my body, right?"
"Hmm?" All of them immediately observed Bing Xingying’s body, and they found Luo Zhenyu’s Yang Qi to be strong and dense in her body.

Bing Xingying immediately continued explaining. "I couldn’t reveal this matter to you before for a certain reason that I can’t reveal to anyone, but I swear to you that I don’t have the slightest ill intention towards this family. Even though I never told my husband about this matter, I truly love him, and I have always used my real body whenever I was with him since our marriage. Otherwise, I would never risk all to be with him, and I would use my clone to serve him."
Luo Yunxiao immediately took out a pill and handed it to Bing Xingying. "Swallow it."

Bing Xingying swallowed the pill without hesitation, which took effect a few minutes later. Her mouth opened and closed, but not a word came out. "I’m sorry, Sister-in-law. Even if you use the truth pill on me, I still can’t tell you my true reasons. I’ve told you my true feelings for my husband, but if you guys still don’t believe me and still want to punish me, then I will accept your punishment, even if I have to die because of it."
"What do you think, husband?" Huang Xiaoyi asked.
Instead of answering his wife, Luo Fenghan asked Ma Kuangyu, "What do you think?"

"I don’t think this little girl is lying, especially since she has swallowed the truth pill." Ma Kuangyu then observed Bing Xingying. "If you guys still have doubts, Yunxiao can contact Zhang Fei and ask him to bring Tang Ying here. I’m sure she can help you get the truth and dispel your doubts about her."
Luo Fenghan looked at Luo Yunxiao, who immediately contacted Zhang Fei through the harem link. In a few minutes, he had appeared in front of them along with Tang Ying. "Can you see her secret?"
"Let me try it." Tang Ying summoned the white eye and checked Bing Xingying, but the results did not meet their expectations. "I can’t check her secret because she’s not a human."
"Not human?" They looked at Bing Xinqing in shock, but she herself was also shocked because Tang Ying could tell that she wasn’t human. "Then, what kind of living creature is she?"

"Hahaha." Huo Diqiu suddenly emerged from Zhang Fei’s body along with Lei, which shocked Luo Fenghan, Huang Xiaoyi, and their two daughters-in-law. "Master, this woman is not a human but a spirit like us, so it’s natural that Tang Ying can’t find out her secret."

"Master, she’s the spirit of the void, but she’s still weak, and she can’t leave that place for too long. If she continues to stay here, she will wither and die." Lei’s words finally confirmed the truth of Bing Xingying’s previous confession.
"Return." Lei and Huo Diqiu nodded before entering Zhang Fei’s body again. He then released the Yin-Yang Absorbing Shackles from Bing Xingying’s clone. "Send your real body back."
Bing Xingying looked at Luo Feng and the others with an apologetic gaze, and she immediately disappeared into the void.

Luo Yunxiao immediately questioned Bing Xingying. "How can a spirit like you be attracted to my brother? Moreover, who are your relatives that we’ve met all this time? Are they also clones of members of your race?"

"I don’t have a family, and someone helped me create one. However, I can’t tell you all the identity of that person, or that person will erase me." Bing Xingying’s answer caused them to frown. "As for my husband, I met him when I came out of there for the first time. At that time, I had never seen the outside world, and I was too preoccupied with going around, which significantly weakened me. Luckily, I met him, and he helped me recover a small portion of my strength, which allowed me to go back inside. Unfortunately, we couldn’t be together because we lived in different worlds, but that person taught me to create a clone, and that person also created a family for me. As for the rest of the story, all of you should still remember everything."
Luo Yunxiao and others nodded to Bing Xingying, but she looked at Zhang Fei in confusion, mainly because of his curious gaze. ’Was it the will of the universe that helped you all this time?’
’How... how did you know about that?’ Bing Xingying asked in a stutter.
’I’ve met the will of the universe several times, so I know about her.’ Bing Xingying was stunned hearing that from Zhang Fei. "Looks like it’s time for me to make my move."
"What do you mean by that, husband?" Luo Yunxiao asked.
"Tian Baixing just completed her Dao Test."

"How can you dual cultivate with him while still maintaining your virginity, Sister-in-law?"
"Tell us the truth, Yunxiao." Huang Xiaoyi urged her daughter.

"What kind of ability is that?

chapters.title: Chapter 1083: Zhang Fei’s Injured
paragraphs: In midair, Tian Baixing opened her eyes and exhaled a sense of relief, particularly since her test had concluded. She instantly froze when she sensed someone’s presence behind her, but she immediately turned around to attack.
However, Zhang Xiaolong [3] directly grabbed Tian Baixing’s hand and smirked faintly. "The current you is not my opponent."

"You bastard!" Tian Baixing used her nine tails to attack Zhang Xiaolong [3], but he deflected them using his eight tails, which were dragon tails instead of fox tails. She kicked his chest and flew away from him directly. "What did you do to me? Why can’t I use my abilities?"

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed before showing the soul replica to Tian Baixing. "Did you forget what I did to you that time? I have replicated your soul and merged it with mine, so you can say that your soul is mine. Since the soul is a vital part of the body, you will not be able to do anything as long as I control your soul. Even though I did not enslave you, you are no different from my slave now, and the current you is no longer my opponent."
Tian Baixing’s face turned deathly pale after she remembered how Nalan Yushu controlled her soul at their first meeting, and she also remembered when Zhang Xiaolong [3] replicated her soul that time.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] removed the soul and moved toward Tian Baixing, but a sudden attack that came out of nowhere struck him, sending him rolling inmidair several times. He immediately looked for the source, but he couldn’t find anyone. ’Damn it! What was that attack just now? The force of that attack caused my entire body to hurt so much.’

Tian Baixing was also confused by that, especially since she couldn’t use her abilities due to Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s control over her soul. She turned to Tian Baitian, but her brother was still seriously engaged in his test, and he didn’t have such a surprise attack, so he couldn’t have attacked him. ’Who attacked him just now?’

Just as they were thinking about that, a void crack suddenly appeared above them, and a man dressed entirely in white emerged from it. However, none of them could see the man’s face because he was wearing a silver fox mask; nonetheless, Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Tian Baixing immediately recognized him as a fox beast, especially due to the nine silver tails dancing behind him.
[Master, the system cannot scan this mysterious man’s status, so you must be careful of him.] Mei warned Zhang Xiaolong [3].

"You are indeed extraordinary, the heir of the ten-tailed fox." The mysterious man instantly enveloped Tian Baixing and Tian Baitian with his aura, bringing them to his side. "Unfortunately, I can’t allow you to capture these two heavenly foxes now, and I will take them away with me. If you want to get them, you will have to come to the Illusion Spirit Fox Domain."
Without the mysterious man realizing, the other clones sent all the beasts into the beast space, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately activated the soul link. "I won’t let you take them away!"
"Haha." The mysterious man laughed as Zhang Xiaolong [3] charged toward him, and he immediately fired several invisible attacks that instantly pierced his body.

"Argh!" Zhang Xiaolong [3] screamed in pain as the mysterious man’s invisible attacks left several large, bloody holes in several parts of his body. He instantly fell to the ground like a broken kite, and his body slammed there quite hard. "Cough... Cough..."

The mysterious man floated down to Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s side, stomped on his chest, and looked at him with a condescending gaze. "I don’t know how you managed to increase your strength to the level of a cultivator at the Celestial Emperor Realm, but your current strength is too meager in front of me. Since you’re so confident in your current strength, I’ll give you a little lesson to open your eyes."
"Argh!" Zhang Xiaolong [3] screamed in pain once again as another invisible attack pierced his body, causing his blood to flow out even more and soak the ground below.

Mu Ling, who saw the incident from a distance, immediately moved to help Zhang Xiaolong [3]. However, the mysterious man immediately locked him in an invisible prison, as did Tian Kui and Serpentera, who had just appeared above them.

"A Willow-Whisker Elk, huh?" The mysterious man then looked at Serpentera and Tian Kui before nodding in understanding. "So, you two are the Ancient Abyssal Leviathan Demon Beast and the Ancient Devourer Demon Beast left in this universe, right? Your cultivation is indeed high, but you two have spent too long in these Three Mortal Realms, so you two are no match for me."
"Who the hell are you? Why are you interfering in this kid’s business?" Tian Kui asked with a shout.
The mysterious man showed them his nine tails. "Can you still not recognize my identity after seeing my tails?"
"You—"

"Hahaha." The mysterious man sealed their mouths and looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was helpless under his feet. "If you want to defeat me and snatch them from me, you should stop borrowing other people’s strength and cultivate harder. Otherwise, you will die by my hands on our second meeting, and your predecessor will be disappointed that the savior he chose was just a useless snotty brat who can only borrow other people’s strength."
After saying that, the mysterious man knocked Zhang Xiaolong [3] unconscious. He immediately took Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing away from the scene, freeing Tian Kui, Serpentera, and Mu Ling.

The three male beasts immediately moved to Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s side to check on his condition, and they breathed a sigh of relief. Although his injuries looked horrific, they weren’t life-threatening, as the mysterious man had no intention of killing him.
Mu Ling immediately carried Zhang Xiaolong [3] and spoke to the two beasts. "I will take him to the Life Pond, and his injuries will recover faster there."
"Yes." After Mu Ling took Zhang Xiaolong [3] away, Tian Kui asked Serpentera directly. "Do you think the mysterious man just now was really part of the fox race? Why did he only act now?"

"Based on the shape and fur of his nine tails, he is clearly part of the Ancient Spirit Fox Race. However, that race has long since disappeared, and no one has ever known their whereabouts." Serpentera looked in the direction the mysterious man disappeared. "His abilities are clearly related to the void element, and it seems he’s been observing Zhang Fei for a long time. If my guess is correct, he didn’t act before because that kid hadn’t attacked the two heavenly foxes, and he made his move as soon as he wanted to capture the female fox."
"What was the purpose of that mysterious man saving them?"

Serpentera shook his head in response. "I can’t guess that mysterious man’s reasons, but it’s not yet time for that kid to get the two foxes. I hope he won’t be down or discouraged because of this incident, and I hope he can use his first defeat to spur his spirit even more; only then will he become a stronger and more mature cultivator. Let’s go back and wait for him to return."
"Yeah."

In the eastern forest, Ren Shuo and the others were completely shocked when Mu Ling brought Zhang Xiaolong [3] there, especially since his injuries were too severe and caused his blood to continuously flow out.
They immediately carried Zhang Xiaolong [3] to the Life Pond and laid him on its surface. Some of those with light elements immediately used theirs to aid his recovery.
"What exactly happened to him? How could he be injured this badly?" Ju Tan asked Mu Ling, who immediately explained the situation to them. "A mysterious man who emerged from the void?"

Mu Lin nodded at them. "That mysterious person’s strength is too high; even his two acquaintances couldn’t move in front of him. Fortunately, he didn’t intend to kill him; otherwise, he would have died earlier. For now, we should focus on helping him recover, but I hope his defeat just now won’t deal a heavy blow to his mentality."
"Let’s hope."

Panic gripped the pavilion as Zhang Fei’s other four clones also suffered the same injuries as his third clone. All of his women who possessed the light element, such as Ru Xue, Liu Qingyu, Chu Xing, and several others, immediately moved to heal them.
Meanwhile, Luo Yunxiao sat by his bedside and cleaned the blood on Zhang Fei’s body, while Huang Xiaoyi sat beside her daughter and used her healing technique to treat her son-in-law.

Cheng Mengyao and Bing Xingying stood side by side a little distance away from them, staring at Zhang Fei, who had fallen unconscious, with a confused look. He was previously fine when chatting with them, but he suddenly suffered such horrific injuries.
"What really happened?" Luo Fenghan asked Ma Kuangyu.
Ma Kuangyu shook his head at him. "I’m here, so I don’t know what happened to him, but Nalan Yushu should know the matter."

"A mysterious male fox attacked my master when he was about to capture Tian Baixing, and he beat him to such an extent." Nalan Yushu’s answer caused all of them to frown. "I don’t know the identity of that man, but he seems to belong to the ancient fox race because he recognized Tian Kui and Serpentera, and he stopped those two beasts from saving my master."
Ma Kuangyu frowned at that. "Are you sure that mysterious fox can stop Tian Kui and Serpentera?"
"Do I need to lie to you?" Nalan Yushu immediately created a Qi screen in front of them, which showed the incident at the Dao Test location. "See? That male fox is truly powerful!"
"The Ancient Spirit Fox Race."
"Huh?" Luo Fenghan turned to Ma Kuangyu directly. "Are you sure this mysterious man is a member of that fox race?"

"A hundred percent." Ma Kuangyu pointed at the screen. "There are many fox races in this universe, but only the Ancient Fox Race has such silver fur, so I’m sure he’s a member of that race. However, I’m certain that the fox race disappeared along with their Illusion Spirit Fox Domain long ago, and no one has seen or heard of them since."
"Then, why did this man suddenly appear and beat my son-in-law this badly?" Luo Fenghan asked with a gloomy tone.

Ma Kuangyu just shook his head, especially since he didn’t have the answer himself. "Even though this kid’s injuries are quite severe, his regenerative healing factor continues to work to restore his condition, so he will be fine soon. The main problem is that he has never lost before, and I’m afraid this first defeat will weigh on his heart and bring him down mentally."

"Uncle Ma, my husband has experienced defeat in the past, and he has also experienced death once, so this incident will not affect him." Luo Yunxiao confidently spoke. "I believe my husband will not be like that, and I believe he will rise again to become a much better cultivator after this. By the way, you guys should go first, and I will help him recover from his injuries."

He immediately took Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing away from the scene, freeing Tian Kui, Serpentera, and Mu Ling.
The three male beasts immediately moved to Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s side to check on his condition, and they breathed a sigh of relief.
Although his injuries looked horrific, they weren’t life-threatening, as the mysterious man had no intention of killing him.
Mu Ling immediately carried Zhang Xiaolong [3] and spoke to the two beasts.
"I will take him to the Life Pond, and his injuries will recover faster there."
"Yes." After Mu Ling took Zhang Xiaolong [3] away, Tian Kui asked Serpentera directly.
"Do you think the mysterious man just now was really part of the fox race?
Why did he only act now?"
"Based on the shape and fur of his nine tails, he is clearly part of the Ancient Spirit Fox Race.
However, that race has long since disappeared, and no one has ever known their whereabouts." Serpentera looked in the direction the mysterious man disappeared.
"His abilities are clearly related to the void element, and it seems he’s been observing Zhang Fei for a long time.
If my guess is correct, he didn’t act before because that kid hadn’t attacked the two heavenly foxes, and he made his move as soon as he wanted to capture the female fox."
"What was the purpose of that mysterious man saving them?"
Serpentera shook his head in response.
"I can’t guess that mysterious man’s reasons, but it’s not yet time for that kid to get the two foxes.
I hope he won’t be down or discouraged because of this incident, and I hope he can use his first defeat to spur his spirit even more; only then will he become a stronger and more mature cultivator.
Let’s go back and wait for him to return."
"Yeah."

In the eastern forest, Ren Shuo and the others were completely shocked when Mu Ling brought Zhang Xiaolong [3] there, especially since his injuries were too severe and caused his blood to continuously flow out.
They immediately carried Zhang Xiaolong [3] to the Life Pond and laid him on its surface.
Some of those with light elements immediately used theirs to aid his recovery.
"What exactly happened to him?
How could he be injured this badly?" Ju Tan asked Mu Ling, who immediately explained the situation to them.
"A mysterious man who emerged from the void?"
Mu Lin nodded at them.
"That mysterious person’s strength is too high; even his two acquaintances couldn’t move in front of him.
Fortunately, he didn’t intend to kill him; otherwise, he would have died earlier.
For now, we should focus on helping him recover, but I hope his defeat just now won’t deal a heavy blow to his mentality."
"Let’s hope."
Panic gripped the pavilion as Zhang Fei’s other four clones also suffered the same injuries as his third clone.
All of his women who possessed the light element, such as Ru Xue, Liu Qingyu, Chu Xing, and several others, immediately moved to heal them.
Meanwhile, Luo Yunxiao sat by his bedside and cleaned the blood on Zhang Fei’s body, while Huang Xiaoyi sat beside her daughter and used her healing technique to treat her son-in-law.
Cheng Mengyao and Bing Xingying stood side by side a little distance away from them, staring at Zhang Fei, who had fallen unconscious, with a confused look.
He was previously fine when chatting with them, but he suddenly suffered such horrific injuries.
"What really happened?" Luo Fenghan asked Ma Kuangyu.
Ma Kuangyu shook his head at him.
"I’m here, so I don’t know what happened to him, but Nalan Yushu should know the matter."
"A mysterious male fox attacked my master when he was about to capture Tian Baixing, and he beat him to such an extent." Nalan Yushu’s answer caused all of them to frown.
"I don’t know the identity of that man, but he seems to belong to the ancient fox race because he recognized Tian Kui and Serpentera, and he stopped those two beasts from saving my master."
Ma Kuangyu frowned at that.
"Are you sure that mysterious fox can stop Tian Kui and Serpentera?"
"Do I need to lie to you?" Nalan Yushu immediately created a Qi screen in front of them, which showed the incident at the Dao Test location.
"See?
That male fox is truly powerful!"
"The Ancient Spirit Fox Race."
"Huh?" Luo Fenghan turned to Ma Kuangyu directly.
"Are you sure this mysterious man is a member of that fox race?"
"A hundred percent." Ma Kuangyu pointed at the screen.
"There are many fox races in this universe, but only the Ancient Fox Race has such silver fur, so I’m sure he’s a member of that race.
However, I’m certain that the fox race disappeared along with their Illusion Spirit Fox Domain long ago, and no one has seen or heard of them since."
"Then, why did this man suddenly appear and beat my son-in-law this badly?" Luo Fenghan asked with a gloomy tone.
Ma Kuangyu just shook his head, especially since he didn’t have the answer himself.
"Even though this kid’s injuries are quite severe, his regenerative healing factor continues to work to restore his condition, so he will be fine soon.
The main problem is that he has never lost before, and I’m afraid this first defeat will weigh on his heart and bring him down mentally."
"Uncle Ma, my husband has experienced defeat in the past, and he has also experienced death once, so this incident will not affect him." Luo Yunxiao confidently spoke.
"I believe my husband will not be like that, and I believe he will rise again to become a much better cultivator after this.
By the way, you guys should go first, and I will help him recover from his injuries."

chapters.title: Chapter 1084: Cursed Demon Heart Awakening
paragraphs: Just as they were about to leave, Zhang Fei’s heart suddenly beat so loudly that it could be heard by their ears.
*Badump... Badump... Badump...*
"Move, Yunxiao!" Huang Xiaoyin shouted as she pulled her daughter away from Zhang Fei, especially when his body began to emit black smoke that slowly enveloped him.

On the other hand, Luo Fenghan immediately walked to the side of the window and activated a barrier that quickly enveloped the entire area of the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, causing confusion among the sect members. He then ordered his sect members to calm all the disciples, and he also forbade anyone to approach their location.
Despite their high cultivation, Chen Mengyao and Bing Xingying were trembling with fear, sensing the terrifying aura from the black smoke that had wrapped Zhang Fei like a black cocoon.

Not only in that room, but panic swept through the eastern forest in the Sovereign Heaven Realm. Inside the pavilion, none of Zhang Fei’s wives dared to approach his four clones, including those with light elements, mainly because the black smoke covering their bodies absorbed their light elements.
"Is this what I think, Yushu?"

"Yes." Nalan Yushu nodded to Ma Kuangyu. "My master’s cursed demon heart is starting to awaken, and the cause is the attack of that mysterious male fox. If he doesn’t suppress his heart, it will awaken completely, and he will transform into a pure evil living being."

"Can we do something to suppress his heart?" Both Nalan Yushu and Ma Kuangyu shook their heads at Huang Xiaoyi, who immediately tried to use her light element to dispel the black smoke. Unfortunately, the results were not as she expected, and the black smoke directly devoured her light element. "Shit! How can there be such a strong darkness element?"

"This darkness doesn’t only come from the Calamity Demon Dragon, but it also comes from the evil soul of the ten-tailed fox that this kid absorbed back then, so you shouldn’t be surprised if it’s this strong." Ma Kuangyu responded to Huang Xiaoyi. "Have you forbidden your people from coming near here, Fenghan?"

Luo Fenghan nodded at him. "This darkness gives me a bad feeling, and I’m afraid it will spread throughout the sect, which will bring chaos here. Moreover, the situation will become chaotic if people from other sects and clans find out about this matter, and they might attack us."
"Have you contacted them, husband?" Huang Xiaoyi asked Luo Fenghan, who responded with a nod. "I hope they get here quickly, and I hope they have a solution to help Zhang Fei."

Just as they were thinking about how to stop the awakening of Zhang Fei’s cursed demon heart, a wisp of crimson flame shot out from within his body, which immediately transformed into Feng Yao, surprising all of them.
"Why didn’t you save him when the mysterious male fox attacked him previously, Big Sis Yao?" Luo Yunxiao immediately asked.

As she seriously observed Zhang Fei’s body, Feng Yao shook her head and replied to Luo Yunxiao. "You must be aware that he is still not fully mature as a cultivator, right? His talent is indeed extraordinary, but he has relied too heavily on his advantages, including the ability to borrow power from the beasts by his side. His future enemies will be even stronger, and he needs something to open his eyes to the fact that all his advantages cannot help him forever. Moreover, the male fox had no intention of killing him, so I didn’t stop him."
"But—"

Feng Yao interrupted Luo Yunxiao directly. "I understand your feelings towards Zhang Fei, but your husband carries enormous duties and responsibilities. Moreover, he is not as weak as you think, so you should stop acting like this."

"I agree with her, Yunxiao." Tang Ying, who had been silent for a long time, finally spoke. "We’ve known for a long time that Zhang Fei’s cursed demon heart will awaken sooner or later, and the mysterious male fox is only accelerating the process. His situation is indeed dire, but he’s not weak-minded, and you have to believe that he will get through it. If he manages to get through it and suppress his heart, I’m sure he will become more mature than before."
Luo Yunxiao released a soft sigh and nodded to them. ’Fei! Please suppress your heart and don’t let it control you.’
*Swoosh*

The black smoke suddenly spread throughout the room, but Feng Yao immediately enveloped Luo Fenghan, Huang Xiaoyi, Luo Yunxiao, Cheng Mengyao, and Bing Xingying with her aura, preventing the smoke from affecting them. Unlike them, Tang Ying, Nalan Yushu, and Ma Kuangyu were not too worried about the black smoke.

Feng Yao then pressed her palm onto Zhang Fei’s chest. "Hey! How are you going to protect the people around you if your heart beats you? How can you be worthy of me if you lose to your heart? You have to fight it, control it, and take advantage of it."
One of Feng Yao’s questions stunned Luo Fenghan, Huang Xiaoyi, Cheng Mengyao, and Bing Xingying, mainly because of her past identities. ’This kid is too lucky when it comes to women!’

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei had just opened his eyes and found himself in a dark place, but he frowned when countless familiar people appeared before him. ’Where am I? How did they all appear here? I’m not surprised about the others because I killed them in the past, but Zhang Hai should still be alive on Earth now, so he shouldn’t be among them.’

"You’re an ungrateful son!" Zhang Hai spoke hatefully. "I wasn’t wrong to abandon you back then! You’re a disgrace to the family! Not only did you have an incestuous relationship with your big sister and little sister, but you also did it with your biological mother!"

"So what? Didn’t I become like this because of you?" Zhang Fei then pointed to Zhang He and Chen Xin behind Zhang Hai. "In the past, I had no relationship with Big Sis Yue at all, but your stupidity made you unable to see the truth, and you listened to your idiot son and traitorous daughter-in-law instead. Since you abandoned me, and I became a demon, I decided to enjoy my life as one by taking them as my wife. Moreover, you were just an idiot and a pathetic guy, and Qing Yi was much happier with me than with you. By the way, you don’t belong here, so get lost now."

After Zhang Fei said that, Zhang Hai disappeared by himself. He then looked at Zhang He, who stared at him hatefully. "Hey! What are you looking at, my dear brother? Do you still remember how I fucked your wife to death?"
"You bastard!" Zhang He charged towards him, but Zhang Fei simply dodged to the side, causing him to stumble. "I will kill you!"

"I killed you in the past, remember? I don’t know how you ended up here, but a dead man like you should go back to hell, especially since that place is much more suitable for you." Zhang Fei immediately beat Zhang He, causing him to disappear. "Hmm? Could this be a test for me? Who tested me in this way?"
"Zhang Fei." Zhang Fei turned to Chen Xin and Fu Min, who were walking towards him with their clothes off. "Do you miss our bodies?"

"Get lost!" Zhang Fei shouted as he attacked them directly, causing Chen Xin and Fu Min to fall backwards. "Do you two think you can seduce me with your bodies? There are so many women far better than whores like you two by my side, so I don’t need you guys."

Zhang Fei then turned to the men who seemed impatient to kill him. "Hahaha! If you all think I’m afraid of you, you guys can attack me together now. Back then, I killed all of you, and I never held any regrets over your deaths."

Hearing that, those people immediately attacked Zhang Fei in unison, but he was no longer the old him, and their sheer numbers were no problem for him. For quite some time, he fought against them all, causing them to disappear one by one. Since it wasn’t his body, he didn’t feel the slightest tiredness fighting them, and he enjoyed himself in killing them once again.

Once those people disappeared, Zhang Fei was suddenly transported to another area where several others were waiting for him. He naturally recognized himself, but it was clearly not him. He then looked at the others, two of whom were the evil soul of the ten-tailed fox and Long Zhaihuo.

Zhang Fei was more curious about the man standing behind them, especially since he was certain he had never met him before. However, the man’s demon-like appearance made him realize something, and he asked them directly. "Were you the one who brought me here, the previous owner of the cursed demon heart?"

"Hahaha." The man let out an eerie laugh as he moved in front of Zhang Fei, causing him to subconsciously take a few steps back. "Are you afraid of me, little brat? Back then, Long Wuzhao killed me and wanted to destroy my heart, and I thought I was going to die at that time. Unexpectedly, someone snatched my heart from him, which saved me from death. I don’t know how my heart got in my body, but my heart has already devoured your human heart, and I will take over your body as soon as my heart awakens from its long sleep."

"Do I look like I’m afraid of you?" Zhang Fei shook his head in response. "I’ve met someone far more terrifying than you before, and you’re not as strong as you think because you’re not your complete soul but a strand of it, right?"
*Bam*

The male demon punched him directly, but Zhang Fei swiftly caught his fist and struck back, forcing him to stagger backwards. "I admit your cursed demon heart is terrifying, but I will never let it take over my body. I don’t know where this place is, but I believe we are both still in my body. Therefore, I will suppress your heart, take it over, and devour your soul."
