chapters.title: Chapter 1085: Desperation
paragraphs: "Hehehe... hahaha..." Zhang Fei frowned at the male demon. "Haven’t you realized it yet? We’re still in your body, but we’re in my heart now, and it has begun to take over your body. Once my heart fully awakens, your body will be completely mine, and you’ll remain imprisoned here until I absorb your soul entirely."

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei looked around them for a way out of this place, but he couldn’t find one. Furthermore, he couldn’t use his strength or abilities, and the system also didn’t show any signs that it would move.

Just as Zhang Fei was contemplating his situation, the evil soul of the ten-tailed fox and Long Zhaihuo suddenly attacked him. Even so, he wasn’t too worried about them, especially since he believed that they weren’t real.
Unfortunately, Zhang Fei’s guess was half right, especially since one of them was real. He screamed in pain as soon as the evil soul of the ten-tailed fox’s claws pierced through his chest. "Argh!"

"Hahaha." The evil soul of the ten-tailed fox laughed at Zhang Fei’s painful expression. "Back then, you beat me to death and absorbed my soul, but unfortunately, you didn’t realize that I would always exist within your body as your evil side. Once the Cursed Demon Heart takes over your body, that demon and I will control your body, and we will have fun with all your women before killing them. As for you, you won’t have the chance to witness it, especially since your soul will become nourishment for our souls."
*Splurt*
A black liquid immediately gushed from Zhang Fei’s chest as soon as the evil soul of the ten-tailed fox retracted its claws, causing him to fall to his knees.

The evil soul of the ten-tailed fox grabbed Zhang Fei’s head and bared his long fangs. "Hahaha! What can you do now? Without your strength and abilities, you are nothing but an ant in my eyes. I really want to eat you right now, but this heart will die if you die, so I can’t do it now. Once this heart takes over your body, I will enjoy myself devouring your soul."

"Heh." Zhang Fei snorted at him. "The ten-tailed fox is a dignified fox, and he would never cooperate with a near-dead demon like him. No wonder he decided to discard you from him and imprisoned you in that place for so long, especially since you are just a lowly soul."

"You bastard!" The evil soul of the ten-tailed fox shouted furiously and stabbed its long claws into his body several times, causing him to fall to the floor and black liquid to continuously flow from his body.
"Hey! Stop it! If he dies, our efforts will be in vain, and we will die with him." The male demon finally stopped the evil soul of the ten-tailed fox.

"Tch!" The evil soul of the ten-tailed fox gritted his long fangs and hatefully stared at Zhang Fei. "How long will it take for your heart to wake up? I can’t wait to eat his soul, and I will use his body to have fun with his woman."

The male demon shook his head in response. "My soul is not perfect because Long Wuzhao destroyed my main soul, so the process of awakening my heart will be much slower than it should be. For now, we can only be patient, and no one can stop my heart from awakening."

The evil soul of the ten-tailed fox frowned at that, and he looked at Zhang Fei again before kicking him, sending him rolling on the ground several times. "What a weak little brat! I don’t understand why my benevolent soul chose him as our heir!"

Zhang Fei helplessly lay on the ground, and he felt that he was getting weaker and weaker. Since he became a cultivator, this was the second time he felt so helpless, and the first was his encounter with the mysterious woman from the Ancient Nether Clan. ’Am I really going to die here? What will happen to them if these two bastards take over my body?’

{Is your determination only limited to this, kid? Can you really not do anything without the help of your system and all your strengths? You are my heir, and my heir cannot be weak. Get up! Fight them!}

Zhang Fei wanted to do that, but he grew weaker as time passed. ’You are the benevolent soul of the ten-tailed fox, right? What can I do? That evil soul is so powerful, and I don’t have the power or abilities to fight him right now. Moreover, that demon is by his side, and he’s no less powerful even though he’s not a complete soul.’

{Have I made a mistake in choosing you as my heir? Have you forgotten your promise to all the women and people closest to you?} Zhang Fei naturally never forgot his promise to them. {If you give up now, they will take over your body. At that time, they will do bad things to them, and worst of all, they will torture them to death. Do you really want to see that happen? Additionally, they will use your body to create great chaos in this universe, and more and more people will suffer because of you.}

Zhang Fei could no longer respond to the benevolent soul of the ten-tailed fox, as his consciousness increasingly disappeared due to the severe injuries in his chest. ’I’m sorry, I couldn’t do anything to defeat them.’

In the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, Zhang Fei suddenly absorbed the black smoke covering his body before he opened his eyes. However, his eyes had turned pitch-black, and a baleful aura radiated from his body.
Zhang Fei immediately attacked Feng Yao, who was standing beside him. However, the phoenix princess simply overpowered him, restricted his movements, and sealed his cultivation.
*Slap*
Feng Yao slapped Zhang Fei’s cheeks really hard, causing him to bounce and slam into the wall behind him. "Idiot! Fight your heart!"
Despite this, Zhang Fei said nothing and glared at Feng Yao with his pitch-black eyes. He struggled to break free from her restraint, but his efforts were in vain.
"What happened to him, Big Sis Yao? Has the Cursed Demon Heart taken over his body?" Although Luo Yunxiao’s tone was calm, her expression was filled with panic.

"Not yet." Feng Yao replied with a shake of her head. "The Cursed Demon Heart has begun to awaken, but it’s still not fully awake. I don’t know what’s happening to him, but the heart will completely take over his body if he continues like this. If that happens, I’ll have no choice but to kill him."
"Big Sis Yao." Luo Yunxiao suddenly realized something. "Shit! His five clones are connected to his main body directly, and they must be experiencing the same situation."

Feng Yao just remembered that, but she also remembered that there were many powerful cultivators by Zhang Fei’s clones’ side. "Don’t worry, they’ll definitely be fine. Some of his women have already broken through to the Five Celestial Realms, and Jia Yuyan was also with them, so it shouldn’t be difficult for them to stop his clones in their current state."
"I hope you are right, Big Sis Yao." Luo Yunxiao released a heavy sigh. "Otherwise, they will be seriously injured because of our husband’s clones."

"Grandma." Zhang Lin called out to Zhang Chen, who was already cross-legged in front of Zhang Fei’s first clone. "What would you do?"

Zhang Chen shook her head slightly, grabbed her grandson’s hands, and rubbed them. ’Fei’er, you must resist the temptation of your Cursed Demon Heat! We’re waiting for your return, and we believe you’ll become stronger if you make it through this situation.’

sentences.text: "Hehehe... hahaha..." Zhang Fei frowned at the male demon.

"Argh!"

"Back then, you beat me to death and absorbed my soul, but unfortunately, you didn’t realize that I would always exist within your body as your evil side.

*Splurt*
A black liquid immediately gushed from Zhang Fei’s chest as soon as the evil soul of the ten-tailed fox retracted its claws, causing him to fall to his knees.
The evil soul of the ten-tailed fox grabbed Zhang Fei’s head and bared his long fangs.
"Hahaha!

Without your strength and abilities, you are nothing but an ant in my eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 1086: Zhang Chen’s Decision
paragraphs: After trying for a while, Hun Di opened his eyes and informed them, "I can’t find Zhang Fei’s soul in his tiny soul world, and he seems to be trapped inside the Cursed Demon Heart. Moreover, the situation inside his soul world is extremely grim, and it’s only getting worse with each passing moment. If his condition continues like this, he will really succumb to the influence of his heart."

"We agree with our master," Lin Moxian and the others spoke after opening their eyes. "The only way to save our junior brother is to awaken his soul, but he hasn’t responded to us, perhaps due to the Cursed Demon Heart’s influence."
"Can you send me into his soul world, Senior?" Zhang Chen asked Hun Di.

Qing Yi immediately spoke to her. "Mother, you shouldn’t do that. It will be dangerous for you, and you might die if the Cursed Demon Heart devours your soul. Even if you can save Fei’er that way, he will surely suffer greatly if you die."

"Grandma, I want to help my big brother, but we should think of another solution to do it. He will blame himself if one of us dies, and he will never forgive himself." Zhang Lin also spoke to Zhang Chen.
Unlike them, Zhang Yue sat on Zhang Chen’s side and spoke to Hun Di directly. "Senior, please send my soul into my husband’s soul world, and I will save him from the Cursed Demon Heart."
"No." Zhang Chen called out to Zhang Yue. "Yue’er, you’re still young, so I can’t let you take such a risk. I’ll go in there to awaken his soul, and I’ll make sure he returns to all of you."
"But, Grandma—"

"Don’t argue with me, Yue’er." Zhang Chen looked at Hun Di again. "Senior, please send me there. I know it’s dangerous, but I can’t let my grandson fall into the control of the Cursed Demon Heart. No matter the cost, I will save him and bring him back, so please do it now."

"I’ll accompany you there, Grandma," Qian Shuang suddenly spoke as she sat beside Zhang Chen. "I have a special ability that I can only use once a year, and I haven’t used it in a long time, so I’ll use it now. I will connect you to my husband’s soul, and you can try to awaken him, but I can only do it from within his soul world."

Jia Yuyan immediately spoke. "Qian Shuang is right; she’s the only person who can connect our souls with Zhang Fei’s. Moreover, her light element is quite pure, so I think it can protect her and Grandma Chen from the Cursed Demon Heart’s influence. However, they can’t stay in his soul world for too long, and they must leave immediately if the heart further affects his soul world."
"Then it’s decided; please send Quang’er and me into Fei’er’s tiny world, Senior." Zhang Chen spoke to Hun Di.
Hun Di released a soft sigh and turned to his disciples. "Use your soul powers to strengthen their souls, and I will send them into your junior brother’s soul world afterward."

"Yes, Master." Lin Moxian, Qiao Liangren, Shang Yingyue, Yan Yinqing, and Jing Qiuyue moved to sit behind Zhang Chen and Qian Shuang. They pressed their palms against their backs and used their soul power to boost theirs. "They are ready, Master."
Hun Di first handed two items to Zhang Chen and Qian Shuang. "Hold them tight so I can detect if the situation worsens, and I will immediately pull your souls out of there."
"Yes, Senior."
Zhang Chen and Qian Shuang fell unconscious as soon as Hun Di sent their souls into Zhang Fei’s soul world. "Are you sure they won’t encounter any problems?"

"I can’t be sure, Senior," Hun Di answered Jia Yuyan with a shake of his head. "My disciples have strengthened their souls, and I’m also using my soul power to protect their souls. If I sense the cursed demon heart is affecting them, I will immediately pull their souls out of there so the heart won’t be able to devour them."
Jia Yuyan nodded in understanding. "Let’s wait then; I hope Grandma Chen can awaken our husband’s soul."

A while later, the souls of the two women were already inside Zhang Fei’s soul world, but their expressions turned ugly because the situation inside was too chaotic, and many disasters were occurring within. "Quang’er, use your ability now, and I will try to awaken Fei’er’s soul so that he will not succumb to the influence of the cursed demon heart."
"Yes, Grandma." Qian Shuang touched Zhang Chen’s back directly. "Grandma, you might feel a little nauseous and dizzy, but I’m sure you will meet my husband’s soul in person."
Zhang Chen nodded at her. "Do it now, Quang’er."
"Get ready, Grandma."

When Zhang Chen opened her eyes, she found herself in a dark place. However, she did not see the evil soul of the nine-tailed fox or the male demon, and she only found Zhang Fei lying on the ground in a half-dead state, making his soul slightly transparent.
Zhang Chen immediately approached his grandson, sat by his side, and placed his head on her lap. "Fei’er, please wake up; I came here to save you."
Zhang Fei’s eyelashes trembled when he heard that familiar voice, but his eyes were too heavy as his consciousness was already too thin.
"Fei’er, wake up, it’s your grandma." Zhang Chen called out to him once again, but Zhang Fei still did not open his eyes. She lowered her face, kissed him, and infused her soul power into his soul.

Zhang Fei’s soul gradually returned to its original state, but Zhang Chen’s soul gradually faded away due to her actions. However, she suddenly received an injection of soul power from outside, stopping her soul from fading away.
Through their mouths, Zhang Chen kept channeling her soul power into Zhang Fei’s for quite a while, making his soul return to its original state sometime later.

Zhang Fei slowly opened his eyes before staring blankly at Zhang Chen, who was kissing him. As a cultivator, he could sense her soul power flowing into his soul, which mixed with the soul power of several other people.
Zhang Fei stretched his hands, embraced Zhang Chen’s head, and kissed her back, startling her.

In her entire life, Zhang Chen never imagined kissing her own grandson, but she took the initiative to kiss Zhang Fei to restore his soul. Even so, they did not share a passionate kiss; instead, they merely pressed their lips together while she continued to channel soul power into his soul.

Once Zhang Fei’s soul had completely recovered, Zhang Chen stopped her action and separated their lips. She caressed his cheeks and looked at him with great affection. "Why do you like this, Fei’er? I always believed you were a strong child, and you never gave up easily in the face of your situation, but you’ve made us all worry about you. If I didn’t come here, you would have succumbed to the influence of the cursed demon heart, and you would have made us all miserable."

"I’m sorry, Grandma." Zhang Fei replied with a soft sigh. "We are inside the Cursed Demon Heart now, and they are too strong for me. I can’t use my strength in this place, so I am unable to defeat them.

Zhang Chen shook her head in response. "You say you don’t have your power, but I can actually get it in here, right? If I, an outsider, can channel the power of my soul and several other people into your soul, you as the owner should be able to use your power here, right? We may be inside the Cursed Demon Heart, but you have to remember that the heart merged with your body long ago, so you are its true owner. Therefore, I believe that your weakness is just your imagination, which is influenced by the heart. Moreover, your soul is different from the souls of other people because of the existence of hundreds of white lotuses in it, so I believe that the soul of the previous owner of your heart will never be able to defeat you."
"Grandma, I—"

Zhang Chen placed her fingers on Zhang Fei’s lips. "For now, you should focus on removing the influence of the Cursed Demon Heart from your mind and soul, and you’ll realize that you still have your powers. After that, you can meet the old owner of your heart, and you must kick his ass because he has made us worry about you."
"Haha." Zhang Fei softly laughed upon hearing Zhang Chen speak like that.

{Foolish kid.} Zhang Fei and Zhang Chen turned to the benevolent soul of the ten-tailed fox. {I delayed my appearance to evaluate your determination, but you disappointed me by quickly succumbing to the influence of the Cursed Demon Heart. As your grandmother said just now, we are in your body, and the heart has long been yours. If only you could have seen everything clearly from the start, your grandmother wouldn’t have taken the risk of saving you.}

Zhang Fei released a soft sigh before getting up and lifting Zhang Chen to her feet. "You’re right, old fox. I I was too stupid to see the truth, and I was foolish for always relying on all my advantages. They have helped me become strong, but they are not everything to me; my true strength lies within myself."

{It’s good that you finally realized it.} The benevolent soul of the ten-tailed fox spoke while nodding. {Now it’s time to eliminate this darkness and defeat that demon, after which you can fully take control of the Cursed Demon Heart. As for my evil soul, I’ll take care of it for you, so you just need to focus on that demon.}
"Yeah." Zhang Fei looked at his grandmother. "Grandma, you have to go now, and I will see you soon."
Zhang Chen smiled and nodded to him. "I’ll wait for you outside, Fei’er."
After Zhang Chen disappeared, Zhang Fei inhaled and exhaled several times. His eyes became sharp and firm, and he immediately released his soul power, which dispelled the darkness around them.
"What the hell!" The male demon and the evil soul of the ten-tailed fox screamed in shock. "How is this possible? My heart has already affected your mind and soul!"
Unlike the male demon, the evil soul of the ten-tailed fox solely focuses his attention on the benevolent soul. "You must be the one who saved him!"

"Unfortunately, you’re wrong about that." The benevolent soul of the ten-tailed fox spoke with a shake of its head. "Someone saved him, but you two didn’t notice that person’s presence. Unfortunately, it’s too late because he already realized everything, and it’s time for him to fight back."

"You—" Both the male demon and the evil soul of the ten-tailed fox stopped talking as hundreds of white lotuses shot out from Zhang Fei’s soul, rotating in place and emitting an extremely powerful aura.
Zhang Fei looked at the two of them with seriousness. "It’s my turn to defeat you two."
- To Be Continued

"You say you don’t have your power, but I can actually get it in here, right?
If I, an outsider, can channel the power of my soul and several other people into your soul, you as the owner should be able to use your power here, right?

Therefore, I believe that your weakness is just your imagination, which is influenced by the heart.

Moreover, your soul is different from the souls of other people because of the existence of hundreds of white lotuses in it, so I believe that the soul of the previous owner of your heart will never be able to defeat you."
"Grandma, I—"

"It’s my turn to defeat you two."

paragraphs: "Grandma! You did it!" Zhang Lin exclaimed as she hugged Zhang Chen, who had just opened her eyes from behind. "How did you wake up big brother’s soul?"

Zhang Chen didn’t immediately answer her second granddaughter; instead, she rubbed Zhang Fei’s cheek with a gentle and affectionate gaze. She was truly relieved because the black smoke was starting to fade. "When I found your Big Brother, he was in a truly dire state, and his soul was already fading. Therefore, I channeled my soul power into his soul, and I also used their soul power that flowed into mine, which allowed me to wake him up."
"What really happened there, Grandma? Why did Fei’er almost succumb to the influence of the cursed demon heart?" Zhang Yue asked, and her tone was filled with relief.

Zhang Chen released a soft sigh. "Due to his previous injuries, Fei’er’s cursed demon heart clouded his mind and soul, causing him to be unable to think clearly. He thought that he couldn’t use his strength and abilities there, and the previous owner of the heart attacked him along with the evil soul of the ten-tailed fox, making him feel even more helpless. Fortunately, I arrived when none of them were there, and I managed to save him. By now, he should have started fighting them, and the benevolent soul of the ten-tailed fox is assisting him. Therefore, we no longer need to worry about him, and we just need to wait for him to wake up."
Zhang Chen’s explanation brought a sense of relief to all of Zhang Fei’s women.

Hun Di, his five disciples, and Xi Hongyan also felt relieved upon hearing this. However, they didn’t immediately leave the pavilion, instead continuing to wait and monitor the situation of Zhang Fei’s four clones.

In the eastern forest of the Sovereign Heaven Realm, Xie Jingxian and Bai Shuxiang, who were waiting for Zhang Xiaolong [3] along with the members of the natural races, also felt relieved that the situation had returned to normal.
"Let’s wait for our husband to wake up."

"Sisters! Let’s prepare something for our husband while waiting for him to wake up!" Liu Hua spoke as she walked away from the main garden, followed by most of her sisters, while some others stayed behind to wait there.

In the Immortal Lotus Realm, an old man and an old woman were standing behind Feng Yao, and they were observing Zhang Fei, who had calmed down again with great relief. They were two of the several ancestors of the Luo Clan, Luo Shiwen and Luo Meizhen.

"This kid is truly troublesome!" Feng Yao spoke as she shook her head. "What actually happened to him? How could he suddenly calm down again? Moreover, his cursed demon heart seemed to be already under his control."

"Perhaps the people in the pavilion are helping his clones, Big Sis Yao. After all, Hun Di is an expert soul cultivator, and he might find a solution to help her." Luo Yunxiao spoke with great relief on her face.

Tang Ying, who was sitting behind Zhang Fei, opened her eyes immediately. "The one who saved this kid was not my junior brother but Zhang Chen. My junior brother sent her soul to his soul world, and his disciples used their soul power to strengthen her soul. He had awakened with a clear mind, and he fought with the previous owner of the heart and the evil soul of the ten-tailed fox. I wanted to help him, but I couldn’t because of the latter’s presence. However, you don’t need to worry about him, especially since the benevolent soul of the ten-tailed fox helped him fight them."
"Is this kid really the heir of the ten-tailed fox, Empress Huo?"
Feng Yao turned to Luo Shiwen and Luo Meizhen. "Do you two still need to doubt that, Shiwen and Meizhen? Have you ever met someone with four different identities like him?"
"No." Both Luo Shiwen and Luo Meizhen responded with a shake of their heads. "Are there many people who know his four identities?"

"Most cultivators from the Three Immortal Realms know three of his identities because he never hid any of them, but they don’t know about his fourth identity, especially since he acquired it not long ago." Feng Yao paused for a few moments before continuing. "However, all the natural and beast races in this realm know about him and his three identities, and some of them obviously don’t like his status as the heir of the ten-tailed fox, one of whom is Jia Zizhen."
"The Fairy King?" Luo Shiwen and Luo Meizhen were confused by that, as they had heard that Zhang Fei had only arrived a few months ago, and he had not gone anywhere before.

Feng Yao nodded at them. "Unlike you humans, all the natural and beast races have long known that the heir of the ten-tailed fox will be born with three identities, and Jia Zizhen sent an elf to the Three Immortal Realms to search for his heir. Actually, Zhang Fei and the Fairy King haven’t had any problems for now, but that stupid fairy will make a move once he notices that he’s arrived in this realm. All this time, many people thought that he was a righteous cultivator, but in fact, he was in cahoots with the Nine Nethers Demon Race to kill his predecessor."
"What?" All of them exclaimed in shock. "So, the news circulating outside about the Fairy King all this time is true?"

"Yeah." Feng Yao turned to Zhang Fei again. "This kid listened to Jia Zizhen’s message and immediately realized that the Fairy King isn’t a good person. I don’t know when it will happen, but a battle between them will be inevitable, and it will be one of the greatest battles ever."

Luo Meizhen then spoke to her. "Empress Huo, who would dare fight this kid if they knew you were on his side? Even if the Fairy King and the Nine Nethers Demon Race united, they would still be no match for you and the people of the Blazing Nirvana Domain."

"I have helped him a lot in the Three Mortal Realms, so I will no longer help him in this realm, and he must be independent in taking care of all his problems." After saying this, Feng Yao turned into a wisp of crimson flame and entered Zhang Fei’s body, leaving them stunned.

Luo Yunxiao shook her head at their expressions. "Ancestor Shiwen and Ancestor Meizhen, I would definitely be worried if he faced a cultivator from this realm, but I support Yao’s choice not to help him. Moreover, he’s not as weak as you two imagine, and he’ll definitely become stronger after this incident. If you don’t believe me, you two can see his progress after we emerge from our seclusion in a few years."
"Will you two return to seclusion again after this, Yunxiao?" Luo Meizhen asked her.

"Yes." Luo Yunxiao replied with a nod. "As soon as he finishes fighting those two evil souls, we will enter seclusion again, and we will come out when the Forgotten Realm opens. By the way, great responsibilities await him in the future, and he needs troops to help him, so I hope our Luo Clan will stand behind him at that time."

Luo Shiwen and Luo Meizhen exchanged glances for a moment before answering her. "Yunxiao, I know he is your husband, but our Luo Clan has never been involved in such matters. Moreover, the matter is still far in the future, so we will not make a decision today, and we will first assess the situation when the time comes."

"I know." Luo Yunxiao herself had already guessed that they would answer this way, so she did not press them. "My husband’s situation has calmed down now, so I hope you can all leave this place, and I will use something to help him."
After they left, and only Tang Ying and Nalan Yushu were there, Luo Yunxiao immediately took off her dress before helping Zhang Fei undress.
"Haha." Nalan Yushu laughed at that. "What are you going to do, little girl?"
Luo Yunxiao first rode Zhang Fei’s lower body and inserted his sleeping dick into her pussy. She then asked Tang Ying, "You should be able to send my soul to his soul world, right?"

Luo Yunxiao shook her head and then explained her intentions. "I’m not asking you to send me to their battle location, and I want to go to his soul world to do something, which will be of great help to him."
"I see." Tang Ying nodded in understanding and touched Luo Yunxiao. "Are you going back in there?"
"That’s for sure!" Nalan Yushu immediately entered Zhang Fei’s soul world, followed by Tang Ying, who brought Luo Yunxiao’s soul there.
Once they left, Luo Yunxiao’s body emitted a black and white aura, and the two quickly formed a Yin-Yang Symbol above them.

Upon their arrival inside Zhang Fei’s soul world, Luo Yunxiao immediately released her soul power and spread it throughout the place, shocking Tang Ying and Nalan Yushu. Just like her body, her soul also emitted a black and white aura, which formed a Yin-Yang Symbol above them.

"Yin and Yang." Tang Ying muttered as she paid attention to the changes in Zhang Fei’s soul world, where the day and night began to form, as well as the sun and moon. Additionally, various kinds of plants, rivers, lakes, mountains, and many other things began to appear one by one. "How did she do this kind of thing?"

"She can do it thanks to her special physique." Tang Ying turned to Nalan Yushu directly. "According to Feng Yao, this girl possesses the Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique, which once belonged to the ten-tailed fox. Her physique allows her to manipulate Yin and Yang, which are the source of all things."
Tang Ying returned her focus to Luo Yunxiao again. "Zhang Fei is the heir of the ten-tailed fox, and this girl is the current owner of his past physique, which means they both complement each other."

"That’s right." Nalan Yushu nodded in agreement. "This way, my master will have no trouble fighting the evil soul of the ten-tailed fox, and I believe he will gain complete control over the cursed demon heart."
"I hope so."

Meanwhile, in a distant domain, the mysterious male fox had brought the two heavenly foxes into a house. He took off his fox mask, and his face shocked Tian Baixing. "Who exactly are you, Senior? Why did you suddenly appear and save us?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1088: The Mysterious Fox’s Identity
paragraphs: "You’ve seen my face, but you still can’t recognize me, my foolish descendant." Tian Baixing froze as a tenth tail appeared behind the mysterious male fox, and his fur turned from silver to completely white. "That’s right, I am the mighty Hu Tianlang."
"How... how is this possible? Isn’t—"

"I’m dead?" Tian Baixing vigorously nodded at Hu Tianlang. "Hahaha! I was dead the moment I split into two, you foolish fox. Long before I died, I had already divided my soul into several parts, and I left my soul of wrath in this realm. However, this soul was different from my other souls, and it was much stronger than the others, which allowed me to monitor everything."
"Does... does that mean—"

"There is no resurrection in this universe, and I am only the soul of my wrath. Even so, I can still kill you and your foolish brother, you know?" Tian Baixing trembled when Hun Tianlang said that. "You two are my direct descendants, and I passed on so much knowledge to you two, but you haven’t put it to good use. So much time has passed since I separated myself into you two, but your cultivation is stuck at the Ten Mortal Realms, and you don’t even know how to reach this realm. Unlike you two, Zhang Fei didn’t inherit anything from me, and he’s much younger than you two, but his strength terrifies you two. If I hadn’t made a move, you two would have fallen into his hands by now."

Tian Baixing’s expression turned gloomy after hearing that. "Why? Why did you choose him as your heir? Why are you being unfair to us? We are both your direct descendants, but you chose an outsider as your heir!"
"Do you think I really chose Zhang Fei as my heir?" Hu Tianlang responded with a shake of his head.
"What do you mean by that? Weren’t you the one who left the writing on those stone monuments?"

Hu Tianlang let out a soft sigh. "It’s true that I left those writings behind, but I didn’t choose him as my heir. Instead, a hidden power that surpasses me and the other primordials chose him as my heir, and I simply wrote down what it conveyed to me."
"A hidden power that surpasses you?" Tian Baixing was quite confused by what Hu Tianlang had just said.

"Our cultivation, this universe, the laws, the Dao, the Heavens, and many others are all part of that hidden power. I won’t talk too much about it because I don’t understand it myself, but that hidden power does exist, and it shackles us with some things that we can’t just let go of." Hu Tianlang directly touched Tian Baixing’s chest and channeled his qi into her, causing her cultivation to soar suddenly. "Cultivate and break through to the Five Celestial Realms for now."
Tian Baixing just nodded and sat cross-legged at her spot, especially since her cultivation had started to fluctuate, indicating that she would break through soon.

’I’m sorry, but your fates have been sealed since you two were born, and you guys will be the sacrifices for Zhang Fei to break the shackles.’ Hu Tianlang immediately disappeared from that place and went elsewhere.
Time passed so fast, and Zhang Fei’s soul world has changed completely. It has become a true world with many living creatures in it, except for humans, demons, and natural races.
Tang Ying immediately moved to support Luo Yunxiao as soon as she withdrew her soul power, especially since her soul became so weak after she did all that.
"Hah... Hah..." Luo Yunxiao gasped heavily. "I’m exhausted."
"How did you manage to do this? As far as I know, your physique hasn’t awakened yet, right?" Nalan Yushu asked her.

"You’re wrong about that, Yushu," Luo Yunxiao responded to her. "The benevolent soul of the ten-tailed fox told me that the key to awakening my physique was my husband, and my physique had already begun awakening as soon as our bodies were connected. Although it hasn’t fully awakened yet, it’s enough for me to do all this. If I dual cultivate with him more often, my physique will fully awaken sooner, and my cultivation speed will be several times faster than it is now."

Nalan Yushu nodded in understanding. "Your physique is truly terrifying; did you know that? Look at this Soul World! It was previously completely empty, but you’ve made it more vibrant, and it’s now like the real world out there! Day, night, plants, oceans, valleys, lakes, mountains, and beasts have appeared. This way, my master can bring other living creatures to live here, and they will become his strength."

"Hehe." Luo Yunxiao chuckled. "Please bring me back, Tang Ying. I need a long sleep after this, and I probably won’t wake up for a while. Therefore, you two should tell him that I’m okay if he wakes up before me."

Both women nodded to Luo Yunxiao, and Tang Ying immediately took her soul out of Zhang Fei’s soul world, returning it to her body. Meanwhile, Nalan Yushu went out to pick up Ma Kuangyu, and she took him back to the soul world afterwards.

"This is crazy!" Ma Kuangyu exclaimed in astonishment as he observed the interior of Zhang Fei’s soul world. "Little Yunxiao’s Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique is too terrifying! No wonder Fenghan and Xiaoyi hid her from the public, especially since people would target her if they knew about her physique."
Nalan Yushu nodded in agreement. "This way, my master’s strength will increase significantly, and he will be even more prepared to explore the Paradise Realm in the future."
"Yeah." Ma Kuangyu let out a soft sigh. "Yushu, I think we should go to that place to reshape our bodies soon, especially since Zhang Fei will need our help in the future."
"Have you obtained the materials?" Nalan Yushu asked excitedly, especially since she had long wanted to reshape her body.

Ma Kuangyu nodded at her. "Fenghan has already obtained some of the materials, and he is still looking for the rest. Since Zhang Fei will still be in seclusion for a long time, we will use that time to reshape our bodies once he has collected all the materials."
"Alright, I agree with you, but we must wait for my master to wake up and discuss this matter with him first."
"Yeah."

In their battle area, Zhang Fei, who had gained additional strength due to Luo Yunxiao’s actions in his soul world, attacked the former owner of the cursed demon heart with full force. His current soul strength simply surpassed the male demon’s incomplete soul, and he pinned his soul under his leg. "After this, the cursed demon heart will be completely mine, and I won’t have to worry about it turning me into pure evil."
"No! Don’t kill me! I don’t want to die!" The male demon shouted hysterically.

"Too late!" After saying this, Zhang Fei immediately absorbed the male demon’s soul until he disappeared from that place, but he did not feel any increase in his soul power because the male demon’s soul was incomplete.

Zhang Fei then turned to the two souls of the ten-tailed fox who were fighting not far from his location, and he could see that the benevolent soul of the ten-tailed fox was inferior to the evil soul, especially since the evil soul of the ten-tailed fox had superior strength.

Zhang Fei immediately dashed toward them and attacked the ten-tailed fox’s evil soul. "Back then, I successfully absorbed your soul, and I’ll absorb your soul power clean this time, so you won’t be able to bother me again forever."

Therefore, you must have more confidence in yourself and hone yourself further; only then will you become a true cultivator, and you will be worthy to become my successor."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "Thank you for your advice, old fox. I will definitely improve myself, and I won’t disappoint you again."
"You’ve been here too long, so it’s time for you to go back."
"Yeah."

"That’s right, I am the mighty Hu Tianlang."
"How... how is this possible?

"I’m dead?" Tian Baixing vigorously nodded at Hu Tianlang.
"Hahaha!
I was dead the moment I split into two, you foolish fox.
Long before I died, I had already divided my soul into several parts, and I left my soul of wrath in this realm.

We are both your direct descendants, but you chose an outsider as your heir!"

Hu Tianlang let out a soft sigh.

"Our cultivation, this universe, the laws, the Dao, the Heavens, and many others are all part of that hidden power.

I won’t talk too much about it because I don’t understand it myself, but that hidden power does exist, and it shackles us with some things that we can’t just let go of." Hu Tianlang directly touched Tian Baixing’s chest and channeled his qi into her, causing her cultivation to soar suddenly.
"Cultivate and break through to the Five Celestial Realms for now."
Tian Baixing just nodded and sat cross-legged at her spot, especially since her cultivation had started to fluctuate, indicating that she would break through soon.

Time passed so fast, and Zhang Fei’s soul world has changed completely.
It has become a true world with many living creatures in it, except for humans, demons, and natural races.
Tang Ying immediately moved to support Luo Yunxiao as soon as she withdrew her soul power, especially since her soul became so weak after she did all that.
"Hah...
Hah..." Luo Yunxiao gasped heavily.
"I’m exhausted."
"How did you manage to do this?
As far as I know, your physique hasn’t awakened yet, right?" Nalan Yushu asked her.
"You’re wrong about that, Yushu," Luo Yunxiao responded to her.
"The benevolent soul of the ten-tailed fox told me that the key to awakening my physique was my husband, and my physique had already begun awakening as soon as our bodies were connected.

chapters.title: Chapter 1089: Return
paragraphs: "Wake up?" Zhang Fei immediately sat up in bed before turning to Luo Yunxiao, who was still sound asleep. Tang Ying immediately explained the situation to him, causing him to let out a regretful sigh. "It’s all over, and she’s in excellent condition. Sooner or later, she’ll wake up on her own, so you don’t need to blame yourself for this."
Zhang Fei just nodded. "How long was I asleep?"
[You slept for more than a month and a half, Master.]
"You slept for more than a month and a half, Zhang Fei."
"Phew." Zhang Fei didn’t expect his battle with the evil soul of the ten-tailed fox to last so long. "Where are my parents-in-law?"

Tang Ying informed him directly. "They went to attend an event at another sect. Your mother-in-law said you don’t need to wait for them to return, and you can take Luo Yunxiao with you directly to continue your seclusion."

"I see." Zhang Fei used the map to check on the other members of the Luo Clan, and he found them busy with their own affairs. He immediately picked up Luo Yunxiao before bringing her and Tang Ying back to the training space.
Tang Ying immediately joined the others to continue training, and Zhang Fei brought Luo Yunxiao to the pavilion.
When he arrived there, Zhang Fei found all his wives looking relieved, especially since his four clones had woken up. "Please forgive me; I’ve made you all worry."

They shook their heads at Zhang Fei, especially since the mysterious male fox had suddenly attacked him. Zhang Chen immediately approached him and examined it. "How’s your cursed demon heart, Fei’er?"

"Thank you, Grandma. If you hadn’t come to save me, I would have fallen under the control of my cursed demon heart." Zhang Fei then looked at Hun Di and his other disciples. "Master! Senior Brothers! Senior Sisters! Thank you all for your help, and I managed to defeat the demon because you guys helped me with your soul power."
"Does this mean you have controlled your cursed demon heart, Fei’er?" Hun Di questioned him.

"Yes, Master." Zhang Fei then explained to them about his battle with the male demon and the evil soul of the ten-tailed fox. "The heart is under my complete control now, so it will never affect me again, let alone turn me into a pure evil living being. As for the evil soul, I can’t do anything to it for now, and it will remain inside my soul until I successfully gather all the pieces of the old fox’s soul and merge them with mine. However, I’ve already thought of a way so that it won’t bother me anymore, but I still need all of your help to do so, especially since the soul is simply overpowered."
"What are your plans for the evil soul, Junior Brother?"

Zhang Fei answered Lin Moxian directly. "I planned to create a soul prison to imprison the evil soul in my soul, but my current soul power is not enough to create a strong prison. Therefore, I need all of your soul power to create a truly strong prison that can effectively imprison the evil soul."
"When are you going to do it?" Qiao Liangren asked Zhang Fei. Shang Yingyue, Yan Yinqing, and Jing Qiuyue also looked at him seriously.

"I haven’t finalized it yet." Zhang Fei then told them about his idea for the evil soul. "For now, it’s still my rough idea, and I’ll refine it first. Once I have finalized my plan, I will meet with all of you, and together we will directly imprison the evil soul."

Hun Di patted his shoulder. "Even though your previous situation worried us, I’m glad that you managed to control your cursed demon heart. As for the evil soul, you can tell us once your idea is final, and we will help you to imprison it."
"Thank you, Master." Zhang Fei sincerely replied.
Hun Di immediately led his disciples and Xi Hongyan to leave, and only Jing Qiuyue remained because she always lived in the pavilion with Zhang Fei and the others.
"Grandma, I will take Yunxiao to the room first, and I will meet you after." Zhang Chen just nodded and walked away to her room, waiting for Zhang Fei, who took Luo Yunxiao away.

Zhang Fei’s four clones didn’t immediately dual cultivate with their respective wives; instead, they led them to the training ground, especially since his encounter with the wrath soul of the ten-tailed fox taught him a valuable lesson. He also gained some enlightenment from his battle with the male demon and the evil soul, and he no longer wanted to rely too heavily on all his advantages, especially the soul link.

Zhang Fei left Luo Yunxiao to rest in her room before meeting all his wives, giving all of them a hug and a kiss. After that, he went to meet Zhang Chen in his room, but the kiss they shared in the cursed demon heart made him feel awkward toward her.

Zhang Chen herself felt awkward facing her grandson, and she slightly regretted her decision to kiss Zhang Fei there. However, she knew that she had no choice but to do that; otherwise, he would have already fallen under the control of the cursed demon heart.
Zhang Fei immediately sat down beside Zhang Chen and grabbed her hand. "Grandma."

"Please forget it, Fei’er," Zhang Chen spoke as she sighed softly, then she placed her head on his shoulder. "I had no choice before, and I kissed you to save you, mainly because I didn’t want to lose you. I don’t want to have that kind of relationship with you, and I will always be your grandmother. Therefore, you should forget our kiss and pretend it never happened, okay?"
"Grandma, I—"
Zhang Chen immediately covered Zhang Fei’s mouth with her hand and looked at him. "I beg you, please forget it and don’t mention it ever again."
’Sigh.’ Zhang Fei pulled Zhang Chen’s hand down and hugged her. "I understand, Grandma."

After they talked for a few minutes, Zhang Fei left his grandmother’s room. Zhang Chen released a soft sigh, lay down on her bed, and rubbed her lips while recalling the kiss she had shared with her grandson earlier. ’Fei’er, I love you so much, and I would do anything for you, but I never want to be in such a relationship with you.’
"Did something happen between you and my mother?" Qing Yi asked her son as soon as he left Zhang Chen’s room.
"Nothing happened between us, and we were just having a small talk." Zhang Fei chose not to disclose her previous kiss with Zhang Chen to anyone. "What are they doing?"
Qing Yi hugged Zhang Fei’s arm and explained it to him directly. "What are your plans next? Do you want to start dual cultivating with us again after this?"

"We will start dual cultivating again after this, but we will divide our time into honing our fighting skills." Zhang Fei paused for a while. "After the mysterious male fox attacked me and almost killed me, coupled with my spar with Yunxiao before, I realized that my fighting skills were far inferior to theirs. My speed was extremely high to face cultivators in the Three Mortal Realms, but it was too slow when compared to cultivators from the Paradise Realm. Moreover, I couldn’t continue relying on my soul link to increase my strength, and I had to be able to face my enemies without borrowing their strength."
Qing Yi looked at him in confusion. "Why is that?"

"My reliance on borrowing their power has made me foolish and arrogant, and I didn’t realize the Cursed Demon Heart’s influence on me." Zhang Fei let out a heavy sigh and clenched his fists. "If my grandmother hadn’t taken the risk to go there and wake me up, I would be dead by now, and those two bastards would have taken over my body without you all knowing. If that happened, they would use my body to do many terrible things to all of you, and you guys would suffer because of my stupidity. I promised to protect you all, but I almost harmed you all. Therefore, I can’t continue like this, and I have to be better so I can protect you all well."

Qing Yi nodded slightly. "In that case, we will help you with your cultivation, and we will also improve ourselves by training harder in the next few years. This way, you don’t have to keep worrying about us, and we will protect ourselves."

"Yes." Unlike before, Zhang Fei had made a decision for all of his wives, and he would no longer confine them to the pavilion. He wanted his wives to roam freely in the Paradise Realm to experience more things, which would help them become better cultivators and assist him in facing any future problems.

Qing Yi then told him something else. "You may not know it yet, but your grandmother was able to enter there not because of your master and the others. Instead, Qian Shuang used her rare ability to send her to that place, so you should thank her too."

"Oh?" Zhang Fei was surprised to hear that, especially since he had not seen Qian Shuang at that place before. Qing Yi immediately provided him with further details about the actions of the female elf. "I’m going to see Shuang’er now."
"Go on." Qing Yi pushed him forward.
"Shuang’er."
Qian Shuang, who was sitting by the bed, turned to Zhang Fei with a smile. She patted her side and spoke. "Come here, husband."
"I’m sorry; I didn’t know you were also helping me by sending my grandmother there." Zhang Fei then sat beside Qian Shuang and hugged her. "Thank you, Shuang’er."
Qian Shuang hugged Zhang Fei back and rubbed his back. "Husband, I’m your wife now, so you don’t need to thank me. Moreover, I only helped our grandmother enter that place from your soul world, so—"
"Regardless, you two have saved me, and I am truly grateful for that." Zhang Fei pulled Qian Shuang to the center of the bed, laid her there, and crawled on top of her. "Shuang’er."
Qian Shuang’s face turned shy and her heartbeat accelerated, smelling his masculine scent. "Husband, my sisters are preparing a small banquet for your recovery, so we can’t do that now."
Zhang Fei kissed her, lay down beside her, and hugged her. "Do you miss your father and the others?"
"Uhm." Qian Shuang nodded and snuggled closer to his chest, enjoying his scent. "I missed them, but it’s only been a few days in the Three Mortal Realms, right?"
Zhang Fei nodded slightly. "A week, to be exact."

"In that case, I won’t go back there now, and I will meet them again after we complete our seclusion." Qian Shuang looked up slightly. "I hope to reach a higher level by then, and I will surprise them with my cultivation level by then."
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed in response. "Don’t worry; you will be stronger than them, including your father, when we come out of our seclusion."

’Sigh.’ Zhang Fei pulled Zhang Chen’s hand down and hugged her.
"I understand, Grandma."
After they talked for a few minutes, Zhang Fei left his grandmother’s room.

Zhang Chen released a soft sigh, lay down on her bed, and rubbed her lips while recalling the kiss she had shared with her grandson earlier. ’Fei’er, I love you so much, and I would do anything for you, but I never want to be in such a relationship with you.’
"Did something happen between you and my mother?" Qing Yi asked her son as soon as he left Zhang Chen’s room.
"Nothing happened between us, and we were just having a small talk." Zhang Fei chose not to disclose her previous kiss with Zhang Chen to anyone.
"What are they doing?"
Qing Yi hugged Zhang Fei’s arm and explained it to him directly.
"What are your plans next?
Do you want to start dual cultivating with us again after this?"
"We will start dual cultivating again after this, but we will divide our time into honing our fighting skills." Zhang Fei paused for a while.
"After the mysterious male fox attacked me and almost killed me, coupled with my spar with Yunxiao before, I realized that my fighting skills were far inferior to theirs.
My speed was extremely high to face cultivators in the Three Mortal Realms, but it was too slow when compared to cultivators from the Paradise Realm.
Moreover, I couldn’t continue relying on my soul link to increase my strength, and I had to be able to face my enemies without borrowing their strength."
Qing Yi looked at him in confusion.
"Why is that?"
"My reliance on borrowing their power has made me foolish and arrogant, and I didn’t realize the Cursed Demon Heart’s influence on me." Zhang Fei let out a heavy sigh and clenched his fists.
"If my grandmother hadn’t taken the risk to go there and wake me up, I would be dead by now, and those two bastards would have taken over my body without you all knowing.
If that happened, they would use my body to do many terrible things to all of you, and you guys would suffer because of my stupidity.
I promised to protect you all, but I almost harmed you all.
Therefore, I can’t continue like this, and I have to be better so I can protect you all well."
Qing Yi nodded slightly.
"In that case, we will help you with your cultivation, and we will also improve ourselves by training harder in the next few years.
This way, you don’t have to keep worrying about us, and we will protect ourselves."
"Yes." Unlike before, Zhang Fei had made a decision for all of his wives, and he would no longer confine them to the pavilion.
He wanted his wives to roam freely in the Paradise Realm to experience more things, which would help them become better cultivators and assist him in facing any future problems.
Qing Yi then told him something else.
"You may not know it yet, but your grandmother was able to enter there not because of your master and the others.
Instead, Qian Shuang used her rare ability to send her to that place, so you should thank her too."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei was surprised to hear that, especially since he had not seen Qian Shuang at that place before.
Qing Yi immediately provided him with further details about the actions of the female elf.
"I’m going to see Shuang’er now."
"Go on." Qing Yi pushed him forward.
"Shuang’er."
Qian Shuang, who was sitting by the bed, turned to Zhang Fei with a smile.
She patted her side and spoke.
"Come here, husband."
"I’m sorry; I didn’t know you were also helping me by sending my grandmother there." Zhang Fei then sat beside Qian Shuang and hugged her.
"Thank you, Shuang’er."
Qian Shuang hugged Zhang Fei back and rubbed his back.
"Husband, I’m your wife now, so you don’t need to thank me.
Moreover, I only helped our grandmother enter that place from your soul world, so—"
"Regardless, you two have saved me, and I am truly grateful for that." Zhang Fei pulled Qian Shuang to the center of the bed, laid her there, and crawled on top of her.
"Shuang’er."
Qian Shuang’s face turned shy and her heartbeat accelerated, smelling his masculine scent.
"Husband, my sisters are preparing a small banquet for your recovery, so we can’t do that now."
Zhang Fei kissed her, lay down beside her, and hugged her.
"Do you miss your father and the others?"
"Uhm." Qian Shuang nodded and snuggled closer to his chest, enjoying his scent.
"I missed them, but it’s only been a few days in the Three Mortal Realms, right?"
Zhang Fei nodded slightly.
"A week, to be exact."
"In that case, I won’t go back there now, and I will meet them again after we complete our seclusion." Qian Shuang looked up slightly.
"I hope to reach a higher level by then, and I will surprise them with my cultivation level by then."
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed in response.
"Don’t worry; you will be stronger than them, including your father, when we come out of our seclusion."

chapters.title: Chapter 1090: Feng Bingying’s Visit
paragraphs: Once everything was ready, Zhang Fei gathered with all the members of his official harem at a large dining table, except for Luo Yunxiao, who still hadn’t woken up from her sleep.

This time, they didn’t invite anyone else, including Zhang Chen, and they enjoyed several dishes while discussing his future plans. As for his clones and their wives, they were focused on practicing on the training ground using the environment control feature.

Liu Hua and the others were quite surprised by Zhang Fei’s decision, mainly because he allowed them to leave the training space and explore the Paradise Realm after their seclusion ended. They were excited about it, but they doubted that they would be able to reach the Five Celestial Realms after their long seclusion, and they would not have the ability to face the cultivators in that realm if they failed to do so.

Despite their doubts, Zhang Fei assured them that they would reach the Five Celestial Realms after their long seclusion. If they failed, he planned to extend their seclusion and use one of his clones to travel to the Forgotten Land with Luo Fenghan and the others, and he would only end their seclusion once all of them reached that stage.

Feng Yichen, Hong Xinxin, Huli Zhishen, Duanmu Luolan, Shangguan Yan, Leng Xueyan, and Jia Yuyan didn’t think much of it, especially since their cultivation had long since reached the Five Celestial Realms. Although they still wanted to dual-cultivate with Zhang Fei, they asked him to focus entirely on their other sisters, and they would only do it with him if they were no longer able to do so.
After their small banquet ended, Zhang Fei brought all of them into his soul world. All of the women entered with their real bodies, unlike Ma Kuangyu and Nalan Yushu.

Hu Yue and the others were amazed by Zhang Fei’s soul world because it was already similar to their real world, but they were also shocked by Luo Yunxiao’s ability to accelerate the development of his soul world, and she did it in just a few hours.
Zhang Fei then led them to explore every area of his soul world, which was filled with various kinds of baby beasts in the air, mountains, forests, valleys, and water.

Liu Qingyu and the other women thought about staying there rather than in the pavilion, especially since the flow of time inside adjusted to that in the training space while his real body was in there, which was four times faster than the outside world. However, the flow of time inside would return to normal if his real body left the training space.

Since all of them were soul cultivators like their husbands, Zhang Yue and the others became impatient to create their own soul worlds. After all, the soul world would increase their soul power significantly, especially if a large number of living beings resided within it. However, just like their normal cultivation, their soul cultivation was simply too slow compared to Zhang Fei’s, who dual-soul cultivated with more than a hundred women.

After they finished exploring his soul world, Zhang Fei took them to the Sealed World Pearl. He tried to use his current soul power to speed up the flow of time inside, and Mei informed him that he had managed to accelerate it ten times faster without consuming too much of it. Even so, his soul power would still run low if he accelerated the time flow for too long, and he needed pills or other items to keep it from running low.

Mei also informed Zhang Fei that one of the five sealed areas was already open, which is the area where the beasts live. However, he chose to ignore it first because he didn’t really need a new beast. After Jia Yuyan, Shi Wu, Janette, and Lillea took care of all the herbs, which were increasingly abundant in number and type, he took them back to the pavilion.

Upon returning to the pavilion, Zhang Fei and his wives did not immediately engage in dual cultivation; instead, they went to the training ground, where they sparred with other people using the environment control feature to adapt to even the most extreme conditions.

In the end, they continued practicing and sparring for a whole month, based on the time flow in the training room. After a full month of sleep, Luo Yunxiao finally woke up, but she didn’t relax, and she decided to learn some other things she hadn’t learned before, including alchemy.

At first, Luo Yunxiao wanted to learn blacksmithing, but Zhang Fei forbade her. She asked one of her sisters to teach her, but Shi Xi also refused her request, forcing her to give up and focus on alchemy.

Luo Yunxiao herself was a fast learner, and she did not have the slightest difficulty in learning alchemy. With just a few trials, she succeeded in concocting superior-grade pills, leaving Zhang Fei, Zhang Lingxue, Chu Ying, Chu Qing, and Ning Zhuan’er jealous of her talent.

Zhang Fei decided to pick up Han Ling at the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary and take him into the training space. He asked his master to help several of his women, who were swordmasters like Xian Xianqin, Xian Changyue, Ye Lian, and others, deepen their abilities in the sword cultivation path.

The other wives of Zhang Fei, who possessed the light element, did not solely concentrate on their training. They were also deepening their healing skills under the guidance of Jia Yuyan and Elmyra, such as Ru Xue, Liu Qingyu, Chu Xing, Daniella, Meng Tianshi, Jiang Yinghua, Bai Tian’er, Bai Shushi, Xing Mei, and several other women.

Zhong Yan, Guo Lan, Tang Ziyu, and several other women chose to learn about the formation array from Duanmu Luolan, who was an array master expert. Some other women learned to become domain masters from Shangguan Yan, and some others asked Shang Ziyuan to teach them to create new techniques.
Shang Ziyuan had no problem teaching them, but creating new techniques was not simple; it required an extreme talent like hers, which made the process difficult for the learners.

Liu Hua decided to learn about poison from You Shen, especially since he was the poison god from the Three Mortal Realms. Wen Xuan and Wen Yuan joined her, mainly because poison was useful for assassins like them.
Several other women of Zhang Fei learned assassination from Xi Yingying and Xi Hongyan. The two teenage girls, Xu Ling’er and Wu Lianzhi, chose to learn about puppetry from Lin Moxian.

As for the speed cultivation path, Zhang Fei asked Yan Leibao to help his wives with wind elements, such as Qing Yi, Zhao Ziqin, Zhou Shenxin, and several other women. Since all of them were also body cultivators, Hong Xinxin, Hong Quan, and Hong Chong were in charge of helping them.
Despite their busy lives learning new things, they also deepened their knowledge in the soul cultivation path under the guidance of Hun Di and his disciples.
As Zhang Fei had previously planned, they divided their time between training and dual cultivating, which allowed them to increase their cultivation and abilities simultaneously.

Since Feng Xueying and Feng Jinqiu lived with them in the pavilion, and they also used their Yang Qi for cultivation, Zhang Fei could approach them more easily. Even so, the two ice phoenixes still kept their distance from him, but he never gave up on approaching them.

Zhang Fei invited Yuwen Xingyuan of the Kunpeng Clan and Lei Huoting of the Qilin Clan to join them. However, they had long been aware of his intentions towards them, and they vehemently refused him. Instead, they asked him to approach the female beasts of the Mythical Deer, Golden Crow, Golden Fox, Nian, Dragon, White Tiger, and Black Tortoise Clans.

However, Zhang Fei had no interest in the female beasts of the seven beast clans, including their ancestors, such as Zhu Danqing, Nu Ying, and Fu Yin. Despite Yuwen Xingyuan and Lei Huoting’s repeated rejections, he continued to approach them with his clones while concentrating on his official harem members.

While they were busy with their activities, the leader of the Ice Phoenix Clan, Feng Bingying, arrived at the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary. After searching for Zhang Fei for two months, she finally learned from one of her subordinates that he had married Luo Yunxiao; therefore, she decided to go to the sect to find him.

Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi were quite surprised when the guard informed them of Feng Bingying’s arrival, and they were naturally able to guess the reason behind her arrival. Despite this, they still decided to meet her, especially since the ice phoenix race is one of the strongest beast races in the Paradise Realm.
After they took their seats facing each other, Luo Fenghan immediately asked her a question. "What can I do for you, Senior Bingying?"

"Sect Master Luo, I won’t mince words with you. I came here specifically to look for your son-in-law, Zhang Fei." Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi pretended to be surprised when Feng Bingying said that. "I received information that he ascended to this realm about ten months ago, and I’ve been looking for him in the last two months, especially since he brought three female ice phoenixes with him. Since they are of the same race as me, I would like to invite them to live with our race, which would be more beneficial for them than staying with him."
Huang Xiaoyi immediately answered her. "Senior Bingying, since you already know about them, you should know that they are my son-in-law’s wives, right?
"Hmm?" Feng Bingying furrowed her brows. "I heard that Zhang Yue is indeed Zhang Fei’s wife, but my information says that Feng Xueying and Feng Jinqiu are not his wives."

"Unfortunately, the information you got is wrong, Senior Bingying." Feng Bingying looked at Huang Xiaoyi in distrust. "Actually, I’ve never met Feng Xueying and Feng Jinqiu before, but my daughter has lived with them for quite a long time, and she told us that they were part of Zhang Fei’s harem now. You don’t know him like we do, and I can tell you that he would never let any of his women leave his side. Moreover, they are dual cultivators, so you should know that their cultivation will be much faster if they stay by his side."

Feng Bingying didn’t believe her explanation in the slightest, and she thought that Huang Xiaoyi was deliberately making up a story to prevent her from bringing Feng Xueying and Feng Jinqiu with her. "Can you contact Zhang Fei for me? Please tell him to bring those two women with him, and I will confirm their relationship myself."

"No," Huang Xiaoyi answered with a shake of her head. "First, I don’t know where they are now, and you can search the entire sect if you think I’m deliberately hiding them. Second, my son-in-law has decided to enter long seclusion, and he won’t come out until the portal to the Forgotten Land opens in about four years and four months."

"Hmm?" Feng Bingying instantly spread her senses throughout the entire area of the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, making Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi inwardly laugh. ’Are they really not here? Where do they do their exclusion?’

"Can you find them, Senior Bingying?" Feng Bingying shook her head at Huang Xiaoyi. "If you want to meet my son-in-law, you can only wait until the portal to the Forgotten Land opens, especially since my husband will take him there at that time."
"I see." Feng Bingying nodded in understanding. "In that case, I take my leave now, and I will wait for Zhang Fei at the Divine Samsara Sect at that time."
After Feng Bingying left, Luo Fenghan let out a soft sigh. "Fortunately, she is not stubborn; otherwise, we would have no other choice but to stop her."
"Hehe." Huang Xiaoyi chuckled. "We don’t need to interfere in their affairs, and I’m sure Zhang Fei can handle her on his own."

Luo Fenghan nodded in agreement. "Four years and four months isn’t long; I hope Zhang Fei has truly broken through to the Five Celestial Realms by then; otherwise, he’ll face a new problem if they meet."

chapters.title: Chapter 1091: Sealed World Pearl: First Area
paragraphs: Another two years passed in the training space, equivalent to half a year and a few days in the Paradise Realm. Zhang Fei’s cultivation had already broken through to the 1-Moon Divine Fusion Realm. Meanwhile, his body cultivation had already reached the first stage of the Eight Body Gates, known as the Muscle Rebirth Stage.
Zhang Fei’s soul cultivation has reached the half-perfection stage of the soul venerate level, especially since he and his five clones repeatedly dual-soul cultivated with more than a hundred women.

Apart from dual-soul cultivating with all his women, Zhang Fei often did it with Meng Qi, Meng Guanqiu, Xian Xian, Lei Ting, Tang Ying, and Jing Qiuyue in recent years. Additionally, he taught the soul cultivation path to both Feng Xueying and Feng Jinqiu, and he also engaged in dual-soul cultivation with them.

Meng Qi (Sky Jade Realm-Meng Clan), Meng Guanqiu, Xian Xian (Duan Zhao’s disciple), Lei Ting (Thunder Fairy from Nine Stars Realm), Tang Ying, Jing Qiuyue, Feng Xueying, and Feng Jinqiu were the women who had not yet become Zhang Fei’s women among those living in the pavilion.

Meng Qi and Meng Guanqiu had lived with Zhang Fei for a long time, but he had never even touched them. Back then, Feng Yao had told him that he should keep Meng Qi by his side, but he still didn’t know why she said that, especially since he had never seen anything special about her.

Xian Xian had also been living with Zhang Fei ever since he sent Duan Zhao and his other disciples to the Xianjin Realm, and they had shared kisses too many times, but she was never ready to become his wife.
Even though she lived in the pavilion, Lei Ting never had any feelings for Zhang Fei, just like Jing Qiuyue, who only loved Qiao Liangren.
Feng Xueying and Feng Jinqiu knew Zhang Fei wanted them, but they always limited the relationship between them, leaving him quite helpless to seduce them.

Since they entered seclusion more than four years ago, Zhang Fei himself never abandoned his swordsmanship, alchemy, blacksmithing, and formation array. He always used his four clones to improve his abilities in all four fields. Despite the great efforts of his four clones, he has not yet reached the God Rank in alchemy, but his blacksmithing has already reached the Saint Rank. His formation array reached level nine, and his swordsmanship was equivalent to Han Ling at the Saint Rank.

All of Zhang Fei’s wives also experienced significant improvements in their cultivation, thanks to the harem sharing. Their soul cultivation also improved significantly thanks to dual soul cultivation with him, combined with guidance from Hun Di and his disciples.

Their body cultivation continued to rise due to the guidance of Hong Xinxin, Hong Quan, and Hong Chong, which strengthened their physiques and allowed them to endure longer during each dual cultivation session with him.

Those female wind cultivators also experienced significant progress in their speed cultivation path, which was thanks to the guidance of Yan Leibao and the people from the Yan Clan. Under Jia Yuyan and Elmyra, female light cultivators succeeded in increasing their healing abilities. Several new domain masters and formation array masters also appeared among them, which was thanks to the guidance of Shangguan Yan and Duanmu Luolan.
Some of Zhang Fei’s women who were swordmasters, such as Xian Xianqin, Xian Changyue, Ye Lian, and others, reached quite high levels in the sword cultivation path due to Han Ling’s guidance.
Liu Hua, Wen Xuan, and Wen Yuan became more knowledgeable about various types of poisons and antidotes after they studied diligently under the guidance of You Shen, his family, and his disciples.

Xu Ling’er and Wu Lianzhi, now 17 and 18 years old, had also broken through to the Seven Divine Realms long ago. Since neither of them could dual-cultivate with Zhang Fei before, they focused more on their training, but they were even more enthusiastic about learning puppetry from Lin Moxian, and they succeeded in making several puppets according to his instructions.

For the past two years, Shi Xi, the white tiger beast with the metal element, not only focused on her blacksmithing, cultivation, and training, but she also learned to make artifacts from Cheng Gaoji and Gong Ren.

With the guidance of the two seniors, Shi Xi was able to create several middle-grade artifacts in recent years, but he still had a lot to learn in that field, especially since it was much more difficult than blacksmithing.

Luo Yunxiao’s progress in alchemy also accelerated significantly, and she succeeded in reaching the venerable rank in just two years, which was the fastest among Zhang Fei and the other female alchemists on their side.

Zhe Wuming and the cultivators from the upper realms also showed significant progress, especially after Zhang Fei brought them into the training space eight months ago and cultivated with Celestial Qi for over two and a half years within it.

For the past two years, Zhang Fei had sent one of his clones to Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi several times, mainly to increase the stock of items in his shop, which was becoming increasingly popular in the Empyrean Domain. As for the restaurant, Zhu Yan handled matters there, but Zhang Chen, Qing Tan, and Zhang Hanzi came out several times to help her.

Among all the people living in the training space, Zhang Chen was the most anxious. She asked Zhang Fei to forget their kiss back then, but she couldn’t forget it, and she repeatedly dreamed of it in her sleep.

Zhang Chen asked her grandson whether he used his dream technique on her or not, but Zhang Fei firmly denied it, as he never used such a thing on her. She always believed in him, and she didn’t doubt him; instead, she doubted her own feelings, and she felt that her feelings began to change because of their kiss and closeness.

Since they had been cultivating and training so hard since arriving at the Paradise Realm about a year and five months ago, which meant more than five years in the training space, Zhang Fei allowed them to relax for some time.
Despite this, most of them chose not to rest and continued their activities, and only a few of them decided to rest their bodies and minds, especially those who were still young.

Zhang Fei wanted to go to the Sealed World Pearl, but Wu Lianzhi and Xu Ling’er suddenly approached him. He smiled as he saw that the two women had grown up and become more beautiful, especially his stepdaughter.

Xu Ling’er’s adult face featured soft, youthful characteristics and fair skin. Her eyes were big, with a calm and kind expression. She has straight black bangs and long black hair, decorated with white and green ribbons like when she was little. She wore a traditional-style dress in shades of mint green and white. Her dress suited her tall and slender figure, emphasizing elegance rather than sensuality. Her breasts are modestly curved—not exaggerated.

For the past years, Xu Ling’er’s past identity, the first winged race, Tian Huangjin, appeared to see Zhang Fei several times. The older she grew and the more her cultivation increased, the more she could remember the emergence of her past identity, and she remembered their conversations in detail.
Unlike Xu Ling’er, who didn’t look much different from when she was little, Wu Lianzhi underwent a drastic change after reaching adulthood.

Wu Lianzhi’s face looked much more mature, like Shang Yingyue’s, with a small symbol on her forehead, big brown eyes, a sharp nose, and small but slightly thick, pink lips. She didn’t look as childish as in the past, and the aura radiating from her body showed her maturity.

Wu Lianzhi’s long, straight black hair flows down her back. Her hair was neatly styled, with part of it tied up and the rest left loose. She was now quite tall, like her father, Wu Xueming, and her waist was perfectly curvy, accentuated by her deep purple and white dress adorned with gold patterns. Her breasts were full and well-shaped, sticking out slightly from the back of her dress.

"Big Brother." Wu Lianzhi and Xu Ling’er called out to Zhang Fei as they hugged his arms, placing them between their breasts. Their voices were no longer those of little girls but of mature women, each quite deep. Without saying anything, he brought the two young women into the Sealed World Pearl.
"Why did you bring us here, Big Brother?" Xu Ling’er asked.

On the other hand, Wu Lianzhi hugged Zhang Fei’s arm tightly and teased him. "Did you bring me here to have fun with me, Big Brother? I’m 18 now, and we’ve been married for several years, so we can dual cultivate now."

"Hahaha." Zhang Fei laughed when he heard that, and he pecked Wu Lianzhi’s rosy lips. "Do you want to do it with me now, Lianzhi? Don’t you want to wait for Ling’er to reach maturity in another year?"

"Hehe." Wu Lianzhi giggled as she nodded. "Ling’er is my sister, and we have agreed to spend our wedding night together, so I will wait another year. So, what are we going to do here? Why don’t you bring Big Sis Yuyan and the others over?"
Zhang Fei took his two wives by the hand and led them to the first location, which was the area where the beasts lived.
Xu Ling’er and Wu Lianzhi already knew that the interior of the Sealed World Pearl was very vast, but its vastness was beyond their imagination, especially after the first area opened.

Although the area was open, the beasts couldn’t leave due to the barrier separating the two areas. Even so, the barrier did not prevent Zhang Fei and his two wives from entering the area, and they immediately saw a much wider area, filled with various types of beasts from various races.

[Master, all the beasts in this place don’t exist in the outside world.] Zhang Fei was shocked to hear this from Mei. [By the way, you’ve left the mysterious egg in the beast space for almost ten years based on the time flow inside, but it still hasn’t hatched even though you’ve used the Beast Incubation Array. Therefore, I think you should move these two to this place because it’s most suitable for beasts, and they might hatch faster.]
’Do you think I should move all the beasts to this place, Mei?’ Zhang Fei asked as he monitored the area via the map, and he found many powerful beasts in that place.

[Instead of moving them here, you can move them into your soul world, and their strength will strengthen yours without you needing to use the soul link. If you want to move some of them here, you can bring Lei Que and the others here.]

"Ling’er and Lianzhi, you two wait here for a moment, and I will go get something in the beast space." Zhang Fei went straight to the beast space, but he didn’t stay there for long and came out again carrying the mysterious egg.
"Eh?" Both Xu Ling’er and Wu Lianzhi were surprised to see the mysterious egg. "Where did you get this egg, Big Brother? Why does the shell look like the Yin-Yang diagram?"

"I got it like I got my other items before, but I don’t know what kind of beast is inside this egg." Xu Ling’er and Wu Lianzhi pouted their lips because Zhang Fei was still secretive with them. "Let’s check this area first, and I’ll find a suitable place to leave this egg."
- To Be Continued -
