chapters.title: Chapter 1092: Three Beasts
paragraphs: "Big brother, why are all the beasts here so docile and calm?" Xu Ling’er asked as she patted a small emerald-scaled pangolin beast at the foundation rank.

Zhang Fei squatted beside her and patted the beast, which was acting like a house dog. "I don’t understand why all the beasts in this place are acting like this, but this is good, right? If these beasts had their wild instincts like they do in the outside world, this place would be in chaos because of them."
"Big brother."
Zhang Fei turned to Wu Lianzhi. "Why are you calling me big brother now? Didn’t you say before that you would continue calling me Long’er?"

"Hehe." Wu Lianzhi giggled and hugged him from behind. "Back then, I wasn’t your wife yet, right? My mother said that I couldn’t keep addressing you as Long’er after we got married, so I chose to address you as a big brother like Ling’er."

Zhang Fei shook his head at that. "Actually, it’s fine if you want to call me whatever you want. By the way, you don’t have a beast contract yet, right? If you find a beast that catches your eye here, you can just tell me, and I’ll help you form a contract with it."

"I haven’t found a suitable beast yet, Big Brother." Wu Lianzhi looked around at the vast area before them. "This place is much wider than I imagined, and it’s more like a domain within a domain. Moreover, you haven’t found a suitable place to leave the egg, so we can search for that place while I look for a beast that suits my taste."
Zhang Fei immediately lifted Xu Ling’er to her feet, and the three of them continued their journey, exploring all areas of the place.

All the beasts in the middle area were just as tame as those they encountered in the outer area, which confused Zhang Fei and the two women because it seemed like the beasts lacked any wild instincts. The beast rank got higher the deeper they went, and their cultivation also got higher.

Soon, they arrived at the central area of the place, where they saw a giant old banyan tree standing tall in the middle. Xu Ling’er immediately pointed to three beasts lying leisurely under the tree. "Big brother! Look at those beasts! They are mythical-rank beasts, right?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded at her. "Sunfire Emperor Behemoth, Tusked War Elephant Tiger, and Three-Eyed Sky Tyrant are all mythical-rank beasts. Actually, I detected several other mythical-rank beasts in this place, but they are spread across several areas, as are those divine-rank beasts."
"Big brother! I want the Three-Eyed Sky Tyrant as my contract beast!" Wu Lianzhi pointed at the beast with eyes sparkling like stars.

According to data in the system, the Sunfire Emperor Behemoth was a colossal creature born from the core flames of the Sun Star. Its eyes were burning like twin blazing suns, and its mane was covered with golden flame, which was similar almost to the Golden Crow Flame. It has three flame-carved horns, and it has a fiery comet-like tail. It has a proud, majestic, and wrathful character. It will only be subject to those who have a strong will and unyielding character.

The Tusked War Elephant Tiger was a fearsome hybrid born from an ancient bloodline fusion between the Tusked Elephant and the Mountain War Tiger. It has an enormous and muscular physique, covered in thick, granite-like striped hide. It has burning amber eyes, framed by a short armored trunk and dual curved tusks. Its ivory tusks curved forward like blades, with a rugged black mane covering its body. It has an elephantine proboscis, with a sharp tip like a blade. It has a long, powerful, club-like tail.

The Three-Eyed Sky Tyrant was a sovereign of the upper skies; not even the Azure Emperor Roc could compete with it. Its body was sleek yet heavily muscled, draped in red feathers. Its eyes were sharp gold, but the third eye in the center glowed a deep violet, capable of seeing the most hidden truths. Its long and wide wings were bladed and feathered with mirrored scales; they slashed the wind like sabers. It has a long, whip-like tail with a crescent blade at the tip. Its talons were razor-sharp, capable of crushing the hardest metal with ease.
The three beasts opened their eyes as Zhang Fei and the two women approached; just like all the other beasts they had encountered before, they did not display any aggressiveness.

The Three-Eyed Sky Tyrant looked at Wu Lianzhi with its golden eyes and appeared curious about her. Meanwhile, his third eye focused on Zhang Fei, but it trembled when it discovered something from him.

Sensing the fear of the Three-Eyed Sky Tyrant, the Sunfire Emperor Behemoth and the Tusked War Elephant Tiger looked at Zhang Fei. Just like their friend, the two beasts also trembled in fear as soon as they felt the terror of his aura, which came from his identity as the Calamity Demon Dragon.

"Calm down." Zhang Fei immediately released his light element and heavenly fox aura, spreading them to cover the area. He then led the two women closer to the three beasts, but they were still afraid of him. "I am the owner of this place, and I won’t harm anyone. Therefore, you guys can calm down and don’t be so afraid of me, okay?"

The three beasts nodded to Zhang Fei, and Wu Lianzhi immediately approached the Three-Eyed Sky Tyrant, patting its head. "Don’t be afraid, okay? Big brother’s calamity demon dragon aura is indeed terrifying for beasts like the three of you, but he won’t hurt you. By the way, I want you to be my contract beast. Are you willing?"

The Three-Eyed Sky Tyrant looked surprised when it heard that, and it turned to Zhang Fei, who shook his head. "My wife wants you to be her contract beast, but I won’t force you to accept it. You can decide for yourself. However, you will gain many benefits by becoming her contract beast, and you will become stronger than you are now. Most importantly, you will have the opportunity to evolve into an immortal-rank beast in the future, so you should think carefully about it first."

When they heard that Zhang Fei could help them evolve into immortal-rank beasts, the Sunfire Emperor Behemoth and the Tusked War Elephant Tiger looked at him with pleading gazes, which made the two women giggle at their behavior.

Xu Ling’er directly spoke to Zhang Fei. "Big Brother, you already have quite a lot of contract beasts and beast wives. Meanwhile, most of our sisters don’t have a contract beast yet, so I think you can bring them here, and these two beasts can choose two of them who are worthy of being their masters."

"Yeah, you’re right." Zhang Fei first walked under the banyan tree and placed the mysterious egg and incubator there, making the three beasts curious. "You two stay here for a while, and I’ll bring them here."

After Zhang Fei disappeared, Wu Lianzhi took out some beast pills he had given her earlier, showing them to The Three-Eyed Sky Tyrant. "These pills are very beneficial for beasts, and I will give them to you if you are willing to become my contract beast. Moreover, my big brother has long been a Celestial Rank alchemist, and he has so many precious pills."
"Back off a bit." Xu Ling’er said as she pulled Wu Lianzhi back as the Three-Eyed Sky Tyrant’s body glowed.

Soon, the Three-Eyed Sky Tyrant transformed into a mature woman. She has a mature, beautiful face with fair skin. Her eyes were long and slightly sharp, giving her a confident expression. Her long red hair was tied in a high ponytail, flowing behind her like her feathers. A golden ornament sits on her forehead. Her body was tall and slim, with an athletic build. Her waist was narrow, and her curves were natural but not exaggerated. Her breasts were modestly full but not overly large. She wore a fitted battle outfit that blended flowing white and red fabric with ornate golden armor.
"Wow! Pretty!" Wu Lianzhi and Xu Ling’er exclaimed in unison. The two exchanged glances, thought the same thing in their minds, and giggled at the thought. "Hehehe."
"Are you really going to give those pills to me if I’m willing to become your beast contract?" The Three-Eyed Sky Tyrant asked in a soft but deep voice.

"Yes." Wu Lianzhi nodded to her. "My big brother concocted these pills, and many beasts on our side are already enjoying their benefits. If you are willing to become my contract beast, I will give them to you. By the way, what is your name, Big Sis?"
"Sha Huoyan."
"My name is Wu Lianzhi." Wu Lianzhi then embraced her sister. "Xu Ling’er is my sister, and we are both our big brother’s wives."
The two other beasts, the Sunfire Emperor Behemoth and the Tusked War Elephant Tiger, hastily transformed into humans as well.

The Sunfire Emperor Behemoth turned into a woman with a pale face. She has long, straight, and golden-red hair. Her eyes were burning like twin blazing suns. Her figure was tall with an hourglass shape—slim waist, wide hips, and a strong upper body. Her breasts were well-defined, naturally accentuated by the tight-fitting red and gold armor she wore. A sharp golden crown rested on her head.

On the other hand, the Tusked War Elephant Tiger transformed into a young man with a robust and tall figure. He has two sharp amber eyes. His body was covered in thick ancient armor, with two ivory tusks resting on his shoulders. He held a long iron rod with barbed tips.
"Two little girls, my name is Shou Yunzhi." The Sunfire Emperor Behemoth introduced herself.
The Tusked War Elephant Tiger also introduced himself to them. "My name is Xiang Zhan."

Xu Ling’er and Wu Lianzhi sighed inwardly, especially since the Tusked War Elephant Tiger was a male beast. Naturally, Zhang Fei wouldn’t allow any of their sisters to form a contract with Xiang Zhan, especially with his possessive nature. Therefore, they had to fight over Shou Yunzhi.
"Will you also give me these pills if I’m willing to form a contract with one of you?" Shou Yanzhi asked.
Xu Ling’er shook her head. "Big Sister, I already have Hu Er as my contract beast, so I won’t form a contract with you."
"I only want Big Sis Sha Huoyan as my contract beast." Wu Lianzhi pulled the female beast to her side.
Shou Yanzhi looked disappointed when he heard that, but he and Xiang Zhan suddenly saw Zhang Fei moving quickly towards them, followed by dozens of women behind him.
Soon, they arrived at the place, but Zhang Fei sighed a little because Xiang Zhan was a male beast, causing all his wives to laugh as they understood his thoughts.
Xian Xianqin immediately spoke to him. "Husband, it’s okay if one of us forms a contract with this male beast, right? You know we wouldn’t cheat on you, so you don’t need to think too much about it."

"She’s right, husband," Luo Yunxiao spoke as she looked at Xiang Zhan. "Even if he becomes a contract beast for one of us, he will never live with us, and he will stay in your beast space. As Sister Xianqin said just now, we will never betray you, so you don’t need to worry about it."
Zhou Shenxin and the others also spoke to Zhang Fei, persuading him to let Xiang Zhan make a contract with one of them.

Zhang Fei let out a soft sigh and nodded to them. "Lianzhi has already chosen the Three-Eyed Sky Tyrant, so only the Sunfire Emperor Behemoth and the Tusked War Elephant Tiger are left now. Since there are so many of you, I’ll let them choose two of you, and I’ll look for other contract beasts for the rest in the future. Moreover, there are still so many other beasts here, and you can choose the one that suits your taste."

Zhang Fei immediately lifted Xu Ling’er to her feet, and the three of them continued their journey, exploring all areas of the place.

All the beasts in the middle area were just as tame as those they encountered in the outer area, which confused Zhang Fei and the two women because it seemed like the beasts lacked any wild instincts.
The beast rank got higher the deeper they went, and their cultivation also got higher.
Soon, they arrived at the central area of the place, where they saw a giant old banyan tree standing tall in the middle.
Xu Ling’er immediately pointed to three beasts lying leisurely under the tree.
"Big brother!
Look at those beasts!
They are mythical-rank beasts, right?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded at her.
"Sunfire Emperor Behemoth, Tusked War Elephant Tiger, and Three-Eyed Sky Tyrant are all mythical-rank beasts.
Actually, I detected several other mythical-rank beasts in this place, but they are spread across several areas, as are those divine-rank beasts."
"Big brother!
I want the Three-Eyed Sky Tyrant as my contract beast!" Wu Lianzhi pointed at the beast with eyes sparkling like stars.
According to data in the system, the Sunfire Emperor Behemoth was a colossal creature born from the core flames of the Sun Star.
Its eyes were burning like twin blazing suns, and its mane was covered with golden flame, which was similar almost to the Golden Crow Flame.
It has three flame-carved horns, and it has a fiery comet-like tail.
It has a proud, majestic, and wrathful character.
It will only be subject to those who have a strong will and unyielding character.
The Tusked War Elephant Tiger was a fearsome hybrid born from an ancient bloodline fusion between the Tusked Elephant and the Mountain War Tiger.
It has an enormous and muscular physique, covered in thick, granite-like striped hide.
It has burning amber eyes, framed by a short armored trunk and dual curved tusks.
Its ivory tusks curved forward like blades, with a rugged black mane covering its body.
It has an elephantine proboscis, with a sharp tip like a blade.
It has a long, powerful, club-like tail.
The Three-Eyed Sky Tyrant was a sovereign of the upper skies; not even the Azure Emperor Roc could compete with it.
Its body was sleek yet heavily muscled, draped in red feathers.
Its eyes were sharp gold, but the third eye in the center glowed a deep violet, capable of seeing the most hidden truths.
Its long and wide wings were bladed and feathered with mirrored scales; they slashed the wind like sabers.
It has a long, whip-like tail with a crescent blade at the tip.
Its talons were razor-sharp, capable of crushing the hardest metal with ease.
The three beasts opened their eyes as Zhang Fei and the two women approached; just like all the other beasts they had encountered before, they did not display any aggressiveness.
The Three-Eyed Sky Tyrant looked at Wu Lianzhi with its golden eyes and appeared curious about her.
Meanwhile, his third eye focused on Zhang Fei, but it trembled when it discovered something from him.
Sensing the fear of the Three-Eyed Sky Tyrant, the Sunfire Emperor Behemoth and the Tusked War Elephant Tiger looked at Zhang Fei.
Just like their friend, the two beasts also trembled in fear as soon as they felt the terror of his aura, which came from his identity as the Calamity Demon Dragon.
"Calm down." Zhang Fei immediately released his light element and heavenly fox aura, spreading them to cover the area.
He then led the two women closer to the three beasts, but they were still afraid of him.
"I am the owner of this place, and I won’t harm anyone.
Therefore, you guys can calm down and don’t be so afraid of me, okay?"
The three beasts nodded to Zhang Fei, and Wu Lianzhi immediately approached the Three-Eyed Sky Tyrant, patting its head.
"Don’t be afraid, okay?
Big brother’s calamity demon dragon aura is indeed terrifying for beasts like the three of you, but he won’t hurt you.
By the way, I want you to be my contract beast.
Are you willing?"
The Three-Eyed Sky Tyrant looked surprised when it heard that, and it turned to Zhang Fei, who shook his head.
"My wife wants you to be her contract beast, but I won’t force you to accept it.
You can decide for yourself.
However, you will gain many benefits by becoming her contract beast, and you will become stronger than you are now.
Most importantly, you will have the opportunity to evolve into an immortal-rank beast in the future, so you should think carefully about it first."

When they heard that Zhang Fei could help them evolve into immortal-rank beasts, the Sunfire Emperor Behemoth and the Tusked War Elephant Tiger looked at him with pleading gazes, which made the two women giggle at their behavior.
Xu Ling’er directly spoke to Zhang Fei.
"Big Brother, you already have quite a lot of contract beasts and beast wives.
Meanwhile, most of our sisters don’t have a contract beast yet, so I think you can bring them here, and these two beasts can choose two of them who are worthy of being their masters."
"Yeah, you’re right." Zhang Fei first walked under the banyan tree and placed the mysterious egg and incubator there, making the three beasts curious.
"You two stay here for a while, and I’ll bring them here."
After Zhang Fei disappeared, Wu Lianzhi took out some beast pills he had given her earlier, showing them to The Three-Eyed Sky Tyrant.
"These pills are very beneficial for beasts, and I will give them to you if you are willing to become my contract beast.
Moreover, my big brother has long been a Celestial Rank alchemist, and he has so many precious pills."
"Back off a bit." Xu Ling’er said as she pulled Wu Lianzhi back as the Three-Eyed Sky Tyrant’s body glowed.
Soon, the Three-Eyed Sky Tyrant transformed into a mature woman.
She has a mature, beautiful face with fair skin.
Her eyes were long and slightly sharp, giving her a confident expression.
Her long red hair was tied in a high ponytail, flowing behind her like her feathers.
A golden ornament sits on her forehead.
Her body was tall and slim, with an athletic build.
Her waist was narrow, and her curves were natural but not exaggerated.
Her breasts were modestly full but not overly large.
She wore a fitted battle outfit that blended flowing white and red fabric with ornate golden armor.
"Wow!
Pretty!" Wu Lianzhi and Xu Ling’er exclaimed in unison.
The two exchanged glances, thought the same thing in their minds, and giggled at the thought.
"Hehehe."
"Are you really going to give those pills to me if I’m willing to become your beast contract?" The Three-Eyed Sky Tyrant asked in a soft but deep voice.
"Yes." Wu Lianzhi nodded to her.
"My big brother concocted these pills, and many beasts on our side are already enjoying their benefits.
If you are willing to become my contract beast, I will give them to you.
By the way, what is your name, Big Sis?"
"Sha Huoyan."
"My name is Wu Lianzhi." Wu Lianzhi then embraced her sister.
"Xu Ling’er is my sister, and we are both our big brother’s wives."
The two other beasts, the Sunfire Emperor Behemoth and the Tusked War Elephant Tiger, hastily transformed into humans as well.
The Sunfire Emperor Behemoth turned into a woman with a pale face.
She has long, straight, and golden-red hair.
Her eyes were burning like twin blazing suns.
Her figure was tall with an hourglass shape—slim waist, wide hips, and a strong upper body.
Her breasts were well-defined, naturally accentuated by the tight-fitting red and gold armor she wore.
A sharp golden crown rested on her head.
On the other hand, the Tusked War Elephant Tiger transformed into a young man with a robust and tall figure.
He has two sharp amber eyes.
His body was covered in thick ancient armor, with two ivory tusks resting on his shoulders.
He held a long iron rod with barbed tips.
"Two little girls, my name is Shou Yunzhi." The Sunfire Emperor Behemoth introduced herself.
The Tusked War Elephant Tiger also introduced himself to them.
"My name is Xiang Zhan."
Xu Ling’er and Wu Lianzhi sighed inwardly, especially since the Tusked War Elephant Tiger was a male beast.
Naturally, Zhang Fei wouldn’t allow any of their sisters to form a contract with Xiang Zhan, especially with his possessive nature.
Therefore, they had to fight over Shou Yunzhi.
"Will you also give me these pills if I’m willing to form a contract with one of you?" Shou Yanzhi asked.
Xu Ling’er shook her head.
"Big Sister, I already have Hu Er as my contract beast, so I won’t form a contract with you."
"I only want Big Sis Sha Huoyan as my contract beast." Wu Lianzhi pulled the female beast to her side.
Shou Yanzhi looked disappointed when he heard that, but he and Xiang Zhan suddenly saw Zhang Fei moving quickly towards them, followed by dozens of women behind him.
Soon, they arrived at the place, but Zhang Fei sighed a little because Xiang Zhan was a male beast, causing all his wives to laugh as they understood his thoughts.
Xian Xianqin immediately spoke to him.
"Husband, it’s okay if one of us forms a contract with this male beast, right?
You know we wouldn’t cheat on you, so you don’t need to think too much about it."
"She’s right, husband," Luo Yunxiao spoke as she looked at Xiang Zhan.
"Even if he becomes a contract beast for one of us, he will never live with us, and he will stay in your beast space.
As Sister Xianqin said just now, we will never betray you, so you don’t need to worry about it."
Zhou Shenxin and the others also spoke to Zhang Fei, persuading him to let Xiang Zhan make a contract with one of them.
Zhang Fei let out a soft sigh and nodded to them.
"Lianzhi has already chosen the Three-Eyed Sky Tyrant, so only the Sunfire Emperor Behemoth and the Tusked War Elephant Tiger are left now.
Since there are so many of you, I’ll let them choose two of you, and I’ll look for other contract beasts for the rest in the future.
Moreover, there are still so many other beasts here, and you can choose the one that suits your taste."

chapters.title: Chapter 1093: Three Beasts Choices
paragraphs: "Can I choose her?" Xiang Zhan pointed to one of the women.
"Eh?" Tang Ziyu pointed her index finger at her face. "Do you really want to form a contract with me?"

Xiang Zhan nodded at her. "There are only three of you who possess the earth element, but yours is stronger than the other two. In fact, it’s as strong as mine; therefore, I want to form a contract with you."
Helian Yueyi and Lian Xing immediately pushed Tang Ziyu forward. "Go on, make a contract with him."
"Thank you." Tang Ziyu immediately walked in front of Xiang Zhan, and Zhang Fei helped them form a contract between them.
In a few minutes, an elephant-tiger mark appeared on Tang Ziyu’s forehead, and another mark appeared on Xiang Zhan’s forehead, indicating that the contract between them was successful.
Xiang Zhan immediately knelt on one knee in front of Tang Ziyu. "Master."
"Please get up and don’t do this again in the future." Tang Ziyu awkwardly spoke.

"Yes, Master." After standing, Xiang Zhan immediately touched Tang Ziyu’s forehead and shared two techniques with her. "Master, you can use the Beast King’s Scripture to use combined techniques with me, and you must learn the Immovable Flesh Scripture to increase your physical strength."
Tang Ziyu nodded to him. "Thank you, I will learn both as soon as possible."

"Master, you can’t learn both without my bloodline, so I will give my bloodline to you first." After he said that, a blood clot appeared on Xiang Zhan’s finger, and he shot it into Tang Ziyu’s body. "Please sit down, and I will help you to merge with my bloodline."
"Alright." After Tang Ziyu sat down, Xiang Zhan immediately stood behind her and touched her shoulder.

Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows slightly when he saw that, but he allowed Xiang Zhan to help Tang Ziyu. He then helped Wu Lianzhi to make a contract with Sha Huoyan, and the female beast imparted two techniques to her after the contract between them was established. "Master, you can use my third eye after you learn the Heaven-Seizing Manual, and you can use the Tyrant Body Refinement Scripture to strengthen your physique."
"Can I share the Tyrant Body Refinement Scripture with my brother and the others?" Wu Lianzhi asked.
Sha Huoyan nodded at her. "Unlike Xiang Zhan’s body technique, my body cultivation technique can be learned by anyone, so you can share it with them if you like, master."
"Ha ha." Wu Lianzhi softly laughed, and she immediately shared the technique with Zhang Fei and everyone present there.
[Ding]
[The host obtained the Tyrant Body Refinement Scripture. Grade: Divine.]

"Oh? A divine-grade body cultivation technique, huh?" Even though he had learned five body techniques, Zhang Fei was still interested in them. "The heavens bend to the strong. The tyrant does not ask for permission."
[The Tyrant Body Refinement Scripture has six stages.]
[1. Bone of the Tyrant: Refines the bones under pressure equal to a falling mountain, mimicking the skeletal density of tyrant beasts.]
[2. Blood of the Tyrant: The blood thickens into pure essence, flowing with violent qi that devours impurities.]
[3. Flesh of the Tyrant: Rebuild the flesh with Qi and soul power, gaining resistance to blades, flames, and lightning.]
[4. Spine of the Tyrant: The spine channels all qi like a dragon vein, anchoring strength and focus across the body.]
[5. Eye of the Tyrant: A phantom third eye awakens on the cultivator’s brow, granting battle foresight.]
[6. Heaven-Walking Tyrant: Each step radiates dominance, crushing weaker wills and warping natural law around the body.]
"Your body technique demonstrates your dominance, Sha Huoyan." Hong Xinxin and the others nodded in agreement with Zhang Fei, feeling that the body cultivation technique lived up to its tyrant name.
Sha Huoyan smiled when she heard that. "I didn’t expect you to have a female Azure Emperor Roc by your side, Master."

"Hong Xinxin used to be an ordinary human, but she was lucky to meet the dead Azure Emperor Roc. Since the beast was dead, I used the beast’s bloodline and physique to transform her into it." Sha Huoyan was shocked to hear that from Zhang Fei, especially since turning humans into beasts should be impossible. "Additionally, she also inherited the beast’s soul and past strength, which significantly increased her cultivation. So, how can we train your technique?"

"Master, you must use the greatest pressure and train in the most extreme place to learn it." Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows at Sha Huoyan, especially since there was no such place inside the Sealed World Pearl. "Master, we are not actually native to this world, and someone sent us into this place in the past, mainly because our race was nearly extinct."
"Oh?" Sha Huoyan’s explanation shocked Zhang Fei and the others. "Do you know the identity of the person who sent you all into this world? How long have you all been here?"
Sha Huoyan shook her head in response. "We don’t know that person’s identity, and we don’t remember how long we’ve been here."
"Master, we don’t remember that, but I think we’ve been here for hundreds of thousands of years or more." Shou Yunzhi spoke to Zhang Fei.

Zhang Fei nodded slightly as he read the status of the three beasts that had just appeared before him. All three were much older than Huli Zhishen and the others, and their cultivation had also reached the Five Celestial Realms, with Xiang Zhan being the strongest among them, having already reached the 1-Sun Celestial Emperor Realm. Meanwhile, Sha Huoyan’s cultivation was at the 2-Sun Celestial King Realm, and Shou Yunzhi’s cultivation was at the 1-Sun Celestial King.

Zhang Fei was truly curious about the identity of the person who sent them there, especially since the Sealed World Pearl was one of the Seven Profound Treasures. Although it was ranked at the bottom, it was no ordinary item, especially with the many benefits it offered.

"Master, I choose her as my master." Zhang Fei turned to Xian Xianqin, whom Shou Yunzhi had pointed out. "I know she possesses the wind element, and her wind element is quite strong, which will complement my sunfire."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "Since Shou Yunzhi has chosen you, I will help you form a contract with her now, Qin’er."
"Yes." After Xian Xianqin stood in front of Shou Yunzhi, Zhang Fei immediately helped them make a contract, which was completed in just a matter of minutes.

Shou Yunzhi then gave two techniques to Xian Xianqin and asked her to sit down. "Master, I will give my bloodline to you, and once it merges with your body, you can learn my Sunfire Body Scripture and Sunfire Emperor Scripture."
"Does this mean I will get the fire element through your bloodline?" Xian Xianqin asked in confusion, especially since he knew that he could only get the fire element through the fire elemental seed.
"Oh! I forgot about that." Shou Yunzhi immediately took out a red seed that emitted incredible heat.
"A peak-grade fire elemental seed." Zhang Fei and the others muttered.

Shou Yunzhi nodded and handed the seed to Xian Xianzhi. "The mysterious person who sent us here gave this seed to me, and that person asked me to give it to the person I chose as my master. Once you get the fire element, I will give you my bloodline. Therefore, you can swallow it now, Master."

"Alright." Since she knew that Zhang Fei managed to obtain some of the elements thanks to the elemental seeds, Xian Xianqin unhesitatingly swallowed the fire elemental seed, which made her body slowly become hot due to the heat generated by the seed.

"I will send you all back to the pavilion, and I will wait for them here." After they agreed, Zhang Fei sent them out of the Sealed World Pearl, except for Wu Lianzhi, Xu Ling’er, and Sha Huoyan. He then used his soul power to accelerate the flow of time there, especially since the process of merging bloodlines and acquiring a new element takes a long time. "This way, the process will be completed more quickly, and we can continue with our exclusion."
Zhang Fei then distributed his basic pills and beast pills to Shou Yunzhi, Xiang Zhan, and Sha Huoyan, who were delighted to receive them.

Sha Huoyan was the first to start swallowing them, and Shou Yunzhi followed suit, especially since Xian Xianqin still needed some time to acquire the fire element. As for Xiang Zhan, he was forced to delay swallowing them, especially since he was helping Tang Ziyu merge with his bloodline.

Wu Lianzhi walked beside Zhang Fei, hugged his arm, and asked him a question. "Are you interested in Big Sis Huoyan, Big Brother? She is strong and no less beautiful than my sisters, even though she hasn’t swallowed your two beauty pills."
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed and rubbed her head. "Would you believe me if I thought about stopping adding more women to my harem?

"Humph! We don’t believe you!" Wu Lianzhi and Xu Ling’er retorted at the same time. "You are the most perverted man in the universe! We will never believe that you will stop adding new women to your harem."

Zhang Fei smiled wryly in response. "Honestly, I have really thought about that because I have a huge number of women now, and I want to focus on those who have been with us for a long time, such as Feng Xueying, Feng Jinqiu, Xian Xian, and several others."

"Big Sis Huoyan is my beast contract now, which means she is already part of our family. Therefore, you must accept her as your woman, which will help you evolve into a nine-tails faster." Wu Lianzhi then pointed at Shou Yunzhi. "She too."

"Let’s see later." Thereafter, Zhang Fei left the group behind and went to explore other areas, where he discovered many different beast races. Although none of them had reached the mythical rank, he saw several beasts suitable for some of his wives, and he thought about taking them out of that place.
Sometime later, Xian Xianqin obtained the fire element, and Shou Yunzhi, who had also finished swallowing the pills, immediately gave her bloodline to the Xian Princess.
Shou Yunzhi sat behind Xian Xianqin with his hands on her back, and he helped the Xian Princess merge with her bloodline.
Xiang Zhan’s bloodline had completely merged with Tang Ziyu’s body, and the male beast taught her to practice the two techniques he had previously imparted to her.
Zhang Fei himself had returned to the area and asked Sha Huoyan to spar with him. He also urged her to use her full strength.

Sha Huoyan was initially hesitant because Zhang Fei’s cultivation was far below hers, but she ultimately complied due to his insistence. As a result, the female beast suppressed and overwhelmed him, just like what he experienced when he sparred with Luo Yunxiao years ago.

Without the soul link and his enhancement techniques, Zhang Fei could barely move under Sha Huoyan’s pressure and attacks. Even though his speed surpassed hers, she kept him pressed, leaving his body covered in bruises and wounds.

Zhang Fei and Sha Huoyan stopped their spar after Shou Yunzhi finished helping Xian Xianqin to merge with her Sunfire Emperor Behemoth bloodline, but his condition made the Xian Princess sigh helplessly.

Thereafter, Zhang Fei sent Xiang Zhan to the beast space, and he took his three wives and two female beasts back to the pavilion, which amazed Shao Yunzhi and Sha Huoyan. Seeing his condition, Liu Qingyu and the others immediately helped him heal his wounds.

paragraphs: After he had fun with Zhu Shanniang, Zhang Fei went straight to the training ground and used the environment control feature to create the harshest environment, especially since he wanted to master the Tyrant Body Refinement Scripture as soon as possible.

Meanwhile, Zhang Xiaolong [3] decided to take his two wives, Xie Jingxian and Ba Shuxiang, out of the Life Pond. He then took them to meet Ren Shuo and the others, informing them that he would bring his two wives back to his training space.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not take Ren Shuo and the others back there; instead, he asked them to focus on helping Qian Chaoying and the others. Although the elf race became his family after marrying Qian Shuang, he did not want to bring them to the training space because he believed their souls were not truly good and that Jin Zhongli’s training was currently sufficient for them.

Thereafter, Zhang Xiaolong [3] brought his two wives to meet Serpentera and Tian Kui, who were satisfied after they sensed that his cultivation had already reached the 1-Moon Divine Fusion Realm. Even so, it still wasn’t enough for him, and he still had to catch up to the Five Celestial Realms.

"Before that incident, your cultivation was still at the Divine Expansion Realm, and you’ve already reached the Divine Fusion Realm, which means you’ve broken through two major stages directly," Tian Kui spoke, nodding his head a few times.

However, Zhang Xiaolong [3] showed no satisfaction at all. "My cultivation could actually be even faster, but I deliberately held back to help all my wives, and all of them have reached the Seven Divine Realms, except for these two women by my side. Additionally, the last incident made me feel so weak, so I didn’t focus too much on my cultivation, and I was more concerned with honing and developing my fighting skills."

"I think that’s a good choice, kid." Serpentera spoke. "High cultivation is useless if your fighting skills are mediocre; you have to balance the two and develop them at the same time. I know your training space has many advantages that can help you improve, but I think you should improve yourself by facing other living beings. Since you live in the Empyrean Main Domain, you can try going to the Moon Illusion Domain."
"The Moon Illusion Domain?"

"The Moon Illusion domain, where moonlight weaves illusions. Reality becomes illusions, but illusions are also reality." Zhang Xiaolong [3] raised an eyebrow slightly after Serpentera said that. "Even though the situation in that domain is quite terrifying, many cultivators in the Paradise Realm test their abilities there, especially to increase the sharpness of their instincts and senses. Many of them managed to return, but many of them ended up dying there."
"So, you mean there is no boundary between illusion and reality in that domain?"

"Yes." Serpentera then explained. "That domain is illuminated by a silver moon that hangs unnaturally large in the sky, casting shimmering reflections across the domain, creating many powerful illusions. Once you set foot in that domain, you will find it difficult to distinguish between reality and illusion, as the illusion you will encounter there could be either an illusion or a reality’. Even if it really is an illusion, it is much stronger than the ones you have encountered so far, so you must exercise caution while you are there."

Although Zhang Xiaolong [3] had long ago mimicked the Illusion Negation ability from the Black Amaris, he did not dare to underestimate Serpentera’s warning, especially after experiencing the horror of cultivators in the Paradise Realm. "Old Snake and Old Kui, I will take them away now, and I will pick you two up after I come out of my seclusion."
"What about the three old men, Kid?" Tian Kui asked him.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked towards the location of the Tian, Shi, and Huang Clans before answering him. "They are strong, but they are no longer my match even if I don’t use my ability to borrow the strength of other beasts. Therefore, I no longer want to think about them, and I will focus myself completely on facing the situation in the Paradise Realm, so you can do whatever you want with them."

After he said that, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately took Ba Shuxiang and Xie Jingxian to the training space, especially since the progress of the two of them was more than four years behind his other woman.
"Should we do something about those three old men, Old Snake?"

Serpentera nodded to Tian Kui. "Back then, I didn’t want to make a move on them and waited for that kid’s decision. Since he’s already made up his mind about them, we’ll make a move now, and I’ll erase most of their memories, especially their memories of him."
"Let’s do it then."
As soon as they arrived at the pavilion, Zhang Xiaolong [3] went straight to the alchemy room to meet Luo Yunxiao, who was there with Zhang Lingxue and the others.
"Oh? Why did you bring this third clone of yours back here? Aren’t you going to continue cultivating in the Life Pond?" Luo Yunxiao asked him.

"I think I’m wasting too much time cultivating there, so I brought this clone back. I’m going to find another place to improve my water element, elemental law, and body technique." Zhang Xiaolong then asked her. "What do you know about the Moon Illusion Domain, Yunxiao?"
Luo Yunxiao immediately pointed out it to Zhang Xiaolong [3], but her explanation wasn’t much different from Serpentera’s earlier. "Are you thinking of going to that domain?"
"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at her. "I want to go to that domain, but not now, and I will go there after my cultivation reaches the Five Celestial Realms."

"Hehe." Luo Yunxiao giggled. "I’ve also wanted to go to that domain for a long time, but my parents never allowed me to go there. However, my situation has changed now that I’m your wife, and I’ll accompany you to that domain in the future."

Zhang Lingxue immediately spoke to him. "Fei, I’ll also go with you to that domain. Ever since we left the Sky Jade Realm, I’ve concentrated on my cultivation and training, rarely engaging in actual combat with real opponents. The only opponents I’ve faced are those creatures in the Star Tower, which makes me feel that my fighting ability is too dull, so I want to hone it again."

"Big Sis Lingxue is right, Fei." Chu Ying joined in. "It’s true that we can train with Senior Hun Di and the others, but that’s different from fighting real enemies. Thus, I also want to go to that domain to improve myself, and I’m sure the other sisters also have the same thoughts as us."
"I’m in!" Chu Qing and Ning Zhuan’er raised their hands.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded to them. "The entrance to the Forgotten Land will open in three years and ten months, but I won’t be going there using my real body; instead, my real body will bring all of you to the Moon Illusion Domain. However, you guys must work hard to raise your cultivation as high as possible first, so you all won’t experience any big problems there."
"Alright, we will work hard in our cultivation." Thereafter, Zhang Lingxue and the others continued their alchemy.
On the other hand, Zhang Xiaolong [3] joined his two wives, Ba Shuxiang and Xie Jingxian, in their room, where he dual cultivated and dual-soul cultivated with them.
After that day, Zhang Fei and everyone else ignored the affairs of the outside world and focused entirely on their training and cultivation inside the training room.
After a long time, Tian Baitian finally completed his dao test and opened his eyes, but he seemed confused by his surroundings.
*Tap... Tap...*
Tian Baitian immediately looked at his sister, who had just walked in. "Where are we now? Why can’t I sense your cultivation?"

"Brother, we’re in the Illusion Spirit Fox Domain, one of the domains in the Paradise Realm." Tian Baitian was utterly shocked after Tian Baixing mentioned this, prompting her to explain the situation to him. "I still can’t believe that fox is one of our ancestor’s souls. He taught me to transform my Divine Qi into the Celestial Qi, and my cultivation has broken through to the 2-Sun Celestial Lord in the past six and a half months."
Tian Baitian then asked her. "Where is our ancestor now?"
"I don’t know." Tian Baixing shook her head in reply. "Our ancestor never showed up again after he brought us here, and I’ve tried looking for him everywhere, but I couldn’t find him."

"That kid arrived in this realm much longer than we did, but our ancestor didn’t tell me his location." Tian Baixing then informed his brother about their ancestor’s past actions regarding Zhang Xiaolong [3], but Tian Baitian became furious when she revealed that their ancestor had chosen him as his successor. "Why? Why did our ancestor choose that little bastard over us, who are his direct descendants?"

"I’ve asked our ancestor about the matter, but he said he didn’t choose that kid. Instead, he said that a hidden power, which surpassed him, was responsible for choosing that kid, and he merely followed its decision. However, he didn’t explain the hidden power to me in detail, especially since he himself didn’t understand it. According to him, our cultivation, this universe, the laws, the Dao, the Heavens, and many others are all part of that hidden power." Tian Baitian frowned in response, as he did not understand what their ancestor meant. Tian Baixing then spoke to him again. "Alright, you don’t have to think about him, and I will teach you the method to transform your Divine Qi into the Celestial Qi; thus, you can continue your cultivation to break through to the Five Celestial Realms."
Tian Baitian nodded slightly. "Teach me now! Once my cultivation breaks through to the Five Celestial Realms, I’ll find that little bastard and kill him instantly."

"Sigh." Tian Baixing let out a soft sigh. "Brother, you can forget about that, especially since we can’t leave this domain without our ancestor’s permission. There are many fox races here, including the Ancient Spirit Fox Race. I’ve gotten to know quite a few of them, and they told me that this domain has been sealed for a long time. They said that it had something to do with events in the past, and they have never been able to leave this place since then."
"Hmm?" Tian Baitian frowned again. "If that’s true, how could our ancestor bring us into this domain?"
Tain Baixing shook her head slightly and touched Tian Baitian’s forehead, imparting the method to him. "Learn it first, and I will guide you once you understand everything."
"Yeah."

With their busy schedules, time passed quickly for them, and a year has passed in the training space (Around three months outside). The following year, Tang Ying had reached the Five Celestial Realms. She wanted to leave the training space and explore the paradise realm, but Zhang Fei asked her to stay because he still needed her help to increase his soul cultivation level.

Tang Ying eventually decided to stay, especially after Hun Di and the others persuaded her. Although her cultivation had reached the One-Sun Celestial Lord realm, they believed she couldn’t possibly explore the Paradise Realm alone, and they asked her to wait for them to reach that realm first.
During the past year, Xu Ling’er turned 18 years old and Wu Lianzhi turned 19 years old; therefore, Zhang Fei decided to take them as his harem members.

Although he initially had no interest in Sha Huoyan and Shao Yunzhi, Zhang Fei eventually became intimate with both female beasts. They joined him when he dual cultivated with Xu Ling’er and Wu Lianzhi, but he didn’t actually dual cultivate with both female beasts, mainly because of their high cultivation.

Sha Huoyan and Shao Yunzhi themselves are mythical beasts, just like Feng Yichen and the others, making their number of beast essences as large as theirs, which is very useful for Zhang Fei, especially since his beast form still requires numerous beast essences to evolve to nine tails.
- To Be Continued -
(A/N: I decided to speed up their seclusion, and they will start their true journey in the Paradise Realm soon.)

"The entrance to the Forgotten Land will open in three years and ten months, but I won’t be going there using my real body; instead, my real body will bring all of you to the Moon Illusion Domain.
However, you guys must work hard to raise your cultivation as high as possible first, so you all won’t experience any big problems there."
"Alright, we will work hard in our cultivation." Thereafter, Zhang Lingxue and the others continued their alchemy.
On the other hand, Zhang Xiaolong [3] joined his two wives, Ba Shuxiang and Xie Jingxian, in their room, where he dual cultivated and dual-soul cultivated with them.
After that day, Zhang Fei and everyone else ignored the affairs of the outside world and focused entirely on their training and cultivation inside the training room.
After a long time, Tian Baitian finally completed his dao test and opened his eyes, but he seemed confused by his surroundings.
*Tap...
Tap...*
Tian Baitian immediately looked at his sister, who had just walked in.
"Where are we now?
Why can’t I sense your cultivation?"

"Brother, we’re in the Illusion Spirit Fox Domain, one of the domains in the Paradise Realm." Tian Baitian was utterly shocked after Tian Baixing mentioned this, prompting her to explain the situation to him.
"I still can’t believe that fox is one of our ancestor’s souls.
He taught me to transform my Divine Qi into the Celestial Qi, and my cultivation has broken through to the 2-Sun Celestial Lord in the past six and a half months."
Tian Baitian then asked her.
"Where is our ancestor now?"
"I don’t know." Tian Baixing shook her head in reply.
"Our ancestor never showed up again after he brought us here, and I’ve tried looking for him everywhere, but I couldn’t find him."

"That kid arrived in this realm much longer than we did, but our ancestor didn’t tell me his location." Tian Baixing then informed his brother about their ancestor’s past actions regarding Zhang Xiaolong [3], but Tian Baitian became furious when she revealed that their ancestor had chosen him as his successor.
"Why?
Why did our ancestor choose that little bastard over us, who are his direct descendants?"
"I’ve asked our ancestor about the matter, but he said he didn’t choose that kid.
Instead, he said that a hidden power, which surpassed him, was responsible for choosing that kid, and he merely followed its decision.
However, he didn’t explain the hidden power to me in detail, especially since he himself didn’t understand it.

According to him, our cultivation, this universe, the laws, the Dao, the Heavens, and many others are all part of that hidden power." Tian Baitian frowned in response, as he did not understand what their ancestor meant.
Tian Baixing then spoke to him again.

"Alright, you don’t have to think about him, and I will teach you the method to transform your Divine Qi into the Celestial Qi; thus, you can continue your cultivation to break through to the Five Celestial Realms."
Tian Baitian nodded slightly.
"Teach me now!
Once my cultivation breaks through to the Five Celestial Realms, I’ll find that little bastard and kill him instantly."
"Sigh." Tian Baixing let out a soft sigh.
"Brother, you can forget about that, especially since we can’t leave this domain without our ancestor’s permission.
There are many fox races here, including the Ancient Spirit Fox Race.
I’ve gotten to know quite a few of them, and they told me that this domain has been sealed for a long time.
They said that it had something to do with events in the past, and they have never been able to leave this place since then."
"Hmm?" Tian Baitian frowned again.
"If that’s true, how could our ancestor bring us into this domain?"
Tain Baixing shook her head slightly and touched Tian Baitian’s forehead, imparting the method to him.
"Learn it first, and I will guide you once you understand everything."
"Yeah."
With their busy schedules, time passed quickly for them, and a year has passed in the training space (Around three months outside).
The following year, Tang Ying had reached the Five Celestial Realms.
She wanted to leave the training space and explore the paradise realm, but Zhang Fei asked her to stay because he still needed her help to increase his soul cultivation level.
Tang Ying eventually decided to stay, especially after Hun Di and the others persuaded her.

Although her cultivation had reached the One-Sun Celestial Lord realm, they believed she couldn’t possibly explore the Paradise Realm alone, and they asked her to wait for them to reach that realm first.
During the past year, Xu Ling’er turned 18 years old and Wu Lianzhi turned 19 years old; therefore, Zhang Fei decided to take them as his harem members.
Although he initially had no interest in Sha Huoyan and Shao Yunzhi, Zhang Fei eventually became intimate with both female beasts.
They joined him when he dual cultivated with Xu Ling’er and Wu Lianzhi, but he didn’t actually dual cultivate with both female beasts, mainly because of their high cultivation.

Sha Huoyan and Shao Yunzhi themselves are mythical beasts, just like Feng Yichen and the others, making their number of beast essences as large as theirs, which is very useful for Zhang Fei, especially since his beast form still requires numerous beast essences to evolve to nine tails.
- To Be Continued -
(A/N: I decided to speed up their seclusion, and they will start their true journey in the Paradise Realm soon.)

chapters.title: Chapter 1097: End Of Seclusion (5Years/20Years-End)
paragraphs: Unlike in previous years, Zhang Fei didn’t use the harem sharing to help all his wives. Instead, his full focus was on reaching the Divine Ascension Realm first, and he would assist them once they reached that stage. He also used all the Qi in the Yin-Yang Space for himself, which was quite a lot because all his prisoners had converted their Qi into the Celestial Qi, allowing his cultivation to break through a few minor stages in the past year.

Even so, Zhang Fei didn’t spend all his time dual cultivating or dual-soul cultivating with them. He and his clones divided their time to practice other things, as well as studying the books that he obtained from Tian Kongquan’s tomb. Most of his elements have reached the peak rank, except for his water and wood elements. His mastery in several of the elemental laws has also reached the perfection stage, except for his water and wood elemental laws.

In the past year, Zhang Fei had already reached the second stage of the Tyrant Body Refinement Scripture, the Blood of the Tyrant. His Indestructible Vajra Immortal Body reached the third stage, the Golden Blood Stage. However, his Ocean Flesh Scripture is still stuck at the intermediate stage.

Zhang Fei’s relationship with Zhang Chen slowly moved in a different direction, and they often shared intimate moments together. Despite this, their relationship hadn’t progressed to the next stage, and they mostly kissed each other.

As usual, Zhang Fei sent his clones to the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary several times to increase the amount of stock in his shop. Ma Kuangyu also met Luo Fenghan several times to find out information about the materials he and Nalan Yushu needed to reshape their bodies, but he hasn’t managed to find all the necessary materials, so they still have to wait.

Zhang Fei didn’t forget about Huli Yaohu, who resided in Shang Yumei’s soul space. He had long asked his father-in-law to find the same materials for her, but her soul was different from Ma Kuangyu and Nalan Yushu’s, and her soul had not yet fully recovered enough to reshape her body.

A year later (Training space’s timeflow), Zhang Fei managed to break through to the Divine Transformation Realm, and he had also achieved the highest level of mastery in all the techniques in his possession.

Although he had many women, the amount of Qi that Zhang Fei needed to break through increased with each breakthrough. It took him two years to break through from the Divine Fusion Realm to the Divine Manifestation Realm.

With Zhang Fei’s cultivation reaching that stage, all of his clones stopped dual cultivating with their wives and focused on practicing using the sixth level of the gravity feature. However, he did not stop his activities with his main harem members, which allowed them to surpass all of his clones’ women.

It took all his clones more than a year to fully adapt to the six levels of gravity, and three years after he broke through to the Divine Transformation Realm, Zhang Fei successfully reached the Divine Ascendant Realm.

All members of Zhang Fei’s main harem have also continued to break through in recent years, with the weakest among them reaching the 1-Moon Divine Manifestation Realm, and the strongest still being Luo Yunxiao.
Zhang Fei’s clones’ wives have also reached the Seven Divine Realms, but their progress is much slower than that of the main harem members.
Although Zhang Chen and Qing Tan never engaged in dual cultivation with Zhang Fei, they consistently utilized his Yang Qi for their cultivation, which enabled them to reach the Seven Divine Realms.

The past four years have been enough to change Zhang Fei and Zhang Chen’s relationship, but he never took the initiative with his grandmother. Instead, she took the initiative to take a step forward in their relationship, and they began to have a more intimate one.

Zhang Fei’s alchemy level finally reached that of Lin Jingxia, the God Rank alchemist. By reaching that rank, he could concoct all the pill recipes in the alchemy system shop, which would be useful for him and everyone around him. In addition to his achievements in alchemy, he has also attained perfect mastery in swordsmanship, blacksmithing, and formation arrays.

During this time, several senior cultivators, such as Zhe Wuming, Hun Di, and several others, managed to reach the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm. This meant they were only one step away from breaking through to the Five Celestial Realms. However, some of them were still far from that stage, such as Lin Moxian, Yan Yinqing, Jing Qiuyue, and others.

Although most of them weren’t dual cultivators, several people from the Heavenly Sword Sect, the Hidden Sea Palace, and the Yin-Yang Pavilion managed to reach the Seven Divine Realms, such as Hai Dongyin and Hai Dongxin. Some others weren’t far from breaking through, but their progress was clearly much slower than that of Zhang Fei’s women.

After Zhang Fei’s clone brought him back from the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, Ma Kuangyu informed him that Luo Fengyan had obtained all the materials he, Nalan Yushu, and Huli Yaouhu needed to reshape their bodies.

After several years, Huli Yaohu’s soul was completely strong and fully recovered. Therefore, she left Shang Yumei’s soul space; she joined Ma Kuangyu and Nalan Yuhsu to reshape their bodies, and Luo Fenghan took them to another domain to do so. They told him that the process would be very long, and they wouldn’t be back for several years.
Of the five years remaining before the entrance of the Forgotten Land opens, one and a half years have already passed, so Zhang Fei only has three and a half years left to prepare himself.

Three and a half years may be short for cultivators living in the outside world, but not for Zhang Fei and those around him, especially with the flow of time inside four times faster than outside. This way, he still had around fourteen years left to improve himself, and he believed that he would be able to reach the Five Celestial Realms before their seclusion ended.
After resting for a few days, they immediately resumed their seclusion, and several years passed quickly.

Five years later, Zhang Fei finally reached the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm, as did several others around him. Among all of his wives, the weakest among them reached the 1-Moon Divine Transformation Realm, and the strongest was still Luo Yunxiao. Meanwhile, all the wives of his clones reached the highest 1-Moon Divine Fusion, such as Yan Lu’er, Yan Zhixiu, Zi Xihua, and several others, while the rest were still at the Divine Expansion Realm and the Divine Manifestation Realm.

Although they haven’t been engaged in dual cultivation since the beginning of their intimate relationship, Zhang Fei and Zhang Chen’s relationship has been transformed from that of grandmother and grandson to that of mutual lovers.

Naturally, their relationship has reached the ears of all his wives and those closest to him, making some of them feel strange about their relationship, especially Qing Tan, Zhang Hanzhi, Wang Zhetian, and Dou Luotian.

Hun Di, Zhe Wuming, Lin Jingxia, and several other senior cultivators managed to break through to the 1-Sun Celestial Lord Realm. Since Zhang Fei and all his wives were much more experienced in many ways, and their combat abilities had improved significantly, the senior cultivators decided to leave the training space. However, they did not leave the Empyrean Main Domain, and they decided to join sects in the same domain as the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary.
Among them, only Tang Ying and Feng Xueying remained in the training space, mainly because of Zhang Fei’s request.

Since he had already broken through to the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm, Zhang Fei didn’t rush to break through to the Five Celestial Realm. Instead, he and his clones fully assisted their respective wives in reaching the highest levels of their cultivation, and he would take them to other domains to start their true adventure in the Paradise Realm afterwards.

Three years and three months later, or around nine years in the training space, Zhang Fei, who had been delaying his breakthrough for so many years for the sake of all his women, decided to break through to the Five Celestial Realms.

Although not all of Zhang Fei’s women had reached the peak of the Seven Divine Realms, many had, especially those from the Upper Realms, such as Murong Mengying, Yuan Tianling, Shang Yumei, Wei Xiaoya, and several others.

"Where will you make your breakthrough, my husband?" Luo Yunxiao asked, approaching Zhang Fei, who was standing in front of the glass tube in the Yin-Yang Space. "I think your breakthrough to the Five Celestial Realms will be even more terrifying than your breakthrough to this stage, and the phenomenon that appears will definitely attract the attention of people in my domain even more."

Zhang Fei nodded in agreement. "Unfortunately, I have no other choice, right? Currently, I only know about your domain, especially since I haven’t explored this realm since I arrived here. Moreover, the entrance to the Forgotten Land will open in a few days, so I have to break through to that stage first before I go with my father-in-law to that place."

"You’re right." Luo Yunxiao nodded in agreement. "In that case, we should meet my parents first, so they can prepare everything before you break through to the Five Celestial Realms. Otherwise, those people might attack you, especially since your cultivation speed is too absurd in their eyes, with you reaching this stage in just five years."

"Let’s go." Zhang Fei first brought Luo Yunxiao back to the pavilion, informing his other women of his decision to break through. Thereafter, he took her to the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, meeting Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi.

Their arrival shocked Luo Zhenyu and Luo Jiaxuan, who five years ago doubted Zhang Fei’s ability to break through to the Five Celestial Realms in such a short time. Their wives, Cheng Mengyao and Bing Xingying, were also shocked after detecting that his cultivation had reached the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm.

"Hahaha." Luo Fenghan laughed out loud as he nodded several times. "You’re truly amazing, son! I already knew about some of your advantages, but not everyone can utilize theirs well. On the contrary, you’ve utilized them well, and you’ve managed to reach this stage within your five-year goal."
"Do you want to break through to the Five Celestial Realms today, son?" Huang Xiaoyi asked him.

"Yes, Mother-in-law," Zhang Fei replied with a nod. "I have no choice but to break through in this domain, especially since I don’t know about the other domains. Therefore, I came here to ask for your help, especially since my breakthrough this time will be much stronger than in the past, and those people will definitely show up again to witness it."

"That’s true." Huang Xiaoyi then turned to her husband. "Husband, you should contact them and ask for their help to guard our son-in-law’s breakthrough; otherwise, the situation will be chaotic if they burn with jealousy and envy."

Luo Fenghan immediately contacted Luo Zhenhai, Luo Shiwen, Luo Meizhen, and several others. He then informed Zhang Fei, "The body reshaping process of Ma Kuangyu and the two female demons is progressing smoothly, but the process will still require two to three years to be fully completed. I’ve left several powerful cultivators from this sect to protect them, so you don’t need to worry about them."
"Thank you, Father-in-law." Zhang Fei then asked him. "What about Long Zhaihuo’s soul? Has his soul purification been completed?"

"Almost." Zhang Fei immediately turned to Luo Zhenhai, who had just arrived. "You guys will be going to the Forbidden Land in a few days, and I can assure you that his soul will be completely purified before that."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "Thank you for your help, Senior."

"No need." Luo Zhenhai then stood in front of him. "I initially doubted it, but you actually managed to break through from the Divine Expansion Realm to the Divine Ascension Realm in just five years. Moreover, I felt that there was something different about you after the last incident, and you were much more mature than before. After your breakthrough today, many powerful cultivators will definitely keep their eyes on you, and news of you will probably spread to other domains. Therefore, you must be careful when you travel to other domains; otherwise, you will bring trouble to yourself and us."
Zhang Fei smiled bitterly hearing that. "I understand, Senior. I would rather not get into trouble with them, and I don’t want to bring trouble to the sect either, so I will definitely be careful."

After waiting for some time, Luo Shiwen and Luo Meizhen finally arrived, along with three other people, all ancestors of the Luo Clan. "We wanted to speak with you, Kid. However, your Qi is already starting to fluctuate, so you should break through first."

chapters.title: Chapter 1098: Nine Colors Lightning Bolts
paragraphs: "What if I break through in another domain?" Luo Fenghan and the others turned to Zhang Fei straight away, especially since it was too late for that with his Qi starting to fluctuate.

Luo Yunxiao spoke to them directly. "My husband plans to go to the Moon Illusion Domain, and the cultivators in there will surely be busy dealing with those illusions. Therefore, he thinks it will be a suitable place for him to break through, and he can avoid the surveillance of other cultivators."

"You’re not wrong, but those illusions will also affect you. They could disrupt your breakthrough, potentially causing serious injuries or even crippling you." Huang Xiaoyi and the others agreed with Luo Zhenhai.
"Do any of you have illusion techniques?"
"Me." Luo Meizhen then asked him. "What do you want to do?"

"Try using your strongest illusion on me, Senior." Luo Meizhen wanted to reject Zhang Fei, but Luo Yunxiao hurriedly explained to her ancestor about his ability to negate illusion. "I don’t know how strong your illusions or those in the Moon Illusion Domain are, but if I manage to negate your illusion, I can probably do it against those in that domain as well."

"Get ready." After Zhang Fei nodded, Luo Meizhen used her illusion on him, which caused his expression to change slightly. It only lasted a split second, and his expression returned to normal again. "Does this mean you succeeded in negating my illusion?"

Zhang Fei nodded at her. "Initially, I thought my ability was not enough to negate such a strong illusion, but my thinking was wrong, and I succeeded in negating yours. Do you think my ability is enough to negate the illusion in that domain, Senior?"

"Yes." Luo Meizhen replied with a nod. "The illusion I used on you just now was the strongest of all my illusions, and it’s no less powerful than the strongest illusion in that domain. Therefore, you should be able to dispel all the illusions there, and you should be able to break through without any hindrance."
Luo Shiwen then spoke. "Let’s go now! Otherwise, his lightning tribulations will appear soon, and those cultivators will flock to our sect."
"Let’s go."
"Wait a minute, Seniors!" They turned to Zhang Fei again, but he immediately enveloped them with his aura. "Please show me the direction to that domain, and I will take us all there."
"What—"
"1500 miles east, husband." Luo Yunxiao pointed toward the east. "There’s a portal there, and we can go to the Moon Illusion Domain through it, so we won’t waste much time."
"Alright."

In the blink of an eye, they arrived at the portal’s location, shocking Luo Zhenhai and the others. Luo Yunxiao pulled Zhang Fei with her, and she paid the guards some purple jewels before pulling him into the portal.
"How can that kid have such speed with his current cultivation?" Another ancestor of the Luo Clan asked.

Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi could only shake their heads, especially since they still didn’t know much about Zhang Fei’s abilities. "Ancestor Qifeng, we don’t have time to discuss it, and we should follow them now."
"Let’s go." Luo Qifeng immediately led them into the portal.
"Is this the entrance to the Moon Illusion Domain?" Zhang Fei asked his wife after they exited the portal.

Luo Yunxiao nodded at him. "In the past, this gate and barrier didn’t exist, and cultivators in the Paradise Realm worked together to build it, especially since too many people accidentally lost their way and died inside. To prevent needless deaths, they decided to build a barrier in this domain, and we can only enter through this gate."
"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "Do you have any information about the areas inside?"

"When we pass through this gate, we will arrive at the Waning Crescent Grove." Zhang Fei looked at a female ancestor of the Luo Clan. "My name is Luo Jieyi, and the other two are Luo Qifeng and Luo Zhigui. By the way, the grove is difficult for normal cultivators to pass through, and the illusions within are some of the strongest compared to several other areas of this domain."
"Let’s talk later, Jieyi." Luo Zhigui took out a device, activated it, and unlocked the gate. "Let’s go in."

A powerful illusion confronted them as soon as they entered, but Luo Meizhen quickly moved to dispel it. "Rather than going to another area, we can utilize one of the areas in the Waning Crescent Grove for your breakthrough."
"Okay." Luo Meizhen immediately led them into the grove before going to one of the slightly open areas.
After they arrived, the five Luo Ancestors set up several barriers around their location, preventing anyone from approaching them.
"You can start now, son."
Zhang Fei summoned his five clones, Hong Xinxin, Lei Que, Lei, and Long Jishan, before flying into the sky, where he began his breakthrough.
"Such realistic clones!" Luo Zhigui exclaimed.

Luo Jieyi nodded in agreement. "The four people beside him are also living beings with high affinity with the lightning element! An Azure Emperor Roc beast, a Thunderbird beast, a Thunder Dragon, and a lightning spirit!"
"I don’t know how strong the breakthrough will be this time, but I think this kid should have made it through with their help." Luo Qifeng also spoke.

Luo Zhenhai looked at Zhang Fei and shook his head. "That kid has caused a huge commotion in our domain ever since he broke through from the Divine Expansion Realm to the Divine Ascension Realm, and those old folks have been monitoring our sect from afar because of him. If he breaks through to this stage there, those people will definitely make a move against us."
"His breakthrough has begun." Luo Shiwen looked at the sky, which was quickly darkening, and flashes of lightning began to flash up there.

Soon, an extremely powerful pressure descended from the sky, not only in their area but in the entire area of the Moon Illusion Domain, forcing all the cultivators who were practicing there to stop their activities.
Even powerful cultivators like the five Luo Ancestors, Luo Zhenhai, Luo Fenghan, and Huang Xiaoyi felt oppressed by the pressure sent down by the Heavens.
The five Luo Ancestors moved to protect their five younger generations, especially Luo Zhenyu, Luo Jiaxuan, and their two wives.

Unlike them, Luo Yunxiao remained standing with a relaxed expression, seemingly unaffected by the slightest pressure, mainly because she had been practicing using the Environment Control feature in the training space for so many years. Additionally, she had also trained at levels eight and nine of the gravity feature, which put immense pressure on her during her training for the past few years.
"How can you withstand this pressure, Yunxiao?"

Luo Yunxiao turned to her mother. "Mother, I haven’t just been dual cultivating with my husband these past few years, okay? I’ve also trained a lot with my sisters, and some of my training has given me much stronger pressure than this; thus, you don’t need to be surprised if I can withstand this pressure."

"Then—" Huang Xiaoyi stopped talking once the bright white light illuminated all corners of the Moon Illusion Domain, dazzling the eyes and restricting the senses of everyone who was trained there. It also dispelled all illusions within the domain, making it no different from other domains. "This kid, his—"

Once again, Huang Xiaoya did not continue her words, mainly because lightning bolts with nine different colors shot down from the sky, raining down all over the domain, causing many loud explosions to sound from many directions.

"Lightning bolts from lightning tribulations should only have seven colors, right? How can his lightning tribulations produce nine colors?" Luo Fenghan asked as he stared at those lightning bolts that continued to strike down, but they did not strike Zhang Fei and the others.

Luo Jieyi answered him directly. "The seven colors of lightning bolts from the lightning tribulations start with yellow being the weakest, followed by blue, purple, black, gold, red, and white being the strongest."
"I’ve seen all seven colors of lightning bolts in the past, but I’ve never seen prismatic or colorless lightning bolts before." Luo Qifeng spoke with fear and awe.
Luo Zhenhai then spoke. "I’ve never heard of prismatic lightning bolts, but the colorless lightning bolts should be related to the void element."
"The void element? Are you sure about that, Uncle Zhenhai?"

"Yes." Luo Zhenhai nodded to Luo Fenghan. "I can’t measure the power of those colorless lightning bolts, but it’s clear that the heavens are eager to kill your son-in-law. If they strike him directly, he will probably suffer much more serious injuries than before."
"Look!" Luo Meizhen pointed at Zhang Fei. "That kid realized the power of his lightning tribulations this time, and he deliberately sent the others back, leaving only the lightning spirit."

"That lightning spirit must have informed him." All of them nodded in agreement with Luo Shiwen. After all, a lightning spirit was born from the heavenly lightning, so it must be aware of the power of Zhang Fei’s lightning tribulations.

’Tch! Our brother-in-law is as scary as our big sister!’ Luo Zhenyu and Luo Jiaxuan stole glances at Luo Yunxiao, but she looked so relaxed without the slightest worry on her face. "Big Sis, are you sure our brother-in-law will successfully pass his lightning tribulations?"
Luo Yunxiao glared at them. "Shut up and pay attention to him!"
"Tch!" Luo Zhenyu and Luo Jiaxuan gritted their teeth and shut their mouths tightly.
