chapters.title: Chapter 1099: Luo Yunxiao’s Move
paragraphs: Up in the sky, Zhang Fei and his five clones stood with tense expressions, mainly because of the prismatic and colorless lightning bolts. "Are you sure about that, Lei?"

"Yes, Master." Lei nodded at him. "The prismatic lightning bolts are created from the fusion of all elemental laws, and the colorless lightning bolts are created from the void element. You might be able to withstand the prismatic lightning bolts, but I doubt you’ll be able to withstand the colorless lightning bolts. Luckily, both of them appeared early on, or else Hong Xinxin and the others would have died if the two of them suddenly appeared and attacked them."
"What are my chances of withstanding both of them?"
"You have a 50% chance of withstanding the prismatic lightning bolts, but you have a 0% chance of withstanding the colorless lightning bolts."

After Lei said that, Zhang Fei took a deep breath and clenched his fists tightly. He had already died once, and he had also been on the verge of death twice, which filled his heart with fear of those two lightning bolts. "Tch! Whatever happens, I have to withstand both of them! Let’s go there, Lei! We will face those lightning bolts from their core directly."

"Yes, Master." Thereafter, Zhang Fei led his five clones and Lei disappeared behind the clouds, which were filled with countless lightning bolts of nine colors. "Master, get ready! They will attack you soon!"
"Yeah."
After they spread out to several positions, Zhang Fei immediately released his soul and all his cultivation cores, absorbing the power of his lightning tribulations.
Zhang Fei and his five clones also activated their lightning domains, preparing to face attacks from those lightning bolts.

Zhang Fei would rather not use the soul link, but the terrifying power of those lightning bolts forced him to activate it. However, its effect wasn’t as significant as it had been in the past, even though most of the beasts within it had already reached the Five Celestial Realms.

Back then, Zhang Fei’s cultivation was far below those beasts, and the effect was reduced, mainly because his cultivation was almost equal to theirs. Even so, his strength still increased quite a bit, and he felt that it should be enough to help him deal with those lightning bolts.

Just as Lei expected, those lightning bolts began to attack Zhang Fei and his five clones, starting from the weakest, which are the yellow lightning bolts, and progressing to the strongest, which are the colorless lightning bolts.

Zhang Fei and his clones couldn’t possibly allow those lightning bolts to strike them directly, so they summoned the mirror from the Reversal Mirror Technique, the Heavenly Mirror, to reverse their attacks. Additionally, they used their light element to create the light, female wing race figures as support for their recovery if the lightning bolts managed to hit them.
Zhang Fei and his clones also used several sub-techniques of the Nine Heavens Lightning Art to counter them.
"Fourth Heaven—Lightning Shadow Split!"
"Seventh Heaven—Heavenly Punishment Lightning Lance!"
"Eighth Heaven—Lightning Annihilation Field!"
"Ninth Heaven—Lightning Tribulation Descent!"
Zhang Fei and his clones didn’t stop there; they then used the Hellflame Frost Lotus and the Annihilation Flame to attack those lightning bolts.
*Boom... Boom... Boom...*
Several explosions rang out from behind the clouds, audible to all the cultivators scattered throughout the domain, especially after their attacks collided with some of those lightning bolts.

All the attacks of Zhang Fei and his five clones could destroy the other seven lightning bolts, but their attacks were instantly dispelled upon colliding with the prismatic and colorless lightning bolts, which were hurtling towards them.

Zhang Fei and his five clones moved to avoid them, especially since their lightning domains disappeared because of the colorless lightning bolts, which convinced them that they were indeed made of the void element.
"Shit!" Zhang Fei cursed as the prismatic and colorless lightning bolts changed trajectories, chasing after him and his five clones.

Lei immediately flew to Zhang Fei’s side. "Master, you won’t be able to avoid them forever, as they will keep chasing you. The only way is to face those prismatic lightning bolts first, and I will use my power to divert the colorless lightning bolts from you."
"Are you sure they won’t hurt you, Lei?" Zhang Fei asked with concern as they flew faster.

"Hehe." Lei chuckled in response. "Master, those colorless lightning bolts are indeed powerful, but I am a lightning spirit, remember? Even if they attack me, they won’t be able to harm me; instead, I will grow stronger because of them."
Zhang Fei nodded at him. "Alright, help me divert those colorless lightning bolts, and we will face those prismatic ones."

"Yes, Master." Lei immediately turned around and flew toward the colorless lightning bolts, but something unexpected happened as a cage suddenly appeared and confined the lightning spirit. "Master! Run! The heavens lock me up! I can’t help you!"
Zhang Fei was startled hearing that, but he immediately stopped flying and faced those prismatic lightning bolts. On the other hand, his five clones face those colorful ones.

Zhang Fei and his five clones used some of their techniques again to stop those lightning bolts, but another unexpected thing happened as those lightning bolts avoided his clones, and they hurtled toward his main body.
"Master! Watch out!" Lei shouted from the distance.

"Shit!" Zhang Fei teleported again and again to evade their pursuit. On the other hand, his five clones used the Heaven Suppression Palm to suppress the lightning bolts, but their efforts were in vain as they kept chasing his real body. "Damn it! I can’t possibly keep avoiding them forever, and I have to find a way to deal with them."

Zhang Fei’s five clones tried to block those colorless lightning bolts using some other means, but their attacks always disappeared every time they touched them, and they kept avoiding them and targeting his real body.
Zhang Fei felt completely helpless as he watched everything happening. "Do you have any ideas to help me, Mei?"
[Unfortunately, I don’t have any ideas to help you face your lightning tribulations this time, so you’ll have to fight them yourself to the end, Master.]
Zhang Fei let out a heavy sigh as he kept teleporting and avoiding those lightning bolts, but he frowned when several more lightning bolts appeared in the distance and shot towards him.

"Crap! They are lightning bolts from the second stage of my lightning tribulations." Zhang Fei finally decided to face the prismatic and colorless lightning bolts from the first stage of his lightning tribulations. Before that, he activated his lightning domain, even though he knew that it would only be in vain. "Come to me!"
Zap... Zap... Zap...
"Arghhh!" Zhang Fei groaned in pain as soon as they grabbed his body, and they turned into a lightning vortex, slicing his clothes and flesh.

Although Zhang Fei’s body cultivation has reached the Muscle Rebirth Stage, and most of his body techniques have reached max levels, he is still in great pain because of the attacks of those lightnings. As usual, his five clones also experienced the pain, causing all of them to scream in pain, and their bodies were also covered in cuts with blood flowing profusely from their bodies.

The first attack wasn’t over yet, but the second wave of lightning bolts had already struck Zhang Fei, adding to his suffering. His expression was grim as he endured the shocks and cuts from the lightning, which caused his blood to flow even more. "Arghhh!"
Luo Yunxiao, who watched that from below, turned pale. She clenched her fists until her nails pierced her palms, causing them to bleed.

’He will die if you don’t move soon.’ Luo Yunxiao was startled hearing the voice in her mind, and she recognized the identity of its owner. ’You are the owner of the Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique, and you are the only person who can help him pass his lightning tribulation this time.’
Luo Yunxiao nodded slightly, and her previously hopeless expression completely changed. She briefly looked at her parents and ancestors, and she released her full strength before flying into the sky.
"Yunxiao!"
"Big Sis!"
"Sister-in-law!"
Luo Fenghan, Huang Xiaoyi, their two sons, and their two daughters-in-law exclaimed in shock.
Luo Zhenhai and the five ancestors moved to stop Luo Yunxiao, but to their shock, she accelerated her speed, leaving all of them behind.
"Shit!" Luo Zhenhai cursed to himself. "Her speed suddenly surpassed us!"

Luo Qifeng nodded in agreement. "Little Yunxiao seems to have been training hard for the past five years, and not only has her speed increased significantly, but her cultivation has already broken through two minor stages."
"Are we going to let Little Yunxiao go there?" Luo Jieyi asked them. "If she dies because of that kid’s lightning tribulation, our clan will suffer huge losses."
"What can we do?" Luo Zhigui returned the question with a helpless sigh. "If we follow them there, that kid’s lightning tribulation will kill us instantly."

Luo Shiwen let out a soft sigh. "I don’t know what Little Yunxiao was thinking for her to act so recklessly, but we know that she possesses the Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique, which is not an ordinary one."
"We can only wait and hope that they will pull through." Even though Sehe said that, Luo Meizhen’s tone sounded discouraged.

"Husband!" Zhang Fei was shocked to hear Luo Yunxiao’s call, but she hurriedly activated her physique. The lightning vortex that enveloped and attacked him immediately disappeared by itself, bringing relief to him.

Zhang Fei let out a heavy sigh as he kept teleporting and avoiding those lightning bolts, but he frowned when several more lightning bolts appeared in the distance and shot towards him.
"Crap!

They are lightning bolts from the second stage of my lightning tribulations." Zhang Fei finally decided to face the prismatic and colorless lightning bolts from the first stage of his lightning tribulations.
Before that, he activated his lightning domain, even though he knew that it would only be in vain.
"Come to me!"
Zap...
Zap...
Zap...
"Arghhh!" Zhang Fei groaned in pain as soon as they grabbed his body, and they turned into a lightning vortex, slicing his clothes and flesh.

Although Zhang Fei’s body cultivation has reached the Muscle Rebirth Stage, and most of his body techniques have reached max levels, he is still in great pain because of the attacks of those lightnings.
As usual, his five clones also experienced the pain, causing all of them to scream in pain, and their bodies were also covered in cuts with blood flowing profusely from their bodies.
The first attack wasn’t over yet, but the second wave of lightning bolts had already struck Zhang Fei, adding to his suffering.
His expression was grim as he endured the shocks and cuts from the lightning, which caused his blood to flow even more.
"Arghhh!"
Luo Yunxiao, who watched that from below, turned pale.
She clenched her fists until her nails pierced her palms, causing them to bleed.

’He will die if you don’t move soon.’ Luo Yunxiao was startled hearing the voice in her mind, and she recognized the identity of its owner. ’You are the owner of the Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique, and you are the only person who can help him pass his lightning tribulation this time.’
Luo Yunxiao nodded slightly, and her previously hopeless expression completely changed.
She briefly looked at her parents and ancestors, and she released her full strength before flying into the sky.
"Yunxiao!"
"Big Sis!"
"Sister-in-law!"
Luo Fenghan, Huang Xiaoyi, their two sons, and their two daughters-in-law exclaimed in shock.
Luo Zhenhai and the five ancestors moved to stop Luo Yunxiao, but to their shock, she accelerated her speed, leaving all of them behind.
"Shit!" Luo Zhenhai cursed to himself.
"Her speed suddenly surpassed us!"
Luo Qifeng nodded in agreement.
"Little Yunxiao seems to have been training hard for the past five years, and not only has her speed increased significantly, but her cultivation has already broken through two minor stages."
"Are we going to let Little Yunxiao go there?" Luo Jieyi asked them.
"If she dies because of that kid’s lightning tribulation, our clan will suffer huge losses."
"What can we do?" Luo Zhigui returned the question with a helpless sigh.
"If we follow them there, that kid’s lightning tribulation will kill us instantly."
Luo Shiwen let out a soft sigh.
"I don’t know what Little Yunxiao was thinking for her to act so recklessly, but we know that she possesses the Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique, which is not an ordinary one."
"We can only wait and hope that they will pull through." Even though Sehe said that, Luo Meizhen’s tone sounded discouraged.
"Husband!" Zhang Fei was shocked to hear Luo Yunxiao’s call, but she hurriedly activated her physique.
The lightning vortex that enveloped and attacked him immediately disappeared by itself, bringing relief to him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1100: My Sword Is My Dao
paragraphs: "Why are you here, Yunxiao?" Zhang Fei asked as he swallowed a few healing pills, especially since his injuries from the attacks just now were quite severe.

Luo Yunxiao immediately supported Zhang Fei and explained it. "Husband, I know your worries, but you won’t be able to pass your lightning tribulations this time without me. You’ll die if you face them by yourself, so let me stay to help you."
"But—"

"Have you forgotten what I did with your soul world?" Zhang Fei shook his head at Luo Yunxiao. "I am your wife, and my physique was born for this kind of situation. Therefore, I will stay and help you through your lightning tribulations, and I will bring you back to my sisters."
"Master! They’re coming again!" Lei shouted from the distance.

As Zhang Fei looked at the lightning bolts from the third stage of the lightning tribulation, he immediately pulled Luo Yunxiao behind him and summoned the demon extermination sword. His five clones immediately lined up behind them before pulling out their respective swords. "Yunxiao, I’ll try using my strongest sword techniques, and you can protect me from those lightning bolts."
"Alright." Luo Yunxiao nodded in agreement.

Zhang Fei and his five clones immediately assumed sword stances, their gazes fully focused on the lightning bolts hurtling toward them. They took a deep breath and activated their sword domains. "My sword is my Dao; the heavens shall tremble before my sword! One sword, one strike, eliminate all obstacles before me! If you block my path, you will die! Even if all the realms fall, my sword will remain!"

Luo Yunxiao, who was standing behind Zhang Fei and his five clones, smiled faintly hearing those words from their mouths. ’Twenty years of seclusion were not in vain! Not only did he succeed in reaching the Five Celestial Realms, but he also succeeded in comprehending many Daos, including the Sword Dao!’

After they said that, their sword Qi flared up and gathered into one, forming a giant golden sword above them. Zhang Fei turned to his five clones, who nodded at him and lined up on either side of him. "Back then, my master used this technique to stop the war on Earth, but his actions caused the Qi to disappear from that planet. Unlike my master, my swordsmanship is several levels higher than his at the time, so I don’t know what will happen to this domain if I use it here. I would rather not use it, but I have no other choice."
"Are you going to use the other one too, husband?" Luo Yunxiao asked.

Zhang Fei nodded at her. "There are six of us now; I and the other two will use the last sub-technique of the Forgotten Sword Technique, and the other three will use the last sub-technique of the Heaven-Severing Sword Technique. By the way, step back a bit, Yunxiao."
Once Luo Yunxiao had stepped back a bit, Zhang Fei and his two clones slashed the swords in their hands. "Final move: Sever the Heavenly Path!"
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei’s other three clones used a different technique while slashing their swords. "Last move! Ashen Bloom!"

In that instant, the giant golden sword above them glided toward those lightning bolts. Three flurries of petals, formed from sword intent, bloomed from nothing before slashing towards those lightning bolts.

Zhang Fei and his five clones seriously looked at their two techniques, and those three flurries of petals destroyed everything in their path, including the clouds. Unlike them, the giant golden sword hurtled straight toward those lightning bolts.

Behind them, Luo Yunxiao clasped her hands together in front of her chest, and her heart pounded, anticipating the clash of her husband’s two sword techniques and those lightning bolts. She was also prepared to use the abilities of her special physique just in case her two techniques failed to stop them.
The people who witnessed the two techniques from below, including the members of the Luo Clan, were shocked by their effects.
As the clouds dissipated, the cultivators from the other domains could see Zhang Fei, his five clones, and Luo Yunxiao, which left them wondering about their identities.

They wanted to know their identities, but none of them had the crazy idea of approaching Zhang Fei and Luo Yunxiao. Not even the strongest among them dared to do so, especially with those lightning tribulations still ongoing.
*Boom*

A much louder explosion than before rang in everyone’s ears as the giant golden sword struck those lightning bolts, destroying seven of them, leaving only the prismatic and colorless lightning bolts. Unlike before, those colorless lightning bolts were unable to dispel Zhang Fei’s giant golden sword, mainly because he and his clones imbued the sword dao into it.

Not long after, the three flurries of petals swept across them, causing the prismatic and colorless lightning bolts to disappear from their sight. Both attacks from Zhang Fei and his clones kept shooting towards the core of Zhang Fei’s lightning tribulations.

Lei, who was watching it, was momentarily stunned. "Hahaha! The heavens underestimate my master! They don’t know that he has mastered the Sword Dao and several other daos in the last twenty years! They won’t be able to defeat him if they don’t use the dao, but they will disturb the balance of this universe if they do."
"Hehe." Luo Yunxiao chuckled after seeing that. "You don’t seem to need my help, husband."

"You’re wrong about that," Zhang Fei replied with a shake of his head, but his eyes were focused ahead of them. "My techniques require quite a bit of preparation, and I can’t use them if those lightning bolts keep chasing me like before."

After he said that, Zhang Fei and his five clones attacked the core of his lightning tribulations again. However, they only used the last sub-technique of the Forgotten Sword Technique, the Ashen Bloom. Instantly, six flurries of petals shot towards the core again, following their previous attack.

Luo Yunxiao looked around them before frowning. "Husband, you should stop using that technique. Try to sense the Qi in this realm, especially in front of us. Everything disappeared without a trace, which happened because of the effect of your technique. Fortunately, the Qi in this domain is the Celestial Qi; however, if you continue to use it, it will likely disappear completely, just like it did on Earth."

Zhang Fei himself had expected that to happen, but he was quite surprised, especially since the Celestial Qi didn’t disappear completely even though he had used the Ashen Bloom nine times. Back then, Han Ling had only used the technique once, but the Qi in the Earth completely disappeared, and it never returned.

Soon, all of Zhang Fei and his five clones’ attacks struck the core of his lightning tribulations, weakening it. However, it did not disappear like the previous lightning bolts, and it remains powerful. Once again, it threw forth another set of lightning bolts.

Zhang Fei and his five clones immediately used their mastery in sword dao again, but they no longer created a giant golden sword like before. Instead, a giant golden bow appeared in front of them with nine golden arrows, all of which were made from their Sword Intent.
They shot these golden arrows toward those nine lightning bolts, eliminating seven of them immediately before colliding with the remaining two.
"Husband, try to create the golden sword again." Zhang Fei nodded to Luo Yunxiao and created it directly, but she immediately floated to the side of the sword and touched it.
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow as the golden sword became twice as large as its original form. "What did you do to it, Yunxiao?"

"Hehe." Luo Yunxiao giggled and returned to his side. "According to Big Sis Yao, my physique has the ability to reverse the natural flow of Heaven and Earth, allowing me to manipulate yin and yang. Yin and Yang are the foundation of everything, such as day and night, life and death, and creation and destruction. I used it to enlarge its size and strengthen its offensive power, but I’m not confident it will be able to destroy its core. Therefore, you have to try it yourself, and I hope it can destroy it directly, so we won’t waste any more time."
"Alright." Zhang Fei launched the golden sword, strengthened by Luo Yunxiao, towards the core.

However, the core of Zhang Fei’s lightning tribulations suddenly launched several sets of lightning bolts directly to stop his attack, causing it to collide with them head-on. Unlike before, his golden sword directly destroyed those lightning bolts and shot at the core, which surprised him.

Zhang Fei suddenly had another idea, and he took out the Heaven Creation Furnace before enlarging it until it was bigger than the core of his lightning tribulations. Once he cancelled his sword technique, he sent the furnace toward the core, and it immediately swallowed it.

Inside the furnace, the core continued to release lightning bolts; however, the furnace’s materials and internal formation prevented any of them from escaping, including the colorless lightning bolts.

Zhang Fei immediately teleported Luo Yunxiao to the top of the furnace, and he sat in front of it before using all his flames, sending them inside. "I’ve never done this before, so I don’t know if this will work, but I’ll try refining the core."
Luo Yunxiao was confused about Zhang Fei’s purpose for doing that, but she didn’t disturb him and stood quietly behind him, waiting for the results of his experiment.
